Through branching dialogue, flashbacks, and shifting memories, the story unravels a haunting case about patterns, control, and the weight of what we inherit.

Inheritance places players in the middle of this psychological standoff, where truth and lies twist into a suffocating knot. As Graves, you are not only chasing answers — you are defending your own sanity. Each question you ask, each choice you make, draws you deeper into Alden’s mind games, and the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur.

Through flashbacks, branching dialogue, and atmospheric tension, the story reveals fragments of the case that brought you here — a case tied to power, betrayal, and a legacy soaked in blood. But nothing is ever what it seems. Even memory can be a weapon.

At its core, Inheritance is about more than solving a crime. It is about facing the past we carry, the truths we deny, and the consequences of digging too deep. Some answers, once spoken aloud, can never be taken back.

title: A Hole to Another Place SCP-1437
description: Short Experience with SCP-1437

title: Escape the Slender forest
description: Escape the Slender forest is a free Creepypasta visual novel made with Ren'Py.

title: Chimps on a Blimp
description:
GHXYK2, Swee Neezy, PilotRedSun, Penneh2006, GHXXXYK2, wolfpupy and Nick Flanagan present the 20th century’s hardest dirigible escape game:

Grow a brain to solve puzzles
Celebrate the Titanic of the dust bowl era.
How will the search for Amelia Earhart ever end?
Air Bud? Air Foe? Air Force One?
The Red Baron can spot any plane on the horizon.

But he couldn’t see this coming.

title: Soft Drizzle: B-Track
description: Soft Drizzle: B-Track is a short visual novel about friendship and Halloween Festivals. It even includes an escape room!

title: Facets
description: Don't give up yet.

A story in sticky notes. Crunchy Lunch is a comedy game about when you take your lunch to work and IT'S SO LOUD THAT EVERYONE ELSE IN THE OFFICE HEARS IT!!!

It was created in 30 days for the game jam NaNoRenO 2018, using pen, paper, sticky notes, and a smartphone camera.

title: Sloppy Shopping

description: ​The sun is setting. Please help.

title: Desolation Seed
description: Society is a decay system you are imprisoned as the reveled flesh that feeds the cybernetic wire, through a cryptic email chain Oceancide Systematics a mysterious corporation pays you to perform seemingly random acts of debasement against society on their behalf. they seethe within the darkened vomitoriums of computational networks. do these debased acts of destruction hold any meaning? can you break from out the hollow shell of pleasure systems? how far will they push you? how far will you go? Nothing can prepare you for the apex of human understanding.

title: Triple Jump
description: Triple Jump is an auto-running puzzle platformer where you have a library of different "jumps" that you can assign in any combination to three slots. You are then faced with levels that require some combination of those jumps to solve.

description: Inspired by obsessive thought patterns and the compulsions that come with them, Exit Mask is an experimental art game where your biggest threat is yourself. Depicted in grainy black-and-white, this project details the experience of being plagued with ceaseless intrusive thoughts and the struggle to coexist with the uglier side within.

title: Memoryleak
description: Immerse yourself in MEMORYLEAK, a unique FPS that blends 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay. Set in 2000s Texas with a gripping narrative, it offers stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a dynamic, interactive world. Ready for an adventure that redefines gaming?

title: Minima
description:
Minima is a short narrative exploration game about an 11-year-old boy named Ian, whose imagination brings his bedroom to life. The story is told without dialogue, using light, sound, and environmental interaction.
Players explore small, intimate scenes inspired by childhood memories, with a focus on observation rather than challenges. The game features minimalist visuals and a calm soundtrack, creating a reflective, atmospheric experience.

title: Co-Pilot
description: The job of a pilot is taxing; non-stop work, hyper-specific scheduling, with only soulless computer screens for company. In order to help Pilot cope, her mind is split into two. Maybe she can keep herself company.

description: First person puzzle game in a city lost to the waves.

description: The flowers call.

description: Point & click graphic (mis)adventure about Max, a young man full of uncertainties with a peculiar problem: he becomes giant everytime he hears the word 'FUTURE'. Puzzles, minigames and existential crises spiced up with humor in a story about growing up in a world that seems to be ending.

title: A New Don
description:
Fia grew up on her mother's hog farm, always dreaming about running away to the bustling city that dotted the horizon.

Just when she thinks this is all her life will ever be, a letter comes in the mail from an old eccentric man she used to call "Grandfather".

He asks her to come to the city so that he may give her something. When she gets there, it turns out that his gift is the ownership of his crime family!

But not everyone is excited to see Fia and internal tensions threaten to tear the family apart.

Can you survive the 6 days it takes to inherit the family?

Become the new Donna, or die trying.

title: Solipsism Reigns
description: A twisted tale of tortured love. Travel through various dimensions to seek the truth about yourself and the worlds around you. Your only constant will be your spirit companion, Kuro.

title: Terra
description: Jump, dodge, and claw your way through a cute and chaotic world in Terra!This casual platformer is packed with tricky platforms, weird monsters, and lovable characters. Can Terra make it through the obstacles and collect every last Magic Orb?

title: Locked Heart
description: A trip to the next town has diverted Aura to the infamous haunted De Lockes mansion... of talking toys?! Play as Aura as she breaks the curse and possibly strike a romance with one of the 3 bears.

title: Powerglove
description:
Powerglove is a classic-era run 'n' gun game developed by Lazycow for the 30 year old Commodore 64 home computer, initially released as an entry in the 2013 RGCD 16K C64 Game Development Competition (where it placed 3rd out of 15 entries). The final version was released as a 16KB physical game cartridge in September 2014, complete with additional content and features.

Guide the hero through the polar thermal reactor complex, navigate the complex network of transport tubes, locate the five control diamonds and blast away every rogue robot that stands in your path!

title: Memorial Pillage
description: Venture into the cave...

Defend your kingdom and outwit the AI in Aloisius!

Your subjects act similar to a widely known board game, but you can also construct buildings and harvest natural resources.

title: Stray Souls
description:
Enter a world of nightmares in this third person, action-horror, inspired by the classics of the genre. Fight terrifying creatures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel a horrid family secret to expose the chilling truth behind your existence.

Unlock the secrets hidden within the haunted town of Aspen Falls, featuring gruesome enemy encounters, epic bosses, cunning puzzles, and a deep story where not everyone is who they seem. Play as Daniel – an average teenager whose life is forever changed after inheriting the home of his estranged grandmother and meeting a mysterious woman with intimate knowledge about his family, the house, and its shocking connection to his past. The gameplay elements inspired by classic horror combat with souls-like precision, put a fresh spin on the modern action-horror genre.

title: Let There Be Cat!

title: Meow Nights
description:
Two cats get lost on a magic and cloudy dungeon while looking for some delicious sky fish. They will have to find 5 fish each and then make their way towards each other, so they can go home and have a cozy sleepover.

There is a catch, however. The cats cannot see each other. For that reason, they have to follow their friend's "meow" ability so they make their way to the same room, after catching their share of snacks.

Once this happens, both cats must "meow" so they can free themselves from the cloudy dungeon.

title: Delirious

description:
A super-powered, shapeshifting pony RPG.

Command a super-powered, shape-shifting pony in this RPG Adventure! In a world where unpredictable legendary beasts pose an existential threat, you'll embark on a journey across the Pinto region to become the best pony tamer in the world and protect your magical companion from those who want to use her as a secret weapon.

Customize your team with hundreds of different moves, stat arrangements, & collectible battle gear to gain the upper hand in this rapid-switchout Rock/Paper/Scissors combat system.

A years-in-the-making love letter to the My Little Pony & Pokémon communities, celebrating one year of progress since the successful Kickstarter campaign!

Command from the sky or take control in third person as your story goes where the people, your actions, and their reactions take it.

title: Mason and Strings
description: Mason needs Strings' help to learn how to play guitar so she can perform at the Castle Concert. Travel around Hub City to collect music sheets, solve puzzles, and interact with the many inhabitants! With Strings, you can grapple between platforms and play different chords using the Chord Wheel! Enjoy exploring a lively world and becoming a master musician!

title: Smilinguido: Desafio na Floresta
description:
The time has come!
Get a closer look at Smilingüido. Take part in a dangerous and fun adventure. Test your skills and limits inside the Brazilian forest. The challenge is great. The difficulties and dangers are enormous, but the mission is worth it.
Face the challenge and discover the great lesson that Jesus has to teach you, whom he loves and cares for!

title: Impious Pumpkins
description: Impious Pumpkins is a cute/spooky real time tactics game where you take control of your own ghostly army to defend their resting places from hordes of evil pumpkins!

title: Cloud Escape
description:
Cloud Escape is a fast-paced 3D precision platformer with countless traps, obstacles and cool movement mechanics. Whether you're dashing through the large, themed areas in Classic Mode or trying to climb to the top in the new game mode: The Tower.
Both game modes have their own worlds with unique challenges, traps, secrets and collectibles. In the new tower, you'll even encounter real enemies for the first time!

title: Super Mumtaz Bros.
description: In Super Mumtaz Bros. you join the titular plumbing brothers on their mission to rescue Princess Sana from... chickens?

title: Over My Dead Body
description: Over My Dead Body is a local multiplayer game where your goal is to be the first to die. Heal the others! Damage yourself! Kick the bucket! Goofy characters, fun stages and an overall colorful and cartoonish style come together to make up a fast-paced gameplay to share with friends.

title: Master Detective Archives: Rain Code
description: A brand new dark fantasy detective action game from the minds behind the Danganronpa series! Yuma, an amnesiac detective-in-training, and Shinigami, the spirit haunting him, tackle unsolved mysteries in a strange city caged by unending rain.

An experimental, retro take on tamogotchi-lite games. Will you fulfill Momo's needs or does he need something greater?

description: Implements of Hell is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the mysteries, unlock the secrets, and change the outcome in a slow-paced atmospheric, and extremely horrifying experience.

title: 3D Ultra Cool Pool
description: Do you love a good game of pool? Cool Pool has all your favorites - Eight Ball, Rotation, Cutthroat, Nine Ball, and Classic Pocket Billiards - on dazzling tables with a super-easy interface and with the option to use standard balls and custom balls. But Cool Pool also has five totally original "cool" games that'll curl your cue and which can be played both on a standard or a differently shaped "cool" table. They give pool a whole new angle of strategy, surprise, and fun!

title: Queue Simulator

title: Mission Improbable

title: Espionage: Mafia Evolved
description: A free-to-play social deduction game for PC and mobile devices in which you attempt to find your adversaries hidden amongst the other players. Set in 1958, role-based play rewards those who rely on strategy and their creative instincts.

title: Latish Destroyer
description:
Latish Destroyer is the game where you dynamically and fast destroy the corporation of one man - Latish.
You will meet multiple enemy types, which Latish's laboratories made especially to kill you, The Destroyer.
This game consists of 6 levels, where you have to complete the objective of it. Simply run through level destroying enemies and do some little activities. You are playing as a cool Dota 2 player named Roman.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 3

title: Precursor
description:
Precursor is a mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two, created by Precursor Team.

It is set in City 17 prior to the events of Half Life 2. You assume the role of a resistance fighter during a Combine crackdown. Your goal is to evade your pursuers and flee the city. At the same time, a mysterious force is working towards ends unknown.

title: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 2
description:
Save your city and your people from great evil and become a heroic princess.

You are having a small adventure outside the city walls. You are the princess, in the guise of a rogue. However, returning home is no longer possible. The city is on fire and the streets have been plundered by hordes of unknown monsters. People are leaving their homes in panic and seek refuge from certain doom. But this is your city and your people. You can’t lie idle. You have to protect your city and get allies to fight by your side against great evil. Gain courage and become a heroic princess.

title: Goalkeeper Training VR
description: VR Goalkeeping game! 3 different modes and a lot of fun!

description:
DC League of Super-Pets: The Adventures of Krypto and Ace is a 2022 video game tie-in to the 2022 movie DC League of Super-Pets.

The player controls Krypto and Ace as they take to the skies to protect the animal population of Metropolis from a new and looming threat.

title: Ball Boys
description: Ball Boys is an online ball-racing championship where you play as a customizable ball and try to score the most points in various parkour challenges. You can roll, double-jump, dash, and maneuver in the air to try and navigate your way through various scenarios.

title: Chicken Attack
description:
Chicken Attack is a single player, 3-D, top-down, isometric game based loosely on the classic Breakout. It is the sequel to the game Chicken's Revenge.

The game features a hen who's out to rescue her chickens which have been captured and imprisoned. To secure their release our heroine fires a ball, 'Breakout style', at everything in her path. This clears the ground uncovers treasure which increases the score, pressure plates that allow her to advance and power-ups that may either help or hinder. All of which, if used carefully, will ultimately enable her to free the chicks. When the last chick has been freed the level is complete.

There are three types of game play, normal, easy and timed, in all the objective is to release the chicks and score points.

The game is entirely mouse controlled.

description: Cop Bastard - is a сlassic FPS takes place in the early 90s in Japan. Fight against yakuza, and other mobs...

There, he and the other shipwrecked passengers he rescues form a village to challenge fearsome beasts and mysterious ruins on the isolated island. Amidst this, Adol begins to dream of a mysterious blue-haired maiden living in an unknown world. Join Adol as he unravels the riddle of the cursed isle and the blue-haired maiden Dana in Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of DANA!

Super Nanaru is a cute and pixel art concept.
A hardcore side-scrolling jumping platformer game.
Test the limits of the player
Obtain and use skins with various abilities
Defeat all bosses with strong power
Bring back all the bread!

description: Do you despise playing scrabble with others? The feeling that everyone knows more words than you? Well, now this time is over. Obgoose is a single-player non-competitive scrabble-like game where no one will ever know when you are obtuse.

title: Humanities Legend: Hollow Ascending
description: A challenging yet forgiving souls-like action adventure. Parry, block, and dodge enemy attacks while exploring a ruined fort. Discover rich lore and epic boss fights.

description: Genpei Kassen is a historical simulation game which focuses on the war between the Genji (Minamoto clan) and the Heike (Taira clan) at the end of Japan's Heian period (12th century).

title: Indie Dev Story
description:
Quit your job to become an indie developer and make your first game!

A short single-player 'clicker' game which tries to mimic the frantic feeling of being an indie developer; make your game while trying to stay healthy, social and earning enough money to pay the bills.

How will your game do when it releases?

title: Tetragun
description: Tetragun is a top-down shooter where you play as a stationary turret and defend yourself against waves of enemies. As you progress through the waves, you will acquire upgrades to help you keep up with the growing strength and numbers of your enemies. The arena is split into 4 quadrants, and your turret will only be able to aim within the confines of the quadrant it is currently in. To aim at enemies outside of your current quadrant, you'll need to enter rotate mode with RMB and click on the quadrant you would like to rotate to. The goal of the game is to make it as far as possible, and get the highest score you can.

title: Void Inc
description: You are the Head of Tech at Void Inc., a rapidly growing SaaS startup where every decision creates another problem. Plan your day, survive frantic technical minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure, and try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

title: Blocked Up
description:
A platforming match 3 puzzle game.
Swap blocks to clear them off the board, and keep enough space for your little guy to run around safely.

title: 100 Flaps
description: In 100 Flaps your goal is to get as high as you can without running out of flaps. Through collecting coins you are also able to unlock more birds as you go.

title: I Want to be Popular!
description:
Hey, you! Yes, you. Do you want to know what's this game about? Keep reading.

Have you ever felt the difficulties of having a public life in social media? Have you been annoyed by comments from people who hide in anonymity to say insulting things? Well, this game is for you!

title: Merc Tactics
description:
Merc Tactics is a top-down tactical turn-based RPG in which you engage in epic tactical shootouts.
The game takes place in a region where civil war has left the country in chaos. The Khondo, a vicious band of looting militia have taken control of the country. You lead a small squad of mercenaries, who have vowed to restore order and rid the country of the Khondo.

You need to carefully plot your way through the region, recruiting mercenaries, upgrading your skills procuring armour and weapons and forming alliances with friendly militia. Each location in the campaign map hosts hostile militia, which you must fight in turn-based squad combat.

When your squad is strong enough you can confront the ringleader militia, but it will not be easy.

Nearly everything in the game is randomly generated, including the campaign map, enemy and resource locations. Scene layout and buildings are procedurally generated, leading to a huge variety of different scenes which your squad has to fight through.

The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

description: Cinderella's stepsister decides she wants to help her... but it seems like she's hiding a terrible secret. A visual novel with six endings, taking the classic fairytale down some unexpected roads.

title: Lavender Laboratories
description: A relaxing sequel to Doctor Voldritch's Experiment intended to help get you nice and chill with hypnosis. The game is for people new and old to hypnotism and gives a tutorial for those not familiar with it.

title: Lemonade.
description:
Are all first loves this bittersweet?

Quiet, shy and anxious, confessing to your crush takes every ounce of your courage. And when it all goes wrong, the last space left that is safe is the roof. But when a kind hand offers a carton of lemonade, how will your paths collide?

title: Yesterday, the World Ended
description: Yesterday, the world ended, but Luke somehow finds himself the only one alive on a train heading who knows where. At least, he believes he's the only one alive still.

title: Obsession
description: Obsession is a game where you play as schoolgirl Akane Reizei.

title: Rain and Red Roses
description:
The Year Is 1968. Trying to sleep amid academic pressure, pretending to be alright, and a raging thunderstorm outside of your dorm room, all you have to do is get in bed and get some rest. If only your dreams would cooperate...

Rain And Red Roses is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4. It primarily uses Alice in Wonderland as its theme mixed with 1960's aesthetic. The goal is to explore and collect effects, with the option to collect four counts of red paint as well, which unlocks a different ending.

title: Miss Bullard's School for Former Ladies
description: A Victorian fantasy lesbian romance, set in a boarding school for women who are not quite as human as they once were.

title: Romantic Rainbow Delights
description: Welcome to Romantic Rainbow Delights, an ice cream-themed dating sim!

title: Irori
description: As the aroma of savoury skewers wafts outside, hungry passengers rest their weary souls at the hearth. You are the chef on the cross-lands train, in charge of the irori cabin. Cook up a variety of skewers to warm bellies and hearts as you cross paths with travellers on their own journeys.

title: You Can Talk to People
description: You Can Talk To People is a simple and compact small-talk simulator. If you think that sounds awful and boring, you are correct. If you think that sounds like the coolest thing to grace our great blue earth, you are also correct.

title: The Sixth Prison
description: You are a resentful alien captive, exchanging hands once again. What do they want from you this time?

title: Trimorta
description: Venture into a mysterious space fortress to find your stranded crew.

title: Area 51: Running Ninja Raid
description: Play as Crossette from SL:DL and storm Area 51 to find out what's really inside!

title: Somewhere Strange
description: Where did all the aliens go?

title: Mysterious Unnamed Space Game
description: Explore a distant galaxy and find a way home.

title: Xiào Ào Jiānghú 2 Wàizhuàn: Dōngfāng Zàiqǐ
Gura's Adventure
description:
Here's the best, smol and adorable shark! Gawr Gura!!!
She's from the mysterious deep sea city Atlantis. However the people can't find the city anymore. Gura decided to take an adventure! Help her to eat some food, beat the bad guys and find Atlantis! Maybe something still left there then Gura can keep it safe...

title: Ashes: 2063 - Enriched Edition
description: Bundle of Ashes 2063 and its expansion Ashes 2063: Dead Man Walking. The Enriched Edition brings the original game's graphics, audio and game mechanics up to parity with its sequel Ashes Afterglow.

description: Show those germs what for!

description: Step out of your comfort zone and make new friends at the cooking club!

description: work, spend and die

description: The #1 Potato Dating Sim

description: A personal game about the city and nature in balance

title: Touhou Mother
description: Touhou Mother is a Touhou Project and EarthBound cross-over parody RPG game. It stars Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Yuuka Kazami and Mima and features many Touhou characters from the PC-98 and Windows canon, along with several characters from the Mother series and a few fan-made characters. The majority of the outside influence and references comes from EarthBound, but other notorious video games are paid homage as well.

title: Sfare: Relax your mind
description: Relax and enjoy what your mind creates. Take your time.

title: Spectrum Valley
description: Spectrum Valley is an interactive experience that is part-exploration game and part music visualizer. Take control of a boy or girl character and run and jump around in several biomes, collecting coins or food bonuses as the world moves and reacts dynamically to an audio file on your system; affecting the ground beneath your feet, some objects, and even the weather.

title: Liquorice
description:
Hyperreal realtime 70bpm.

Connect programmable Node-Terminal machines and create a sonic singularity.

title: The Watcher
description: A surveillance simulator set in a psychological thriller world. You are an unknown observer watching the residents of an apartment building across the street, in the strange city of Z, part of the totalitarian State of Nodia. But who's really watching whom?

title: Athemore
description: Explore the underground ruins of Athemore and learn about the forgotten past. Will you make it out alive?

title: The Peak
description: What will you find on your climb up the mountain?

title: Bludgeons & Krakens
description:
Bludgeons & Krakens is a turn-based, open world RPG in which the player must seek out and destroy, or outwit, the seven Beasts of Destruction threatening the land of Abraxas.

Keep It Classy (Or Don't). Build your character from one of five classes: Fighter, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, or Druid. Play to the strengths of your class or define your own style through mastering weapon skills and magic abilities.
Explore a Strange World. Quests and secrets abound in every corner of Abraxas. Engage in a variety of side quests with multiple endings, or simply wander the land in search of your fortune.
Loot the Bodies. Take on hordes of foes in turn-based combat. Sling spells, quaff potions, rend your enemies, and reap the glorious rewards. When your skills are honed, seek out powerful bosses who will truly challenge your abilities.

title: Nivearum
description: Print a map, mark your path, or be lost forever.

title: 51 Baffes

description: A visual novel about magical girls, aliens, and possibly...love?

title: A-Maze Batz
description: Help Batz find his love Batsie. Traverse a labyrinth without seeing it. Open Source for Windows/MacOS/Linux.

title: Wanderboots
description: Wanderboots is a open world RPG set in a somewhat realistic medieval world, with a focus on exploration, player choice and interactivity. It was in active development for about four years before the developer went on hiatus. After a long pause in development with no updates, the game was cancelled but remains released and available in an unfinished state.

title: Pictures of a reasonably documented year
description: You found a computer. What happened to the owner?

title: A Little Rogue
description: You must escape a deadly dundgeon with only one HP, so beware of all the sneaky enemies!

title: Snowman Arena
description: Local multiplayer arena shooter for up to 4 players. Varied projectiles and power-ups, adjustable difficulty for each player, playing against sneaky bots to be #1 in the world leaderboard, unique maps and several game modes. For gamepads or up to 3 players on one keyboard!

description: A roguelike where the wait key holds the most power.

description: An anti-fascist urban brawler roguelike.

description:
Dirk McSteel is a knight who's not good at fighting, but is at running. He's decided to try raiding the Dungeon of Forgotten Spine Monsters in search of the Five Treasures of Complacency.

Many have died here, but none were as fast as him.

description: A casual game with a moe demon girl.

title: In Next Life
description:
In next Life is a crafting, survival, and civilization building game, where collaboration with other players gives you very real advantages (it is possible to play alone, but it will be harder to survive). Your technology level starts at stone age level, and then it's up to you and your village members to invent and craft tools and technologies such as fire, baskets, spears, ..., in order to survive easier and to advance to new development stages. Time moves quickly and each game played equals one life, including birth, childhood, adulthood and old age.

The goal of each life is to contribute as much as possible to the survival and development of your village, children and future descendants. What you leave behind will be the foundation for others to keep building on. The flint spear you invented one life, could turn out to be the difference between survival and annihilation for your whole civilization. There are hundreds of objects you can craft, collect, cook, and eat. We intend to add at least 1,000 more during the Early Access period.

title: Maestro
description: Make your way to the top of the mysterious Casino by shooting Cards, Gambling, Upgrading your cards and create your optimal build in this Fast Paced First Person Roguelite.

title: Ashes: Afterglow
description: Reprise your rule as a "scav" in this post-apocalyptic first-person shooter. A voice on the radio is calling for you. Find this mysterious "Athena" and you might finally get some answers. Be mindful of your choices along your journey or face unintended consequences.

title: Puzzle Inlay

title: 2D Platformer Game (Toy Factory)
description: 2D Platformer Game (Toy Factory) is a cute 2D platformer with cute characters about a mother's soul trying to return safely to her daughter.

title: Half-Life 2: Deeper Down
description: In 2013’s Half Life 2 mod Deep Down, Jim Partridge took several key aspects from Episode Two, Alyx and the car, and expanded on these in an attempt to re-create that amazing Half-Life 2 feeling that everyone is looking for. Now, with seven additional years worth of level and environment design experience, Jim has taken another swing at the concept. With thirteen almost entirely new maps, new environments, new gameplay concepts, new puzzles, custom models (care of Ed Vincent), and original music (from Anicator), Deeper Down asks you to hit the road one last time and take down the one enemy who’s always been watching.

title: The Boss: A Jacksepticeye Fan Game

title: The Black Pyramid
description: A Black Pyramid materializes across the globe. Dr. Mehdi Algun must decipher why, before its hunger for death and suffering consumes everything. An ancient cycle of cleansing has begun. As madness spreads and humanity tears itself apart, choose: become the destroyer, or join the cleansed.

title: Shibuya Marble Texture
description:
Shibuya Marble Texture RPG is a free fangame of a Hypnosis Mic.

In this game you have to find your old enemy - Jakurai and kill him. Before that you must visit the 4 districts of Tokyo.

title: My World Still Burns
description: Life on the run has not taught Lio Fotia the first thing about domesticity, laundry or cooking. Still, that won't keep him from creating the World's #1 Dinner for his second anniversary with Galo Thymos. Lio used to lead the Burnish in their fight against oppression, surely he can manage one simple meal! Meanwhile, Galo has planned an anniversary surprise of his own...

title: Five Nights at Hololive
description:
Welcome to Holo Café. The V-Tuber café with the most modern animatronics. Be prepared to meet Usada Pekora, Nakiri Ayame, Shirakami Fubuki, and other Hololive girls!

But don’t be too careless now, because you must be with them all night long.

title: Mario 2Dyssey
description: This demake was for the DemakeJam ,It is a reproduction of Super Mario Odyssey in 2d in a 16bit style.

title: Goodbye Gordon
description: Hello Gordon, and welcome to your last day at the Black Mesa Research Facility. A cloning experiment has gone awry and you find yourself in the Black Mesa you know, but it isn't the Black Mesa you know! Dr. Coomer and his clones have gone and made a muck of things and it's up to you to find enough PlayCoins to appease them!

description: Explore planets, collect alien eggs, survive.

title: Puzzle Juggle Trouble
description:
A stacking puzzle game where you get two increasingly terrible pieces at once.

In this game, just like in regular Tetris, pieces fall from the sky. Unlike regular Tetris however, you are given multiple pieces at once, and you can swap between controlling one or another at any given time. You clear blocks by either making solid lines, or by filling square regions of at least 5 blocks by 5 blocks. The former increases the speed of the blocks' fall, the latter makes you move on to more and more complex pieces.

Try Arcade mode to see how far you go and push for higher scores, or race in Time Trial to set record times! You can also play Arcade mode in local Co-op between a keyboard player and a controller player, or have a custom game of Arcade mode where you can change various settings, from what pieces you get to how many at once are falling or even the size of the board.

title: Bruxa
description: Candy world, book world, fantasy world...

title: Vastynex
description:
Thunder Force Inspired Shooter. Homages to retro shooting games.

At the beginning of the game, you'll only be capable of shooting in front and behind your ship, but by acquiring weapons from the item carriers that appear during each stage, you'll gain access to lasers, homing shots and more.

Defeating enemies in rapid succession increases the score multiplier gauge up to a maximum of x8, with larger and more durable enemies offering a speed-kill bonus equal to x4 of your current score multiplier (maximum x32).

The ending can be reached by clearing all six stages, and you can watch a replay of your run from the main menu.

title: Open Solomon's Key

description: Roll the dice, Possess the heroes and focus on the weak ennemies, build your die deck smartly.

title: A Hexagon's Adventures
description: Move by the dice roll and battle enemies through the power of typing to advance through your adventure.

title: A storm is approaching
description: Multiple choices, multiple endings.

title: The Devil's Gospel
description: A Preacher finds himself cursed by a devil... can he be free?

title: Taiheiki
description: Taiheiki is a turn-based strategy game based on the Japanese 14th century historical epic of the same name. Like the book, the game portrays the struggle between the Northern Court, ruled by the decadent Hōjō clan (later betrayed by their vassal Ashikaga Takauji), and the Southern Court of the emperor Go-Daigo. The gameplay has strong grand strategy elements and is similar to Koei's "historical simulation" series. The player can choose to control either the Northern or the Southern forces, choosing the actions for the leader and all his vassals. The player can choose to engage in diplomacy with rulers of other provinces, sign agreements, and manage and navigate armies. Combat takes place on a separate top-down grid, on which he player navigates the soldiers in turn-based fashion. Individual battles proceed automatically, their outcome based on the participant's attributes.

title: Packing House
description: Start your own online store! Buy products from wholesalers and list them profitably on the Internet. Increase your shipping capacity and assortment. Ensure timely delivery to customers and that everyone receives the goods they ordered. Beware of negative reviews as they can spoil your reputation!

title: Zombie Carnage 2
description: Zombie Carnage 2 is a 32 player first person shooter where you will play both as a human and zombie. By killing zombies and infecting humans you will permanently level up, unlock weapons, attachments, zombie classes and more.

title: Creamy Mami: Futari no Rondo
description:
Based on the anime Creamy Mami, the Magic Angel. The original tells the story of a 10-year-old girl named Yuu Morisawa, who gains a magical ability to transform into a grown-up young woman, eventually becoming a pop star and acquainting the inhabitants of the Earth with the rest of the galaxy. Yuu appears in the game, but is not the protagonist; the player controls four young women in four different scenarios: two of them, Yuri and Aya, on the Earth, and the other two, Ora and Sita, in an alien world, mixture of sci-fi and medieval fantasy. The story goes beyond the original anime by introducing a magical, sacred land known as Finality, populated by fantasy being, and calling the guardians (the four girl protagonist) to bring peace to the galaxy.

Futatsu no Sekai plays automatically for the most part, except key scenes which allow interaction - two, sometimes more choices that have to be done by the player. In many cases these choices are merely cosmetic, or may lead to a different text description and scene.

title: Panty&Demons
description:
According to Japanese folklore, if you won't destroy the thing that have seen service, it will come to life and turn into yokai. It's called Tsukumogami - "spirit of the old tool".
One of such long forgotten yokai breaks free, leaded by the appetite for revenge to the descendants of thouse who sealed him, starving for women Yin energy.
Will and ordinary schoolboy be able to save all his friends?

Panty & Demons is a match-3 style puzzle game with a visual novel style of presentation and a little sprinkle of RPG elements.

title: I'm on Observation Duty 4
description: Fourth instalment in the indie horror game series "I'm on Observation Duty". A spot the difference -type of puzzle horror game. Monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies ranging from furniture movement to intruders. Fix anomalies by filing a reports describing the type and location of the anomaly. You will need sharp eyes and good memory. The goal is to survive from 00:00 to 06:00.

title: Tipston Salvage
description: Junkyard logistics couch co-op game that focuses on teamwork and communication. Store, crush and ship processed scrap as fast as possible, while trying to synchronize with your teammates.

title: Newtonian Horror
description: Step into the boots of Isaac Newton, in a world before gravity was invented. Newtonian Horror is an occult platformer where you can't move or shoot and the only weapon at your disposal is gravity. Use your exceptional knowledge as Newton to manipulate gravity and defeat your enemies!

title: Made in Physics
description: A physics based game with many minigames!

title: Ancient Orb
description: You are in a Ancient Temple. Collect orbs to fuel the ancient apparatuses.

title: Sebil Engineering
description: Sebil Engineering is a game about "fixing" roads.

title: Jolly 3: Chapter 1
description:
Thirty-two years after the incident has happened, an indie entertainment company sets out on a mission to revive the unsolved mysteries of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! This Halloween, they will open a horror attraction called "Fazbear's Fright" featuring ancient and original artifacts which made childhood memories who should never be spoken about again.

This time, they set out location to location to find more items to put in their attraction. Their first target would be in an abandoned factory where Jolly Entertainment used to be in! Conspiracy theorists nationwide are more than hyped! And hopes to find clues that will solve the mysteries once and for all.

title: Jolly 3: Chapter 2
description: Your job isn't finished just yet. You must spend another five nights in this horrid facility. But this time, an atrocious discovery has yet to be made...

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Wave 1: Pulse of the Ancients
description: Wave 1 includes an expanded roster, newly added weapon types, and challenging enemies. Dominate the battlefield as the playable Battle-Tested Guardian or try out the added Flail weapon for Link and Master Cycle for Zelda. These combat styles will come in handy as you face the challenging Apocalyptic difficulty and added enemies like the bomb-throwing Moblin and Giant Chuchu. You can also stop by the Royal Ancient Tech Lab to test yourself with new challenges!

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Wave 2: Guardian of Remembrance
description: In Wave 2, experience a newly playable character duo, additional stages, and new story sequences. Defend Hyrule as the quirky duo character, Purah & Robbie, and their array of ancient technology. See how places like the Coliseum and Kakariko Village looked 100 years in the past in brand-new story stages. And learn more about the Champions and the mysterious Guardian in emotional new story sequences as the fight for Hyrule’s future continues.

title: Crusader Kings III: Royal Court
description: The Royal Court expansion to Crusader Kings III adds new ways to interact with the characters in your kingdom or empire, as well as major changes to the cultural system of the game, adding greater dynamism and historical fluidity.

title: Spaceship Hunters
description: Spaceship Hunters is a chaotic couch co-op shoot-em-up for 4 players. Working as a crew, fight your way through the worst criminals the universe has to offer.

title: Mystik Adventure
description:
You enter a world, after selecting New Game and entering a 'World-Seed'.

This number determines how the world looks and plays like. Find powerful spells and mighty weapons and armors that help you bring peace to the worlds!

The goal for the hero is to retrieve 3 crystals out of the dungeons and use them to enter the Void where the Dark Master waits. Can you defeat him? Or can you defeat him more than once?

title: Bouquet
description: Collect coins. Purchase flowers. Arrange bouquet. Surprise your darling.

title: Goddess Husk
description: A beautifully presented adventure to awaken the Goddesses of old begins here. Guide your mute knight and blind magicker through harrowing encounters with the creatures of the Scourge and then wipe them out in the blink of an eye using the legendary power of the giantess Goddess.

title: Project Unirah
description: Project Unirah is a third person shooter created by a single developer using Unreal Engine 4. Fight your way through a factory setting, learn what happened and uncover the reason for your existence.

title: Roskis: A Boozy Beginning

title: Legend of Egypt: Jewels of the Gods 2
description: A cat-like creature has entered the chambers of the Pharaoh and absorbed his soul. Who is behind this dark magic and will succeed in lifting the curse by building an imposing city?

title: The Divine Deception
description: The Divine Deception awaits you in Panthea. Will you be able to find the truth? Deduce, brainstorm, fight, and hack your ways through obstacles. But remember: Panthea's story is a game to be bet on. Nothing more.

title: Press D to Die
description: Did you ever want to die with the press of a button? Well now you can! In this quick to finish puzzle-platformer the corpses that will pave your path to victory will be your own.

title: Circus Pocus
description: Welcome to the circus of violence!

title: No Crooks on Christmas
description: No Crooks on Christmas is a tower defense game with a fun holiday theme. Defend your house against a relentless onslaught of crooks and save Christmas!

title: Loosepo
description: This is an ultra-lightweight Top-Down shooting game with roguelike elements. You need to constantly recycle your empty wine bottles to replenish ammunition. Use the initial props cards and the upgrade cards in the game to build a powerful butt baby, and then help it defeat the evil rotten demons

title: Carrot
description: 20 minutes long. Point and click your way through a short story which involves a magnifying glass, strawberries, flowers, unicorns and a carrot.

title: Seeds of Hope: The Last Stand
description: Manage a space ship and survive alien waves to save the humanity of brink of extinction

title: Onigami
description: Defend The Empire! Take turns to construct your buildings, deploy your units, and attack the Oni!

title: Turbotron
description: A 7DRL turn-based twist on classic arcade action

title: Rainbow City
description: Rainbow City is a colorful horror/puzzle game.

title: Nb107a
description:
Micheal's life isn't easy.

His father is a famous spy who was poisoned on his last mission by NB107A, an unknown chemical with no known cure. In a desperate attempt to alleviate his father's pain, Micheal joins Atlin Missionary University's Chemical Analysis program to find the cure himself.

Now his graduate adviser wants to have a serious talk and he knows that he's about to be sacked.

His last chance rests with a mysterious man who looks almost exactly like Micheal himself and who seems to know a little too much about NB107A...

Will Micheal find the cure for his father's illness? Why does this mysterious man look exactly like Micheal? Will Micheal's life ever get easier?!

title: Exit 19
description:
A forgotten highway exit erodes under the fading desert sun.

Dusk approaches as a car burns away its last drop of fuel.

title: Squid Game: The Game
description:
Squid Game: The Game is a survival horror game based on the popular Netflix thriller ‘Squid Game’. Compete among a crowd in a number of games direct from the show to see if you have what it takes to survive.

You meet a man in the subway offering vast riches and exorbitant amounts of money. All you have to do is play a few simple games. Sounds like child's play... right?

title: Into the Deep Web
description: A dicey venture through the deep web.

title: Picowars
description: A retro fan-game and unofficial prequel to Nintendo's Advance Wars series made in the PICO-8 fantasy console.

title: Operation: Ops
description:
Operation:OPS is a lo-fi stealth-action FPS set in an alternate 199X.

Play as an operative seemingly working for the world's most notorious terrorist, who is known only as "The Operator".

Your health is low, and you are outnumbered and vulnerable. Once you are detected, enemy reinforcements will arrive in waves until your mission is complete.

A variety of equipment can be selected before you deploy, such as explosives, motion trackers, nerve-gas grenades, sentry guns and amphetamines.

Fight in up to nine different operations, with seven possible endings, depending on who you save, and whose orders you choose to follow.

title: Taxi By Night

title: Soundsaber
description: A twin-stick shooter where your music is your weapon. Whichever track you choose will power your engines and your lasers, but beware: your enemies are also driven by the music.

title: Pumpkin Curse
description: Destroy monsters, buy new heads and have fun!

title: Eddsworld: The Masquerade
description: A crossover AU between "Eddsworld" and "Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines". Share the adventures of four vampires who have to put their differences aside in order to survive in the world of darkness. Dark places, dark secrets, dark humour...everything is dark around here!

title: Misfortunate Tadpole
description: A cute one-button platform adventure

title: Luminous Corridor 2
description:
PSI GUY has powerful psionic powers and a very handsome moustache. but can PSI GUY reclaim the CRYSTALS?

Guide PSI GUY through endless waves of monsters in this twin stick shooter.

title: Momentum Tenebris
description: Take on the role of a dragon-hunting vampire that seeks to give rest to an undead dragon.

title: High Stakes
description: High Stakes is a strategic roguelike card game where every prediction matters. Build powerful combinations of Stakes, earn Chips and Trump Cards, manipulate your deck, and master endless challenges with card series.

title: Bloodless

title: And All Is Well
description: Nonsense happens all the time and all is well.

After one hundred years you have finally awakened only to discover that some out-of-control, booty-shaking kittens have infested your Castlevania and are messing around with all the power-ups! They are so cute and curious, but unfortunately it looks like you'll have go around and catch them all before a vampire hunter arrives.

description: Embark on a global adventure in this ‘90s-inspired platformer about a chubby underdog kid with wacky superpowers.

title: The Candles Breathe
description: The Candles Breathe is a small game about a vampire looking for a victim, in a world where Spirits are very real and the people hold ceremonies twice a year to appease them and protect themselves.

title: Phucker in the Woods: Volume 0
description: A group of youngsters go to the woods to self-investigate a disappearance...

title: SinsFromGod 2
description: SinsFromGod makes a return for a second part and it's now better than ever, SinsFromGod 2 introduces all new mechanics that were not in the original game like interacting with objects such as picking up items like notes, weapons, health items, and more. We have also added horrifying jumpscares to make sure you have nightmares for nights on end.

title: Wrought Flesh
description: Rip out organs and equip them in your own body. Fight biopunk monsters and drugged-up space bandits. You are a Gajeshian Cultist: A near-mythological being built from the bodies of long-dead saints.

title: Monster Rancher 1 DX
description:
Monster Rancher 1 DX is an updated version of Monster Rancher, featuring additional save slots, Freeze slots, Monster Hall of Fame slots, memos, rankings, and a high-speed mode.

It was released together with Monster Rancher 2 DX in the Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX bundle.

title: Monster Rancher 2 DX
description: Welcome to the magical world of Monster Rancher! The beloved series makes its triumphant return with Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX, bringing together the wildly popular simulation games – Monster Rancher and Monster Rancher 2 – all in one amazing collection. Raise your own monsters and train them to compete against other eccentric creatures in combat and tournaments. With hundreds of different monster types, each with their own skills and abilities, every Rancher will be able to raise and train a monster that's a perfect fit for their personality and play style. Returning fans and newcomers alike can enjoy the timeless monster training and battling experience in Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX!

title: Detective GUI
description: Detective GUI is a puzzle platformer, played with mouse and keyboard.

title: KateLabs
description: My vast library of platformer tech is available to you to play with! A big level editing toy.

title: Trains Girl Locomotion
description: Build train infrastructure to connect towns so girlfriends can visit for hangouts and parties.

title: Orbital Paladin Melchior Y
description: Visual novel and mecha shooting action

title: Radiant Core
description:
Created in 48hrs for Ludum Dare 35 game jam with the theme "Shapeshift"

Control a micro drone that is capable of hacking AI systems. Infiltrate a facility and destroy the brain core which controls the enemy drones. (Unfortunately, I need to rush the ending)

The game is short as I have removed some planned features and levels because of the time constraint Still, I hope you guys will enjoy playing it. :)

title: Alette 0: Red Moon of April
description: Alette 0: Red Moon of April is a science fiction visual novel for the PC and PlayStation Vita about Kohime, a Japanese girl who, after losing everything, set off on a one-month journey riding her Metal Knight.

title: Terra Centauri: Last Stand
description: Anime RTS Protect Terra from voracious parasites.

title: Road Warriors 2
description: CAVE-style vertical bullet hell shooter

title: Ancient Metal
description: Jump in your mecha and save the world from ancient invaders! Made for the E1M1 Magazine Game Jam.

title: FroggieChat
description: A faithful remake of Pictochat for Windows and Android

title: Burd.
description: the kingdom of birds has fallen and will not again rise from the ashes.

title: Cain
description: Carrying the weight of an unforgivable sin, the murder of his brother Abel, Cain wrapped his body in bandages to hide his guilt. In a devastated world, he faces relentless obstacles, and with each step, he moves closer to a choice: seek redemption or succumb to the hatred consuming him.

title: Steelbreakers
description: Arena combat with your friends!

title: Sylvie
description: You're part of an evil-hunting squad, but recently your partner has gone missing while out on a contract. This is a very short platformer where you hack and slash your way through a cult hideout and face a challenging rival.

title: The Bleeding Tree
description: The Bleeding Tree is a roguelike, hack-and-slash game with unique consequences for winning and losing.

title: Enterchained
description: Enterchained is a co-op gladiatorial hack and slash where you are chained to your teammate and have to take down waves of different enemies

title: Asterogue
description: A sci-fi roguelike where you descend 17 procedurally generated levels into a hollow asteroid. Battle aliens, collect futuristic weapons and nanotech, manage hunger and permadeath. Fast, minimal, turn-based combat inspired by the original Rogue.

title: Dungeons of Mysteria
description: A procedurally generated Dungeon Crawler

title: Farm and Mine
description: From Ludum Dare 48: "Deeper and deeper" to full game release

title: RWBY Fading Light
description: Hack'n'Slash your way across Remant with the 4 Huntresses of team RWBY experience the beginning of their journey.

title: Port Traventor
description: Plagued by orcs and dwarves, Traventor needs a true king to rise to the occasion! Would it be that you are such a king?

title: Elated Sorrow
description: A yuri kinetic novel about two lonely women who meet by chance.

title: Craftomation 101
description: You land on a frozen planet in a tiny rocket with a robot inside. Harvest and combine materials to discover new ones. Use visual programming to make the robot do the tiresome work for you. Slowly build a gang of self-sustaining robot workers and watch them terraform the planet.

title: I Can't Believe the Most Popular Girl in School is a Lesbian, Just Like Me!
description: A lesbian? Just like me?

title: In the Cards
description: a short game about a first date & a tarot reading

title: Helena's Flowers
description:
After her elopement with the neighboring Wilusan princess, Achaea declares war on Wilusa resulting in a years-long bloody conflict. As the war is drawing to a close, Helena is escorted back to her rightful place in Achaea. However, something goes wrong and their ship crash lands on a desolate tiny planet, killing everyone on board except for Helena and a single soldier.

Now stranded in the vastness of space with only a strange soldier for company, Helena finds herself thinking about what sort of fate awaits her. And more importantly, does she even have a place to return to?

title: Lovely Anemone
description: Salena's ex-girlfriend hurt her in ways she never knew were possible. She's pretty sure the break up was a result of her being asexual. Now Salena's afraid to commit to another relationship and has lost confidence in herself. She still wants a girlfriend, but is refusing sexual intimacy a deal-breaker? That's when she accidentally finds herself falling in love with another girl, but is afraid to come out to her. At the same time her ex-girlfriend pleads for her forgiveness and wants her back. What will she do?

title: Wire Wood Daughters
description: "Wire Wood Daughters" is a beautiful, 16 bit narrative game. Follow the forest's memory through this female protaganist fantasy story.

title: Dream Hard
description: Dream Hard is a short two-player co-op queer-themed beat 'em up game. In it, you must defend the local NYC queer performance space The Dreamhouse from hordes of fascists. The retro-style 3D graphics imagine a history of queer punk games in the late 1990s, connecting those politics of resistance to today.

title: Dreaming of You
description: Find the girl of your dreams! Literally!

title: Strange Terror from the Deep
description: Explore a derelict submersible as you try to find an escape route or attempt to kill the creature that stalks you.

title: Ahmmit's Gate
description: A reverse-horror game where you play as a blind monster that survives off the fear of humans.

title: Path of Shadows
description: A strange warrior back from the dead. A dangerous journey full of blood and secrets.

title: SneakR
description: A short stealth game with 5 levels.

title: Midnight Heist
description: You're a thief who is afraid of darkness, but your boss doesn't know that and he sends you out to do his dirty work in the middle of the night. You must stay on the edge of darkness so you don't pass out and don't get caught by the guards.

title: 3:30 am. at Floater's Cemetery
description: Mr.Krabs has returned to Floater's Cemetery to rob some graves at 3:30 AM. Will you escape with all the booty?

title: A Child's Courage
description: A 2D rogue-like with horror elements

title: Dora Is Dead: Remastered
description: Get ready to be scared stiff in this new refined and improved version of the original Dora is Dead!

title: Sneks Fiend
description: Wrap yourself (and others) in snakes. Made for Strawberry Jam.

title: Ariel Cleanomancer and the Eldritch Sweep
description: Ariel has to vacuum the basements of a weird-ass hotel to become a certified cleanomancer.

title: Kusoge
description: The most kuso a game can have. This is the Kusoge.

title: Sika: Tribe's salvation
description: Contemplative 3d platformer set in Snowy Canada

title: Bomber's Run
description: Are you fast enough?

title: Absence: Verdict of Silence
description: A Turn-Based Adventure RPG based in the land of Asalthana.

title: Adolfish
description: You're a little piranha trying to catch your food, a blowfish. It's not as easy as it seems!

title: A Flower from Hermes
description: Grab your bronze weapons and guide Odysseus’ high-maintenance crew through a dangerous island in this strategic RPG.

title: Moon Drop
description: Moon Drop is a small game created on RPG Maker VX ACE made for the Space Bunny Jam of 2019, hosted by Choko-flan. The game follows a moon spirit known as Osmond who is going out to collect his offerings after blessing his village with a successful harvest.

title: Acrodog
description: Bow-wow the crowd!

title: Rwen's Day Out
description: A mundane visual novel about dragons hanging out.

title: Ayre
description: Dragon Flying Freedom

title: Vigil
description: Vigil is a short Narrative Horror Game that takes place in an unsettling underground facility. Your job is to dispose of boxes, however, you’re not alone. A terrifying automaton roams the facility, moving only when you look away or when you blink in real life.

title: Tacape
description: Tacape is a deck-builder card game with roguelite elements for those who love a tactical challenge. Take part in a series of combats, build your strategy, upgrade your cards, and face folkloric creatures along the way!

title: Garbageland
description: Block breaking RPG about our trash-filled future.

title: Printed Mars
description: Post-apocaliptical quest

title: ColdSun
description: stealth exploration game

title: Microvania
description:
Microvania is a short metroidvania game developed by BluebsTopCat where you play as a wizard where each keyboard button is an upgrade that will give you new abilities to explore the game map in search of a mysterious item.

The game is simple but enjoyable. It has fluid gameplay and reasonable physics for an adventure game. Your goal is to acquire new skills and use them to access new areas that are increasingly complex and challenging.

title: Honey Home
description: When it rains, it pours. Guide your bees back to their hive to stay out of the weather! Visit flowers to get some bee reinforcement, and bring as many bees back home while avoiding the massive dangers of the tiny bee world.

title: Lead Haul
description: It's time to break free and show these pirates the benefits of switching to a lead based diet!

title: Deadline of the Dead
description: Balance work and not being eaten by zombies

title: UnMarked
description: A game made about conflict, racism, violence with mechanics mixing AI, agency and emergent behaviours.

title: A Tale about Tail
description:
There is always a thief and a grumpy old man.

A never-ending tale about the little mute fox, who appear to be Slipper, a thief. As always, the threat looms over the kingdom. This time, it's a lots of golden coins. Save the world or just feed your family - today it doesn't really matter. Grab your trusty green sack and become one of the famous ghostlike invisible of the world !

title: Bickadoodle
description: Hand-drawn fairy-tale adventure.

title: Approaches
description: Ambient horror game about repairing a radio tower and birdwatching.

title: 2 Foxes and the Puzzling Forest
description: Play as 2 foxes as they navigate through dozens of puzzles in hopes to play and find shelter!

title: Furries & Scalies & Bears Oh My!: Ultimate Edition
Arnaud Thion's Dragons
description: Destroy the land as a dragon!

title: Flip of Light
description: A precision platformer where you can instantaneously flip from ceiling to floor. Run, jump, and flip your way through difficult and vibrant stages, each themed around a pair of complementary colors. Master a constant barrage of new level mechanics, each designed around your flip ability.

title: Anise Flowers
description: Anise Flowers is a short visual novel about a farmer and a fallen angel living together on a small farm. Will their relationship blossom? Or will greater forces pull them apart... forever?

title: Kardiossomatic
description:
Can you keep it alive?
Your life in your hands (literally).
Follow your heart’s shine and survive dangerous illusions and a strange reality.
Find the ones it’s calling for, they’re waiting for you.
Pay attention to your heartbeats, they reveal your feelings to the world!
And be aware, the things you'll see will can make your heart race... Or stop completely.

title: Lotan
description: Chaoskampf on the Stormy Seas

title: Bizzarioware
description: Bizzarioware is an ongoing collection of psychedelic, strange and surreal microgames played for 15 seconds or less.

title: Terminull
description: Terminull is a game in which you play as a 1990's hacker that's planting viruses into government servers.

title: Bobls
description: Bobls is a precise and bouncy 2D retro platformer. Complete the story through the single player or unique two-player campaign, create and play levels made by the community through the level editor used by the developers themselves.

title: Freegglers
description: Freegglers is an action-platformer with unique, funny and chaotic, flexible, physics-base movement of the main character. Train, jump, fight and find the escape hole inside the maze of traps, rescue your fellow Freegglers who suffer under the tyranny of Evil Freaks.

title: Casadastra
description: Tread with see-through plan into the ocean of the night.

title: Dies Mortis
description: Dies Mortis is a bittersweet story that presents a metaphorical view of death.

title: Lady Pac
description:
Lady Pac is a homage to Ms. Pac-Man, an arcade game published by Midway in 1982.

Main differences from the original version:
- Randomly generated mazes
- Bonus rounds

title: Fluffhood's Adventure
description: A Togainu No Chi fan game, Little Red Riding Hood style.

title: Polka Dot Pirate
description:
Pick up rare, mysterious treasures and give them to your pirate friends.

A game by Daniel Linssen, with music by Jared Hahn.

Made for GGJ 2017.

title: Vampliar
description: A boys' love kinetic novel about a human who meets a vampire.

title: My Best Friend's Birthday
description: Give something nice for your friend's special day!

title: Fox in the Hollyhocks
description:
Altea Rosata – a city of flowers– is both parts prosperous and destitute, and this prosperity and destitution brings people in droves and waves, searching for limelight...

...or a place to hide.

title: Agarta
description: Agarta is an interactive live-action game (FMV), it follows the story of a serial killer nicknamed the Surgeon. You will observe his plans as he questions the themes of justice and law on earth. You have to choose wisely because any decisions you make will lead you to one of the 19 finals.

title: Heart Agency
description: Adrian Heart is a reclusive composer dragged into the world of the entertainment industry by his famous sister to become the new personal assistant to one of the elite talents who calls the agency home. He is none to happy about it.

title: Halt the Heist!
description: An online party game

title: Last Man Kicking
description: a bunch of dude play soccer in a swivel chair... any more questions?

title: Pool Party
description:
Challenge your friends and have a ball in tons of chaotic party games!

Dive into a wave of fun at the Pool Party resort! Play solo or with up to four players in tons of sports & brawl games and fight to become king of the party. Customize your pool ball – choose your favorite color and design - and go head-to-head with your friends. Have a splashing good time!

These pool balls are not just adorable, but also surprisingly athletic. They reach ridiculous speeds as they roll and bounce around the arena in no-time! Plus, these balls can kick each other around because they're balls after all! You'll be amazed by the sheer power of a perfectly aimed kick, propelling a rival ball all over the stage. Grab a cue and join the party!

title: Deep Relics
description: Deep underwater you drive a submarine to find relics.

title: Chimney Prowler
description: Christmas horror with a twist

title: Grimcurse
description: Venture down into a gallery-shooter top-down RPG hybrid. Manage your resources while you wander around the cryptic jungle with questions no one wants to know the answers to.

title: Flatwoods
description: You are Lemon, a small child that feels a great need to uncover the mystery of the "shooting star" that has just flown over your home and landed somewhere in the woods nearby. Loosely based on the story of the Flatwoods Monster.

title: Kiteboarding Pro
description: Race against the clock in time trials, beat that ultimate high score in freestyle or go BIG with massive jumps in freeride mode. From wakestyle to oldschool to kiteloops to wave riding - in Kiteboarding Pro the sky isn't the limit.

title: Deluded
description: Deluded is the latest live action crime thriller game by New IDEA Games, it's an experimental fusion of narrative FMV (Full Motion Video), point and click investigation and quick time event (QTE) based interactive games. You play as a detective and try to solve a case with your the assistance of Susan.

title: Rise Up!
description: Rise Up!, a space adventure and survival game with hints of 4x that tests your strategic abilities and challenges your entrepreneurial skills. Scavenge for supplies. Recover and repurpose the mangled bits of robots and equipment. Repair and fly your drone before mining asteroids. Build your empire. Collect achievement badges as you progress. Rise Up! contains stunning visuals and an original soundtrack. The game also includes free updates and players will have the opportunity to make decisions on future updates.

title: Ultimate Super Powers Old Maid: 3Days
description:
Produced in 3 days!
The Ultimate Combination of Old maid and Mahjong!

"Ultimate Super Powers Old Maid: 3Days" is a game based on the card game Babanuki. It is an irregular Old Maid where the player's actions are determined by the ability tiles that are replenished each turn, apart from the cards such as Numbers and Jokers.

title: Stick Match
description: A silly game for two players.

title: Egg King
description: Egg King is a platformer game with a twist, you're going to go down by jumping and rolling. Go on a journey across the land and reach the lost crown of the king. Visit different landscapes and raise your ability. Become the new king and make the rich!

title: ZigZag
description: ZIGZAG is a little arcade game.

title: Dream Dye
description:
A 2D puzzle platformer in which you delve into dreams and mix colours to dye objects, in a world where colours are a pigment of the imagination.

Dream Dye takes place in a doctor's office in the fictional village of Renkaya, a relatively normal village with just one strange difference—the only way to “make” colour is to dream about it.

title: Postbird in Provence
description: Hop on your bike and become Marcel, the new postbird in town! Meet the lovely and quirky people of Montélimace and bring this charming village back to life. Set amongst the lavender fields and fanned by the sea breeze, take a real breath of provençal air.

title: Your Gay Monster Family
description: Only one ending. Don't worry about it.

title: Mixed Feelings
description: You find yourself whisked away into a beautiful place that's strangely familiar. Join Peri, Silas, and Kahira as they take you through Asphodel Meadows, and fall deeper and deeper down the rabbit hole as you learn more about their lives, the world around you, and possibly... yourself.

title: Time to Morp
description: Time to Morp is a colony sim game in which you take care of playful creatures - Morps. Use their skills to gather resources, build pipe networks, automate everything and explore the world to find new species and rare materials.

title: One-Eyed Ripper
description:
The protagonist, Mebuki Meme, had a peaceful everyday life.
A dear friend, and a dear brother, she held them closely.

However, that mundane peacefulness came to an abrupt end.
Because of the “murder case” which revolving around her.

“The One Eyed Ripper.”
Remembering that name,
Rumors created by someone had created a murderer.
Those peaceful everyday’s have ended.
Now begins the story of a person killing another.

For love, for desire, for the sake of finding the right answer.
Well then, who’s the culprit?

title: Bad Gobelet
description:
There is a dark tower with a deep basement that holds the BAD GOBLET, an evil artifact that many have attempted to retrieve for research... or to make use of its strange powers...

You're desperate enough to try and find it. You will face evil monsters and the limits of your own strength and wit. Also the tower is really really scary.

title: MawaruWorld
description: You move the world! Protect your trees and watch out for thunder storms and asteroids

title: A Garden on the Sea
description: A Garden on the Sea, an indie adventure game, tells the journey of Elliot and Lori to find a new home. Dive, explore and tend to your garden to uncover a story of fear, of growing up and being in the middle of the ocean.

title: No More Papers Please
description: No more papers please is a physics-based game about working over-time in a stressful job. Use the tools in your office to fill out the papers and put them in your scanner. Make sure you get the work done as soon as possible so you can go home to your family!

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
description: Take on the role of one of the notorious Slaughter family, or their victims, in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series
description: In the near future on the outskirts of the asteroid belt, a bloody mutiny breaks loose on the Artemis. You take the role of XO Camina Drummer, where your choices determine the fate of the ship. What will you do with the truth, Bosmang?

title: Thirsty Suitors
description: Can Jala learn to love herself and heal the wounds of her past? Thirsty Suitors is a stylish, story-driven adventure that unfolds through turn-based battles, skateboarding, and cooking.

title: Have a Nice Death
description: Have a Nice Death is a 2D action roguelite where you play as an overworked Death, whose employees have run rampant, completely throwing off the balance of souls - and his vacation plans. In order to restore order, you'll have to grab your trusty scythe and show your employees who's boss.

title: Summer Gems
description:
Summer.

A special time when anything can happen.

The possibilities are infinite: even a shard of glass worn by the sea

can become the most precious treasure.

Friendships are like that.

In a seaside summer, friendships can last no longer

than a splashing wave.

But like those pieces of glass,

they're turned into treasures by the sea.

That is what happens to Leo and Mara.

Join them in this little summer break through the salty breeze

of the Mediterranean Sea.

Explore. Live. Love.

title: MiniNatura
description:
Ever wondered what it'd be like to view nature from a completely different perspective? In MiniNatura, you play as bug-sized sprite searching for magic seeds in a forest full of moss and mushrooms. Explore all the nooks and crannies of the forest floor, and maybe you'll discover all of it's secrets.

Rotate the camera freely around the diorama to look for potential spots where a seed could be hidden, and dig up the sprout to collect them.

title: Star Wars: Eclipse
description: A new action-adventure, multiple-character branching narrative game set in the High Republic era, presented to you by Quantic Dream and Lucasfilm Games. Now early in development.

title: Alan Wake II
description: Alan Wake 2 marks Remedy Entertainment’s first foray into the survival horror genre. Ritualistic murders in a small town. A writer trapped in a nightmare. An FBI agent looking for answers. Two realities. Two hero characters. One horror story that wants them dead.

title: When the River Runs Dry
description: When The River Runs Dry is a game that joins together the adventure, narrative, and survival genres. With 2D art set in a 3D environment, there is a whole world to explore with many different landscapes and tons of different characters to meet!

title: Slitterhead
description:
Set in the densely cluttered streets of "Kowlong," filled with obscurity and chaos, this battle action-adventure game casts players as the "Hyoki," an entity devoid of memory and physical form. His only motive is to eradicate the monstrous beings known as "Slitterheads" crawling around the city, disguising themselves as humans.

Roaming the vibrant neon-lit cityscape, players must seek out allies among humans known as "Rarities," infiltrate and track dangerous organizations, and engage in battles harnessing the power of blood. As the suspenseful drama unfolds, delve into the mystery behind Hyoki's existence and the appearance of the Slitterheads.

title: Nightingale
description: Nightingale is a shared world survival-crafting game set in a rich gaslamp Victorian fantasy setting. Players venture through portals where adventure and mystery awaits across a myriad of beautiful and increasingly-dangerous worlds.

title: Contractually Bound
description: You are trapped inside an office and you don't know how you got there. All you see is a contract in front of you and when you break it, it effects the world around you. You explore the seemingly abandoned office in hopes of finding your escape.

title: The Matrix: Awakens - An Unreal Engine 5 Experience
description: The Matrix: Awakens morphs from breathtakingly realistic cinematic to fast-paced third-person shooter experience, complete with action-packed car chase sequence, and also provides a rich, vastly detailed open world to explore, set within the universe of 'The Matrix'.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II
description: The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you. Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors, with Clive Standen (Vikings, Taken) as the iconic Captain Titus. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

title: Dune: Spice Wars
description: Dune: Spice Wars is a real-time strategy game with 4X elements, from the developers of the critically acclaimed Northgard. Set in Frank Herbert’s groundbreaking Dune universe, you must lead your faction and battle for control and dominance over the harsh desert planet of Arrakis. Best your opponents through political intrigue, crush them in combat, and undermine them with your network of illusive spies.

title: Star Trek: Resurgence
description: Star Trek: Resurgence is an interactive narrative video game that tells an original story in a choice-driven adventure set within the iconic sci-fi universe

title: Rumbleverse
description:
Rumbleverse is a brand new, free-to-play, 40-person Brawler Royale where anyone can be a champion.

In February 2023, Epic games announced that it was shutting down all support and servers for Rumbleverse. This took effect as of 28th February 2023.

title: ARC Raiders
description:
ARC Raiders is a multiplayer extraction adventure, set in a lethal future earth, ravaged by a mysterious mechanized threat known as ARC. Enlist as a Raider and scavenge the surface to thrive in a desolate world. But beware of the machines. Beware of Raiders preying on others.

ARC Raiders blends the tension from extraction shooters with atmospheric settings from the adventure genre. Lurking threats—from deadly machines to other Raiders—create a constant ebb and flow of intensity, where every moment is charged with the thrill of high stakes. Extract valuable loot and explore the unfolding mysteries of a vibrant, lethal world.

ARC Raiders supports seamless social play across PlayStation, Xbox, and PC. Play with your squad and thrive as a team, or rise in the ranks as a lone ranger.

title: Coffee Break Mazes
description: Do you remember when our computers came preloaded with those very simple games, minesweeper, solitaire... That was nice, and I miss small, pleasant little digital diversions to click on absentmindedly during a break.

title: Romance Club
description:
An interactive visual novel game for mobile devices. Play your way through dozens of titles spanning several genres, including mystery, sci-fi, romance, and fantasy. Customize your character, choose your route, pursue your love interests, unlock full color images. But be careful -- the choices you make will affect your journey and your story's outcome!

Available on Apple Store and Google Play.

title: Roombattle
description:
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.
