Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!

title: Flannel Amethyst
description: Join Franka in Flannel Amethyst: a 3D platformer featuring ten different levels. Double jump and airdash your way through various levels and use your burst to reach greater heights!

title: Glory Hunters
description: Glory Hunters is an innovative action-adventure RPG designed for the original GameBoy. It introduces a distinctive and original gameplay twist: progression is driven by earning achievements.

title: The Intruder
description: Uncover the chilling secrets of 'The Intruder.' Navigate a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking darkness. A suspenseful horror-adventure that tests your survival instincts.

title: Jump Challenge!
description:
Jump Challenge! is an arcade game in which you must run away from the lava! To escape, you must face numerous obstacles such as spikes, shooting flowers, cacti, cannons, and much more! You can also race with your buddies or run away from lava together!

It's a platformer set in mines, castles, jungles, the sky and space! Your goal is to jump from one "level" to the next as high as you can.
And beat all the other players in this universe by getting the highest score! Good luck!

title: Galzoo Island
description: Leo is called a genius in using basic magic spells. But he is still learning the spells for monster capturing and he can't even tame weak monsters yet.One day he meets with a monster girl 'Captain Vanilla' and she teleports him to a mysterious island saying this will help him master his magic.

title: Snowy Path
description:
Explore and survive in a mysterious and cold mountain haunted by iroquois spirits.

Snowy Path is a solo adventure survival game on PC. It has been made by students at Gamagora in 4 months with the help of MAAAV and CPE students. This is a vertical slice of what the game could be if it had a longer development.

title: Gravitus Minus
description: Gravitus Minus is based on the classic gravity-based shooters from the 1980s and early 90s, such as Thrust, Solar Jetman and Gravitar.

title: Albedo
description: Use your own voice to survive against terrifying encounters with something beyond the human.

title: No Internet Connection
description: A remake of the classic browser game.

title: Cave Story's Secret Santa
description: After Balrog recovers the Christmas presents that were stolen by Chaba, the cowardly Mimiga named Santa must sneak into every house and return the missing packages. Be the Mimiga Who Saves Christmas!

title: Commuting
description: Commuting is a racing game in which you roll your way back home after countless hours of stressful work.

title: Hellcoming
description: Hellcoming is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players, who need to clean large areas from hellish abomination with the help of special tools.

title: AquaNautic: Underwater Submarine Simulator
description: Explore the deep sea and collect resources, build new mines and other stations!

title: Until It's Undone
description: An eerie yet humorous anti-point-and-click.

title: A Lot of Asteroids
description: Multiplayer Retro Asteroids

title: Fantastic Keyboard Party
description: Is it possible to type 100 words? No.

title: Square Word: Christmas Edition
description: Help Santa’s cats to organize Christmas!

title: Covert: Order of the Vulture
description: Inspired by various 80s TV shows!

title: Long Long: A Snake Lies in the Past
description: Go on an epic long adventure puzzle with Long - the ridiculously long and always growing snake.

title: Khamsin
description: Contemplative bullet hell

title: They Come at Poop Time
description: Poop while fending off monsters.

title: Chaos Mansion
description:
Chaos Mansion is a point & click escape room puzzle game.

You will play the role of a sect´s prisoner. Waking up in a cell you must find the way to escape before the adepts come back and use you as a sacrifice to summon the mighty Cthulhu. Find the way to get out while discovering little narrative pills to know more about that crazy sect.

title: The Romance Theorem
description: An anti-dating sim exploring relationships and cycles of happiness.

title: Zombaliens
description: Zombaliens is a retro FPS with elements of immersive sim.

title: Afro Frog
description: What all the cool frogs are croaking about

title: A Flutter of Silicon Wings
description: Fly through a wonderous circuit board forest to collect colorful flowers in this 3D arcade game.

title: A Party for a Picky Porridge Picker
description: Help the three bears throw a last minute surprise birthday party for the picky Miss Goldilocks.

title: Lighthouse of Better Days
description: Lighthouse of Better Days is a parable of hope in a time of despair.

title: Rescue Squad Omega
description:
Rescue Squad Omega is a rogue like deck building game in space. For reasons still unknown, you are the last hope for the galaxy (the known parts anyways) and sent on a very special rescue mission. Fight your way through enemies of ever-increasing strength while picking up new crew members and capabilities along the way.

It's gonna be a hard journey, Captain!

title: Bob PicRoss: The Joy of Painting 2
description: Picross with Bob Ross!

title: By Day and Night
description: A short game designed to help the player recognize the stages of grief and provide a story in the process. You will play as Clara, a young woman who has lost both of her parents. You'll help her start a long awaited journey and meet characters who need her help to cope with their past.

title: A Good Day to Pie
description: Save the universe from the Evil Pie Stealing Gremlins!

title: Rocky Rhodes and the Cracked Case
description: Step into the shoes of Detective Rocky Rhodes and solve the mystery of the mysterious relic with the help of your partner Barbara and mentor Sullivan. The truth can be evasive - but for Rocky, he doesn't have a choice.

title: Noir Detective
description: 2D stealth game that takes place in 30’s Chicago.

title: Succubus Shop
description: You're a Succubus owning an Item Shop! Sell stuff and earn hearts.

title: Al'ulA
description:
First-person narrative puzzle game made by a team of French students!
In Al’ulA you play as Mariam, a moroccan astronomer that just lost her mentor. One day while studying, she discovers a strange cube, a prototype created by a strange Entity.
You will manipulate the room around you using the alien Artefact : turn, rotate and twist the environment to your will and pierce the secrets of a strange and unknown dimension!

Think, Rotate, Escape

title: The Five Gods of Kung Fu
description: Five Gods of Kung Fu is a story driven Beat 'em Up.

title: Bullet Express
description: Loot, Level up and Merge your guns to their ultimate form as you rush through the Bullet Express!

title: Copycat: Cee Ann
description: Copycat: Cee Ann is an action platformer with RPG elements, featuring a feline protagonist named Cee Ann. Players navigate through various stages, combining speed and combat while mastering environmental challenges. The game offers a skill point system that allows players to switch between abilities, crafting their own playstyle as they progress. As Cee Ann, players can customize their approach to each scenario, building their character's capabilities throughout the adventure.

title: The Plane Game
description: Competitive arcade shooter with a changing name, unique art style and game feel!

title: Super Mega Bread
description: A bread-and-butter platformer where Bread Man must save his home from Dr. Yogurt. Bread Man can collect sticks of butter and then shoot them out to defeat enemies or boost through the air!

title: Everdawn
description: Everdawn is a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you create a beautiful and ever-growing landscape by placing tiles. Explore a variety of biomes, discover and unlock new tiles and complete quests to fill your world with life!

title: Amethyst Waters
description: Explore deep sea caverns with your submarine in this procedurally generated shoot 'em up.

title: ..And the Mooncats
description:
A simple sidescroller, controlled with two buttons only.

Created in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 34.

title: Dust Bunnies
description: Your usual First-Person Sweeper

title: Grepr
description: Cyberpunk stealth shooter.

title: Interminal
description: Procedural First-Person Shopper

title: Ylvar
description: Short adventure game about life and death with handpainted graphics

title: I Was cursed
description: I Was cursed is an exploration experience in which you learn to take your time and enjoy looking around you.

title: On the Roadside
description: On the Roadside is a turn-based ASCII strategy game in which you take control of a squad of mercenaries fighting for survival in a world shaped by unknown forces.

title: Unsigned Character
description: Dynamic platformer with ASCII art and procedural generation. The game takes place in an endless dungeon filled with various opponents. Move deeper, destroy everything in its path.

title: Subterranean Detectives Orin and Satori
description: Touhou Project point-and-click fangame

title: Code Dungeon
description: Code Dungeon is a short atmospheric dungeon crawler hack-n-slash game where you fight your way up a tower through hordes of enemies. Designed to be accessible to people with low vision or no vision.

title: Little Heroine Playset
description: Little Heroine Playset is a Touhou Project fangame.

title: More of a Kind
description: A 3D puzzle platformer where you help the Flandres get to the goal. But their number keep on increasing. Move multiple Flandres at the same time using ASWD keys. If one of your Flandres falls, you lose the game. You can also use the left and right arrows to orbit the camera (sometime looking at a different angle is the key to solving a puzzle).

title: Space Danger: G.O.N.
description: Intergalactic awesomeness...... Exploring, missions (well.........just 2 missions), shedloads of pew-pew, 3 different guns, 4 different races and etc....

title: Oink Royale
description: Bankrupt the evil piggy banks!

title: Crossroads of Fate
description: Experience the game through eleven different heroes: Powerhouse, Wildcard, The Showoff, Paladin and many more with their unique strengths and special moves! Customize, level up and equip your hero with a massive array of options and skill charts as you delve into the mysteries. With hundreds of side quests and adventures, the story and challenges never end. Discover new items and rewards as you dive into the mysteries of Ur.

title: Building 37
description: A Noir Investigation

title: Candle Prick
description: Puzzle game about using your enemies as extensions of yourself

title: We Need the Sun
description: You need to reach the sun... Explore 16 randomly appearing levels on a quest to reach the sun, racking up scores through collecting coins... One problem though, you can only move by jumping. That means only one method of transport and one goal.

title: Your Blue Room
description: A real-time based horror game.

title: An Aware Guy in the Past
description: Welcome to the future! Our civilization has advanced to a new stage in evolution! Cars now fly and houses look like UFOs! It's amazing! But also very boring... that's why you go back to the past because life was just better back then. But of course, with you comes all the knowledge of your time, and it may have some consequences...

title: The Silence
description: Dive into the dark depths of an abandoned hospital in "The Silence", a thrilling single-player horror game. Alone and abandoned, you awaken in a gloomy corridor, surrounded by crumbling walls and an oppressive feeling of isolation. But the silence is deceptive because you are never truly alone. A sinister presence stalks you, watching your every move from the shadows.

title: The Furniture of Self
description:
The Furniture of Self is an autobiographical VR game about identity and self. Explore my room, create your identity and find out about my own.

This game is the product of a year of studying the topics identity and self. It tries to visualize the process of building ones own identity and exploring a given identity.

Everything you touch will become a part of your self and you cannot let go anymore. Your body is not able to interact with the surrounding, only your identity can do so.

While exploring the room and its contents stories about myself will be unlocked, which are attached to the items in the room.

title: Wildland: Initial Attack
description: Stamp out fires with your friends using planes, helicopters, and your hands in a huge beautiful world. Customize your character. Play online or LAN. Save towns, people, animals, and the forest. Build your base to get better tools and vehicles. Jump into the fiery abyss as a smokejumper and see if you can survive!

title: An Ode to Todd the Toad: Frogcare!
description:
Be a frog mom! Play with your frogs in the nest mode. Name them, give them outfits, and let them play with the toys they found!

Protect your frogs in The Maze! With 1 or 2 players on keyboard, or a bunch of players on gamepad, smack away the wasps while your frogs eat flies. Don't let the wasps get to them!

title: Love Delivery
description: This games is about starting a relationship while working delivery job!

title: The Slaverian Trucker
description: The Slaverian Trucker is a Survival/Truck/Life simulator game. Make enough money to survive and expand your wealth in the harsh semi-post apocalyptic lands of Slaveria, doing legal and illegal work, while maintaining, fixing, building, repairing, tuning your trucks, cars and other vehicles.

title: Godfall: Challenger Edition
description: Instantly unleash Godfall’s power! Godfall Challenger Edition immediately unlocks a maximum level Valorplate, spoils you with skill points, and equips you with a spread of deadly weapons. Challenge all three end-game modes Lightbringer, Dreamstones, and the Ascended Tower of Trials. Vanquish your enemies and be rewarded with loot worthy of a true Valorian. Loot and slash in up to 3-player matchmade co-op to show your skill, perfect your build, and smash your enemies.

title: Twitter Island
description:
Find yourself or make new friends as you explore an island filled with 10,000 birds.

A short project by Daniel Linssen to celebrate reaching 10,000 Twitter followers and to say thank you very much to all of them.

title: Afterimage
description: Reveal the hidden secrets of a fantasy land in Afterimage! Explore the magnificent landscapes and ruins of an ancient metropolis, meeting mysterious colossal beings and adorable roaming spirits along the way. The thrilling adventure of this marvelous 2D hand-drawn world awaits you!

title: Tales of Shadowland
description:
Explore a thrilling wide world full of adventure and danger. Gather materials, craft your weapons, improve your skills and conquer your enemies with a non-target realtime classless combat system, challenging monsters with player-driven economy. Tales of Shadowland is a medieval fantasy MMORPG with open PvP and PvE combat.
Get along with your friends and create a brand new adventure in this universe of mysteries.

title: 6 Degrees of Sabotage
description:
One hour ago, a bomb exploded at the mayor's rally.

We have gathered intelligence that implicates the Clockmaker as the mastermind behind the attack. However, the Gambler was seen placing the bomb at the rally. We believe the Clockmaker does not personally know the Gambler.

There is a network of saboteurs disguised among groups of innocent citizens. Bomb instructions were passed between multiple pairs of saboteur acquaintances.

Review the security tapes from today to track the note and uncover the saboteurs.

title: Unsolicited
description: Make the Acme Form-letter company stand out as the premier form-letter mailing service on earth.

title: Strip Fighter 5: Chimpocon Edition
description: 22 eccentric fighters battle for supremacy in a mysterious underground fighting competition! Brimming with tongue-in-cheek humor, excess violence, and wanton titillation...re-experience a classic age of gaming with this love filled tribute to hardcore fans of 90's era 2D fighting games!

title: Lost Alone EP.1: Little Sister
description: Growing up with his paternal grandmother after his father was arrested for murdering his mother, George emerges from the spiral of alcohol addiction by meeting his fiancée Hanna. But his childhood traumas will soon return to haunt him, pushing him into the abyss of despair.

title: 4-Lung Boy
description:
A week after moving to a small town, you are confronted by frustration, an astronaut, and striped siblings...

4-Lung Boy is a short point & click adventure story, designed and illustrated by Anatola Howard (maroonracoon) & put into motion by denzquix

title: This Panda Needs You
description: Help panda re-stack her building blocks blown over by the wind with your block stacking and problem solving!

title: Fat Slice 2
description: Slice up shapes with your mouse or finger, reach the goal size, avoid bouncing balls, bombs and impenetrable walls. Better your score and earn achievements.

title: Pixel Driver
description: Fast paced infinite driving in heavy traffic.

title: Cloud Serpent
description: An easy-to-learn puzzle game where you can't stop moving. Collect all the orbs and get to the exit without crashing into anything. Wrap around the map to get to hard-to-reach locations and discover new challenges in each zone.

title: Team Hogus: GHAMEMFAIFTH OTHIYLTIM
description: Team Hogus is a minigame compilation where you go through a series of short minigames that go over a story-line styled after a cheesy action movie. Play as both heroes and villains through a variety of tasks, from tasks as cool as blasting away at robots to tasks as mundane as stirring a cup of coffee.

title: Dungeon Universe
description: Dungeon Universe is an upcoming fantasy MMORPG where players connect their gaming enthusiasm with latest blockchain technology. It's an open seamless world that allows for endless possibilities. You can explore the world, participate in trading, complete dungeons, quest and much more.

title: Lost Bubbles: Sweet Mates
description: Control the soap, move, and dash to get to the soap holder. However, each time the soap is moved, its durability is reduced by friction with the floor. Please reach the soap holder before it loses its durability.

title: The Invisible Guardian
description: The Invisible Guardian is a live-action interactive video experience, take part in the spy wars during the troubled times of the Chinese resistance war against Japan. Gain insight, turn the tide, and your choices will give birth to hundreds of life and death stories!

title: BBQ Simulator: The Squad
description: BBQ Simulator lets you experience what barbecue means which that most of the time messy ways. You have to feed your friends with well cooked meats before they pass out from hunger. You can play all the experiences with up to 8 friends in multiplayer mode or single player mode.

title: Garden
description: They came across a ghost with a dream like their own.

title: Warcos
description:
Warcos is an excellent real-time tactical command shooter game. Choose whom you want to be a SWAT soldier or Cartel member. Win fights, eliminate opponents, earn game money, increase your level and customize your equipment.
Play online with thousands of players in this multiplayer first-person shooter game as a solo or together with friends.
Plunge into the world of battles and victories. Assemble your team and fight till the end. Enjoy the game and improve your skills.

title: Cat Box Paradox
description: A fast paced retro platform game, you must think fast as you run, jump and swap colour, making your way through 8 floors of challenging and amusing colour changing mayhem.

title: Skeal
description: A short skiing game that features Seal, pleasure, and pain.

title: Molly and the Gunmids
description: A shoot 'em up / adventure full of drawings and sounds. There's one sound that's really annoying at one point, and that is the best sound in the game. Some of the drawings look as if they were drawn by a 1 year old baby. You can even explore a solar system and read a tiny book while fighting a sun demon.

title: Small Army
description: Its an FPS adventure game, with semi open world, where u take a control of Cobi soldier figurine. This game was supplied with Cobi Bricks.

title: Sengoku Rance: Limited Edition
description:
The limited edition comes with:
- Special Box Case
- 80 Page Manual Booklet
- Reversible DVD cover case
- Sengoku Rance game DVD
- Sengoku Rance OST CD
- Sengoku Rance Digital download card
- Kenshin Acrylic Keychain

title: Made of DIrt
description: I continue living this cyclical quiet life, but these strange yet familiar dreams of mine keep appearing...

title: King of the Dwarves: Underground City Builder
description: Build an epic kingdom inside a mountain in this underground city builder. Mine and build in a vast procedurally generated 3D world. Gather resources, research technology, train warriors and engineers, forge weapons, fight monsters and manage hundreds of units. Become the King of the Dwarves!

title: The Wreck
description: The Wreck is a mature 3D visual novel about sisterhood, motherhood, grief and survival. Follow failed screenwriter Junon as she attempts to make it through the most pivotal day in her life. Relive the past, alter the present, and embrace the future - or watch Junon's story end in a wreck.

title: Ryan's Rescue Squad
description: Rescue Ryan’s friends from Dark Titan and his evil allies! Explore four worlds packed with slime, hilarious characters, and unlockable costumes on an unforgettable platforming adventure!

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Dawn of Ragnarök
description: In the most ambitious expansion in franchise history, Eivor must embrace their destiny as Odin, the Norse god of Battle and Wisdom. Unleash new divine powers as you embark on a desperate quest through a breathtaking world. Complete a legendary Viking saga and save your son in the face of the gods’ doom.

title: Musicus!: Limited Edition
description:
Musicus! Limited Edition includes the following:
- Musicus!
- B2 Tapestry
- Dr. Flower Maxi-Single "Vintage Memories"

title: Let's Sing 2022 with German Hits: Platinum Edition
Rocket Bot Royale
description: A frantic Battle Royale set on a destructible, sinking Island. Fire rockets from your custom robo-tank to eliminate the competition using advanced tactics and powerful weapons.

title: Curious Expedition 2: Highlands of Avalon
description: The Highlands of Avalon DLC features a brand new island type (the Highlands) with new tile types, items, locations, enemies, and recruitable characters. Once the DLC is activated it will expand possibilities across the entire game, both in Campaign Mode and Director Mode.

title: World Turtles
description: A wholesome colony builder where you help Meeps save the life of the World Turtle they live on. Construct buildings, harvest resources, allocate and prioritise tasks, research and develop, and cooperate with other Meeps. And who knows? You may even meet others from different worlds.

title: Squad Battles: First World War
description: Squad Battles: First World War allows you to experience the technical and tactical advancements of that conflict, and the terrible battles that were carried out. Can you survive the horrific campaigns of the First World War?

title: Babble Royale
description: Babble Royale is an intense multiplayer free-for-all that combines word-making skill with fast-paced tactical and strategic action. Earn money and collect loot to upgrade your abilities, outrun the deadly hot zone, and outwit or outlast all your opponents to have the Last Word!

title: Marimoth
description: Marimoth is a short shoot 'em up that puts in control of a moth whose shots bounce off the walls. Calculate your aim, evade enemy attacks by learning their patterns and collect coins to power up.

title: Mon Bazou
description: Build your crappy vehicle into a race car, install the parts yourself. Make money by cutting wood, racing at night or delivering pizza. Maybe you want to manage a sugar shack or build yourself a big garage?

title: Average4k
description: Average4k is a Rhythm Game inspired by other four key rhythm games like Stepmania (Etterna), Quaver, and Osu! that allows you to play almost any chart format with your friends in an instant, you'll be able to drag and drop your folders and immediately play with an insanely customizable experience.

title: Match Three Pirates! II
description: Enjoy the great Match 3 Pirate Adventure. Form groups of three or more crabs, canons, steering wheels, explosives and other pirate items to unlock powerful boosters and complete all level goals. Use the right strategy, earn coins and build your own great theme park on Pirate Island.

title: Asteroids: Recharged
description:
The original space shooter warps to the modern era! Asteroids: Recharged has been reimagined for modern gameplay, with vibrant visuals, powerful new abilities, and another original soundtrack from award-winning video game composer Megan McDuffee.

Asteroids: Recharged creates a familiar, but revitalized and modern challenge to both old school and new high score chasers. And 30 unique and creative challenge levels take the space shooting game play into new territory, complete with local and global leaderboards.

title: The Well Speaks to Me
description:
The Well Speaks To Me is a horror game where a definitely normal girl does chores, lives their daily life and gathers water from a well.

You can't stop her from going insane, but you can enjoy the ride.
You live alone in the forest doing tasks to survive. Turn on the generator, chop the firewood, draw water from the well...

But appearances are deceiving, and not everything is as innocent as it seems. Why don't people really come to the forest? Was your family really killed in an accident? What is that thing outside the window? What really happened in the well?

Some of these questions will be answered. Some of them won't. But one thing's for sure: something's very wrong. And you're running out of time.

title: Scrapland Remastered
description: The cult game that marked MercurySteam's origins returns; a sci-fi adventure with memorable characters, powerful ships and humor! Enjoy intense Multiplayer battles and races with ships you build.

title: AiliA
description:
Ailia gets lost in a mysterious world.

She has no special power but going into the mirror and walking on the reflections.

Traveling through the maze, playing with reflections, revealing her past with the help of the mirror, her only friend in this world.

Try to use your understanding of mirror reflections to solve the puzzles and help Ailia find her way home.

AiliA is a tricky puzzle game where mirror reflections are made real. Manipulate mirrors and guide Ail through a stunning, reflected world to save her long lost "twin sister" Lia, who was captured inside a mirror.

title: Exo
description: Exo is a third person speed shooter action game where speed is the ultimate weapon. Build up speed by shooting and chaining high-velocity abilities on enemies to circle and run planet-to-planet.

title: Goody Bad Heroes
description: Goody Bad Heroes is a side-scrolling fight action platformer for only 1 player.

title: Dear Agent
description: Dear Agent is an action game with some thinking involved. It plays similarly to a typical platform game. As an agent, your job is to complete several missions, all of which involve killing all enemies (both humans that walk around randomly, and beasts that breathe fire when up close) and destroying all objects on a level, then getting to the teleporter.

title: The Timeless Child
description:
The Timeless Child is a 2-player puzzle-adventure coop game with first-person view.

Start an exciting and engaging adventure, a tale about family, bonds and secrets. You will explore Wells Manor, an ancient 16th century villa full of history and secrets, living the experience from two different temporal perspectives.
Whether you decide to take on the role of Chris Hunt, a skilled hunter on call, or Emily Wells, a child trapped in the past, you'll need to collaborate with your partner to solve puzzles that require cooperation and logic to be completed.

Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey to the borders of time and space to save Emily from her time captivity?

title: Stuck in Time
description: A unique mix of adventure and idle game. Plan and optimise your loops carefully and let the grind happen automatically. Explore this unique world, meet strange characters and escape the loop. A high-quality idle game that elevate the mechanics through an old school pixel-art adventure.

title: Sphaze
description: Find the path through labyrinths! Sphaze is a sci-fi puzzle game with beautiful vivid art created by an indie team from Poland! In Sphaze, you will manipulate impossible mazes and guide mysterious robots through stunningly beautiful worlds. Sphaze is a relaxing exploration through fantasy and sci-fi worlds. Guide the mysterious robots through different areas, solving arcade puzzles, challenging your reflex, and helping the energetic RoBeep.

title: Bitburner
description: Bitburner is a programming-based incremental game. Write scripts in JavaScript to automate gameplay, learn skills, play minigames, solve puzzles, and more in this cyberpunk text-based incremental RPG.

title: Fractal Fighter
description: Fractal Fighter is a shooting game, where the player's spaceship engages several large enemy ships in one-on-one combat. The enemy ships resemble a branching fractal; they are made of a core, out of which branch out several large lasers; out of the tip of every laser branch out several heat-seeking missile launchers, which further branch out into triple guns, and finally small weak guns.

title: The Design
description: The Design is a shooting game where the player simultaneously controls two circles, yellow and green, which can be freely moved in four directions around the screen. They can also shoot bullets outwards, along the line on which both circles lie.

title: Holey Hell
description: Try to stay alive as you run and jump deeper and deeper into the Holey Hell.

title: Skate or Don't!
description: Skate or Don't! is a massively multiplayer online arcade game.

title: Age Archives: 20th Box Edition
description:
Including the Bonus Story from Kimi ga Nozomu Eien ~Latest Edition~ named "Kanashimi wa Kaze no you ni" & 4 Bonus Titles.
Contains Vocal & Soundtrack CDs, 20th Anniversary Celebration Illustration Art, Fan Club Newsletter, Title Booklet & Sticker Set.

Age Maniax ~Isumi Yon Shimai Saigo no Hi~, Anonymous, Kaseki no Uta, Kimi ga Ita, Kisetsu ~Primary~, Kimi ga Nozomu Eien, Kimi ga Nozomu Eien Another Episode –, Kanashimi wa Kaze no Youni, Kimi ga Nozomu Eien ~Special Fan Disc~, Muv-Luv, Muv-Luv Altered Fable, Muv-Luv Alternative, Muv-Luv Alternative – Total Eclipse, Muv-Luv Alternative Chronicles Vol.1, Muv-Luv Alternative Chronicles Vol.2, Muv-Luv Alternative Chronicles Vol.3, Muv-Luv Alternative Chronicles Vol.4, Muv-Luv Photonflowers*, Owarinaki Natsu, Towa Naru Shirabe, Pikopiko ~Koisuru Kimochi no Nemuru Basho~, Rasen Kairou, Rasen Kairou 2, Schwarzesmarken and Shapeshifter.

title: Circus Electrique
description: Circus Electrique is part story-driven RPG, part tactics, part circus management, and completely enthralling - all with a steampunk twist. When everyday Londoners mysteriously turn into vicious killers, only the show's talented performers possess the skills necessary to save the city.

title: Mortal Kombat: Solano Edition
description: It is a good edition and compilation of several old school MKs with classic characters, stages, music and even brings editions of characters of the new MKs of current consoles and edits of characters not seen before

title: International Basketball Manager 22
description: Become the best basketball coach of the moment with International Basketball Manager 2022. Take your team to the pinnacle of the sport by managing all its day-to-day affairs with the seemingly endless array of management tools that the game offers you. Your team’s results will depend on you. Can you handle the pressure?

title: Too Many Santas!
description: A Christmas wish come true, or a holiday nightmare? The Santa Claus dating sim you can play all year round!

title: Aliisha: The Oblivion of Twin Goddesses
description: Play solo or team up with a friend and guide twin sisters Aisha and Lisha through a mysterious temple in the beautiful fantasy adventure Aliisha: The Oblivion of Twin Goddesses. In the game, Aisha and Lisha will be controlled in their own distinctive way, so that the players will enjoy the playing experience exclusive to themselves. Both players not only have to brainstorm to solve puzzles, but they also need to move around to pass one level and another in the ruins.

title: Afterlove EP
description: Afterlove EP is a slice-of-life adventure about love, loss and music. Explore modern Jakarta as Rama in his journey to learn about himself, create music, find love and come to terms with the loss of his girlfriend Cinta, whose voice still lives on in his head.

title: Let's Play! Oink Games
description: Wouldn’t it be great if we could play board games online even if we couldn’t meet in person? With Let's Play! Oink Games, you can play Oink Games' titles, Deep Sea Adventure, A Fake Artist Goes to New York, and more on your gaming console. You can play at home with your family, online with your friends, or test your skills against CPUs. Plenty of ways to play!

title: Baby Storm
description: Baby Storm is a cooperative party game. Watch over unpredictable kids as they unleash chaos in your kindergarten! Maintain order, run, clean and feed your way to the highest score, in solo or up to 4 players!

title: Gerda: A Flame in Winter
description: When the snow stops falling, the small Danish village of Tinglev will no longer be the same. Walk the path of Gerda as her quiet life is turned upside down during the World War 2 occupation of her home. Choose where to go, how to act, and who to trust in this intimate narrative RPG-lite experience inspired by real life events. How far would you go to protect your loved ones?

title: Turtle Head: Unmasked
description: A remake of the game Turtle Head (Originially by Pikasprey) created by Team Meatpie.

title: Sleepy Sheep
description: Welcome to the Dream World! Follow our protagonist Nicole Armatti as she gets to explore a place completely built off her own subconscious. Meet friends, foes, and explore a plethora of colorful settings as Nicole travels deeper and deeper into her own dreams.

title: There Will Be No Turkey This Christmas
description: Christmas is coming, and your goal is to spoil it! After all, you are the turkey! Hide in the barrel so you won't be seen by your enemies. Be stealthy! You are escaping, after all. Seek the keys to make your way to freedom and escape all 7 members of the Silva family. Pass through hidden tunnels in the house so the enemies do not see you! Collect items to make new skins available. Take on the 30 levels and win the challenge of not becoming a roast turkey.

title: Project Bore
description: Project bore is a Psychological-Horror RPG is about the story of a man trying to fight himself and his inner demons. Project Bore takes you through seven handcrafted levels with their own tailor-made songs. Project Bore was made as a sort of experiment on how a new approach on the traditional turn-based could lead to a different yet exciting experience.

title: Gloom Reducer
description: A wandering game with two endings.

title: 8-Bit Adv Steins;Gate
description: Experience the city of Akihabara completely re-imagined in an 8-bit world and solve mysteries as Okarin! When Okarin and his friends made the "Phonewave", they had no idea it would have the ability to send emails to the past and, as a result, change the present. Tragedy strikes as an organization behind a global conspiracy seeks to obtain their invention and threaten the fate of humanity! But even when the outcome changes, their fate ends in disaster time and time again... Faced with overwhelming despair, which future will Okarin choose? Change the past to save the future!

title: Picross S7
description: The seventh entry in the Picross S series adds more puzzles in the same familiar model, with the addition of touchscreen controls.

title: Wibble Wobble Multiplayer
description:
It's a wibbly wobbly world for four friends.

Collect stars to boost your score multiplier, jump on top of dead players to revive them, avoid hazards, stay alive and get a high score.

title: Pinball FX
description: Discover brand new exclusive tables created for Pinball FX, or find your favorites among more than 40 unique and visually enhanced favorites from Zen's extensive digital pinball library. Relive the most iconic moments from entertainment powerhouses like Indiana Jones, Star Wars, Marvel, Universal Studios, and many more. Enjoy accurate re-creations of the most famous pinball machines of all time with Williams Pinball, or have fun with Zen’s original creations.

title: Disney Melee Mania
description: Disney Melee Mania is a 3v3 arena brawler video game featuring Disney and Pixar characters. Each champion will appear in a distinct action-ready design equipped with their own set of iconic moves and unlockable

title: Five Nights at Sonic's Maniac Mania
description: Five Nights at Sonic's Maniac Mania is fan game made by SmilerFurcifier/PyroTheRapidFox, it is based of FNaF and it is a UCN.

title: Halloween Chronicles: Monsters Among Us
description: Do you have what it takes to save the town from an army of Halloween monsters before it’s too late?

title: Halloween Chronicles: Monsters Among Us - Collector's Edition
description: Do you have what it takes to save the town from an army of Halloween monsters before it’s too late?

title: Bit of War
description: An 8-Bit demake of God of War, this game is a love letter to both the series itself as well as old school gaming in general.

title: Você é um Defunto Mecânico
description: Você é um Defunto Mecânico is a short interactive fiction game about a deceased mechanic remembering how he died, and the tortured lives that are now left behind.

title: Life in Willowdale: Farm Adventures
description:
Welcome to Willowdale, your life of farming and adventure starts here!
The once thriving town of Willowdale is in ruins! The mayor’s business minded daughter Penny has seized the opportunity to transport this once pleasant place into a high-flying modern tourist destination. She doesn’t really like animals and thinks keeping livestock is dirty especially when you can import all these products easily from a nearby town. With humans and nature so out of balance… some of the animals felt abandoned and have already left. Is it too late to stop the changes set in motion by her?

Your uncle, mayor Moneybags calls for your help. Return to your family’s farm to help restore harmony between the people and nature! It is time to light the way for the lost people of the town by reigniting their passion and helping them appreciate the beauty of Willowdale!

title: Doctor Who: Worlds Apart
description: Doctor Who: Worlds Apart is a fast-paced trading card game set in the wide universe of the official Doctor Who series. Players create decks of cards made up of a wide variety of characters, items and phenomena and use these to do battle with opponents. Establish yourself as supreme with a Dalek-dominated deck or mix it up with a combination of Doctors and Cybermen, the choice is yours. All card artwork has been hand-drawn by our talented artists and approved by our official partners, the BBC.

title: Void Frame
description: Void Frame is a 2d platformer. Move,jump and dash ,through various sorts and varieties items, completed one and after levels,meet final boss and defeaut it.

title: Bouncy Bunnies
description: Race against your friends in a colorful platform world. Take the boost to run faster or find the shortest path to be the first bunny to reach the goal. Choose between 8 different levels. Collect carrots to get higher score!

title: The Great Circle
description: The Great Circle is an open world animal survival experience set in an African wildlife preserve.

title: Mending Wall
description: A game inspired by a poem, and intended for two players—but playable solo.

title: PhasR
description: Survive the treacherous tubular highway, dodging grey blocks and phasing through colored ones. You may go far, but the road is endless...

title: All Hams on Deck!
description: Bounce that ham! 50+ pigs to acquire! Aim for the highest score you can!

title: Dungeonblade: Haunted Kingdom
description: A text adventure game where you explore a "living" dungeon, defeating otherworldly beasts and avoiding deadly traps on a journey to discover the legendary Golden Coins and defeat the Necromancer.

title: Toy Kingdom 2
description:
Fast-paced, relentless first-person combat sandbox game full of magic and dinosaurs in a 3D procedural generated world.

Play as an action figure that has landed in a mysterious world. Gain the ability to harness the power of lightning, fight back against hordes of Velociraptors and other deadly creatures. Play your own way, at your own pace. Collect all the protons to win!

title: O o o
description: Air hockey but you control both players. Keep the puck from touching bad stuff to rack up points!

title: PepaFatal
description: In PepaFatal you play as Pepa the toilet paper. Trying to survive the endless panic buying from several hands trying to grab you. Dodge hands, obstacles by rolling and jumping.

title: Can't Let Go
description: Can't Let Go is a 2d narrative platformer. Connect with the heart and mind of the protagonist and help them work through a tough part of their life with simple timing-based gameplay.

title: Attraction
description: Attraction is a game about the search for answers. You are a friendly explorer robot, searching for answers in a far away planet. Discovering hidden items, dialogues and upgrades. Harness the power of the cosmos with your matter gun in this clever and minimalist adventure-puzzle-platformer.

title: Jollibee's: Phase 1
description:
20 years after the incident (aka, in 2037), the player (Justin Smith) is working the night-shift at Jollibee's. Every night, you must keep track of the animatronics to stop them from getting in your office. You must check the cameras to locate them. On the cameras, you can check for them throughout the building and in the vents by clicking the "CHANGE FLOOR" button. Aside from checking the cameras, you must shut vents, "close" lights, and flash your light to keep them away. There is a vent to your left, a door in front of your desk, and a window to your right. The vent and window require flashing the light to keep the characters from getting you into trouble. However, the door requires shutting the lights off so they think the office is an empty room.

You will have to defend yourself from five characters as the nights progress. The first animatronics active are Yum, Hetty, and Twirlie.

title: Jollibee's: Phase 2
description:
The player plays/works as an employee of the shipping company, LBM Shipments, Inc. (LBM Shipments Inc Warehouse). Their job is to transport boxes each night shift. To do this, they must use the workstation panel on the left side of the office that controls the conveyor belts and security systems. On the first night, 50 boxes must be transported to their respective conveyer belts. The boxes and tracks are labelled by a letter (A, B, C, D, and E). To transport them, the player needs to click and drag the node to the other corresponding side. The number of boxes increases by 25 boxes each new night, reaching its maximum of 100 boxes on Night 3. It is recommended to keep track of the box/track labels, otherwise errors will be added to the counter on the bottom left corner of the area on the screen. Errors are counted when a box is ignored or misplaced. If the player gets 1 error, 50$ will be removed from the paycheck at the end of the night. The maximum amount of errors the player can get is 15. If any more are added, the result will be a GAME OVER screen.

The workstation panel also contains four tabs: Motion Detect, Cameras, Audio, and Hack. These systems decrease their stability the more you use them. The less the stability is, the higher the chance it can go offline. However, there is a maintenance panel at the right side of the office to reboot them. It takes about 3-5 seconds to reboot any system.

title: Brutal Orchestra
description: Brutal Orchestra is a turn-based roguelike strategy game. You died, someone killed you. You are now in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with the "demon" Bosch and set off into this bastardous world finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get petty revenge.

title: Elevator
description: 电梯 Elevator is a first-person psychology horror puzzle game. You woke up in an malfunctioned elevator and found yourself trapped in the floors of a different era. Find your way to escape.

title: Sex
description: Sex, released for the PC-98 in 1995, is a game about sex, not to be confused with "Sex", another game about sex, also released in 1995 but for the 3DO.

title: Sex 2
description: Sex 2 has the same basic premise as its predecessor, which is easy to deduce from the game's title. It's all about engaging in the titular pleasurable activity, and doing it in various "creative" ways. Unlike the first Sex, there is only one girl in Sex 2: Ayaka, the cute flower-raising character from Satyr, another game by the same company.

title: Overlord: Escape from Nazarick
description:
The rich world of Overlord is yours to explore in this robust, story-driven Metroidvania.
Play as fan-favorite Clementine and delve into an entirely new chapter in the Overlord series, brought to life under the supervision of the original creator, Kugane Maruyama.
Whether you’re new to the series or a diehard fan, there will be plenty for you to discover and enjoy in this dark fantasy action-adventure that ensnares you in a web of intrigue in typical Overlord fashion.

title: Baba Yaga
description: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

title: Another Day in Paradise
description: Play with 5 characters, find the clues and reveal the mystery of that October 24th. You will explore the places and survive terrifying rituals, the astral world is waiting for you. A story that mixes adventure and terror in equal parts.

title: Collateral Thinking DX
description: Collateral Thinking DX is an arcade-style action platformer that's all about beating up alien ghosts and recovering blueprints on a tight schedule (and budget) to save the true victims - billionaires!

title: The Forgotten Caves of Foolish Linger
description: A short (45-60 minutes) 2D platformer game, about a little creature who needs to leave dark caves. Climbing your way up, you'll meet some of it's residents and you'll need to face obstacles that will try to keep you in the darkness of this hollowed place.

title: Baby Labor
description: An absurd workplace tragedy. You hire a baby. What can go wrong?

title: Martial Cards
description: You signed up for the biggest martial-arts challenge in history! In a gauntlet beyond example, contestants from all around the world face myriads of artificial monstrosities to find out who can deal with them performing the most stylish and efficient combos. There’s a twist though - you can only move in accordance with the hand of cards you’re holding. Ah, there’s nothing like the beautiful arbitrariness of game rules...

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Through Daybreak II
description: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Through Daybreak II is the twelfth installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of The Legend of Heroes: Trails Through Daybreak. An unexpected visit to the Arkride Solutions Office puts Spriggan Van Arkride to the matter. As Van searches for the culprit behind the accident, Agnès Claudel continues her search for the eighth and last Oct-Genesis.

title: Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center
description: Join Queen Amidala and Boss Nass as they lead the people of Naboo and the Gungans in a fun-filled celebration. Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center is a playful introduction to the world of Star Wars, designed for young learners. It provides a learn through play experience in a celebratory setting, featuring open-ended and directed play set in two exciting cities. Showcase your talents in music, dance and puppetry. Improve skills in sequencing, sorting, classifying, and following directions.

title: Star Wars: Jar Jar's Journey Adventure Book
description: An interactive tale with fourteen animated pages, Jar Jar's Journey is a CD-ROM designed to immerse children ages 4 and up in the exciting story of Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace. In this adventure book, children will read along with Jar Jar, Queen Amidala, Anakin Skywalker, and Qui-Gon Jinn as they follow Jar Jar on his exciting adventure from the Naboo swamp to Tatooine.

title: Bopping Drive
description: Strive to be the top driver as you combo your way through! Soar across the city's skyline as you leap between rooftops and smash weapon-wielding robots! Scrape your way to the next finish line in this modern golden-age styled arcade platformer.

title: Queen Sized
description: MS-Paint styled, RPG Roguelike about matresses

title: Tabbers
description: Craft, Build, and Explore while experiencing the peaceful weather and environment as you explore your new home - in the sky!

title: Moonlaw
description: Moonlaw is a mini-micro-metroidvania about a heroic knight's adventure to destroy a horrible monster on the moon!

title: Astlibra: Living Proof
description: ASTLIBRA -Living proof- is a side scrolling 2D action RPG. It contains various reinforcement elements, exhilarating combat, rare equipment, battles with huge bosses, beautiful art, and long story. Estimated playtime: 40+ hours

title: Astlibra Mini Side Story: Cave of Genghiri
description: Astlibra Mini Side Story: Cave of Genghiri is a side story of Astlibra: Living Proof, a side-scrolling 2D action RPG. It features a variety of enhancements, exhilarating combat, rare equipment, battles with huge bosses, beautiful art, and a short storyline. Estimated playing time: 15+ hours

title: Christmas Horror
description:
Merry Christmas!

Santa Claus is ready to take over your soul and gain a few more years of life. He only needs two days to get all the resources he needs for the ritual, so this is your time to escape!

You can escape on your own or finish off Santa, it's up to you, but we don't know how to finish him off yet... Just make sure he don't catch you or he will just make your life difficult.

Technical details:
Christmas Horror is a short horror FPS (first-person-shooter) game where you must find a way to escape Santa's house using the scattered items around. You have two ways of escaping and even a way to finish santa forever! As a child, you have severe limitations such as carryng only 1 item per time and of course, being slowly than Santa. The game has no save system, so you just have one chance to escape.

Good Luck and remember, be a nice child and maybe he forgives you.

title: F1 Circus Special: Pole to Win
description: F1 Circus Special is a Formula 1 racing game. Players can choose between a world championship mode, which follows the path of one driver through the game's available courses in a linear fashion; a test drive mode, which allows players to choose any course as well as change rules and conditions (e.g. the amount of damage inflicted); and a time attack mode for competing against each other.

title: Cyberfrags '69
description: Move fast and shoot fast in Cyberfrags '69. Double jump, wall-run, and blast your way to victory in intense PvP and Co-Op, or play as Cyber-Frank as he slaughters the Cyber-Nazis invading his home! It's time to get your blood up with some lightning-speed FPS action! Double-jump, wall-run, slide, and shoot your way to victory in PvP, Co-op, and single-player. In CF69, the fastest way to die is to stop moving. So don't.

title: Jumpstart Spy Masters: Unmask the Prankster
description: JumpStart Spy Masters: Unmask the Prankster is the first-half of the JumpStart Spy Masters series & the predecessor to JumpStart Spy Masters: Unmask the Prankster.

title: Crazy Zen Codeword
description: It's codeword! The classic pen and paper puzzle. In this translation from paper to screen, animated highlights make it is easier to read the state of the board and autofill makes it much quicker to try out different letter combinations. Simply use the letter picker to fill in the grey blanks and find as many words as you can to complete the board! Remember that every letter used can only be used once, so choose wisely. Crazy Zen Codeword. For the wordsmiths, English Language enthusiasts, and boredom fighters alike!

title: Celerity
description: Celerity is a fast-paced, first person parkour game. Use Wall Running, Grappling Hooks, Hookshots and many more, chain your moves and never lose momentum.

title: Xuxa e os Duendes 2: No Caminho das Fadas
description: Play with Xuxa! Have fun in this enchanting world and fight to keep love in passionate hearts. Be Kira, the Elf of Light, and battle witches and trolls to break the spell of Witch Algaz in the Witches' Castle.

title: Brick Hill
description: Brick Hill is an online User-generated content (UGC) sandbox game where users can purchase virtual items with virtual currencies, build with bricks in a voxel style 3D building environment, play on multiplayer servers, and make use of the in-site forum

title: Lost Alone Ep.2: Daddy
description:
George's mind journey continues in Lost Alone EP. 2 - Daddy.

George wakes up in a house that is familiar to him. He doesn't know what year it is. He doesn't know how he got into that house. Time and space lose all meaning. As his memory begins to come together, he realizes that he has ended up in his worst nightmare: his childhood!

title: King Rabbit: Race
description:
Hop quickly through deadly obstacle courses and get further than the other rabbits to win! Catchy gameplay and competitive leaderboards will have you playing just one more round. Earn trophies to rank up and face more challenging opponents! Are you skilled enough to place in the top 10 of the daily challenge? A new daily challenge level is generated daily. You'll be exercising your precision, speed, coordination, and memory. Use the arrow keys or WASD to move and hop your way to victory. Invite & follow your friends to race with them!

Includes an in-game marketplace is where you can buy and sell rabbit skins and rings! Rabbit skins are limited to only 100 of each design. With tons of rabbits and new ones being added, you're sure to find something your style. Decorate your rabbits with rings for unique spawn and death sound effects and particles. Complete quests for soft currency and encounter rare items on encounter islands.

title: God Damn the Garden
description: God Damn the Garden challenges you to face the trial of Skeleton Bastard, which tests whether or not you're worthy of becoming the next king of Badass Heaven.

title: Touhou Diablo 2: Gensokyo Treasure Hunting
description: Embark on an adventure with a ton of Touhou characters! From your airship base, explore various areas where you can fulfill Nazrin's quests and acquire new equipment in this action RPG.

title: Chameneon
description:
Run, jump and dodge! Chameneon is a 2D Runner with unique physics that create a great challenge!

Switch the neon colors and surf your way to the end. A powerful virus has infected the Cyber Space and now is up to you to control a manual message called CHAMENEON.

Collect the Neon Disks to show everyone who's boss. With simple gameplay and tons of stages to go throgh, you will be tested to the limit!

So what are you waiting for? It's your time to shiny!

title: Infinite Fleet
description: Explore a vast procedurally generated galaxy in which the narrative is directed entirely by you, the players. In Infinite Fleet, you are a commander within the United Sol Federation Combined Fleet, a military organization tasked with defeating the merciless Atrox alien threat. Build and customize your fleet, secure territory, traverse the deep recesses of space, and join forces with your friends to turn the tide of the war.

title: Witch Explorer
description:
Witch Explorer is a game which features a mix of both shoot 'em up and tower defense gameplay.
You play as the witch Tia, who is on a teasure-hunt in order to remove her debt and improve her magic shop.
The goal of the game is to defeat waves of monsters by both strategically placing units on the map, and by flying around on the map while shooting and dodging projectiles and enemies yourself.

title: Botzin!!!
description: BOTZIN!!! is a free turn-based ballistic strategy game that aims to defeat other robots from different teams.

title: MegaMacho Oco
description: MegaMacho Oco is a parody platformer based on the Megaman franchise and the gay pornographic movie 'Ursos Grandes, Peludos e Mansos', it also features various Brazilian memes as enemies.

title: Lost on Jupiter
description:
A 2D side-scrolling survival base-building survival game!

Explore the unknown lands inside of the gas giant, Jupiter.
Expand and build a base of operations for safety.
Exploit the new mineral to fuel and create your machines.
Exterminate the growing horde of enemies as they outnumber you more and more every day.

title: Tiny Stories: Santa Closes
description: Santa Closes is a short point & click adventure in which you take on the role of an Elf whose sole mission is to save Christmas with is friend Pingui... but those poor devil will soon find how hard spreading that holiday cheer can be.

title: Rettend: File 1
description: A text based adventure game. In Rettend - File #1 you will solve puzzles and collect photographs.

title: Beppo's Hole in One Golf
description: A 2D top-down golf game featuring 9 holes of golf.

title: Feisty Heist
description: Enjoy a throwback to the game design of yonder year, as you rob a bank for every dollar it has! Grid based movement lets you carefully plan your approach, but watch out for a security system that is constantly upgrading to try and stop you!

title: The Veil of Mystery: Seven Little Gnomes
Dark Interval
description: Dark Interval is a restoration/revision mod that lets you play Half-Life 2 as it could have been. Using Valve's early concepts, we're creating new maps, models, textures, and custom dialogue. The mod is released in episodes, the most recent being Dark Interval: Part I - an intro chapter to the bigger story.

title: Sonic Galactic
description:
Sonic Galactic is a 2D fan-game inspired by the Classics. Taking a more "Saturn" approach with its art direction, Galactic aims to be a sort of continuation to where the classics left off. Aiming to follow the classics, Galactic features new zones, brand new sprites, and a new character! This energetic mole is more than willing to join the team in their battle against Dr. Eggman!

This has been a fan-game under the works for about 3 years, and is currently using Hatch Game Engine, an engine built from the ground up with accuracy perfectly replicating the classics.

title: The Warmth Between Us
description: The Warmth Between Us is a visual novel. It's a story about the warmth between people. It was a simple act that brought us together but became a life-defining moment, affecting the choices we make.

title: The Two of Us
description: The Two of Us is a 2D Co-op Platformer that has a strong emphasis on working together. You will be greeted with various puzzle levels where you must work in conjunction with your friend to navigate the level. The game is complete with 2D Animations, Sound Effects and PvE Combat.

title: Cryonauts
description: MMO action Sci-fi game set in the future year of 2069 where you play as a cybernetic robot to eliminate other robots that represent Biomorph defence system, gameplay take place in Egypt near an ancient temple complex along the Nile river.

title: Wukong
description:
A small and colorful platformer, inspired by the "Journey to the West" novel. Every level contains a new mechanic that will explore new ways to use your skills.
In Wukong you play as the Monkey Key in a quest to retrieve the lost scrolls. Jump, spin, throw your staff, and step on the enemies that will try to put an end to your journey.

title: Mace: Mapinguari's Temple
description: Mace: Mapinguari's Temple is a multiplayer, horror game with adventure and social deduction elements. Venture into a maze-like, procedurally generated dungeon filled with puzzles, avoid the terrible creature that roams it's corridors and discover who is the deceitful cultist among you.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season X - Highlanders
description: Battle for the heart and soul of the Highlands in Season X: Highlanders, based on the rich history and legends of Scotland. Season X features three unlockable Highlander units with several new mechanics, a siege map based on the lush green valleys of Scotland, treasure to be earned from the Battle Pass, and so much more.

title: Scavenger of Dunomini
description: A mix of match-3 and tower-defense in a post-apocalyptic setting, where you have to protect and recycle your trash-pit!

title: Gardener's Path
description:
An immersive 2D puzzle experience about sustaining natural harmony.

Gardener’s Path is a top-down turn-based puzzle game, about fighting giant insects and protecting underground gardens.

Fulfill your duty as a gardener, and fight against the pest of giant insects, to protect the ones you love.

title: Crystal Clash
description: Crystal Clash is a hybrid of MOBA, tower defense and deckbuilding - with fast-paced, easy-to-pickup tug-of-war strategy. Play 2v2 or co-op with a friend, or pair up with new allies and enemies for action-packed battles! Collect cards, build your decks and have fun crushing your enemies!

title: Grid:Locked
description: Grid:Locked is a city building puzzle game, with an interactive world, varied optional game mechanics - like driving, platforming, collectible hunting - and an engaging narrative.

title: Grimscape
description: Open world deck building game set in RPG style fantasy setting

title: MayuShoot
description: Mayushoot is a 2002 doujin horizontal shooter game created by Harukaze. The game contains several Ukagaka characters to play as, the main one being Mayura.

title: Exsanguinate
description: Exsanguinate is an indie survival horror game with challenging puzzles and AI. Play as Matthew Barker and explore an abandoned mansion located in the mountains of Black Ridge. Solve the riddle of what has happened there.

title: Nebulous: Fleet Command
description: Take command of your hand-tailored fleet of space warships and use realistic radar, electronic warfare, advanced movement controls in 3D space, and precision targeting to outmaneuver and outwit your opponents in a simulation-heavy tactical space game like no other.

title: Gordon Streaman 2
description: Gordon Streaman 2 - a new story and personality! Become a media giant in the streamer world! Join the best team, take part in a challenge and leave your opponents behind!

title: Jane: Anyone can be Scared
description: Experience an atmospheric horror game inspired by some very precious first-person point & click games of the 90's: Shivers, Myst, Byzantine the Betrayal and RAMA. Old-style graphics and an original soundtrack will bring you to a place where normal life isn't always safe.

title: Hotel Transylvania: Scary-Tale Adventures
description: Hotel Transylvania: Scary-Tale Adventures is a 3D platform adventure that will take players on a fairy tale journey, putting them in control of their favorite characters as the game re-imagines classic stories, such as “Little Red Riding Hood” and “The Emperor’s New Clothes.”

title: Super Bombinhas
description: A colorful retro 2D platformer, open source and created by a solo developer. Includes a story mode with 36 carefully designed levels and a level editor.

title: Call of Saregnar
description: Call of Saregnar is a nod to the era of party-based RPGs from the 90's. Follow an intriguing story with interesting characters in a unique low-fantasy medieval setting. Enjoy a lush handcrafted 3D world that just begs to be explored. The graphics are charmingly old-school with billboard trees and a low-poly 3D world. All the characters are photographs and frame sequences of real actors, that you can interact with, see them in the world, and fight with. The combat system is a turn-based hex grid affair with many tactical options.

title: Zero Comico
description:
Zero Comico is an Italian video game featuring three famous Italian comedians: Aldo Giovanni and Giacomo as the main characters.

The player is in control of all three characters as they try to free the world from an evil force that has taken control over mankind through television.
The game features a variety of puzzles with a comedy theme.

title: QuizPoker: Mix of Quiz and Poker
description:
Put your knowledge of various topics to the test or bluff your way to victory!

QuizPoker combines poker and quiz elements. Unlike poker, however, QuizPoker does not deal cards, but asks guessing questions to which each player gives an answer.

title: Vegas Tales
description: A wealthy resort owner is dying and needs you to help him decide who should inherit his estate. You'll be interviewing some over-the-top characters and helping decide which of them most deserves to become extremely wealthy. Be careful, as there may be more to some than meets the eye.

title: Half-Life 2: Calamity
description: Half-Life 2 calamity is an exciting and heavily beta-tested new addon to the Half Life universe. Battle the violent combine regime, obliterate zombies and Xen creatures, and learn even more knowledge surrounding the rise of Earth's benefactors. Calamity is around 1-2 hours of solid gameplay filled with tense combat scenes and puzzling conundrums mixed within the deteriorating setting of one of Earths last thriving cities - City 17. Explore a hidden story twist in the climax of the mod, and enjoy every minute of the exploration and fighting.

title: Flipping Beat
description: Flipping Beat is an intense rhythm game where you blow up the beats of adrenaline-pumping music as they fly towards you, surrounded by an abstract world.

title: Call of the Sea: Journey Edition
description:
Call of the Sea is a first-person adventure puzzle game set in the 1930's that tells the story of Norah, a woman on the trail of her missing husband's expedition. The search takes place on a strange but beautiful island in the South Pacific, filled with secrets waiting to be unearthed. It’s an otherworldly tale of mystery, adventure, and self-discovery.

The Journey Edition of Call of the Sea includes:
- Game: Call of the Sea
- Box Collector
- Billet De Voyage
- 2 Photographies
- Concept Art
- 3 x Lithographies
- Disque Vinyle
- Poster
-Artbook

title: Let's Sing 2022: Platinum Edition
description: Grab your microphone for the best singing game experience with Let’s Sing 2022 Platinum Edition! This includes a copy of the Let’s Sing 2022 game and the Let’s Sing 2022 Song Pass which allows you to sing all of the DLC Content!

title: The King of Fighters XV: Omega Edition
description:
The King of Fighters XV: Omega Edition includes:
- Main game
- Three lithographs
- Soundtrack
- 119-page artbook
- Special slipcase
- Team Pass 1 (Team DLC 1 and Team DLC 2)
- Terry "Garou: MotW" DLC costume
- Leona "Classic Leona" DLC costume

title: Neptunia: Sisters vs. Sisters - Special Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Hyperdimension Neptunia: Sisters vs. Sisters
- Limited Edition Box
- Note from Nepgear
- 52-page Visual Book
- Soundtrack CD
- Nepgear and Uni Lovey-Dovey Poster

title: Arcade Archives: Orius
description: Orius is a shooting game released by Konami in 1991. Pilot the cutting-edge fighter craft, Flintlock, and solve the mystery of what happened on planet E-Square. In this game, in addition to your usual shots, you can use the mysterious Flint life form for attack and defense.

title: Titan Quest: Eternal Embers
description: Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain.

title: Granblue Fantasy: Versus - Legendary Edition
description:
Embark on a new fight, O champions of the skies! Take a ringside seat for this brawltastic work! An exciting new title in the Granblue Fantasy series is finally revealed! Featuring stunning visuals, heart-pounding music, and innovative game mechanics, it’ll usher in a new era of fighting games! This fantasy game blends fighting game action and RPG-style adventure. Throw yourself into matches or enjoy powering up your characters! Adding Vira and Avatar Belial to the roster, this version includes every DLC character for an experience that's truly legendary.

Granblue Fantasy: Versus - Legendary Edition includes:
- Granblue Fantasy: Versus (main game)
- Playable Character 'Vira'
- Playable Character 'Avatar Belial'
- All Serial Codes for the Original 'Granblue Fantasy'
- Character Pass 1 & 2 (unlocks all 11 DLC playable characters):
- Pass 1: Beelzebub, Narmaya, Soriz, Djeeta, and Zooey
- Pass 2: Belial, Cagliostro, Yuel, Anre, Eustace, and Seox

title: Fear Therapy
description: Fear Therapy, is a multiplayer(1-4) and single player psychological horror game.Try to complete the quests and leave the horror house before it is too late! Satan getting angrier every second and nothing holding it back.

title: Riot Act
description:
"Numbness and rage. Fright and anger. I open my eyes. Oh, well. My cell is pitch dark anyhow. "Block E1". I heard their inhuman voices. Lying on this cold metal bed, I stretch my arms along my sides. This must be the right posture to fit in a pod. I do not tolerate the idea of not being ready.

Yes, but ready for what? No, I won't give way to grief.

A squeaky sound... No, no way. It can't be true. The door opens, light replaces darkness. I will ask for a reason later. Now I have a choice to take. An easy one. I will run the hell out of here, whatever it takes. It's time to get a little revenge.

It's time to start my own riot act. "

title: Indirection
description: Indirection is a unique puzzle platforming adventure where you can only move in one direction.

title: Icewords
description: Icewords is a tactical word game where you are a penguin that moves around an iceberg by spelling words out of the letters on the ground. Enemies appear over time, and you must move strategically to force them into the water. Achieve the highest score you can before you are dunked yourself!

title: Porcelain Eyes
description: A game about dolls.

title: Season's Greetings from The Smoke Room Team!
description: A small slice-of-life side story for The Smoke Room, in which the cast prepare for Christmas in a modern day alternate universe.

title: Halloween Chronicles: Cursed Family
description: Solve the mystery and defeat the evil vampire that has possessed your uncle and threatens the entire town!

title: Halloween Chronicles: Cursed Family - Collector's Edition
description: Solve the mystery and defeat the evil vampire that has possessed your uncle and threatens the entire town!

title: Untamed Isles
description:
Monster hunting and taming, turn-based MMORPG.

Untamed Isles provides a living breathing world where you can witness friends and other player’s activities in real-time such as fighting, training, breeding, etc.

Untamed Isles is a game that rewards players for their achievements and to show them off publicly. Whether it be rare monsters, items, competitive raiding, ranking, achievements, player housing, and much more.

The entire world is open for you to explore. Focusing on social engagement, the level design will create unique areas for friends to gather, practice PVP, trade, breed monsters, clear dungeons and play through the story of untamed isles socially with open voice proximity communications.

title: Vitas Castle of Horror
description: Vitas Castle of Horror is a fan-made horror game, mainly inspired by Amnesia, where you need to search for relics in the castle haunted by the ghost of the Russian singer, Vitas.

title: Sqroma
description:
Sqroma is a puzzle game where you have to dodge the colored enemies to reach the end. You'll be able to make the enemies kill themself or become yourself colored and pass through them and their shots.
The levels do not restart after each death, use it as an advantage to create a path using your own body to block annoying shots.

title: You're Watching Icebox!
description:
You're watching Icebox! The coolest show on the box. I'm your host Reggie Plunkett, and have we got a show for you.

You'll have to try to keep your cool in this point and click adventure, as you host a disastrous episode of failing 80's variety show, Icebox!

title: Nightmare: The Lunatic
description: Nightmare: The Lunatic is an action roguelite platformer game where you escape your nightmare. Swap between 3 weapons constantly, use special attacks, and dodge and dodge enemy attacks. Strengthen yourself by collecting powerful and distinctive totems.

title: Jester Street: Card Counting Trainer
description:
Welcome to Jester Street, England. Hidden from sight, a small laundrette holds a large secret... A unique, sophisticated card-counting machine, intended to help tip the balance back into the 'common' Player's odds.

Avid Player's drop in to test and perfect their Blackjack (card counting): timings, count(s), and amounts. Locals get priority access! 'Come try your skills....

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Escape From Pripyat
description: A tactical, combat focused modpack, inspired by extraction game Escape From Tarkov.

title: Porcelain Tales
description: Porcelain Tales is a 3D platform, puzzle strategy game. Where you become a tiny garden gnome, brought to life by a generous witch in order to help her collect the things she desires most. Made of porcelain you have to be careful while exploring the world of the witch’s B&B. You have the ability to hide in narrow crannies and sneak around as quiet as a mouse. In addition, you can carry objects six times your size. During your adventure through the B&B, you will encounter many obstacles to overcome and various objects to collect. Your way home won’t be easy to find, as you wander through the maze of the B&B.

title: Popgoes
description:
A year after the fire at Fazbear's Fright, a rich and creative inventor in England, only known as Fritz, has taken the role of continuing the animatronic pizzeria brand with his own restaurant called The Popgoes Pizzeria. Sporting extremely advanced robotic characters such as Popgoes the Weasel and Blake the Badger, the place soon became notable for being technologically ahead of its time.

With 3D printers in almost every room, touch-screen phones for kids to play with, and animatronics that can cook your meal from scratch, surely something is going to malfunction? Well, no. Nothing ever malfunctions, nothing ever plays up. Everything follows orders, and everything is predictable. A true successor to Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, with none of the death!

But, the truth is, Fritz didn't build The Popgoes Pizzeria for customers. He built it for himself. And as a night guard for the place, you're a part of it. So, let's get started. Let's help Fritz out.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition
description:
Released as a free update on the base game, this Anniversary Edition includes:

• All DLC
• The full soundtrack for the game
• Classic and brand new wallpapers
• The original manual (pdf)
• The Official Strategy Guide (pdf)
• Ringtone
• The Collector's Edition Artbook (pdf)
• Collectors cards (pdfs)
• The original launch trailer

title: Fat Baby
description: In Fat baby multiple babies battle it out to get as fat as they can by eating and destroying everything around them. Traverse around a destructible environment while trying to avoid danger. Use your fat to buy abilities and use your abilities to wreak havoc on everything in your path!

title: ClueFinders Search and Solve Adventures: The Phantom Amusement Park
Armis
description: We invite adventurers to the world of Armis, a fantastic mobile MMORPG with a different dimension to enjoy in 3D high definition!

title: Mother 4
description: Mother 4 follows the journey of three kids and the leader of a biker gang. With dark rumors of "Modern Men" running wild, these unassuming heroes set out to uncover the truth, no matter how dangerous. The game was based on the role-playing game series Mother. It was intended to emulate an official new installment to the series, but was rebranded into the original Oddity.

title: Ciudad del Mar
description: Ciudad del Mar is a small game inspired by a short poem written by Federico García Lorca.

title: xDx Ball Shooter
description: Fast-paced brick breaking game.

title: Shmup Ball
description: Created for the AI and games game jam for theme "breaking the rules". The referee has gave up the day job and all rules have been aborted. Except one: Shoot to win. Shoot the ball, shoot the ball at the goal, shoot the enemy team, shoot your team mates. It's shmup ball. Anything goes.

title: Chamber.Repeat();
description: Chamber.Repeat(); is a small 2D puzzle game where the level always changes. Just like Andy Warhol's "Campbell Soup's", some elements shift and change while you have to reach the finish over and over again, getting more difficult with more and more chamber elements.

title: Pixel Wheels
description: Top-down retro racing game. Race for the first place on various tracks. Pick up bonuses to boost your position or slow down competitors!

title: Wave_Machine
description: Wave_Machine is a small adventure where you meet friendly creatures who need your help. Get rid of the pests then stay to chat to the islanders.

title: Cross the Road
description: Players must jump across the street without getting hit by cars or trains, while collecting coins to unlock new characters

title: Redout 2
description: The fastest racing game in the universe. Redout 2 is a tribute to classic arcade racing games and the sequel to the critically acclaimed Redout. Reach impossible speeds in exhilarating futuristic races across an extensive single-player campaign and competitive multiplayer.

title: Arthur's Thinking Games
description: Arthur's Thinking Games is the perfect combination of learning, fun, and helpful features. With 6 different fun-filled activities and 5 levels of difficulty, Arthur's Thinking Games will entertain your child with hours of learning and fun!

title: Liberty's Kids
description:
Approaching the last quarter of the 18th century, a tidal wave of change is poised to engulf the American colonies.
