description: Including new master, new monsters, new game mechanics and more!

title: Concordia: Digital Edition - Salsa
description: An official DLC to Concordia: Digital Edition adding two new maps - Byzantium and Hispania - and Salt - a new trading good - all of which will add variety and new challenges to your games!

title: Detective Agency
description: Exciting adventure game with a stylish comic graphics and lots of puzzles, riddles and mini games. Fun for the whole family.

title: James Peris 2: The Fountain of Eternal Drunkenness
description: The long awaited new adventure by James Peris, after No License, No Control, Much more of everything! A point-and-click adventure with adult humor and a touch of hooliganism. Totally open gameplay and non-linear puzzles.

title: UnnamedGame RPG
description: Enjoy a semi-AFK RNG-HELL RPG game that is ever expanding, find loot, own, get owned, all in the name of RNG. Climb leaderboards for overall XP, gather money, and become a part of a growing game and community!

title: From Heaven to Earth
description: Find your way down to earth in this amazing platformer game

title: Pokémon Ethos
description:
Pokémon Ethos is a fan made Pokémon game. It is not a ROM hack, but rather a game made in RPG Maker XP, using the Pokemon Essentials kit.

When your father goes missing during a routine trip to Juletone City, it's up to you to discover his whereabouts!
Travel through a region fresh off the heels of legalized Pokémon training, battling the newly established Gym Leaders on your way.
Hone your skills for the inevitable confrontation with NOVA: The National Outcry of Valiant Allies!
Learn the truth of what happened to your father on that faithful night with the "help" of your rival, the superhero wannabe: Howlight Harlequin!

This game was made by Voltseon, ENLS, Thundaga & NocTurn.

title: Matchpoint: Tennis Championships
description: Matchpoint: Tennis Championships is a modern take on tennis, featuring a true-to-life on-court experience supported by a deep career mode and unique rivalry system. The game places a strong focus on tactical realism, positioning and aiming, allowing the player to move their tennis star in exactly the right way to get the most out of their shots.

title: Math Circus: Act 1
description: Math Circus: Act 1 is an educational game for children that teaches maths. All of the game's activities are based around setting up and managing a circus with twelve puzzles and activities in total. Each one introduces a new concept based around logic or maths with an adjustable difficulty level. Skills include spatial reasoning, perceiving patterns in size, order or time, or manipulating variables to influence the tricks of the circus acts. The game saves progress for the solved puzzles automatically. Up to 200 circuses can be started as new profiles.

title: Half-Life: Year of the Dragon
description: Year of the dragon is a crossover mod that brings the world of Spyro the Dragon to the Half-Life universe!

title: Learn to Code RPG
description: Learn to Code RPG is a visual novel game. In this game, you will teach yourself to code, make friends in the tech industry, and pursue your dream of becoming a developer.

title: Spider-Man: Ultimate Power
description: Spider-Man: Ultimate Power is an arcade side-scrolling game, consisting of running, jumping, swinging and fighting elements. There are two modes available: Story and Survival. The Story mode requires completing various missions to progress through the story to save Mary Jane kidnapped by Green Goblin, Sandman and Venom. Missions include various simple tasks such as collecting things, defeating designated enemies or rescuing hostages. The player may select one of a few available characters, each with some special abilities. Unlocking the heroes requires spending rare to find diamonds or real cash. Hard-gained game currency can be used for upgrading the hero's powers or applying power-ups. The gameplay features over 40 locations, divided into several city districts.

title: Taiko no Tatsujin: The Drum Master!
description:
Drum out high scores by accurately playing along with 2 different notes, Don and Ka, in Taiko no Tatsujin: The Drum Master! Includes over 70 songs, local multiplayer mode, and online ranked matches.
Light your drumming spirit on fire!

title: Blood West
description: Blood West is an immersive stealth shooter taking place in a nightmare version of a classic wild west setting. The player takes on the role of an outlawed gunslinger brought back to live by strange native spirits to find the root of a curse that has befallen the land. They will explore the dangerous frontier, gather supplies, expand their arsenal, and gain experience to unlock special traits, to best the many monsters and face off with challenging bosses.

title: Smipat and the Lost Bones
description: In Smipat and the Lost Bones you follow the life of Smipat, a necromancer's pet with a will of it's own. Smipat has lost some of it's bones and is going on an adventure to find them. Each bone has it's own unique ability that makes it possible to overcome the challenges ahead.

title: Brave Dwarves
description:
Brave Dwarves is a fantasy platform game where you control one of two Dwarves fighting against 'The Great Evil' that has taken over their underground kingdom.

The player has a warrior and a mage character to choose from; there are ordinary weapons for the warrior, and magic weapons (incantations) for the mage.
Both the magical and ordinary weapon types and strength depends on the power stored in four orbs for controlling the four elements of Fire, Water, Air and Earth.
The orbs are found laying around on the map, and at the beginning, you only have a single weapon & attack type - for the Warrior its a plain melee attack with his axe - but the orbs & diamonds you find lets you use other attack types: the axe can also throw flaming fire, or homing missiles for example. The mage starts out with a wand that can do a water attack. No damage shows any blood, only smokepuffs.

The orbs power source is taken from colored diamonds found in the caves: Green for Earth, Red for Fire, Blue for Water and White for Air.
There are also some diamonds with combined orb energy effects: Light Blue for Air & Water and Purple for Fire & Earth.

The underground Kingdom is divided into 50 platform levels, to finish a level three larger Key-diamonds must be found; one each of Green, Red and White color - these will open the door to the next level. In the unregistered version, only five levels are available, and there are some other limitations - the demo has no bosses for instance.

In the caves are monsters (of course) but also treasure laying around, which is gathered by walking over them, and added to the player score. Touching a monster loses health. Beakers with blue liquid and large red hearts restore health
A highscore list is available in the registered version, as are passwords & savegames letting a player continue from the last saved location.

title: Lovelydoll/Wildmachine
description:
Nordic, a natural born genius, had spent 10 years toiling away making a "mechanical doll", as a way to atone for something in his past. One day the doll gains sentience once a wandering soul resides inside it, and so begins the protagonist’s journey of experiencing what it means to live by interacting with the residents of Wingil, doing errands, battling and mini-games.
There is 1 main story and 3 unique epilogues.

title: Penguin Diner: Restaurant Dash
description: Penny the Penguin goes off track during an Antarctic trek and finds herself completely lost and broke. Help Penny earn enough money to get her home to her family!

title: Alik: Juz Ide Do Szkoly
description: Alik: Juz Ide Do Szkoly is a set of didactic games with the friendly dog Alik, which will surely conquer the hearts of all children and become their friend, helper and guide. In different parts of the garden, the child learns to recognize colors and shapes, compare sizes, evaluate the mutual position of objects, count objects and solve simple tasks requiring logical thinking. In some games single skills are practiced, in others - several at once. Alik patiently explains how to do the task, praises the successes and says when the child has made a mistake.

title: Norse
description: A community driven an adventure MMORPG. We threw aside the traditional MMO and made it for gamers by gamers. In a world of chaos, it's your job as the player to thrive and free the world. The entire game is community based - even the economy is player based.

title: Imperium Revolution
description: Imperium Revolution gives you the ability to capture and train over 200 Imperators and enjoy action-packed battles. Master the fast-paced turn-based strategic combat system and make sure you are always one move ahead of your opponent in order to achieve victory. Meet other Guardians of Everwinter in an all-new Imperium Battle Arena. Fight against other formidable Guardians for the opportunity to claim your rank among the Legendary Guardians.

title: Sword of Atlas
description: Sword of Atlas combines tactical grid combat with turn meter action economy to create a fast, frenetic, and strategic gameplay experience unique amongst the TRPG genre. The real-time action combines with a character-driven story to create a high-stakes environment where your actions will determine the fate of your party.

title: Gold Miner: Vegas
description: Gold Miner: Vegas is an entry in the Gold Miner games. In this title the Gold Miner's goal is to collect enough gold to go to Vegas. The gameplay is largely identical to the original game, where items on a field need to be caught by timing correctly to extend a swinging claw and grab them. The main difference is that the gold miner is now in a cart that can be moved left and right, rather than using a fixed position. The game contains new levels, challenges and gadgets, and new characters, creatures and villains.

title: They Die Tomorrow
description: They Die Tomorrow is a co-op horror investigation game for 1-4 players that sends you to the scene of a murder right before it happens. Use discovered evidence and observed behaviors to identify the killer, but be quick about it... You don't want to be the next victim! Multiple ways to play.

title: Alik: Gry i zabawy
description: Set of didactic games with the friendly dog Alik, which will surely conquer the hearts of all children and become their friend, helper and guide. In different parts of the garden, the child learns to recognize colors and shapes, compare sizes, evaluate the mutual position of objects, count objects and solve simple tasks requiring logical thinking. In some games single skills are practiced, in others - several at once. Alik patiently explains how to do the task, praises the successes and says when the child has made a mistake.

title: The Masters: Survival
description:
Tana (Katana) is testing the new Virtual Proxy Simulation, which is going to be used for training at a school for elementals, as she fights the evil creatures known as the Shadow Dwellers. She is being helped by her Family and Friends who are outside of the system making sure the simulation goes well. All is not what it seems however as she dives deeper into the system and faces off against an old foe, Master Nether.

This is a top-down, hack n' slash, survival game, using Unreal Engine 4. As you progress through each level surviving against waive after waive of enemies called Shadow Dwellers. You have special powers and can summon a companion NPC. There is also one on one boss fights, a survival mode where you survive as long as possible, and rack up a score.

title: Solo Leveling: Arise
description: Solo Leveling: Arise is an action RPG based on the South Korean web novel of the same name.

title: QP Kiss
description: QP Kiss is a game developed by Orange_Juice for April Fools' day 2007. It's a parody of their QP Shooting series, featuring genderbent characters in a mock-BL game.

title: Achtung Banditen?!
description: Immersive VR installation for Smartphone, Tablet and PC, in memory of the victims based on the Atlas of Nazi and Fascist Massacres in Italy.

title: Tower of Hanoi
description: A puzzle category of casual small game. Try to avoid birds while handling the cube, otherwise you will eat bird poop. As the number of blocks increases, the difficulty of clearing the level will increase.

title: PentaBlox
description:
PentaBlox is a single player, shareware implementation of the traditional puzzle Pentominoes. Pentas are shapes made from five connected squares, this means that they all have the same area but a different shape. The player’s task is to fit the shapes into a box. There are twelve shapes in total which must be fitted into a box. The shareware game has just a 6x10 box but the registered game has three other box sizes 5 x 12, 4 x 15, and 3 x 20.

Pieces may be rotated and/or flipped in order to position them in the box and there’s an optional grid setting to help with the planning.

title: Catnight
description: Catnight is an online multiplayer third-person perspective game that will heat up any party. You will not only fight with your opponents and the enormous amount of furry bullets in the air, but you will also need to survive special gameplay circumstances, which will make every match more dynamic and funnier.

title: Arre Unicornio
description: A new concept of the board game Arre Unicornio now driven to the madness that it can regale us with in video game format. Arre Unicornio is an online multiplayer video game for 2 to 8 players. Frantic party game of hidden roles in a madhouse. Mix of point and click and use of cards.

title: Elaborate Lands
description: Elaborate Lands is a relaxing strategy game with a deep building system. It combines unique gameplay mechanics with elements from 4X and city-builder games. Construct buildings, gather resources, research technologies and expand your territory. Different maps and biomes offer endless replayability.

title: Sunset World Online
description: Sunset World Online is a 2D side-scroller MMORPG with four unique elements to choose from; wind, water, earth, and fire! Each element has its' role, bringing unique experiences in Expeditions. Gather your party and embark on a journey to Edge World!

title: Andreas VII
description:
Inspired by the works of Yames, Andreas VII is a puzzle centered talking-sim. Complete tasks, converse with ground control and lose your sense of self as you travel further in space than any who have come before you.

How known are you willing to be to know, how much are you prepared to give up?

title: Seven Cities
description: Seven Cities is an Action-RPG which takes place in an urban contemporary world. A near-future New York full of intrigue. You play as an Outsider along with a robotic companion. Both will evolve through many intensive fights to find the 7 CEROM's.

title: Steamed Hams: The Graphic Adventure
description:
You've invited Superintendent Chalmers over for lunch! He'll be here any second and is expecting a well cooked roast!

Fortunately, you have been preparing just such a roast all morning! Hopefully you don't accidentally burn it and set certain events into motion...

title: Tour de France 2018
description: Embody the greatest champions and hit the official track of the Tour de France 2018. Enjoy all the intensity of this legendary race: attack, follow the best trajectories, and carry out the finest racing tactics to lead your team to victory and earn the mythical Yellow Jersey.

title: Turbo Sliders Unlimited
description: Turbo Sliders Unlimited is a spiritual successor of many classic top-down racing games, but in 3D and with modern online features and extensive customization and modding possibilities. It goes far beyond being just a racing game - it is a community driven platform where anyone can create their own levels, vehicles and game modes. It can be played as a serious esports game or as a fun casual game. It can be played alone, as online multiplayer or as local multiplayer.

title: I Am A I
description: I AM A I is a cartoony, third-person, open level design, sandbox assassin game. In case that description sounds like some corporate gaming-industry gobbledygook, imagine if Nintendo produced a Hitman game. You play as a small robot that is capable of wielding (as of right now) over 100 unique items and are tasked to assassinate one main target and execute dozens of challenges per level.

title: Papiny Dochki
description: A point'n'click quest based on a famous Russian TV series.

title: Abridge
description: Abridge is an abstract, Sokoban puzzle game. Select pieces to move, pull and shift them around into a goal. The colorful shapes on them determine their movement and abilities. Remove them all from the board to solve these hand-crafted, challenging puzzles.

title: Neko to Sakana
description: A top-down, omnidirectional shooting game. Play as a cat and shoot fish to make sushi and power up your ship.

title: Sunlight In A Tin
description:
A tiny spaceship hurtles through the interstellar void, powered by a roaring nuclear reactor. You are its only engineer.
This seems safe.

title: ScreenPlay
description: A comical CCG where movie characters rule on and off screen. Build decks with genre tropes and eccentric stars, and outsmart rival directors in simultaneous-turn battles. Complete your Leads' story arcs to win chaotic cinematic showdowns.

title: Dark Souls III: The Convergence
description:
The Convergence mod grants a whole new Dark Souls 3 experience with plenty of new systems, spell schools, weapons, bosses, map designs and more.

The game maps have been extensively overhauled and feature new surprises and challenges, hoping to reignite the excitement of a first playthrough.

The three basic magic schools of vanilla have each been split into four distinct sub-schools, making 12 in total. Each new spell school has its own distinct playstyle and progression, as well as custom spells, catalysts, vendors and armour.

Infusions for all weapons have been completely overhauled, making every weapon viable.

All bosses have been revamped somehow, and some are even completely new.

title: Pebble
description: 3D-Platformer where you play as Pebble who moves objects in time in search for his parents. Uncover the story by exploring new environments as you go on to find unique setpieces throughout the game.

title: Invitation to Fear
description: Invitation to Fear is a survival horror game for 1 to 4 players. After receiving one of the invitations, you will wake up in an unfamiliar place. Before long, you will realize that a terrifying creature is wandering around the building. Don't let "her" find you.

title: Of Life and Land
description: Of Life and Land is a charming settlement-building strategy game paired with a rich simulation experience. Every animal and plant tries to find their place in nature while you lead your villagers to their future. Expand to different regions and trade with local factions to gain needed resources.

title: Scholar of the Arcane Arts
description: Scholar of the Arcane Arts is a Roguelike Action RPG where every spell you cast interacts with one another. Learn new spells, solve puzzles, unlock secret dungeons, and defeat monstrous beings to save the world invaded by five Planes of magic!

title: The Virtual Museum of Dead-Wifery
description: Meet Mrs. Groan- in exciting color. The didactic meets the sensational when "America's Favoritest Little Dead Wife 2008" explores the moral perils of "Wife Gaming"- taking viewers on an odyssey filled with lessons sure to make you laugh and cry.

title: Space Dragons
description: Space Dragons is a classic "shoot em up" horizontal shooting game, in which you can choose different ships with unique characteristics and abilities to destroy tons of invading aliens. During the adventure you will run into powerful bosses and explosive enemies. Get upgrades for your ship, weapons and much more to make your way through the meaty and bloody path that awaits you in Space Dragons.

title: Nebraska
description: Nebraska takes place as a journalist writing a book about mid-west America, who runs out of gas in a rural area of Nebraska. Players will explore and uncover the secret facility that lies beneath the attraction and discover the terrible experiments that have taken place there.

title: The Recruit
description: Try your hand at the Real Life Interactive Gaming Simulacra! You'll face a variety of challenges and simulations and have a chance to win some money and great prizes. Apply today!

title: La-Mulana 2: The Tower of Oannes
description: The first piece of downloadable content for La-Mulana 2, the newly-added map – The Tower of Oannes. Ranks with the previous instalment’s Hell Temple in difficulty, acting as an optional distraction from the main journey, filled with brutal level design and humour akin to a Masocore title.

title: Voxel Horizon
description: Create your own voxel world! Collaborate with your friends at your own level! The battle over destructible terrain!

title: Fantasia Sango Mysteria
description:
*** This Game is only available in Chinese ***

A brand new chapter in the Fantasy Three Kingdoms series, once again experiencing the coexistence of human beings, gods, demons and monsters, and a world where reality and reality are intertwined.

title: Transformers: Battlegrounds - Complete Edition
description:
Bumblebee and the Autobots have a new commander - you. Assemble your squad and roll out for a battle that will rage from Central City to Cybertron. Choose heroes including Windblade and Optimus Prime, each with unique attacks and abilities. Use each environment to your advantage, taking cover in desert sandstorms and battling your foes in city streets. And charge your Energon to unleash devastating Ultimate Abilities. Then visit the Arcade for local multiplayer battles with the Decepticons and more. It’s the Tramsformers game you’ve waited an eternity for!

Transformers: Battlegrounds - Complete Edition includes:
- a copy of the base game
- Gold Autobot Skin Pack
- Energon Autobot Skin Pack
- Battle Autobot Skin Pack
- Neon Autobot Skin Pack
- Nemesis Prime & Goldfire Bumblebee Skin Pack
- CUBE Game - Arcade Add-on
- Transformers: Battlegrounds - Shattered Spacebridge

title: My Girlfriend is a Mermaid!? Refine
description: My Girlfriend is a Mermaid!?

title: Two Point Campus: Enrollment Edition
description:
Build the university of your dreams with Two Point Campus, the follow up management sim with a twist from the creators of Two Point Hospital. Get to know your students, explore their personalities and fulfill their wants and needs. Craft buildings, choose courses, hire the best staff and build an academic institution to stand the test of time.

The Enrollment Edition includes:
- Exclusive Enrollment Edition packaging and artwork
- A Fold out paper campus poster map, slightly bigger than A3 in size
- Two Point Bonus DLC pack, including exclusive in game items for both Two Point Campus & Two Point Hospital

title: The Fox Awaits Me: Limited Edition
description: This edition includes the following PS4 Game: The Fox Awaits Me, Soundtrack CD, Theme Song CD, Mascot Figure, Digital Artbook Download Code (While supplies last)

title: My Girlfriend is a Mermaid!? Refine: Limited Edition
description:
My Girlfriend is a Mermaid!? Refine: Limited Edition includes;
- The game (region free)
- The soundtrack CD
- The theme song CD
- A Mascot figure
- A digital artbook download code (while supplies last)

title: Rival Fury
description: A three-dimensional street brawler, expanding the way you fight. Featuring atmospheric side scrolling arenas with unique depth and camera style. An immersive and fast paced gang busting experience. Running at your opponents will help you own the streets and increase your martial arts ability.

title: Apex Legends: Defiance
description: Madness Takes Control

title: Johnny Boy: Red Moon's Kiss
description: Johnny Boy: Red Moon's Kiss is a mature, six episode, gritty interactive drama series, shrouded in mystery and the supernatural. A proper adaptation to werewolf fiction, with deep character development.

title: Fantasia Sango 1
description:
*** This Game is only available in Chinese ***

"Fantasy Three Kingdoms" is an RPG stand-alone game developed and operated by Yujun Technology. The battle screen of the game is a 2D screen, but because of the 45-degree viewing angle, it has a three-dimensional effect. The combat system is turn-based and semi-real-time.

title: Fantasia Sango 4
description:
This is the fourth installment of the role-playing series of stand-alone games "Fantasy Three Kingdoms".

The background of the story is set about ten years after the first generation. In addition to the latest developments in the series, it also inherits the battles of the Three Kingdoms and the unique world view of previous generations. Historical figures and military commanders also appeared in this generation.

title: Fantasia Sango 3
description:
*** This Game is only available in Chinese ***

This work is the third part of the role-playing series of stand-alone games "Fantasy Three Kingdoms". The plot of this work continues the unique world view of the previous work and develops the story of a new group of protagonists.

title: MLB The Show 22
description:
Experience faster, deeper and more intense moment-to-moment match action on the field, with a variety of game modes for all you rookie players and returning seasoned vets.

Every pitch. Every hit. Every win. Make your mark and Own The Show in MLB The Show 22.

title: Pachillinko
description: Pachillinko is a mix of japanese Pachinko and western Plinko style game, set in neon synthwave design with some retro feeling of 80s. Relaxing mouse-only clicking gameplay allows you to sit back and just chill...

title: Chromarena
description: Chromarena is a 2D top-down twin-stick arena shooter. Combine offense and defense to tear through hordes of color-coded enemies to unlock new guns and set high scores. Form short and medium-term plans, dodge attacks with fully responsive controls, and get into a flow state.

title: Medieval Battlegrounds
description: Set in medieval times, you must vanquish your foes! Fight again players in 6-man teams or join together and fight hordes of AI enemies. Battle with swords, axes, bows, and magic. Teams are formed in-game, so play with your friends, or against them! Team up and take down enemies and friends alike!

title: Battlecaster
description: BATTLECASTER is a challenging fast paced arena roguelike. Develop mastery over relentless enemies and overcome difficult encounters. Use abilities strategically to control the ring of combat.

title: Entropy: Zero 2
description:
The pessimistic, wisecracking, door-kicking zealot known as 'Bad Cop' is back.

Command a small army of Combine synths and soldiers on a Northern campaign to capture Dr. Judith Mossman.

Tread in the wake of Gordon Freeman at Nova Prospekt. Explore the mysterious 'Arbeit Communications' facility. Discover what lies beneath. Drive an APC through the arctic wastes. Confront the rebels on their doorstep and uncover a long-forgotten secret.

title: Eletar Hero
description: Eletar Hero is a 2D platformer where you use the ability you have acquired from an ancient alien race to traverse through different maze-like levels, defeat many bosses and collect the other abilities the ancient Eletar left behind; all to stop a madman from taking over the world.

title: Circuit City
description: A relaxing city builder set on the tiny scale of a circuit board, where your data agents and electronic components sing a unique, procedurally-generated chiptune song for you as they work.

title: The House of Big people
description: Two Russian students Ivan and Alexander were expelled from the institute, but the knowledge remained with them. One day, while drinking beer, they come up with a brilliant idea - to create a superman who will not need food, and will work 24 hours a day.

title: Ampguard
description: Ampguard is a rogue-like game with a unique combat system and nasty monsters. Combine your skills and use them in the best possible way to emerge victorious from the battle against the Yokai.

title: Off-Road Farming
description: Off-Road Farming is an unusual off-road farming simulator. In the game you will find unique locations, interesting levels, as well as various natural phenomena!

title: SCP Observer
description: SCP Observer is a survival horror game, where you are trapped in a security room and you have to monitor the foundations camera system for threats and manage the power carefully in order to survive. All of this while you try not to be killed by some of the SCP Foundation most terrifying creatures.

title: Project Speed 2
description: Project Speed 2 is a 3D Racing Game with multiple maps and vehicles to choose from made with the Unreal Engine.

title: Buy Me Some Soup
description: Heya! Long time no see. I just have a small -tiny- little favor to ask of you, could you buy me some soup? ...How? Well, that's for you to find out!

title: Magnus Imago
description: Magnus Imago is an atmospheric journey through a mysterious world of characters, traces and symbols. The task of the player is to solve the puzzles, using proper combinations of objects, finding them in the environment around him.

title: Clive vs. Hives 2
description: Blast aliens to pieces and start a rebellion in this fast paced pixel art top down shooter with a range of unique weapons and combat abilities.

title: The Matriarch
description: An online party game where only 1 player is not an Imposter. Play as a Nun and emulate the bot behavior to avoid raising suspicions. Play as the Matriarch and identify all the player-controlled nuns before one of them escapes the Satanic convent!

title: Minecart Madness
description: Minecart Madness is a 2D arcade infinite-runner in the style of early platforming games. Jump your minecart over frequent and fast-approaching obstacles and try for the highscore!

title: Alien Space Bastards
description: Alien Space Bastards is a procedurally generated 3D arcade style shooter. The aliens are attacking in force and you must utilize all the weaponry you have to survive the onslaught and bring piece to the galaxy. Multiple power ups will assist you on your suicide mission, good luck and fight bravely!

title: Herbheim's Mine
description: Last warrior of the Herbheim's clan, it's your duty to defend the last family mine

title: Bessarabian Nightmares
description: Help close the gates of hell, kill bosses, find keys and move on. Good luck!

title: One against the wind
description: A first-person shooter in which there are two game modes. 1. Destroy the enemy generator. 2. Steal the enemy's documents.

title: Within Skerry
description: The Accumulation of Evil is an ancient book stating that if enough evil energy is concentrated in a single area, a dark force may be born.Humans can sometimes be very horrible creatures - but sometimes, it is taken a bit too far.

title: Spirits Chronicles: Born in Flames - Collector's Edition
description: Save the kingdom and tame the magical creatures! You are the only one who can embark on a dangerous journey. Are you ready to accept the challenge?

title: Mary
description: Mary is a mystery and investigation game, in which you are a private detective who has been called to solve a case of a massacre in a bar. Collect all the clues and find an answer to all the mysteries of this case!

title: Purry Furry Adventurry
description: Help Kat escape from her loving owner in this cute little endless runner!

title: Dungeon Castle
description: You have been summoned to an unknown castle. And you will receive one mission. Gather various voice data and approach the truth. And you have to delete the root node of the network metabus that is connected to all that truth. In that "Dungeon Castle" where you are.

title: Melania
description: Solve puzzles and find out all the secrets of the disappearance of civilization in a gloomy 2D platformer.

title: Mago: The Villain's Burger
description: Mago: The Villain's Burger is a retro 2D platformer that puts us in the boots of a sorcerer, who was unfortunate enough to eat evil overlord's food. Now he has to rescue his beloved princess from the dinner menu of the evil Gourmet! Nostalgia awaits!

title: Shadow of Egypt
description: Shadow of Egypt - is an adventurous 3D shooter with surviving and hardcore elements where you will fight with ancient Egyptian evil.

title: Party Rush!!
description: Here we present, a cynical RPG with close to 160,000 patterns of party making. Choose your favorite from about 100 different characters and save the pixelated world. Some events spawn only during certain days of the week. No need to worry, "somebody from another dimension" will help you.

title: Swords and Sandals Immortals
description: Gladiator! Grab your sword, equip your sandals and take on the world in multiplayer Swords and Sandals! Brutal turn-based combat where gladiators can lose limbs, wield guitars and yell so loudly enemy heads will fall off. This is the most fun you'll ever have in the arena!

title: Funny Street Football
description: Introducing Funny Street Football - a 2D side-view sports simulator in which you have to win the street football world championship!

title: Knight Riot
description: Knight Riot - 2d Slasher with a side view, the player uses the cursor to control the direction of the strike and cuts the enemies who are on the attack line.

title: Feeble
description: FEEBLE is an interactive simulation game. Meet FEEBLE, the only surviving character in the village devastated by the epidemic, and save FEEBLE from the Grim Reaper. Look around the village, use various puzzles to protect from the Grim Reaper and save the FEEBLE.

title: Minimal Dungeon RPG
description: Minimal Dungeon RPG is a Simple Dungeon Crawler of RPG. Multiple rooms are connected into dungeons. Tasks, monsters, and rewards are all simplified into squares in the rooms. You can just click on the squares to play and crawl through the dungeons.

title: Turn off the light
description: A gloomy platformer in which you have to get out of the desperate consciousness of the main character. The unique ambient and minimalistic graphics will create a tense atmosphere. Explore the game space and avoid all its aggressive inhabitants.

title: Salaryman Shi
description: Traverse colorful environments, battle strange animals and master the power of your suitcases to... get to work on time? Play as salaryman Takeshi Shi as you hurry to catch the bus to the office!

title: Escape the Living Nebula
description: Turn-based spaceship battles in a tense fight for survival

title: With You
description: With You is a cooperative two-player puzzle-playground. It's a playful space that hopes to inspire couples to connect, communicate, and collaborate.

title: Huckleberry Fields Forever
description: Huckleberry Fields Forever is a co-op mystery action-platformer. Track thieves in scenic real-world locales, run and jump through procedurally generated levels assembled from hundreds of handcrafted challenges, gather clues, interview witnesses, uncover secrets... but can you solve the case in time?

title: 120 Yen Stories
description: In 120 Yen series, each season has a unique heroine. By using the four seasons of Japan to tell the story of two people meeting and getting along through the keyword "120 yen".

title: World of Towers
description: World of Towers combines puzzles with tower defense. Design your base in order to collect all of the puzzle pieces and destroy your enemies. Create and share your own worlds on the Steam Workshop using the World of Towers World Builder

title: Malyshka
description: From the sunken depths of a quiet lake, your heart pulls you to the surface; a doll awaits your ghostly form on the shore. Who are you? Why are you here? Discover the sleepy town of Tikhiyavoda, its community, and most of all, yourself.

title: Redemption Cemetery: Dead Park - Collector's Edition
description: Can you help three souls escape a deadly amusement park?

title: Gaserb
description: Gaserb contains difficult puzzles that can be solvable by only clever ideas. Challenge the timer bar which can change how the game works and see if you're clever and fast enough to beat it.

title: Bouldeurdache
description: Bouldeurdache is a remake as a tribute to the old Commodore 64 classic game released in 1984. 100 caves on 5 levels available and 2 turbo modes!

title: Runner Rtx
description: RUNNER RTX is a classic runner game with a procedurally generated world but with cinematic graphics.

title: Blacken Slash
description: A tactical RPG where the items define your character. Create powerful builds from an abundance of items as you try to save a corrupted retro computer system. Fight, loot and then ... just one more level.

title: Dodge It! 2
description: JUMP, DODGE, DIE, REPEAT

title: Tiny Witch
description: Tiny Witch, is a little game about managing a minion store, where you must mix the right resources to build the minions needed by the dungeon masters.

title: Chaos Chain
description: Chaos Chain is a dark cyberpunk roleplaying game set in a bleak dystopian future. Assume the role of a desperate dweller of Slade City, a sprawling urban nightmare of grimy asphalt and broken dreams where crime and disorder run rampant. - Stay Alert. Stay Armed. Stay Alive. Don't lose your humanity.

title: Mirrored Soul
description: A turn-based RPG detective story with focus on monster-collecting, exploration, and humor. Negotiate with enemies to recruit them to your party, and fuse your monsters to create new ones.

title: OverWall
description: You and your friends play as four brave engineer pandas in their new improvised role : defender of the Great Wall of China. A game in local coop, can be played by four person. Follow the plans and organise to make your ammunition to repel your countless enemies !

title: Windmills
description: Master your combat techniques and explore a magic world in this combat - focused metroidvania. Help the unreliable narrator complete his story which changes depending on the player's actions.

title: Conveyance
description: A conveyor-based production and logistics sandbox including smart machines, node based conveyor belts, logic and recipe based item generation and powerful design time construction. Create and connect Miners, Splitters, Factories, Containers, Vaults and more...

title: Skelton Zone Traveler Emergence
description: Help the travelers escape the horrors of the Skelton Zone.

title: Bangman
description: Very good game!

title: Hunt-or-Haunt
description: Hunt-or-Haunt is a 6 to 12 player online game where two teams, Hunters and Haunts, face-off in pandemonius battles of elimination! As Hunters combine forces to uncover and dispatch their ghostly foes, Haunts use their stealth and trickery to divide and conquer. Eliminate your opponents to win!

title: Grieve
description: This is a single player, action based thirdperson shooter. were the player travels to different openworld type locations to clear out enemy bases and gather intel

title: Sabbuth
description: You've waken up in a strange place not knowing who you are or what your purpose is. A being lays before you emerging from the ground. He offers you an escape, something you can't refuse. Traverse 3 different areas collecting Artifacts to return to this being while avoiding evil forces.

title: Tumblefire
description: Prepare for a good old fashioned heist in this simulated and fully burnable old west world. Burn down walls with torches or use explosives to create shortcuts. Stack coffins and cow skulls to reach higher. Use the world around you to help you in every way you can imagine.

title: Last Gary
description: it's a refreshing third-person overhead shooting game. four chapters, 10 levels in each chapter, total of 40 levels. various of weapons, enemies, BOSS battles make the level challenging. also have various props, trap mechanism. This game lets you feel refreshing and the achievement of success.

title: Last Space Guardian
description: Survive 10 enemy stages! Shoot 'Em Up style, spaceship game, in pixel art and 8-bit retro music! Evolve your shot to the maximum level, use the energy bar for upgrades, and special abilities! Advance each stage by defeating Bosses and enemies to collect new skills, transformations and extra lives!

title: Trapped VR
description: Trapped VR is a VR puzzle game that focuses on how the player interacts with the game world. To win you must solve the puzzles surrounding you to figure out the secret code that unlocks the container doors.

title: Thalamus
description: Thalamus is a First person puzzle and horror Game. You play as Rayan, an average employee that works at a surveillance company, who found out something he shouldn't have. Now with no way out and missing his memory he must team up with a caged mind to complete what he started.

title: Zombie Shotgun Rampage
description: All that's left is you, the endless swarm of zombies, and the beer they stole. Shoot every rotten scoundrel in your path and bring back the coveted drink, which is a pleasure to while away the days of a fading future!

title: Agryos: Recovering Eden
description: AGRYOS: Recovering Eden is a third-person shooter with elements of a bullet hell where you play as Neziha, an adventurer fighting to recover the Branch of Eden from a failed space colony. Destroy hordes of robots with Neziha’s versatile arm cannon as you blast through this fallen AI-created society.

title: Dummy Falls
description: Dummy Falls is a co-op game where you and your teammate tries to overcome various obstacles until the end.

title: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade
description: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade is reimagining a videogame classic: Play virtual table tennis with up to 4 players in a futuristic visual style using new gameplay elements like power ups and randomly generated arenas.

title: Hell's Delivery
description: Hell's Delivery is a platform puzzle game, your objective is to deliver pizza to demons in hell. You can't control the delivery guy, but you have a inventory with helpful tools to place along the way to help him through the depths of hell.

title: The Fox's Drawing World
description: Use your Magic Pen to help the Tiny, Adorable Fox. Let's Join The Fox's Drawing world.

title: Gods of Isekai
description: - Summons mighty heroes that use lethal powers to bind, stun, burn, and poison players. - Select and organise your team's stat allocation to create an incredibly strong and unique raid team comprised of tanking/attacker/wizard roles.

title: Kurukshetra: Ascension
description: Enter the world of Indian mythology in this unique card battler!

title: Haunted Stories
description: Haunted Stories is a captivating mix of horror and thriller. Experience several exciting haunted stories, each telling its own independent storyline. Each playable story contains its own secrets, game mechanics and puzzles to solve.

title: Coins Collector Simulator
description: Taxi driver or policeman, it doesn't matter here, you just have to collect all the coins!

title: BattlefieldCars
description: A shooting game with cars where you can play in split screen local multiplayer or in single player mode .

title: I Am Gangster
description: This is a 2D Multiplicity Deck Building, Turn-Based Card Strategy game. I don't think the gaming industry has seen anything quite like this type of genre before. I am the solo developer and want to create the most fun gangster card game I can think of.

title: Errante
description: This is an experimental project, a sandbox life simulator that gives you the power to suggest how the game should evolve, which features we should focus on, which slice of life to tell and everything you can imagine.

title: Super Shooter
description: Super Shooter is an all-new FPS game where players use an experimental tool to activate unique stage elements, solve puzzles, and propel themselves through the air ("rocket jumping"). In other words, it's a game where you solve all your problems by shooting at them!

title: 100 Days Without Delays
description: In this Match3 game you have to help Lee Milton manage her task to setup a successful new airport - in mere 100 days! Collect three colorful items in a row, upgrade the airport, even help police to solve the crime, and she will become the youngest airport manager in a company’s history!

title: Obama Maze
description: Obama Maze is a 3D horror experience with the former United States president, Barack Obama. You must navigate through his courses collecting all 7 of his "Obamiums." Collect all 7 in order to leave his maze and continue onto the next until you reach the final course.

title: Dungeon Wizards
description: Dungeon Wizards combines classic Rogue-Lite and colorful Match3 with adventurous Roleplay elements. Venture on your very own journey, collect and combine rare relics with powerful spells and face loads of challenging enemies!

title: Total Catastrophe
description: Total CATastrophe - This is a complete CATastrophe! Someone stole all your food and scattered it throughout the dangerous levels of this hardcore platformer. The enemies thought they had won, but it was not there!

title: Strange Town
description: Strange town is a very fun Multiplayer and local multiplayer role-playing game. You must find who the werewolf is in the morning and at night, you must fight and survive. Of course, hiding is a good option too.

title: Elven Warmaiden
description: An fantasy Auto-battler game in which you command the elven Warmaidens to fend off waves and waves of attack from enemies besieging your capital city

title: Dimension Quest Pinball
description: Dimension Quest Pinball is a bouncy mini game made to translate Dimension Quest : Altered Fates into a pinball platformer! Make use of numerous characters and powers all in the pursuit of high scores and victory over evil!

title: Bloon Rush
description: Bloon Rush is a multplayer balloon race game with up to 8 players online! The tracks are brutal and you will have to master your racing skills, while leaving bombs for your enemies! Press B to leave a bomb. Press left-click to accelerate. Do nothing to rotate. Have fun!

title: Reds Adventure A Seasons New Beginning
description: Reds Adventure A Seasons New Beginning is the first game in a trilogy called "Red's Adventure". It is a short and fun little 2D platformer. Red has to collect the chests to break each of the season's curses.

title: Let It Slide
description: Drag to move Cat Mermaid through obstacles and find the legendary Fishburger. Remember: it's not you suffering, it's Cat Mermaid.

title: The Heilwald Loophole
description: The Heilwald Klinikum used to be one of the most renowned medical facilities in Germany. That all changed when that curious loophole appeared...

title: Donut Dodo
description: If a long lost arcade game from 1983 resurfaced today, it would be Donut Dodo - a classic 2D platformer from the golden era, tough as nails and challenging for the whole family! Ready to top the high score table?

title: Fayburrow
description: In a world of fairies, a childhood friend suddenly calls Beatrice back to her old hometown. Yet when she arrives, her friend is mysteriously missing.

title: King of Heroes
description: Follow our hero on his treacherous adventure tackling on a multitude of obstacles and battling strange and scary monsters. A new and interactive strategy game in the making built just for you and your friends!

title: Bylista: Vasna
description: Move through the forest and meet mystical and magical creatures. Make a choice and go to your goal.

title: Cheftastic: Buffet Blast
description: Cheftastic: Buffet Blast is a new exciting top-down arcade shooter! Take back the Isle of Verdura from swarms of mutant vegetables and climb your way to the top of the leaderboard!

title: Lucky Me
description: In a world devoid of originality, where talentless hacks copy your every move, you gotta use their stupidity against them to come out on top. Line up your shots, pull the trigger and survive the bullet storm in this logic-shooter game.

title: RealmLess
description: Unknown reasons cause the world to collapse, and the remaining people restore order. Rebuild civilization in the waste soil and look for the past in the debris. Magic brings a turn for the better, magic brings everything.

title: QuaQua
description: QuaQua (that's Aqua, with a Quack!) is the addictive duck game for you. Catch the falling blocks to build terrain and keep as much water on your island as possible. Beware of falling bombs and heavy rain as the difficulty slowly climbs in this tile-matching arcade puzzle adventure.

title: Yuza
description: Yuza is a gravity game with a story!

title: Darxanadon
description: Explore a massive interconnected labyrinth of grottos, castles, and groves in this 2D retro-inspired Action RPG.

title: Boss Beek-Beekeeping Simulator
description: Boss Beek is a beekeeping game that allows you to play the role of a beekeeper! You'll have hours of entertainment building hives with the best parts you can find to house the best queens and make the best honey!

title: Frog Fight
description: 4 Player online party battle game.

title: Madohi Shiroki no Kamikakushi
description: 《雪境迷途遇仙踪》是由日本知名美少女游戏品牌 Lump of Sugar 制作的奇幻恋爱作品。本作由知名画师萌木原文武（代表作《游魂》系列）担当游戏原画与角色设计，由多位业内资深写手共同创作剧本，由知名音乐人新井健史担当音乐制作，主题歌由方糖社当家歌姬Kicco与新锐创作型歌手逢濑晶联袂献唱。

title: OS: Memories
description: OS: Memories is a short and engaging storyline about the everyday life of a game developer. It offers an immersive experience through an old computer interface, allowing players to relive Andy's life story and uncover his deepest deadlocks. The game includes puzzles that provide insights into difficult situations and encourages players to explore Andy's personal archives and memories.

title: Zombie Good Guy
description: You are the Last Zombie on Earth and You are the Good Guy. The Evil Humans are trying to destroy You. Can You Survive ?

title: Hotel Architect
description:
Step into the chaotic 24/7 lifestyle of a hotel owner as you design and build grand hotels across the globe. Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in Hotel Architect, the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.

Advance in a career campaign mode, with a variety of objectives to complete, in order to unlock the sandbox mode across each location.

Create your own hotel from scratch or transform a dilapidated plot into a thriving business. Design the layout and hire construction workers to lay the foundations and build different facilities across multiple floors. Building requires careful planning, as it plays out in real-time, so be careful annoy, disturb or remove items your guests are using – or else they might leave a bad review!

title: Dead Gun
description: DEAD GUN is a 2D platformer with roguelike elements. Take control of a soldier of the elite squad Z-800 and go on an operation to clear friendly worlds from enemies in order to save them.

title: Line Strike
description: In Line Strike game, you get the role of the commander of a small army. All you need to do is select the type of troops and install it on the battlefield. The game does not require a quick reaction and microcontrol, only knowledge of the stats of your units and tactical ingenuity.

title: Treasure Temples
description: Puzzle your way through ancient treasure chambers in Antarctica. Floor tiles will crumble away behind you with every step you take, so tread carefully in your search for gold!

title: Zoo Seeker
description: Zoo Seeker is a hidden object game set in a fantasy world. Help the cats fix the mess they have caused by traveling to each world and finding the slimes hidden there.

title: Dino Island Adventure
description: Platform and action game set on and island with dinosaurs. Survive the hungry dinosaurs in the dangerous jungle and escape alive from the island.

title: Provisional Detective
description: A first-person mystery solving game, where you try to find out what happened at Syn Archives.

title: Chemistris
description: Chemistris is a tetris-like game based on chemistry equations. Let's play chemistry! Play fire, play water, play every elements in the universe!

title: Deadly Racing Duel
description: Deadly Racing Duel - in the role of a racer who conquers circuit auto racing, you accept challenge after challenge in order to prove how good a racer you are.

title: Aldebaran Legend
description: In a village located to the south, there is one of the twelve guardians, the warrior of Leo, known for his determination in combat and number of victories. Our hero will be responsible for finding the mystical artifacts, to prevent the kingdom from being bathed in blood and darkness.

title: War In Other Space
description: War In Other Space, Role-playing game, first-person shooter, there are 15 maps in the game, smart enemies with artificial intelligence, cool Science Fiction Weapons and all this in other Space

title: Ducky
description: Help save Ducky's siblings in this fun, adventure platformer. Jump your way through levels full of traps, enemies, and goodies. Flick switches, collect the keys, open the doors and let those siblings out!

title: Adventure of Tuck
description: Play as Tuck in this roguelike game called Adventure of Tuck. Explore different biomes, unlock new abilities, fight different types of monsters, befriend silly characters and last but not least, fight epic bosses.

title: Total Anarchy: Pavilion City
description: Welcome to the late ’90s. Explore the fully open-world of Pavilion City, a former paradise now consumed by corruption and violence. The anarchic hooligans, the devious guerrillas and the far-right legion are all vying for control of the city and everybody seems to want you dead.

title: The Tribe Must Survive
description: The Tribe Must Survive is a tribe-builder with a generous splash of survival and rogue-like. Whatever it takes... The Tribe Must Survive!

title: Dragon Evo
description: Dragon Evo is a fantasy themed tactical card game with over 300 different cards to collect. Combine building cards, equipment cards and hero cards with unique abilities with game-changing event cards. Play single player adventures or online in ranked or unranked modes with or without your friends.

title: Tukki & Champ
description: In Tukki & Champ a chameleon rides a toucan and they compete for food in an asymmetrical local 2-player matchup. Fly strategically as Tukki or aim precisely as Champ to grab more food than your opponent, in a game where you and your adversary move as one.

title: Phantom Zone: Cryptophasia
description: The future is just a toe away, where supernatural phenomena are frequent. Two identical twins, Akihito and Fuyuto Shirahane. They are caught up in a strange phenomenon in Yomori City, a town where various legends swirl around them.

title: SpongeGlock SquarePants
description: SpongeGlock SquarePants is an FPS game developed by indie game developer Mix Morris, inspired by Nickelodeon’s favorite cartoon series SpongeBob SquarePants in the late 90s. For those who want to download this unique game in Bikini Bottom, you can find the download links of the game in this article

title: Killbot General
description: Satisfying real-time tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Create a customized cause and lead it to glory as its hero Killbot General in the crazy, dynamic story campaign for single-player or co-op. Simple yet deep, controller-friendly, with emphasis on strategy, not micromanagement.

title: Marmalade box
description: Marmalade box - puzzle game. The object of the game is to find and touch 2 or more blocks of the same color. Enjoy over 100 levels. There are also bonuses (crackers, bombs). More blocks can be destroyed with them. An intelligent game that will increase your concentration.

title: Gyelfars
description: Mini turn-based tactics fantasy game.

title: Space Gliders
description: A young engineer on a quest to help their loved ones. Convince your kin to take the effort and explore distant lands.Protect your family, fight for their survival and a better future.Sky is not the limit.

title: Mologa
description: Description: in 1935, the leadership of the USSR decided to build a new reservoir in one of the regions of the republic. Almost all people left villages and towns, but some refused to leave their homes.

title: Blue Fire: Void Maker
description: Blue Fire: Void Maker is a 3D platforming and level creation game. Let your imagination run wild designing hardcore, epic or silly levels and sharing them with others! The possibilities are endless in this FREE spin-off of the highly-rated action adventure game Blue Fire.

title: Tokyo Detectives
description: Detective Game. Murder Investigation. Interrogate witnesses. Rebut with evidence.

title: Mirror Forge
description: Mirror Forge is a first-person psychological survival horror game. Roam between realities of fear, madness & machinery. Solve puzzles, explore an atmospheric world, survive horrifying entities in an immersive storyline where your choices matter.

title: On Your Hands
description: Cast into a hostile alien world, you alone must solve puzzles and fight deadly monsters using the magical abilities on your hands.

title: Billy Bumbum: A Cheeky Puzzler
description:
Solve challenging puzzles as a cube with a butt. Flip, push and fart your way through colorful levels as you rescue your adorable friends in need. Fart for freedom!

Use seemingly simple mechanics in surprisingly deep and satisfying ways to rescue your friends in over 250 levels.

title: Roll the Cat
description: Did you ever wake up in the middle of the night because you heard the cat meowing? This game is just about that! Meet a family with five naughty cats and solve puzzles while trying to convince them to sleep.

title: Mechanibot
description: In this tactical rogue-like auto battler, you'll build your unique team of robots and keep them alive as they fight. Battle through waves of enemies as you travel from planet to planet on a mission to fix the sun. Strategize, protect, survive. A Mechanibot's wrench never rests.

title: Fish Story: Gourmet Puzzle
description: The new adventures of Lucian and his friend XO! This time the friends are traveling through mysterious planets in search of delicacies!

title: Regular Factory: Escape Room
description: You don't work in a regular assembly line. In this escape room, you will investigate what is really being manufactured in a secret factory, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles. Will you unravel the truth?

title: Alien Age
description: Alien Age is a chaotic merging single player game. As an alien, you combine and deliver a variety of resources before hopeful towns crumble to dust. Prime your engine and shine your saucer, towns are eager to see what the future holds… and they won't wait forever.

title: Hell Bound Monsters
description: Hell Bound Monsters is a TPS survivor game where the goal is not to get us an angel of hell. Everyone goes to hell if they do something wrong. Demons come out of hell and suck your soul out. What do you think you deserve to get to heaven?

title: ABC Flappy
description: Learn how to spell and assemble words to unlock prizes. You can trace and colour the letters of the alphabet too. Swoop deeply into this amazing adventure alongside Albert, the eager for knowledge albatross, flying through the many levels to save his silly friends while learning the alphabet.

title: The Exodus
description: Play an old-school 2D RPG in the vein of Skyfall, Last Heroes and Fantasy Heroes!

title: I, W.O.M.A.N.
description: Battle dangerous robots that have been taken over by a malicious alien program. Customize your character, then fight your way to the Bridge, using power-ups and specialized weapons, to reboot the Central Computer before the berserk robots make it to the human passengers aboard the spaceship.

title: Stop the Saturnians!
description: Stop the Saturnians is a shooter inspired by classic arcade games. Dodge enemy fire, destroy procedurally generated alien waves and fight massive bosses. Collect resources in the midst of combat to upgrade your ship or improve Earth's defenses. Protect yourself and the planet both!

title: Island Berry
description: Search for treasures, fish, garden and craft, help mysterious locals and fight monsters to find your way home one day.

title: Nebula Invasion
description: Nebula Invasion was designed for those who enjoy the classic type arcade games, a spaceship shooter with great gameplay. Aliens attack many different ways from marching to dive bombing. You have the tools to fight back with a ship that can power-up with double, triple, rapid fire, or plasma cannon.

title: Nuclear Assault
description: Nuclear Assault is a Shoot 'em Up with all the essence of Arcades in the 90s! Equip new cannons, collect different Power-Ups, defeat the 4 Robot Kings and earn new scores! But most importantly... Shoot, shoot and don't stop shooting!

title: Larry the Unlucky: Part 3
description: Help Larry find a cure for his wife and break his curse of unluckiness by solving riddles and puzzles on his adventures around the whole world.

title: Auro the Bunny
description: Auro - The Bunny is a 2D platform game, in which the player will have to go through obstacles in order to catch all the fruits of the levels to win.

title: Jaki's Wacky Adventure
description: Play as Jaki, a clever ninja fox, in this WACKY action-adventure. Explore, Fight, & Craft as you investigate a murder & chase a killer. On your perilous journey, you encounter deadly robots, bugs & beasts. You will always be surprised in this diverse wacky adventure!

title: Explosive Snooker
description: A game of dodgeball on a snooker table

title: Pog 6
description: Cute, minimal physical puzzle.

title: Christmas Stories: Yulemen - Collector's Edition
description: A Christmas Calamity Hits Iceland!

title: Babyquick: Adventure of the Moon Dragon
description: Once upon a time, there was a terrible force of evil called "The Fud King." The Fud King fed on the fear, uncertainty and doubt of his people. This story begins shortly before his fall.

title: The Ghost: Task of the Ghost Hunters
description: Always wanted to be a ghost hunter? Then you have come to the right place with The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters. You will experience the job as a ghost hunter up close and have to solve exciting puzzles.

title: Ridle
description: RIDLE is a 2D action game where you run around the stage in all directions.

title: Redshot
description: Quick reflexes and clever strategies are required in REDSHOT, a bullet-time metroidvania where everything is deadly, but you are deadlier. Can you save the royal city from total destruction? ...Can you do it with style?

title: Skull Bullets
description: Skull Bullets is a roguelike game with RPG elements. You are a risen from the dead shooter who is trying to get out of the endless forest with the undead. Upgrade your skills, get new weapons and deal with a whole crowd of enemies. Will you be able to get out? It all depends on you.

title: Rescue Team: Power Eaters
description: Embark on an electrifying adventure to save the world from a robotic menace! As the leader of the Rescue Team, you will guide your courageous crew as it attempts to shut down the Power Eaters before they turn Earth into a huge ball of lightning!

title: Battle Arena Soccer
description: Incredible Arcade Soccer and Football Game.

title: Makis Adventure
description: Makis Adventure is an Action- Platformer with shark demons. Fight, dash, swim and bite your way through 3 different dungeons. Let the inner shark out! Face many different opponents and defeat powerful bosses.

title: Deep Russian Depression
description: “Deep Russian Depression” is a visual novel about people whose fate is a miserable, dreary and hopeless existence somewhere in post-Soviet Russia.

title: Labyrinth of the Demon King
description: Venture through the Labyrinth Of The Demon King, solving puzzles and fighting fearsome monsters in an epic quest to track down the demon who betrayed your lord and end it’s life.

title: Histera
description: Histera is a free-to-play, rapid-fire multiplayer shooter featuring dynamic deathmatch arenas that transform as you fight! Histera propels the FPS genre into the future with our ‘Glitch’ mechanic that procedurally re-generates maps during matches, delivering unpredictable, feverish combat.

title: Is It You?
description: Is It You? is an online social deduction game set in a mushroom world. Voice chat with other players and use the abilities of your role to find out who's friend or foe. For up to 15 players.

title: Sword of Shadow: Revolution
description: Sword of Shadow: Revolution is an open-world role-playing game. the actions of which take place in the universe of the gods and any mistake can lead to the death of the whole world.

title: Moto Roller
description: Moto Roller is an arcade motorcycle racing game. You ride a fast motorcycle through a city filled with cars or along a narrow highway.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic
description: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic is a reimagining of the 3D Platformer but told through a unique, pinball format. End the witch’s wicked schemes and conquer her many challenges. Prove once and for all, that you are the true pinball champion!

title: Photoq
description: Hi, I'm Joseph Karras. I'm a photojournalist specializing in documenting paranormal activities. The church sent me here to this house to collect evidence from a supposed ghost that resides here.

title: Tenebrae
description: A cryptic message takes the young vampire to Tenebrae nightclub, where seven incarnations of deadly sins will stand in her way. Now she has to survive among intrigues and solve the mystery of her mother's disappearance. Which circle will you choose, Beatrice?

title: Goose vs. Zombies
description: Wake up, Goose, your village is invaded by zombies. Solve puzzles, open paths for exploration, defeat enemies. Hooonk!

title: Social Services of the Doomed
description: With all the supernatural feuds you mediate, from vampires to trolls, your city job should be paying you more. And Hell's got a great offer for your soul.

title: Ember Crusade IV
description: Ember Crusade IV is a twin stick looter shooter roguelike where you embark on a blazing crusade to save the solar system from a demonic invasion.

title: Chronicles of Deeps
description: Chronicles of Deeps is Sci-fi FPS where you need to control submarines to get through story. In 2070, an event happened which left the whole world under the ocean. People separated on fractions and started to fight for resources. In 2112, some things happened which you should discover in this game.

title: Time Flipper
description: Press one button to switch between timelines, this is your time-flip device, use it to find the missing people and convince them to follow you. Lead them out by switching the world state. Enemies will attack you but you carry no weapons, escape the violence by switching between timelines.

title: Metroplex Zero
description: Cyberpunk party-based strategic card battle RPG. Assemble a team that fits your playstyle to take on evil mega corporations. Customize your decks and choose your cards wisely to defeat tough foes. Power up your heroes with gear, augments, cards, and level ups.

title: Cradle of Souls
description: After winning the war, Alastria is enjoying peace, but not the King. His wife is sick with a dangerous disease. In charge of finding an antidote is Orlando, the veteran Crusader, and Saigo, the Demon Hunter. What will happen as consequences of this mission and it's outcome will change everything...

title: Mandala

You’ve managed to secure a spot for your new Inn. It might be the shady part of town but at least there are no annoying guards checking up on you.
