description: Run, shoot, dash and magic your way through hordes of vile creatures in various procedurally generated dungeons. Combine items in countless ways and master each character – all while discovering secret places and finding out more about the enchanted world of Vividerie.

title: Showbiz Tycoon
description: Own a movie studio, negotiate with talents, schedule releases, make money, expand your business and become the biggest in the industry.

title: Jaws & Claws
description: Jaws & Claws combines elements of platformer, beat'em up, fighter, gunfires, sports competiotions and adventures in a world full of crazy creatures. Waste no time and jump in the fire to the sounds of hard'n'heavy.

title: Spoockey
description: Who cares about Christmas! We wanted Halloween all year long, so we made Spoockey, a competitive multiplayer air hockey/block break mashup to satisfy your creepy cravings

title: Citrus Rampage
description: Call up your buddies and enjoy the acidic chaos of Citrus Rampage, a physics-based multiplayer shooter with silly guns and destructible environments. Play with up to 4 players in local multiplayer or online using Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Ukiyo
description: Ukiyo is a story-based adventure game set in cyberspace. You control the main character Kai, a samurai cat, as he explores the cyberspace. Enjoy a unique world that combines Japanese art style and cyberpunk.

title: Mondealy
description: Mondealy is about you building relationships and exploring the world. An ordinary guy from an ordinary town on an ordinary day uncovers the secrets of an extraordinary underground kingdom located under his home. Your adventure begins!

title: New Terra
description: New Terra is a challenging and addictive multi-directional gravity-based space shooter. Fuel goes fast and is hard to come by. Hauling cargo makes your ship very heavy and mobility becomes limited. Strategy and resource conservation is key to completing your missions or you won't survive.

title: Suber Driver
description: Complete different driving missions as a taxi or private taxi driver and pick your favorite car from a selection of over 15 amazing vehicles, with tons of customizations.

title: Kingdom Traveler
description: A survival exploration game where you can explore islands, challenge various monsters and defeat powerful Bosses. Craft various weapons and items, place items, grow vegetables and fruits, and trade with merchants. Set sail in the harbor, encounter pirates, monsters and random events in the sea.

title: Chimes
description: Chimes is a silly PvP game with a fully controllable character and goofy Ragdoll physics.

title: IllusionCircle
description: IllusionCircle is a unique and very interesting game, and you will be deeply shocked by it.Make you believe that the world is not real. You will find it very difficult to get a higher score. You need to challenge your limits.It's a good choice to give it as a gift to your friends this Christmas.

title: Master Forge
description: You own a smithy and the land around it. Gather resources outside or buy them when the trader visits and craft products to sell to customers. Some will have special requests for you, which will allow you to earn more money and also fame. Enough fame will make customers pay more money.

title: We are Blacksmith
description: 'We are Blacksmith' is action game created dot image. Became the blacksmith, and adventure the cave, mine the materials, battle to monsters. Cast the products and the weapons, the protectors. And sell to created items.

title: Momo's Mansion
description: Fun and cute RPG about a loveable cat named MOMO who goes on a epic adventure. Family friendly content for all ages. DID WE MENTION CATS!?!?

title: Necrotopia
description: Necrotopia is an exploratory action game, in which a monster, who woke up on a stormy night by lightning, picks up junks as weapons and searches for who he/she is. Use various types of weapons to defeat enemies and explore the fascinating world.

title: Halloween Night
description: HyperCard point and click game where you open the door to Halloween costumed monsters and give them candy.

title: Ooze Redux
description: A NES hard game, made to run and play on original hardware. Ported to the PC. 7 hard and unique levels. An original gripping ChipTune sound track! 8 bit glory in this side scrolling shooter platformer!

title: Umille
description: Un prototipo, un idea di quello che potrebbe essere un RPG classico con le meccaniche di un Souls-like. Questo gioco si concentra soprattutto sulla storia che viene narrata in poche righe di dialogo e sta al giocatore capire come stanno le cose...

title: Crazy Truck
description: Become the king of the road - a truck driver who delivers important cargo! Crazy Truck gives you a very realistic truck driving experience! Deliver heavy oil tanks and other cargo. Put your skills, stamina and speed to the test.

title: Semiconductor
description: A tactical platformer about the near future, powerful organizations, military concerns, and accident.

title: LTO Arcade
description: Blast Off with LTO Arcade! LTO Arcade puts you straight into the action! From our fast-paced arena mode inspired by the classic "Asteroids" game, to the intellectual struggle of "Minesweeper" - LTO Arcade is the perfect fall-back for any quick gaming urge!

title: Her Jentle Hi-ness
description: A fast-paced visual novel game where you must survive the whims of a mad queen, with a unique combination of classic art scenes and cartoon people

title: Obama Boss Fight
description: In the world where all answers were told the great enemies confronted each other. The time has come. Time to defeat Obama once and for all. Will the world be free from racism or you will start a new era? It is up to you. But keep in mind... Obama has no chill.

title: Overbowed
description: Explore a kingdom overrun by evil magic as you fight foes with your own magical bow.

title: Sneezeman
description: Introducing a new type of hero for the pandemic age! Platforming fun with hand drawn graphics from irreverent comedic powerhouse 'Modern Toss'! Avoid the chaotic sneeze cloud, out manoeuvre goose-stepping bad guys and navigate giant virus spores. Can you Escape from Planet Sneeze?!

title: Zenteni
description: Build, conquer and collect puzzles.

title: Falconet
description: Falconet is a retro-style twin stick shooter with smooth weapon switching and quick reaction gameplay. Travel through unique levels, solve puzzles, and use your diverse arsenal of weapons to efficiently eliminate an army of rogue machines, rescue human survivors, and rack up high scores.

title: Luna: Supernatural Hunter
description: In Luna: Supernatural Hunter use your guns in an addictive bullet hell top-down shooter, accompanied by your cat Joe, who has healing powers, to exterminate all the monsters that are attacking the village.

title: Doomer
description: Try on the role of a Russian Doomer, who lives in a typical post-Soviet building. Your pointless life filled with routine and addictions. Can you cope with it?

title: Chesskoban Bishop
description: Relaxing puzzle game for chess lovers and beginners using a combination of sokoban and chess mechanics. Capture enemy bishops to complete levels.

title: Palphone-Sama: Curse Call
description: All of the Twitter accounts and Websites in the game exist in reality. Use your Internet browser to gather information and uncover hidden secrets, and get to the bottom of the urban legend surrounding the popular calling and live streaming App "Palphone"!

title: Full Metal Sergeant
description: You are a drill instructor, you have 12 weeks to turn a herd of dumb conscripts into war machines. Set their planning, upgrade your bootcamp and make sure the recruits don't kill themselves. Sir, Yes Sir!

title: Ekoh Beach
description: Ekoh Beach is where you spent the best vacations of your childhood: golden sandy beaches, awesome arcades, zen tranquility and friendly faces. You have answered the call to return to Ekoh Beach once again and return its former glory with your building skills.

title: Marmoset
description: In a world ravaged by World War III, a group of survivors found safety at the top of the trees, only without the resources of the caves the city of Marmoset will not have a future, however you can change that.

title: Nailed It
description: Nailed It is a VR puzzle game. You will make a path to your agent to reach its target.

title: Catherine Ragnor and the Legend of the Flying Dutchman
description: After falling victim to a curse, Captain Hendrick van der Decken of the Flying Dutchman is doomed to sail the seas for eternity. However, a chance encounter with another cursed pirate shows him a chance to find salvation. Play this thrilling Match3 adventure and help Captain van Decken.

title: Grey Heritage: Faded Vision
description: Command a rebellion as Leon Beaumont, Exiled Prince of Astrea, against the king that betrayed him. Engage in a classic turn-based tactical RPG experience as you unravel untold secrets from the past. Recruit allies, manage inventory, and train your soldiers in this JRPG inspired journey!

title: Funny Panda
description: If you love challenging platformers, then don't pass up this great game. In Funny Panda you have to play as a very funny panda who loves to run, jump and overcome the most difficult traps and obstacles on the way !!!

title: Gangsta: The Return
description: Gangsta series will return. Now you are super gangsta soldier and need find captured virus. Use different weapons and magical skills to destroy enormous evil army

title: Through the World
description: Great Arcade with runner and clicker elements. There are unforgettable adventures waiting for you with many collapsing barriers and more. Get points for destroying barriers, update your health, increase the stock of spheres and open new worlds forward.

title: Ice Sugar
description: Ice Sugar is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level. 100 levels. 5 musical compositions. Varied bonus.

title: Ani Leaving Sirius
description: A dying planet in energy chaos, dangerous districts and challenging combats. Your only chance to escape the planet is through inconsistent portal! Gain energy crystals by slaying enemies. Improve your abilities and acquire drones. Complete your escape quest in this challenging rouge-lite gameplay.

title: The Grave robber
description: The grave robber is a role play / action adventure / puzzle solving game, which tells the story of the treasure hunt for Cao Cao.

title: The House Before
description: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

title: Dungeon's Fall
description: Face the hardest and longest Dungeon ever made. Use power-ups, to increase difficulty or make it easier.

title: Crops and Conveyors
description: Crops and Conveyors is a cozy game about building an automated farm. Enjoy the satisfying progression of starting from scratch, gathering resources, earning money and growing your farm.

title: Balls and Dungeons
description: Challenging spatial puzzle platformer. Open walls and put the balls in the holes. Requires logic and tactics to complete. Lots of levels with increasing complexity. Relaxing and ambient gameplay. How deep can you get?

title: Unko Typing
description: "UNKO Typing" is a simple typing practice game. Players need to type words related to "Japanese UNKO" as quickly and accurately as possible. Even those who are not good at typing can enjoy typing while being healed by "Japanese UNKO" in this game.

title: Seventh Angel
description: Seventh Angel is a surreal psychological first person horror game of a man on the brink of absolute madness. Questioning the veracity of blurred memories and hallucinations, and discovering the lies within himself. Stunning graphics, intense action and masterful storytelling. Experience the madness.

title: Bingiman: Trap Ochido
description: BINGIMAN: Trap Ochido is a fast paced , boomer shooter inspired video game with a sinister African aesthetic feel through its voodoo and gunplay art direction.

title: Jump1000
description: Jump and collect coins to upgrade your slime's jumping power! If the jumping power increases, you will be able to collect more and more coins! Remember! Your goal is to reach 100 floor!

title: Bauer
description: Bauer is a side-scrolling fun little arcade game where you help a simple mouse fly his plane and avoid all the obstacles in the air.

title: Kukumushi Virtual Pet
description: Adopt and care for your Kukumushi, watching them grow and evolve. Feed, clean and play with your virtual pets!

title: Floor is...What!?
description: Floor is...What!? doesn't just mean floor is lava! Experience 4 player mini game mayhem with 50+ games set in a snow filled frozen tundra, hungry shark infested waters, low gravity moon base, and more while customizing your characters with over 100 unlockable costumes!

title: Faye Falling
description: Explore purgatory as you discover who you are and how you died, in this heartfelt RPG.

title: The Paribneur Combination
description: Make your way through the abandoned establishment of Paribneur Co. As you discover the hidden secrets and horrifying creatures of the building. Being forced to find a new way out of the building, you will face hard choices, choose carefully, your choices will affect the rest of the game...

title: Demons Roots
description: In a final struggle for survival, demonkind again invaded the human world. However, the world they return to after years in the darkness isn't the same as it once was...

title: Baptism of Fire
description: What at first was just another ranger duty, becomes the duty of champions trusted to protect the whole country's safety. In a race against time and against the former Champion Jorgen, Zasker and his party must secure all three Volgaia Shards to save the country from total ruin.

title: Alchera
description: Alchera A Struggle for Life steward in an alternate universe, sees a portal at the end of the cave during an operation, wondering and approaching the steward. He enters the portal and finds himself in an age where god and his soldiers rule the earth, his goal is to find the portal and save himself.

title: Everdine: A Lost Girl's Tale
description: Everdine finds herself lost in a forest of eternal twilight. Help her gather the needed ingredients to perform a magic ritual to escape before the dangers of these woods devour poor Everdine. ~ An atmospheric, fairy tale vibes RPG Maker horror adventure.

title: Cattails: Wildwood Story
description: Lead your colony of cats into the mysterious Wildwood. Stalk prey to find food, defend your new home from dark intruders, and discover fresh herbs & ancient treasures. Build a thriving town for all cats to call home. Get to know the residents, fall in love, and raise a litter of kittens!

title: Sniperpunk
description: Sniperpunk is an epic arena shooter where every bullet ricochets. Duel players online or locally in high-octane casual or ranked 1v1 matches. Outplay opponents with 4 punk-themed characters, each with unique weapons and abilities. And it's free! Bring your friends and ricochet your way to victory!

title: Play Outside Simulator
description: Play Outside is a game in which you can do your favorite activities ... on your PC! (without really going outside).

title: Project Delta
description: Explore all possible realities as you try and save the multiverse from the Darkness in this unique Procedural Meta-Metroidlike Adventure.

title: Crow Story
description: Jump, dive, and platform through this minimalistic indie 3D platformer about a little crow trying to save his friends.

title: You Are A Pilot
description: You Are A Pilot is a 2D arcade simulator of a pilot who drives jet-powered flying car. The controls are based on physics. Deliver various goods, drive livestock on a farm, or defend the earth from alien invaders.

title: Celestial Project
description: "Celestial Project" is a Roguelike WarChess game. It is the first game of the story "Celestial". Command the special operations forces, resist and study unknown alien creatures from space, defend the five star ship civilization spacecraft under construction on earth, and retain human kindling!

title: Sokobot
description: Sokobot is an open-ended puzzle game where you place down cute robots, give them commands, and create infinitely-looping assembly lines that combine shapes together!

title: The Flea Evolution: Bugaboo
description: Relive The Flea or experience it for the first time in The Flea Evolution, a skill and ingenuity game where you have to guide the flea through a maze of intricate caverns. Your mission is to find the exit jumping between the different platforms, but be careful not to get eaten by the enemies!

title: The Tale of Fighting Nymphs
description: The fighting game looks like anime style.

title: Wordle 5
description: Wordle 5 is the culmination of the Wordle series with brand new puzzles 10 new categories, 500 puzzles

title: Atelier Agnes
description: Agnes, a girl living will her ill sister, meets her master of alchemy, Bell Faris for the first time in 7 years. She makes up her mind to become a mature alchemist when Bell indicates about the recovery of her sister. But Bell was planning to utilize Agnes's kind character to repay her debt...

title: Sprocket Wings
description: In this fast-paced 3D racing game, you’ll go wing to wing against a motley band of Gnomelings. After zigzagging through 16 trippy courses, you’ll wonder: Is it a race with a twist or a twisted rave? Either way, expect a potent dose of disorienting visuals and disturbing surprises at every turn.

title: Sanya
description: 2D narrative adventure game about the warmth of fleeting childhood memories: about a little boy named Sanya, his dog, his friends and many exciting adventures that await them in a small post-soviet Russian town set in the achingly strange and nostalgic period of the 90s.

title: The Defaloon
description: The Defaloon - this is a single-player game made in an abstract 2.5-day schedule. The essence of the gameplay is to clear the level of enemies with a large number of different weapons, such as magic or spells.

title: Enraged
description: Deck the halls with bullets and elf-matter in this high-octane 2D melee-shooter where you embark on a mission to put an end to Santa's sweatshop

title: Commuter
description: Commuter is a top-down 2D pixel art driving game inspired by old-school arcade games.

title: Nios
description: NIOS is a futuristic anti gravity obstacle racing game arcade where you run along a point to point paths in a open world map. Get your best score overtaking the greatest number of opponents in sequences without hit them. P.S. Remember to follow the green arrow otherwise you could get lost. :-)

title: Ring of Titans
description: Ring of Titans is a modern take on the small scale fast paced team combat arena genre. Queue up to play 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3, the first team to eliminate everyone from the other team wins. No grinding, no pay to win, just queue and play.

title: Goomanuvr
description: In this hilarious and challenging platformer, swing and jump your way though the harsh depths of a Child's Toy Room, the relaxing heat of the Beach, the zaniness of a Carnival, and the extravagance of the Disco! Put your skills to the test in Single or Multiplayer.

title: Kill The Monster Z
description: Kill The Monster Z is a pixel-style, side-scrolling action game where you play The role of The main character, trying to destroy what you see as enemies, but it's not that easy.

title: The Dragon and the Djinn
description: Make a wish! Can your djinn help you save the city from a dragon, or will you befriend the dragon and learn its secrets?

title: Empires of the Void II
description: A sci-fi turn-based strategy game. A faithful digital rendition of the beloved board game, Empires of the Void II.

title: Little Sparks
description: A puzzle game about fireflies

title: Space Waves
description: Space Waves is a procedurally generated 2D arcade style shooter with multiple collectable power ups and varying enemy types. This game will casually draw you in and then increase the pace and difficulty as you progress through the never ending levels.

title: Zarktor's Realm
description: Zarktor's Realm is a beautiful open-world RPG adventure inspired by Skyrim. Explore medieval England on horseback, uncover Arthurian legends, battle hordes of undead, gather and upgrade.

title: Aplestia: Retold
description: Follow the steps of Britton, Summer, Sover and Marina, a team of four rookie adventurers that went on their first ever S Class Quest! Aplestia:Retold is the remade version of the 2017 game and offers double the content, more side quests, stages and much much more!

title: Kingdom's Life
description: Kingdom's Life - Large turn-based global strategy game in pixel style. You have to create your own people and state. Can you lead the state to political, economic, technological and military triumph? It depends on you.

title: MMA Championship
description: MMA Championship is a mixed martial arts fighting game

title: TripSync
description: A machine-learning utilizing application for immersing in a bundle of multi-world diverting storylines of random interesting scenarios in which the characters are vocally interactable.

title: Spookware: Watch Party
description: A collection of spooky microgames featuring fast-paced gameplay inspired by horror classics. Chop off legs, hurl hatchets, clash cards with Nosferatu, and many other ghoulish acts of terror!

title: George: A Horror Story
description: While out on a relaxing hike in the woods, George loses his bearing and finds himself lost in the mountains. He now has one goal. Finding a way back to civilization and safety, and escaping the dangers of these lands.

title: Ball & Roll
description: Ball & Roll is a physics-based platform game that you can play solo or with friends! Control your cute animal inside a rolling ball, overcome challenging obstacles, move fast, and reach the top as quickly as possible. But be careful... One mistake can send you all the way back to the start!

title: Froggerty Arcade 2
description: The hop is on. More classic arcade froggy goodness from Tudou Games.

title: Hard Glide
description: This is an arcade-style inertial skill-shooter with mouse control only.

title: Robert Robie and the Idols of Jade
description: Hilarious adventure game in cartoon style. Robert Robie receives a mysterious assignment while hiding from the police in a cheap motel in Mexico.

title: Mistake
description: This mod will let us into a horroristic world in the Andrew Parker asylum and we will live through (or not) in the view of a mental patient. The mod’s primal object is not the insane bloodbath. The real object is to escape from the huge building which holds a lot of secrets.

title: Apocalyptic Vibes
description: An immersive retro first-person shooter on GZDoom. You are a lone wanderer walking through the endless wasteland. Your destination is vague... Search the ruins of a dead civilization, get into gunfights, survive in severe post-apocalyptic weather. And find the meaning along the way.

title: Missing Mildred
description: A 2D platformer game with puzzle elements in a retro NES/SNES style. The story is about finding a missing cat named Mildred.

title: Imitating Zombies
description: Imitating Zombies is a game where you have to play the role of a zombie, go through the path, eating brains and dodging boomerangs. Only the road is not so smooth, and banging your head takes your life. Balancing and running the entire route, go through all the levels and reach the goal.

title: Ailuri
description: A hand-drawn, 2D platformer following the breathtaking story of an endangered red panda, named Ailuri. Climb, explore and survive the intricate levels while trying to defeat enemies to restore balance of life in the world.

title: Absentis
description: Adventure game with RPG elements in which you have to take on the role of a young and ambitious traveler named Jack, for whom a trip to a frightening, but alluring island with its secrets turned out to have completely unexpected consequences.

title: Memory Grove
description: A mood journal come to life. Record your thoughts and feelings each day and watch as the library of your memories grows more popular and your garden grows more verdant.

title: Last Group Out
description: Shoot, loot and try to escape with your life in this online co-op looter shooter!

title: Ending Way
description: Chapter 2 is now here waiting for you. With horrible creatures and things you can do to get out. But ... beware of Adi

title: Spin City
description: "Spin City" is a simulator of an elite casino full of secrets, where you can fully plunge in the world of excitement and try your luck, enjoying the elegant neon design. Make risky bets, feel free to spin the roulette wheel and win in real time!

title: NeoLemmix
description: NeoLemmix is a modernised clone of the early-90s video game Lemmings. Its history begins with EricLang's "Lemmix", also a Lemmings clone, which sought to replicate the gameplay physics of the DOS version of Lemmings perfectly, while adding features like framestepping, saveable replays and Windows compatibility. Whereas Lemmix's goal was accurate reproduction, NeoLemmix - which began as a fork of Lemmix by namida - had the goal of removing all the glitches, increasing user-friendliness, and simplifying the use of fan-made content. Eventually, it also introduced many new gameplay features. These days, NeoLemmix is considered a completely distinct engine from Lemmix, which is once again being developed by namida.

title: Plinko Panic!
description: Plinko Panic! is a roguelike 'board-builder' about using a set of pinballs and a pachinko board in order to delve through dungeons and defeat numerous enemies. Buy a new pinball at the end of each round and see just how far you can get!

title: Bad Way
description: Bad Way is an action adventure game in the style of TPS.History professor Michael Wayne hadn't yet realised the trouble he was getting into when he got the call. This unexpected trouble that he didn't plan at all would drag him into an adventure that he could never imagine.

title: Sunny Beach
description: Plunge into the summer atmosphere with the game Sunny Beach!

title: Violent Agent
description: Violent Agent - Top Down Shooter, where you play as a secret agent. You need to get rid of enemies and return the money to the company. Gather all your will into a fist and passing level after level, using a knife and a machine gun, destroy everyone in your path.

title: The Dawn: Sniper's Way
description: The industrial city "Seversk" was abandoned after the 1981 flood, which led to a number of irreversible consequences at the nuclear power plant and research laboratories. Play as mercenaries, unite, act in your own or common interests.

title: Life in the Machine
description: A detective game, which involves investigating a crime scene.

title: Death in the Family
description: "Death in the family" is a horror game about how the dead can confuse, frighten and even kill those they don't like.

title: Ninja Soul
description: Ninjasoul is a platform action game that combines roguelite with Galaxy warrior demon city. Kunoichi, Tachibana Yachiyo unexpectedly awakened the ability of "death backtracking". She will find the truth in the land that used to be her hometown in the fight and death again and again.

title: Fire in the Beastlands
description: An old-school 2D sidescrolling action RPG soulslike metroidvania influenced by the greats of the past!

title: Emiko's Pledge
description: Emiko's Pledge is a 2D Platform Action game based on the story of a Half Demon girl called Emiko, whose mission is to fulfill her dream of becoming the best warrior in the Demon world and also, to protect the Ettaze state from the enemies who infiltrated into the territory.

title: Mojito Woody's Rescue
description: MOJITO Woody's Rescue puts you on a journey to find your best dog friend Woody, who has been kidnapped by an evil Cucumber, in a cute 3d adventure with sandbox levels, platforming challenges and exploration zones. Inspired by Super Mario 64 - Odyssey / Banjo Kazooie / Celeste

title: Great Lakes Simulator
description: Great Lakes Simulator... Drive 1-to-1 Scale Lake Freighters On The World Famous Great Lakes!

title: Armchair Racer
description: Race against your friends or AI in this top down arcade racer!

title: Abeyance
description: Abeyance is a roguelite, sci-fi, dungeon-crawler. Salvage wrecked starships in a gritty, post-apocalyptic world. Fight mutants and mechanized defense systems. Battle your inner demons to save your soul… and reclaim your humanity.

title: Lazy Girl
description: Action-platformer with puzzles for the most hardcore gamers! Help the young wizard to save her loved one. Use your reaction, intelligence, and some gravity-changing magic to complete ten dungeons and fight the evil technomage.

title: Happy Bones Infernal
description: Upon arriving at a correctional facility located in a remote mountainous region, a young man named Roan quickly finds his surroundings are falling into disarray in this Horror-Themed JRPG!

title: FlavorSpace
description: Create your own unique dishes across a series of sci-fi cooking competition shows. Learn to impress alien judges with varied tastes, as you master bizarre ingredients and high-tech gadgets. Food is simulated at pixel scale with virtually endless possibilities.

title: Lemon vs. Teddy
description: Become a lemon and destroy the world with sausages before Teddy does it in this combat-focused RPG.

title: The Piano That Stops Time
description: The Piano That Stops Time is an emotional visual novel about a boy and a girl who play the piano.

title: After Shadows
description: After Shadows is a metroidvania with roguelike elements. Get into a distant post-apocalyptic future, where all of humanity became extinct. Explore the abandoned Fortress, look for traps and hide from Dark Monster who is chasing you.

title: Neon Souls
description: Neon Souls is a Fast-paced Splatformer where you Paint Invisible Platforms with Neon Ink. Everything you do(Walk, Jump, Double Jump, Slide by the Walls) Spray Neon Ink in the Platforms, the game have a lot of Levels and Bosses to be beaten for you Soft and Small Hands.

title: Crystarise
description: Explore a vast field, create your own sky island, the island gives the girl the power. An open world-action RPG that rises with a mysterious sky island.

title: Agent Stilus
description: Agent Stilus is a 2D side-scrolling platformer shooter. Omega Corp creates implants and chips for implantation into people.

title: Mistral
description: Mistral is a 3D action roguelike game where you journey through a fantasy world. Collect relics to boost your powers, and use your weapons & spells to defeat the force of evil.

title: Raiders of the Icepeak Mountains
description: Battle orc clans and survive deadly dungeons while leveling up as an adventurer. Will you become a fighter, wizard, cleric or rogue?

title: Sin Bearers Tactics
description: Follow the Sin Bearers' adventures, a mercenary group evolving in a fictive near future on Earth, through the 24 maps of this old school tactical game.

title: Ages of Cataria
description: Care for generations of townsfolk in a land of mystique and wonder. Build colonies along side your friends in this multiplayer colony sim and narrative RPG.

title: Hack and Slime
description: What could be scarier than a massive dungeon-tower infested with skulls, ogres, and dragons? That those same monsters ride the largest multinational in the world with it. You know; business is business.

title: DarkHouse
description: This is not a typical corridor horror, but a game in a semi-open world with horror elements. You will have to perform a reverse ritual in a psychiatric clinic in order to banish the creepy Doctor back to Hell! Not for weaklings!!! Especially in the Nightmare mode, a real hardcore awaits you!

title: Longtail!!
description: Longtail!! is a story-driven action-adventure game where metroidvania-style exploration meets puzzle-filled dungeons. Uncover secrets, master energy powers, and traverse a shifting world on the brink of collapse. A heartwarming, action-packed journey full of charm and discovery awaits!

title: Pizza Man
description: Race against time to deliver your pizzas.

title: Welcome to Empyreum
description: Welcome to Empyreum is a local co-op party game up to 4 players. The main goal is to organize and clean numerous floors of the hotel with mechanics involving everyday chores (vacuuming or making the bed), and crazy tasks like taking care of alien babies and chasing ghosts away!

title: OtherSoul
description: In this horror game, you must do everything you can to escape the demon’s clutches alive. Your soul is at stake. You will be saved or you will be damned forever. Remember, in the game, your choices can affect the people most important to you. Protect them and your mental state! Fight to the end!

title: NecroBouncer
description: Rogue-like dungeon crawler where you have a chance to play as a necromancer, who works as a bouncer in a dungeon club. Choose your path, try out endless builds, and go on to defeat hardcore bosses to acquire and unleash their powers on hordes of enemies!

title: Pity Please!
description: Pity Please! is a homeless mastery game about survival, strategy, exploration, and capitalizing on societal systems while adapting to the vagrant lifestyle! A grid-based, casual survival strategy game with a cartoony 2.5D isometric aesthetic.

title: Twinland
description: Twinland is a Metroidvania set in a kingdom full of weird creatures, dangerous dungeons and powerful artifacts. Explore varied locations, fight numerous bosses – and be on lookout for secrets 'cause they are everywhere!

title: Psycho Bathroom
description:
Psycho Bathroom is a 2D boss rush game. In the bathroom you reside in, your toilet lid is broken. Every toilet flush is splashing aerosols all over the place. You, as a toothbrush, must eradicate the threat and protect your master.
Upgrade your gear! Meet new buddies! Bond with your master and explore his dark but comic story.

title: Cleared Hot
description: CLEARED HOT is a nostalgic helicopter shooter with satisfying physics and light tactical elements. Shoot, dodge, move your squad around the battlefield, and pick up almost anything with your rope and magnet.

title: He Will Shoot
description: He Will Shoot - is a simple zombie killer from the third person in a variety of scenery. Choose from four arenas: a Post-Apocalyptic City, a Slum, an Industrial Zone or the Northern Mountains. Use different types of weapons to clear this place from hordes of bloodthirsty zombies.

title: The Glitch Fairy
description: The Glitch Fairy is an action packed 2d side scroller starring Monie, an eccentric fairy with the unusual power to ''glitch'' her enemies. Each enemy glitches differently, so our little fairy needs to use her ability wisely to reach different places, discover hidden paths, speedrun, and more!

title: The Wrath of the Erlik
description: The Wrath Of The Erlik is a 3d fantasy rpg game based on turkish mythology.

title: EbonSide
description: EbonSide is a JRPG with mmo aspects! What does that mean? Well! You can explore the open world of Mest Jest! Get lost in the story about the false Dark champion trying to corrupt the world with a shard of Ebonside! A sword forged by the God of Darkness!

title: Hammer of Virtue
description: A melee action game with fully destructible levels. Use your hammer for deliberate combat or just smash the environment and hammer the chunks towards your enemies. Interactive environments that creates emergent gameplay and general chaos.

title: Reborn Tribe
description: Reborn Tribe is a medieval style simulation INDIE GAME developed by one person. In this game, players build houses and hire staffs to run the farms, pastures, etc. You have to encounter a lot difficulties and find out the reason why your tribe disappeared.

title: Blood Bay
description: Blood Bay is a 4-player open-world survival RPG. In a Fabulous Fantasy setting.Which is set on magical islands. Each island is fraught with secrets that you have to reveal!

title: Cards of Patience
description: Cards of Patience combines solitaire-like gameplay with RPG and roguelite elements. Choose your hero and fight against a variety of enemies by destroying all their cards. Use different levelable spells and equip yourself with powerful items and potions.

title: Epic Tower for Tireless Lovers
description: Embody an almost fairytale like princess. Housed at the top of a tower she faces an abundant amount of suitors who show up to win her over. Take the control of the princess, create your own tower, place traps and send suitors packing in this colorful and offbeat universe!

title: Tiranogg
description: Help a badass female mercenary and her frail male priest reclaim her throne as the rightful heir of Sangreal!

title: Peak Darkness
description: Survive and defend your home or don't it really doesn't matter. What matters is sending those things back to where they came from. Use weapon upgrades, friends or whatever to do this just get it done.

title: Blockgeon
description: Pick your team with 3 adventurers, explore and clean the dungeon! Cast your skill based on Color Matching to destroy incoming blocks with every round and try to damage the dungeon’s boss when you can. Colour and pattern matching dungeon adventure await you!

title: Stars Arisen
description: Will you rise to the heavens when you wield the magic of fallen stars? Call lightning, ride the wind, and raise the dead in this fantasy epic!

title: Space Doomer
description: "Space Doomer" is a 2D arcade game. The main goal of which is to kill all the enemies on the field and get points.

title: Levenium
description: Levenium, a sci-fi action adventure. Fight, think, craft, hack and puzzle your way to freedom.

title: SnowTunes Island
description: SnowTunes Island is a musical platforming adventure where the soundtrack doubles as your life-bar. As a Snowman, use momentum and ice to cross the island and catch the thief who stole your CD collection!

title: Mythic
description: Mythic is a Roguelite MMO where you explore an infinite, procedurally generated labyrinth. Discover a world packed with puzzles, enemies, bosses, and treasure. Join forces with fellow heroes to hunt down the gods, or strike out alone and be the first to discover uncharted territory. Become Mythic.

title: Slide Stories: Bucky's Quest
description: Follow Bucky, a brave and faithful dog, and his friend Shin on a journey through a mysterious dungeon in this relaxing and minimalist slide puzzle game.

title: Eniko: Ghosts of Grace
description: A story-rich action rpg that pays hommage to 90's gaming with it's retro 2.5D pixel art look. Join Livia, a gusty but ambitious young Warrior, in a tale that explores the meaning of family, loyalty, ambition and war. After a fateful encounter, everything Livia believes in will be put to the test.

title: Deep Fog
description: "Deep Fog" is a single-player 2D horizontal pixel horror adventure game. Explore the strange events that occurred in the fog city, 5 chapters will be phased release.

title: LuPR: Lunar Post Recruit
description:
A retro first-person shooter party game where 1-4 local players battle with or against AI bots as soldiers in the Planetary Faction war. Choose from 4 different arena-style game modes. Throw grenades, shoot black holes, set explosive traps, snipe and have a party as your faction fights for victory!

Defeat the content unlock challenges or configure custom games with your favorite arena game modes, maps, weapons and player setup.

title: Dungeon Lad
description: Explore a randomly generated dungeon as you juggle your health, gold, and remaining time. Complete floors and defeat enemies in order to unlock more powerful upgrades for subsequent runs to delve deeper and deeper. Unlock more upgrades, skins, enemies and more as you explore infinite dungeons.

title: The Shattered Elements Arena
description: The Shattered Elements Arena is a controller based top-down 2D physics action game for 1-4 players. Test if your squad of mages can maneuver through four zones of dangerous encounters with the Jurisdiction inside an Arena the Wise Witch has deviously devised in order to train the Defiance.

title: City Air Battle
description: City Air Battle is an arcade style flight racing and shooting game. In the game, you can not only fly all kinds of stunts between skyscrapers, but also compete and fight fiercely with your opponents, and constantly challenge your flight and shooting skills in fast-paced and high-intensity confrontation.

title: Timber Story
description: A Tree has fallen and blocked the main road, luckily enough there is a kind lumberjack that could clear the fallen tree for a small favor. Go on a mission to find and rescue the lumberjacks best friend who has gone missing deep in the woods.

title: Plague Infection
description: Plague Infection is a Bomberman game, at its best. Lay out the flasks with explosives, and clear your way. You need to collect all the vaccines while there is still time to defeat the disease. But be careful there are zombies everywhere.

title: Find The Cat
description:
Find one different cat among many cats!
A brain training game that exercises your blink of an eye by finding cats!

title: Flat Eye
description: Flat Eye is a resource management sim with an emphasis on story and narrative choices. Oversee the world’s leading technological hub while you explore stories linked to discoverable technology and interact with your most loyal customers. Flat Eye - We're watching.

title: Fallout: Miami
description: Fallout: Miami is an upcoming DLC-sized mod for Fallout 4 with an original setting, complete with its own engrossing main quest, interesting side quests and characters, including new companions. The central theme of our story is the struggle between order and freedom. The setting for this new adventure is the post-post-apocalyptic Vacation Wasteland of Miami Beach. Once a popular tourist destination, attracting rich and glamorous visitors both foreign and domestic, it now plays host to an eclectic assortment of factions and societies, each with its own culture and approach to the challenges of this new post-nuclear world. The once-great slaver kingdom of Sunshine Cove has recently come under threat by a horde of automobile-worshipping nomads calling themselves the Nuclear Patriots. While Miami's various factions vie for control over the Vacation Wasteland, a long-forgotten remnant of the old world slumbers beneath the waves, waiting for an opportunity to reclaim America once again.

title: Lo-Fi: Thexnerxxm
description: A story that takes place in a trauma treatment center in a different world from yours. The "work" is performed in the client's 'memory room', and the members are total of three people; you, the operator, and a field agent 'diver' who will install equipment and perform treatment directly in the memory room. Please carry out therapy work with the diver.

title: The Battle Never Ends
description: The Battle Never Ends is a horror-adventure RPG game that users able to investigate the surroundings and interact with the battle space.

title: Ultra Custom Night
description: Ultra Custom Night is a fan game of Ultimate Custom Night, but Ultra Custom Night has more Characters (500+), additional floors and systems.

title: The Hierophant
description: Take on the role of Hero in a humble land where evil has awoken in this simple hand-drawn, Turn-based RPG!

title: Boss of the Mafia
description: Boss Of The Mafia is a side-scrolling game in which you play as the boss of the mafia! In this incredibly difficult platformer you have to get through all the obstacles and dangerous traps in order to complete this game to the end. Cool relaxing jazz music will help you with this!

title: Chronomaster
description: You are Korda, the Chronomaster. You must re-start time and right the wrongs of a war-plagued past in this epic quest for vengeance. Journey through man-made "pocket universes" full of cyborgs, pirates and witches who provide deadly puzzles. It's up to you to return justice to the stars.

title: Hidden Ghost Town 2
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Insipid
description: Insipid is a puzzle game for vigilance.

title: Thalassophobia
description: As a cataclysmic event rocks the planet, you find yourself in an old, decrepit submarine tasked with only one goal: survive. Manage the internal systems to keep yourself alive and fend off undersea horrors as they attempt to cut your journey short.

title: Grow Flow
description: A first person parkour game with art inspired by european avant-gardes. Make your way through over sixty levels with plenty of different mechanics to explore!

title: Gloomy Juncture
description:
Gloomy Juncture is a neo-noir psychological thriller and a character-driven adventure with a core focus on point & click gameplay with challenging puzzles.

Set in the 90s, the story unfolds in a decaying and morally bankrupt urban setting. You're not special; you're not a hero. One night, a single gunshot shatters the silence, setting the wheels of fate in motion. You'll step into the shoes of a mundane janitor asked to complete a final task before clocking out, and it will turn into a pulp mystery as your fate collides with the aftermath of that pivotal gunshot.

Unravel your fate and cross the edge in this peculiar tale of obsession

title: Solbane
description: Battle against bosses in a top-down action shooter with minor RPG elements. Choose between three diverse classes, each with a unique arsenal of abilities.

title: Roadworks 2
description: City building real time strategy economy simulation game. Manage the resources on the map and build a city connected through road networks of different types of road so that you can meet production targets.

title: Wintertwined
description: When Winter and Giles find themselves stuck in a cabin during a snowstorm, they discover it's horrific history.

title: The Plague Doctor of Wippra
description: The plague spreads fear and agony in the small town of Wippra. As a doctor, you help where you can. Then medieval superstition and religious zeal mix into a deadly threat.

title: Pure Logic
description: Explore logic symbols. Discover the rules. Solve complex puzzles. Conquer all zones. Feel the power of your logical side!

title: Brimstone Manor
description: Can you survive being a demon’s nanny? Uncover a world of paranormal secrets. Magic. Miracles. And a battle between order and chaos. And for your heart.

title: Vanildo's Journey
description: Vanildo, a skilled retired adventurer is forced to return to work because of the peculiar events that are taking place in the city of Pirarotoba, including the disappearance of his old friend.

title: Casual Pro Wrestling
description: Casual Pro Wrestling is a professional wrestling game with an emphasis on fun. It blends intuitive controls inspired by genre classics with ragdoll physics for added fun and drama. It features couch and online multiplayer and offers a plethora of possibilities for customization.

title: Speed Creators
description: A high speed multiplayer platformer where each player builds a slice of a sprawling level filled with traps and special blocks to race in.

title: Magic Disc Golf
description: Magic Disc Golf lets you take control of your disc and steer it towards the basket. Find the optimal route, navigate challenging terrain, and use your speed boost to cover some extra ground. Choose from three 18-hole courses and four game modes.

title: Asteroid Force
description: Asteroids are headed directly towards Earth. Destroy asteroids before they can slam into Earth. Earn medallions to purchase ship upgrades to help in the fight to save Earth.

title: Tri-Star
description: Tri-Star is an endless horizontal-scrolling space shooter featuring Roguelike and Roguelite elements. Blast through waves of enemies and battle against arduous bosses. Form a squadron of three unique ships from an expanding roster and equip them with upgrades as you engage in a battle for survival.

title: This House
description: A hand drawn, creepy puzzle, RPG adventure. Will you be able to escape this House?

title: Willage
description: An interactive series, where the player meets Eastern European culture.

title: Bio Bots
description: Bio Bots is a Free to play third-person team-based shooter. Enjoy playing chaotic matches in different game-modes

title: Generic RPG Idle
description: An idle RPG where your loot matters. Optimize your equipment, defeat mighty foes, perform dark rituals and enjoy a medieval tale of revenge in a twisted version of Brazil. Elite enemies challenge how optimized your build is while random-free combat ensures attacks never miss.

title: Tranquil Cove
description: Your mother recently passed away, and her mysterious childhood home in a small town called Tranquil Cove was passed down to you. In an attempt to learn about your mothers mysterious past, you go to investigate. Nothing could prepare you for what you find there...

title: Doomsday Paradise
description:
Welcome to Sunset Town: a tropical paradise to party your days away before the world devouring monster threatens to end everything. But not to worry- surely some brave hero will rise up to save the world!

Someone is going to save the world.... right?

Doomsday Paradise is a goofy, competitive multiplayer RPG where you put off saving the world to party instead.

title: Uncolored Bob II
description: "Uncolored Bob ii" is a roguelike platformer adventure with randomly generated levels. It has level editor, so you can share challenge with your friends.

title: Space Depression
description: You must do your best to protect the world! Destroy all enemies. Get the highest score.

title: Afterworld King
description: AfterWorld King - Top Down View - A logic game where the player beats off the skulls of punishment and burns the souls of sinners, each completed task brings one step closer to victory.

title: Path to Gaea
description: Path To Gaea is a turn based puzzle-adventure that follows a simple story between good and evil. However, not everything is what is seems.

title: Babba Yagga: Woodboy
description: Baba Yaga is a horror game, where you play as a wooden boy who needs to bring sleeping herbs for his mum, but on the way, he meets the BABA YAGA! After that everything becomes more brutal and scary.

title: Oppcium
description: A sentient alien organism has escaped its cage and now freely roams a government facility. Silence has engulfed the city as a toxic and unidentified cloud was released from black oily stones. Witness and investigate a dire situation that appears to escalate by the hour.

title: Adamanta View
description: An action Surviving game with a mission!

title: Makai Kingdom: Reclaimed and Rebound
description: In Makai Kingdom: Reclaimed and Rebound, Lord Zetta, master of tactical warfare, aims to invade and reclaim the Netherworld—as a book! Utilize clever strategies and powerful magic, along with deadly weapons ranging from broadswords to rocket launchers to take control of your enemies’ land.

title: This & Cats
description: Managing a small shop is cool, but it's even cooler when there are cats around! This & Cats is a relaxing first-person life sim in which you earn money by adopting cats and making customers happy.

title: Voxel Farm Island
description: You now have a dream island right away! Take care of the farm, develop business, Expand transportation, and there are more interesting things on the island, such as magical giving tree, fishery and the mine full of treasures... You have a most important task - to solve the mystery on the island!

title: Mars Tactics
description: Classic turn-based tactical combat with some modern twists. Use stress to manage RNG. Master advanced suppression mechanics. Grow troops who develop abilities, personalities & relationships based on what happens in battle. Procedural, destructible maps. Realistic bullet physics.

title: Camelot: Wrath of the Green Knight
description: Camelot: Home of King Arthur’s court… and intrigue! When the Lady of the Lake goes missing, her husband the Green Knight blames King Arthur, threatening the peace of Camelot for all…

title: Power Pushout
description: Power Pushout is an epic turn-based asian-style strategy game with martial arts elements. Choose your warrior and master figures and fight with them in a wild battle to rule over the game board. Either you throw your opponent off the board or you conquer the opposing towers to win the game.

title: Arrows
description: Arrows is a puzzle game with a minimalist and modern visual that consists of aligning the colored blocks

title: May God Forgive Us
description: Stealthily navigate this tense survival horror by managing scarce resources, solving puzzles and when all else fails, fighting to escape the nightmare you've woken up too in the laboratory..

title: DreamScapes Dimensions
description: A free to play, first person medieval fantasy, MMORPG. Pre-Alpha | Solo Indie | Retro Look and Feel | Versatile Character Creation | Tutorial Quests | Harvesting and Crafting | Skills and Spells | Player Building | Procedurally Generated Random Adventures | Daily Gifts

title: Greed Is Bad
description: Greed Is Bad - A platformer where the player runs through unique and intricate caves, you must collect all the coins to go to the next level, since your greed will not let you leave the level leaving at least one coin to the evil dead.

title: A Gift of War
description: A Gift of War is a role playing game about a young man going on a mission to assist his country's war effort against the bordering enemy. It features simultaneous turn-based combat akin to a roguelike, but its levels are carefully crafted by hand.

title: The Oathkeeper
description: Ira is a famed mercenary, called The Oathkeeper. When one of his contracts puts him in the middle of an ancient war of good v. evil and face to face with the woman he begins to fall in love with, he will have to start fighting for more than just money!

title: Let's Puzzle
description: Let's Puzzle is a collection of beautiful pictures from yourself and from others. You can sit at home, relax and solve fun puzzles. Get rid of the tiredness of the whole day and plunge into the wonderful puzzle world.

title: Delta Zero
description: A fast-paced action platformer with non-linear world progression and level design! Challenging gameplay with 3 difficulty modes, 2 playable characters and local co-op! Fight bosses in any order and experience the world change with each victory, enemies become harder, faster and smarter!

title: Hidden Beast
description: Hidden Beast is a strategy game, similar to chess and an old board game called Combat. The player moves his army towards static totems that, when confronted, turn into beasts. In the clash, the stronger piece defeats the weaker one and removes it from the scene.

title: Oasis: Dark Forest
description: Darkness rules the land. Defend your holy tree. Plant trees to defeat the ghost army. Explore and collect resources in a randomly generated forest world. Upgrade your technology tree. You are the light in the darkness.

title: The Midnight Wind
description: The Midnight Wind is a sarcastic single-player pixel art RPG following the story of four hosts of the souls of a dead star. The story loosely takes place in Indonesia, where players will embark on a bare-bones journey to protect themselves and their people.

title: Fatal Paws
description: A visual novel with dark humor, turn based combat, and stat building. Experience the fatal strength in companionship and the emotional bond that can come from it.

title: Team Ice Cream VR
description: Play alone in VR—or get together with a friend on PC and work as a team—to attract and serve customers ice cream. Earn tips to buy upgrades and outfits and move up in the world!

title: Sketch Crawler
description: Sketch Crawler is a super-creative deck-building roguelike single player RPG game about the King of Cartoons who lost his kingdom in a wicked magic picture.

title: Super Gunfight
description: Super Gunfight Is A top-down Shooter. The goal of the game is to destroy all enemies on the map and complete the mission.This is a unique fusion of arcade, action and unmatched dynamics.

title: Loco Launcher
description: You're an animal with an appetite for destruction. Use a cannon, vehicle, ride in a giant rock, or simply run through walls to destroy buildings as fast as possible. Have fun in these wacky arcade levels with added abilities that make no sense whatsoever!

title: Forest Star
description: Help a monkey find a fallen star in this short adventure game! Meet and recruit other animals, find useful items, and discover new abilities. Multiple endings available depending on your choices!

title: Blow & Fly
description: Fulfill your wildest dreams: become a blowfish that traverses the world by rolling on the floor! Take a deep breath, aim at your target and blow all the water out of your puny body to propel yourself in the air!

title: Astral Space
description: Have you ever controlled a game without using a keyboard or a mouse? Yes, This is possible. We have developed a Artificial Intelligence-based game that gives you the ability to control the ball's movement and directions via hand movements, the challenge is to gain as many points as possible.

title: Pico Islands
description: Lead your settlers to build cities in a medieval island world.

title: Mycosis
description: Mycosis is action-platformer situated in an underground laboratory complex. The gameplay includes fighting various enemies, mostly the fungus infected zombies, collecting different items and solving some simple puzzles. It was inspired by Abuse, Half-life and everyday laboratory work!

title: In Shape 2
description: In this minimalistic arcade game, you have to move and reshape your figure to match the passing figures.

title: Diefrosty
description: Diefrosty is an unsurvival puzzle game, where your one and only goal is to kill your ice-cuby character no matter how. Intereract with many obstacles, use really dumb ways to die while melting your brain to beat each level.

title: First Time in Paris
description: Join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole as they go on their first big business trip to save a Parisian hotel!

title: Time Idle RPG
description: Idle RPG game that uses real life Time as the core mechanic and currency. Featuring offline progress, prestige, unfolding mechanics, trees, and much more!

title: Far Lands
description: Welcome to Far Lands, an open-world survival adventure. After a devastating plane crash, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious island with no way home. Surrounded by danger and uncertainty, your only priority is clear: survive.

title: Galacticon
description: Galacticon is a video game with the look and feel of arcade cabinet games from the early 80's in the style of Williams classics: "Defender" or "Joust", with the gameplay of legendary "Jetpac", and with touches of "puzzle".

title: Blink Planets
description: Blink Planets is a strategy puzzle game where you pioneer a wasteland planet into a settleable home for people. The colorful "BASE" symbolizes the resource needed to develop a planet. Place "BLOCKS" to secure further land. Explore more planets to continue welcoming migrants.

title: Rakuten
description: Rakuten is a physics based space shooter where you pilot your own rocketship, shoot down enemy spacecraft, and unlock upgrades to further increase your capabilities and available weaponry.

title: The Jewel of Monostructure
description: Sanator: The Jewel of Monostructure is a dark fantasy visual novel that combines deep lore with exciting adventures. Who is behind the mysterious thefts and why are the gates of the Monostructure open again? Take control of Richard Murdock, the plague doctor, and find the answer.

title: The Tombs of Ultra 5
description: A Topdown Rouge like shooter. Defeat enemies and collect randomized buffs to help you survive and find the keys needed to progress.

title: Underwater Rescue
description: UnderWater Rescue - A platformer with physical controls for a three-limbed robot that clings to ledges and makes its way through the underwater world, avoiding collisions with missiles and collecting divers on board.

title: Cubstacle
description: Cubstacle is a casual puzzle and maze game. Within it your objective is to free cubes trapped in dangerous and confusing rooms, the movement of the cubes is limited and cannot be canceled stopping only when encountering an obstacle or death.

title: Dashwalk Dueling
description: Dashwalk Dueling is a minimalist 2D platform fighter. Its simple mechanics and visuals are the foundation for complex ground movement, creative combo routes, and fast-flowing combat! Choose from eight supers and reversals to dismantle the competition.

title: Project Snaqe
description:
Project Snaqe is an action and precision game inspired by the classic Snake. Your main goal is to collect the minerals scattered through the map, adding cars to your convoy and increasing your high score.

The game has 3 different modes with progressive difficulty levels, in addition to the Classic Mode that remounts the traditional Snake gameplay. It also features a variety of obstacles, two navigation modes (drill and shooter), a nostalgic and quite charming pixel art look, great chip-tuney soundtracks and a global ranking system supported by Steam.

title: Small Life
description: An interactive city discovery game inspired by Shenzhen, China. Explore this one of a kind city and unravel the playful puzzles that will require a few twists of imagination.

title: Tiger Soldier I: MP091
description: Tiger Soldier is a military-themed run & gun shooter game. Playing as a lone soldier, first by fighting off infantry units and battling tanks then lob a hand grenade into the enemy's fort. Destroy the enemy's fort to clear game. The DLC include mission pack 091.

title: Tiger Soldier I: MP087
description: Tiger Soldier is a military-themed run & gun shooter game. Playing as a lone soldier, first by fighting off infantry units and battling tanks then lob a hand grenade into the enemy's fort. Destroy the enemy's fort to clear game. The DLC include mission pack 087.

title: Mina the Hollower
description:
Mina the Hollower is a bone-chilling action-adventure game featuring classic gameplay and an 8-bit aesthetic in the style of Game Boy Color, refined for the modern era.

Quick and deliberate 60fps action combat, captivating world design, and top-down adventuring combine in a nostalgic blend. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

title: Neon Bricks
description: Neon Bricks is a arcade style game where you can't drop the ball. To reach your goal you need to destroy all the bricks.

title: Quarantineer
description: For the glory of Motherland, the truth shall never be revealed. None of us expected this, Yet history is repeating itself.

title: Catellite-609: Feline Space Adventure
description: Help the cats find alien friends! By exploring space using "Catellite-609" cats will be able to: build rooms, upgrade "Catellite-609" facilities, and develop a cat crew. Enjoy a unique space adventure!

title: Hostile Planet: Survival
description: Hostile Planet: Survival is a harsh adventure on an uncharted planet that full of danger and trials.

title: Thirty-One 3D Premium
description: Thirty-One 3D Premium brings a lot of game variants, challenging opponents and environments with great 3D graphics on your PC.You can play in Singleplayer offline or LAN and Online Mode! The full animated Tutorial explains rules of the popular card game step by step.

title: Arcante: Definitive Edition
description: A Fantasy Action RPG. Create your party and head off on an adventure. Playing Turn-Based or Real Time is up to you.

title: Clean Art
description: Touch the dots to collect pointskeep high 'point per second' in singleplayIn multiplay, get the most points within the time limitMove : WASD or Arrow key and Space barDraw : Mouse buttonWave ON OFF : F key

title: Mars Rover Simulator
description: The landing was successful! The rover under your control has landed on Mars. All you need is the energy, resources and experience gained as you explore. You have to explore the world, find resources, improve mechanisms and move on to explore the "Red Planet".

title: Life of Pepe
description: Explore, craft, and fight in this minimalist survival game. Play alone or with a friend!

title: Spiceshifter
description: Spiceshifter is a single-player game in 2.5D abstract graphics. The essence of the gameplay is to destroy hordes of enemies with the help of a wide variety of weapons, such as brass knuckles, magic or shotguns.

title: Top Gang
description: Top Gang is a very chaotic platform game for up to 4 cooperative players. You need to eliminate all enemies in the level to be able to advance at the same time you will have to rescue the "Nuggets" and take them safely to the exit. Your friends can be a big help or a stumbling block.

title: Soulless Legions
description: Breaking the limits of strategy games by hosting millions of ability combinations for each individual unit. Soulless Legions is a 1v1 multiplayer medieval fantasy 'Tug O' War' game that allows players a lifetime of customization and strategic inquiry.

title: Modern Game Tycoon
description: You are an aspiring game developer in 2000. Hire personal, expand offices, design the games of your dreams and try to make money from them. Reach as high as you can. From a small company to a huge corporation.

title: Telepath Tactics Liberated
description: An SRPG fan's SRPG! Imagine Fire Emblem with destructible battlefields; the ability to place traps; the ability to shove enemies off cliffs, into lava, or into each other; and a built-in campaign creator.

title: Jeremia: Nightfall
description: Jeremiah: The Nightfall Our memories are what tell us who we are. But what if, suddenly, you had none? What if you had to emerge from the darkness on your own strength? Will you be ready to face your demons?

title: Salvationland
description: Dive into the dark world after the Flood. An exciting adventure awaits you as a young wanderer named Victor. Journey to the last city on Earth, whose fate rests solely in your hands. Defeat the elusive villain, destroy the sinister plans of the mysterious mayor, and become the liberating hero!

title: Nitroverse
description: Nitroverse is a rogue-like hack & slay with level-based progression.

title: ArrowBase
description: ArrowBase is a Versus platform game where the objective is to send your arrow on your opponent. You can slide, dive forward, attack your opponent in close combat to propel him into the air.

title: Grub Gauntlet
description: Grub Gauntlet is a playful physics-based puzzle game. Use bombs, portals, gravity wells, and more to make your way around walls, past spikes, through gates all to find your missing lunch!

title: The Grip of Madness
description: The Grip of Madness is a multiplayer cooperative FPS where your teammates can betray you at any time. Shoot your way through hordes of monsters, gather clues, and complete the ritual to stop their invasion.

title: Phobies
description: Phobies is a tactical card collecting strategy game where players battle one another in the surreal realm of the subconscious, where fears manifest. Use devious tactics and unleash a dazzling array of attacks and abilities to achieve victory!

title: OplitisAV
description: You are a Ferocious Anti-virus Systemic Trucidator (FAST), you are injected in an infected system, and your sole objective is to eradicate all virus life forms.

title: Animal Simulator
description: New unique open world survival game. Choose one of the animals and survive in the open world together with your group, or human friend. Each animal has its own style of play. You can choose a predator or a little rabbit. It’s up to you.

title: Hyperjustice
description: HyperJustice is a fast-paced third-person shooter inspired by 1980’s cop movies and television. Sprint through neon-stained Miami as you battle the mob and try to prevent the distribution of a world-ending drug.

title: The Cloud Dream of the Nine
description:
Yang Soyu, lives in a village in Hwaju Castle, in the state of Cheonin. Her father, a fairy god from Mt. Gonryun ascended to the fairy world after his connection with the human world came to an end when his beloved wife passed away, Soyu’s mother.

With no parents to raise her, Soyu was taken in by her friend Chaeyoon and his family. While the villagers in her town, are resentful to Soyu, thinking her story about her father being a fairy god is absurd, it was only her friend Chaeyoon and his family, that she fully trusts.

One unfortunate day, their house burned down and amidst the calamity, Chaeyoon goes missing. Soyu sets off on a journey to find her friend, and along the way meets new characters (which either became her friend or her potential love interest).

During her journey, Soyu will get to unravel the secrets behind the political tyranny of their land. Her fate and ending will change depending on the choices you, as a player, choose for her.

title: VirtualCop
description: Step into the shoes of a New Zealand Police officer. Search for forensic evidence, connect with the community, and catch offenders in this immersive 3D experience. Do you care enough to be a cop?

title: Four Animals
description: Four Animals is an arcade scoring game.

title: Proto Shooter Lychee
description: This is an action shooting game where the girl defeats the monsters that come at her.

title: Parametric Creature: Lab
description: Explore and create parametric creatures

title: Virago
description: Virago is a 2D adventure platformer about a young girl called Willow, who after an incident with her stalker she begins to suffer from hallucinations which affects her psychologically and emotionally.

title: Forgotten Souls
description: Turn-based strategy game based on the classic Lost Souls.

title: Kuroi Tsubasa
description: Meet Kureha Kurono and her friends in this charming visual novel! With the help of the devil Blackwing-chan they'll be able to defeat the evil shadow, right? What was that? It was Blackwing himself who caused this mess? Oh dear, oh dear.

title: Mad Cart
description: Enjoy the ride in a fast-paced game! It is endless runner with puzzle elements! Rotate circle platforms, think, shoot and don't forget to enjoy stylized and colorful graphics!

title: ChaoticNightmare
description: "FerryGate" focuses on the experience of walking in horror scenes. Players will carry cameras to explore special places in areas blocked by the government, record videos, and avoid the supernatural creatures' kill

title: Goodbye World
description: You are a player in a slightly broken RPG game, and have to attempt to solve puzzles and make it through by changing exposed pieces of code around the world.

title: Fruit Basket
description: Fruit Basket is an arcade game that makes your brain work to the maximum. Jump over the fruits, getting further and further to the basket. Pepper flying on its axis can send you to the beginning. Cactus is also dangerous. The game is not for the "weak".

title: Devil's Eyes
description: Mike arrives at university and is ready to have a time of his life, but something is not quite right. Follow the story and unveil the mysteries behind the tragic events.

title: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea
description: At the turn of the century, Victorian life carries on with one sharp difference from our world — vampires run amok and are a part of every day life. After having run away from home to search for his best friend, the young Cecil meets Nemo, a pickpocketing vagabond. The two set out together but in order to find what they're searching for, they must first unravel the truth behind a series of brutal vampire attacks from a decade prior.

title: Blocktopia
description: Blocktopia is a sandbox RPG where you can freely customize characters, buildings, and decorations.

title: Bard Idle
description: Build a unique team, where each character has a random weapon, race and class. Strong combinations of heroes, enhanced by the ballad creation system and jelly dwarfs, will capture your adventure in history!

title: Present Cannon Rebirth
description: Action/Arcade/Rail-Shooter. It's Christmas Eve and it's up to you to save Christmas, by delivering all the Christmas presents while saving people from an alien invasion, using only your magic Present Cannons.

title: SlapBR
description: SlapBR is a simplistic, horror battle royale. You can compete with friends, create and join rooms, and become terrified as you hide-slap-block your way to victory.

title: The Unearthened
description: Build & defend a small remote mining base on Taichin XI from the alien hordes. Deploy defenses, upgrade your turrets and get ready for the nightfall. The Unearthened is a classic Tower Defense game where you build towers and prepare for the invasion.

title: Tied by your Red
description: A story of the sold girl Erica is about to live with the Duke who has a very bad reputation in this terrifying mansion. She has to live where she will die if she says something wrong in accident? ! A Lily story, stereotype but sweet story of Beauty and the Beast will be staged soon.

title: Wave Jumper
description: Wave Jumper is a 80's Synthwave platformer aimed at keeping momentum high and decisions quick.

title: Marlon’s Mystery: The Darkside of Crime
description: Marlon’s Mystery: The Darkside of Crime will test your skills as an investigator. Join Abby Marlon to solve the riddles in this captivating mystery and hidden object game. Embark on an enigmatic adventure and discover the darkest secrets of the Taylor family.

title: They Look Like People
description: A Psychological story game set within a Kubrickian world. A tale of Space & Adventure into the Abyss of your mind, two astronauts come into close encounters with an unknown object during a routine mission.

title: Risk of Rain 2 + Survivors of the Void
description: Unleash the critically acclaimed Risk of Rain 2 and its first ever expansion Survivors of the Void! Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own.

title: Club Soccer Director 2022
description: Take control of a Real Football Club or create your own club, in Club Soccer Director 2022 a fast-paced Football Club Management Game. Download Club Soccer Director 2022 now for FREE & start your Football management journey.

title: Godshard Chronicles
description: Godshard Chronicles is a top-down action RPG based in the world of the Godshard novels with music by famed composer Noriyuki Iwadare. Inspired by titles such as The Legend of Zelda, Grandia, and the Mana series. Fight in action-packed battles, explore a sprawling world either solo or with a friend!

title: Vacant Kingdom
description: Vacant Kingdom is a synthesis of bullet hell and story-driven action-RPG. Explore a whimsical yet desolate land and rally its adrift people by solving their problems.

title: Bomb Club Deluxe
description: If you have a knack for explosives, the Bomb Club welcomes you! Meet new bombs, uncover new challenges, and create awesome chain reactions in this explosive puzzle game!

Discover a humouristic point and click adventure inspired by all the masterpieces which made us stick to our computers back in the day (and therefore we played outside way too infrequently). Full of loony characters, unexpected twists and challenging riddles.
Accompany Vio on her unintentional journey through various realms. Explore broken cities, pirate ships in the deepest jungle and other unreal places. Stand by her side when she makes the acquaintance of the (depressive) Death and engage with lots of explicit and ambiguous references, hommages and imitations of the big classics past (and not quite past) times.

title: Sotano
description: Sotano is a first person 3d escape room puzzle adventure. Explore areas, collect items and take in your surroundings. You will need all of your puzzle solving skills to put together a plan to make your way through the house, solving riddles and through the many rooms to escape the house of Sotano.

title: Bigger Bikes
description: Bigger Bikes is a simulator of riding bikes, in off-road conditions. The game is based on realistic control of motorcycles and bicycles and fun physics!

title: Tails From Alteria
description: Tails From Alteria is a wacky RPG that follows the misadventures of twin foxes Jeeve and Jayla Javari, as they race against unseen forces and try to stop the world from ending.

title: Mr.Treemp
description: Collect gold coins, climb higher and higher, seek the love of voters; everything is like in life! A small polititian began his journey to great wealth and success. But will he stuff his pockets with gold and achieve his aim? It depends only on your agility and persistence...

title: Alchemos
description:
In Alchemos, you'll pilot a Proto-Atomic Shell - an atomic-sized device capable of collecting and combining subatomic particles - to discover the elements. Explore weird and wonderful experimental worlds, and challenge your friends to beat your best times

But beware, the particles you seek may be guarded by the forces of Dark Matter! As the Dark Atoms evolve to defeat you, you'll need to upgrade your Proto-Atomic Shell: dash and jump to safety, traverse quantum tunnels, emit particles to freeze your foes, or even annihilate them completely

title: Heroic Pirates
description: Heroic Pirates puts you in the shoes of a pirate commander and you need to use your pirate team cleverly in order to survive everything that comes your way. The game map features multiple levels that you need to complete until you uncover the treasure. This is not a walk in the park, but it’s one of the most exhilarating and enticing game experiences that you will ever have. Test it out for yourself and you will have fun playing with the pirates as you reach the end and uncover the reassure. You can also recruit pirates along the way and enlarge your team! Features: Exhilarating pirate gameplay Recruit more pirates to join your team Follow a beautiful pirate map

title: Tumbledown Drive
description:
Drive, jump and honk your way to the top of this exceedingly punishing platformer.
Be careful, it's a long, long way down if you fall.
Includes controller support, a speedrun timer, regular secrets and secrets.

title: 1/2 Red Riding Hood
description: There is this girl known as the Red Riding Hood. She has the strength of ten men. This is a completely different story about the familiar fairy-tale character Red Riding Hood. A much darker and twisted version

title: Rude Breaker
