description: Rude Breaker is a shoot 'em up game and a spin-off of the Aleste series.

title: Karagon
description: Survive and shoot killer robots then reuse their parts to construct your own rideable robots! Build a base, gather resources, craft weapons! Shoot, construct, and ride the most massive robots in this post apocalyptic open world survival crafting game! Experience cutting edge UE5 Lumen technology!

title: Community College Hero: Fun and Games
description: Ever wonder how heroes-in-training spend their time between epic confrontations with dastardly villains? Join the students at Speck Community College as they enjoy a tabletop roleplay game, investigate a legendary small-town monster, and endure the embarrassments of Parents’ Day.

title: Devil's Dungeon
description: Heroes and girls come to the Devil Lord's Dungeon. Can they defeat the Devil Lord or be captured and become slaves? Devil's Dungeon is a real-time strategy game. The game centers on creating mazes and monsters to help defend the Devil Lord from heroes seeking to destroy him.

title: Cyberpunk Girls
description: Cyberpunk Girl is a brutal action shooter set in the year 2169 in the cyber metropolis Oplot. The city of the future, which has become a save heaven for thugs, hackers, and gold diggers. Win the most breathtaking battles. And remember that everything comes with a price.

title: Battle Barn: Tactics
description: Recruit animals with abilities to fight bite-sized tactical battles...And why not take down an interdimensional space clown while you're at it?

title: Trapped in the Forest
description: You awake in a mysterious forest that seems strangely familiar. Have you been here before? Is this a dream or a nightmare?

title: Bikini Armour Explorers
description: Pienetta, a weapon store's daughter in a remote country, is fascinated by adventure because of an old map. Fate seemed to see through her mind. Under the influence of some emergencies, Pienetta embarked on an adventure with her three companions.

title: Wizard Girl Anzu
description: An exciting story about a wizard girl who fights evil...? Scratch that, it's actually a story about one of the mob characters from this Anime series. One day, this mob character develops personality and suddenly realizes everyone around him is an "NPC", characters without any kind of willpower.

title: Mystic Cards
description: This Game is a card oracle simulator.It's a game that could change the way you consult an oracle.

title: Lucky Tlhalerwa: Super Incursion
description: Super Incursion is a 7-8 Hours Long Linear Third-Person Story Adventure. Buy & upgrade multiple guns & melee weapons, spend skillpoints on 3 skill trees enabling new powerful abilities, upgrade your 5 main attributes to gain access to new gameplay features which change your gameplay experience.

title: Asteroid Arena
description: A player vs player, last man standing, space ship arena battle.

title: Basault VR
description: Basault VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite!

title: Plum Bun Reformatted
description: Reformatted to 200 custom handmade pages, this Harlem Renaissance story confronts the reader with questions about personas people wear with challenging themes of race, gender, and capitalism. When two sisters Angela and Virginia are prompted by society, this difficult story explores their choices.

title: Robert: Space Stories and Battles
description: Space shootouts and fascinating stories.

title: Idle Research
description: Idle Research is an addictive, resource management, incremental game with both idle and active playstyles. Research and craft colorful Flasks, Tubes, and Cylinders to earn as much Energy as possible! Big numbers guaranteed.

title: Yonder World: Interview with the Void
description: A psychological horror story, with a spiking sense of danger and gentle melancholy. An out of this world adventure, revolving around books, memories and mortality. Along the way, perhaps you shall pick up pieces of a long forgotten heart, or some unlikely companions that you never knew you needed.

title: Light Paradox
description: Light Paradox is an J-RPG/Survival 2D pixelart game. The story behind the creation of the universe, the information control and the individual character storyline mix all together into this complex world.

title: Stakeholder Game
description: Investment business simulation game. Become the richest billionaire ever! Build your financial empire out of merged companies and increase your capital.

title: Warehouse Simulator: Forklift Driver
description: Manage specialized equipment used in warehouses and become a professional in your field. And the well-developed mechanics of the movement of specialized warehouse equipment allows you to experience the sensations of working in a warehouse without leaving your computer.

title: Heart of a Warrior
description: Heart of a warrior is a RPG game in an open world where you play as Nahele, a young warrior of ancient bloodline on his journey to rescue his twin sister from the underworld, as he travel through portals to different realms of existence.

title: Run Ninja Run
description: Become a Ninja and run, throw shurikens, jump, slide and kill to get trought the end of the game.

title: Pleasure Kingdom
description: Pleasure Kingdom gameplay is a mix of traditional CCG mechanics with thrilling visual novel.

title: Skew Pong
description: Skew Pong is a unique fast-paced take on a classic. Make use of inertia and gravity to win. Push the area around and bend the floor to influence the ball's trajectory. Battle against your friends or AI's and see if you can skew with it.

title: Awakened Evil
description: Awakened Evil is an action platformer inspired by the classics. Jump and slash your way through intense linear stages that will put your skills to the test. Do you have what it takes to slay all the bosses, and take on evil itself?

title: Please Subscribe
description: Please Subscribe is the sequel to Gamer Career Tycoon from 2018. Develop your own livestream channel from the ground up. Manage and operate, overcome challenges, learn new tricks in order to rise in the charts, and possibly, become the next big internet superstar.

title: Claustrophobia
description: Claustrophobia is an Action/Adventure/Puzzle type mod in which you play a rebel in the Half-Life 2 universe fighting and solving his way through areas to get to safety.

title: Crowd Sign: Emission
description: Crowd Sign: Emission is a game where you paint a signs and watch the action unfold then later you can explore the world of the game in first person mode. Fantastic quest story with a branched out plot. The scenario is randomly generated each time, and the lore is created by the player himself.

title: Skeeter's Grid
description: Re-connect mixed-up circuits in this 80s-inspired isometric puzzler as you move from board to board, each of increasing complexity and variation. Collect components, remnants of former grid guardians, as you rebuild each system, with the chance of additional components spawning during replays.

title: Abandoned Archive
description: Abandoned Archive is a fantasy, spell-casting, rogue-like, featuring a wide variety of relics, a unique spell-upgrading system, with compelling and engaging bosses. Each floor is filled with items and mysteries for the player to uncover; what will you discover in the Abandoned Archive?

title: Deadly Nightmare
description: Deadly Nightmare is an exciting and engaging Horror/Survival game where you play the role of a boy living in a big manor. You need to use all the tools at your disposal in order to explore the world, find mysteries and explore a variety of challenging, scary and supernatural locations.

title: Zeppelin: Escape Room
description: Escape the impending death by restarting Zeppelin systems and fleeing the dying planet. Cooperative Escape Room game to challenge yourself and your friends. Get out of confinement, solve amazing and challenging mysteries before the timer runs out!

title: Oogy: Can You Help
description: Play as a business card-wielding sheep in this mysterious indie narrative deckbuilder. Explore a character-rich map, collect new mechanics, uncover dark mysteries, and make new friends. Oh—plus secrets, bosses, and all original music with a hand-drawn art style!

title: ConflictCraft 2
description: Conflict Craft 2 it's a strategy game where you'll need proper management of your resources, but also leadership skills in order to fully control the opposing forces.

title: Asterism: Apex of War
description: First and third person single player sci fi action shooter. Destroy the Neurobonded menace and prevent humanities extinction.

title: Greedy Rabbit
description: Fun arcade and logic game, where you are greedy rabbit. In each level you have to collect all the vegetables and possibly stars. Then look for the open portal to the next level. Do this with the best result.

title: Lords of Solgrund
description: Lords of Solgrund combines elements of city building and slow-paced tactical battles. The game features detailed animations and systems inspired by the early middle ages, combined with magical, spiritual and other fantastical elements.

title: Sugar Story
description: The day has come ... You've been given a very important mission to get sugar for your family because it's just over. Can you cope with this challenge? I tell you right away, it won't be easy ... You think it's just a quest for sugar and on the way the world turns upside down

title: Cold House
description: Cold House is a co-op horror game for 1-4 people. You and your friends get into a car accident and are forced to hide from the cold in an abandoned house where it will soon turn out that they are not alone at all..

title: Nello in Antwerp
description: Nello in Antwerp is a free-to-play experience set in the world of A Dog of Flanders (in development). You will play as a young boy in 19th century Belgium, penniless but with an artistic dream of painting. You will use pencil and brush to record the landscape you see.

title: Fragroom: Defenders
description: Fragroom: Defenders is a Tower Defense multiplayer shooting game set in a zombie post-apocalyptic town. Choose your weapons, fight against different enemies, find the best team and tactics to save your shelter from zombie foragers.

title: Artisan
description: A young man finds himself trapped in an otherworldly museum where he is forced to fight in a battle royal using strange ghost-like creatures called Artisans.

title: Debug
description: A single-player, third-person 3D adventure game that follows the journey of B33, better known as BeepBug, a bee-like robot, through three different biomes in various Chilean regions, seeking to discover what has caused these ecosystems to die.

title: MoonFall: Butterfly Lovers
description: 2021 Galgame popular works The story is based on Chinese legends Before the moon fell, Spending time with beautiful girl Kaori. Whether to live in a dreamlike utopia, Or face the harsh reality. Love, self, future, all in the world of Moonfall

title: The Dark Prophecy
description: The Dark Prophecy is a 2D pixel-art point & click adventure inspired by the best retro games of the 90's. Welcome to a peaceful medieval village, where life is safe and calm. But one fateful night, everything changes.

title: Mysterious Adventure of Michael 2
description: Action game of dreams and hopes.

title: Helium Electric
description: The year is 1986 and you just got a job at the Helium Electric corporation.Your adventure begins on the Moon, where you manage a helium harvesting station.You are alone and your family is counting on you.

title: Mega City Void
description: You play the role of a black hole that has penetrated our world. Your task is to absorb as many houses, trees, cars and other objects as possible.

title: Talespinner
description: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

title: Ritual Tournament
description: Ritual Tournament is a 2d Fighting Game with retro style gameplay and story. Choose between 8 fighters, to take part in a deadly tournament, with a story inspired by the 80s movies and also the classic Fighting Games from that age, mixed with a mystical, dark, mythology.

title: Safari Cannon
description: A wholesome game, where you shoot across the African Safari and discover all the wild beasts of the savannah.

title: Goblin Town
description: The Goblins have been enslaved too long under the Ratfolk. Now comes the time to strike back and DESTROY them once and for all, but don't get too cocky, there's no telling what they might have in store for you. Use your Goblin Skills and Charm in this Action-Adventure, Roguelite.

title: Witchbane
description: Witchbane is a retro-styled 2D action platformer where you must use your skills and weapons to defeat the evil brought unto the world by witches. Work your way through each distinct level and defeat the witch who controls the horde of monsters in that area to end the blight placed upon the land.

title: Remoteness
description: New York, 2034: back home from a crazy party at the pub, you wake up late and immediately understand that something is wrong. The district you live in has been evacuated and isolated overnight by the army, after an electrical meteor shower hit the Earth!

title: Whispers in the West
description: Untangle thrilling mysteries by exploring the merciless and lawless Wild Western town of Brimstone. You and your friends need to collaborate, interrogate the town's residents and piece the clues together to solve the mystery!

title: Sharp Wands
description: Fight your friends in an action packed 2D experience, learn to use the forest at your advantage and collect useful powerups to show off your style! Learn to fight with different characters each with its unique powers and flaws

title: Race for Your Life
description: Race for your life - In this racing game you try to pass on the license from a radical car inspector. Any mistake you make can be the last in your life .. Literally!

title: The Last Rite of Death
description: You will have to get used to the role of the main character James, with whom you will learn the terrible story of his Walker family, solve riddles, get to the truth and find out what really happened in this cursed house.

title: SpaceBourne 2
description: Embark on a journey to greatness. Get ready for adrenaline-fueled battles and a chance to claim your place in the galaxy. Grab the controls of your ship, gear up for the fight, and unleash your ambition to conquer and build a new empire in the vastness of space.

title: No Tyrant
description: A FPS shooting hero counter dictator game.

title: Crown Delights Deli
description: Crown Delights Deli is a visual novel with multiple dialect/language choices. As the cashier at a Brooklyn bodega, choose to talk in English, AAVE, or Spanish to a diverse cast of characters as you try to maintain a five-star rating for your boss.

title: Rise of the White Sun
description: Rise of the White Sun is one of the deepest political simulator set in the Chinese Warlord era. Play as every significant faction of 1920’s China : the Guomindang, the Chinese Communist Party, the Warlords and even the masters of the underworld - the Green Gang.

title: Project Absentia
description: Project Absentia is a retro FPS inspired by 2000s-2010s flash animations and sprite comics, with vertical, aerial, elemental combat as the main focus. Play as an angel known as Abby in this retro shooter focused on interactivity, verticality and cool weapons.

title: Tales of Morrow
description: Create your tale! Build, fight, farm, and explore in this relaxing yet adventurous experience. You decide your fate!

title: Wilderplace
description: Wilderplace is a puzzle-adventure game set within the Divine Garden, an idyllic creation of the gods that has plunged into chaos and conflict. You play as a shaman, tasked with restoring order through your magical abilities. Explore the maze-like environment, harness magical artifacts, and uncover mysteries as you wrangle restless spirits and evade dangerous intruders.

title: Tanasurga
description: Tanasurga is an Narrative driven RPG where you play as mecha mercenaries in alternate WW2 setting. Build your own mecha, recruit and lead a team of pilots with different characteristics and skills. Gain riches and determine how the war unfolds between 3 main factions.

title: Escape Logan Estate
description: A visit to the Logan Estate leaves a family in pieces. Play as three different family members to explore and solve puzzles to reveal the mystery surrounding the estate.

title: Nightstalkers
description: Nightstalkers is a retro-styled platformer, with indepth storyline brought to life with voice acting and pixel art cutscenes, attempting to evoke old time 2D consoles such as the Sega CD and the PC-Engine CD.

title: The Legend of the War Axe
description: The Legend of the War Ax is a real-time, third-person PvP combat. Choose a hero and fight other players in various arenas. Dynamic sword fighting, archery, magic and bombs. Now there are 8 heroes for which you can play.

title: Driftence
description: In Driftence, you have to drive a racing car on several tracks. Main goal: To gain points by drifting your car.

title: A Distant Stabbing
description: A game designed to upset you. Master bouncing your arrows to see how high you can climb. Ideal for alt-tab gaming while you wait for your next match to start!

title: The Soul Box
description: The Soul Box is a kinetic visual novel about the mystery of a puzzle box. A story of an inheritance hidden behind what’s written. A different look at the future, a worried glance at the past.

title: Deadwater Saloon
description: Dive into the wild west as a saloon owner in a volatile frontier town. Customize your character and face the consequences of your choices as you forge friendships and enemies of townsfolk, travellers, outlaws and lawmen. Build the most famous saloon in the territory, or be overrun and destroyed.

title: Donut Arena
description: Where hunger prevails, a tournament is organized. There is only one rule: eat them all. Donut Arena is an action game that can't be tamed without smart planning. Try your best to please the kings, hype the crowd, conquer underwears and the gods shall answer the call.

title: Hereford 1642
description: Hereford 1642 is a historically based recreation of my home city of Hereford in England UK from the year 1642. I have pieced together a picture of the city as it once was. Take a step into 17th century life and experience history in full 3D with realistic graphics.

title: Richard West and the Golden Mask
description: Help Richard West to find the Golden Mask in this adventure game, fulfilled with dangerous traps, mysteries and puzzles to solve. Use your skills to overcome obstacles and reach your goal.

title: The Future Project
description: Take control of an AI soldier, explore planets, and partake in fast paced combat in The Future Project, a first person metroidvania. Explore distinct worlds, obtain new weapons and abilities, and defeat powerful enemies in humanity's quest to journey the stars.

title: Alchemical Inc.
description: Card battle your rivals turn by turn. Explore the mean steampunk streets of New Folk City. Trade your cards to craft the perfect deck or else you're going home empty handed.

title: Viy: Retold Story
description: the game in the quest genre is based on the Gogol's story 'Vij'.

title: Frogman Magmaborn
description: A story-based rogue-like startegy RPG. Discover story and characters each run, battle in diverse hand-crafted maps, and edit everything with the dedicated modding tool!

title: One Last Breath
description: A 2.5D adventure set in a world where life is all but extinguished. You play as Gaia, a being born from nature's last wish with the power to influence the surrounding plant life in order to face a dark world while being hunted by malformed creatures.

title: Plunger Boyz
description: Plunger Boyz is an entertaining platformer in which you have to reach the end of Chaos and reclaim your crown using the plunger to pull in and out of objects, as well as going through some challenges and solving puzzles.

title: Chick Boy Adventures
description: Chick Boy Adventures - Immerse yourself in the fantasy world of dreams of an unprecedented sweet tooth and collect all the goodies before someone else eats them! Collect sweets in the vast nooks and crannies of your mind and get as far as possible on this extraordinary adventure.

title: Scrapvival
description: Fight off robot hordes with help of your friends or alone as soon as possible build the helicopter and escape that damned and creepy junkyard!

title: Conrad Stevenson's Paranormal P.I.
description: This ghost hunting simulation is a first-person single player experience. You’re equipped with an EMF Meter, Thermometer, Audio Recorder, Camera, and a Flashlight collecting evidence to satisfy homeowners concerns.

title: Running Challenge
description: Race with other AI players, achieve levels

title: Pets at Work
description: Some pets got lost from their owners in an office and now need to work together, using boxes, mats, buttons, climb on shelves and tables or just make a mess trying to find them in this colorful co-op game!

title: Revenants: Spirit & Mind
description: Revenants is single-player VR Action/ Horror. Become a professional occult investigator, relying on cutting edge technology from 2030 to locate, trap and battle demonic forces, all whilst gathering evidence and solving the mystery of the occult crimes.

title: The Infecting 3
description: Fight zombies, customise your character or your ride and try to survive! In The Infecting 3 the characters have crash landed on a mysterious island, and must find the truth behind this horrific apocalypse.

title: Brave Doggy Quest
description: Brave doggy quest - Mysterious creatures have stolen the entire supply of your favorite bones and scattered them everywhere - you need to do something about it! Go on a journey, collect your wealth and put things in order!

title: Deadly Infestation
description: Collect resources, hunt, mine, build your base, weapons and objects to help you survive. Are you able to discover the real reason for your journey?

title: Ultimate Tag
description: Compete with friends in the fast-paced, 2D platformer! Chase each other through various unique maps, using quick reflexes and maneuverability to avoid being "it". Collect powers along the way to help dash, freeze and teleport your way to the top!

title: Industriality
description: Future, Robots have invaded the planet and terrorized cities. Artificial intelligence is out of control. Only the Hero can stop this madness.

title: Boxville
description: Boxville is an adventure puzzle game about speechless cans living in the city of boxes and drawing doodles on cardboards to tell the stories. Made in Ukraine.

title: WavePlayer
description: WavePlayer is a single player 2D pixelart wave survival game, the goal of the game is to defeat all of the enemies that spawn in intervals using a legendary Warrior and emerge victorious from the depths of the deep circling forests and caves.

title: Nobodies: After Death
description: Nobodies: After Death is a puzzling point-and-click adventure in cleaning up dirty work. After your agency takes out a target, you make the evidence disappear without a trace. Find a way to get in, get out, and leave no bodies behind.

title: Into the Waves
description: Morin is a barkeeper with an unusual curse. All people look like shadows to him, except for one mysterious stranger... Solve the mystery of the curse, fight true darkness and mix the most unusual cocktails in the atmospheric visual novel — Into the Waves!

title: Friendsim 2
description: In this episodic visual novel, follow the adventures of MSPA Reader as they return to Alternia once more to save their friends... and realize that nothing is as it seems.

title: Hell Invades Heaven
description: Can you imagine that God himself missed paying hot water bill? Take command of hellish forces and with the small help of Almighty, but a little bit lazy Devil, show this old man, that hell kettles are not boiling for free.

title: Splodge Royale
description: Use Gyro Aim to Paint and Power Slide your way around while defeating Monsters, building platforms and avoiding the deadly Squog (Square Fog). Single Player and up to 4 Local Players for Co-op and Versus. From the maker of Zombie Death Quota.

title: TraxWorld
description: Open-world third-person game crossed with an off-road vehicle sim. Exit the vehicle in 3rd person, use character tools, collect items to sell from the pouch or collect your machines in the vehicle inventory. Mods, damage and dirtiness is progressive and lasting. Multiple stage releases.

title: Moadra
description: Endure... Evolve... Or Die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

title: Jumphobia: Homeward Bound
description: Jump, skip, hop and leap in Jumphobia: Homeward Bound, an indie sci-fi adventure game! Go as far as your little wheel can take you! Play as a little delivery bot from a far-flung future controlled by the monolithic "MARE" corporation, and find your way back home through the perilous deserts, dead forests, and untold wildlands that lie ahead.

title: Drone Crash Course
description: Drone crash course - Being a pilot of a controlled drone is not easy. Having decided to master this profession, you sign up for training and attend classes for a whole year .. and now the day of the final exam has come!

title: Pieces of Beauty 2
description: Deemed a Master of the Chinese Bird and Flower Painting Style, Ohara Koson produced hundreds of prints during his life. Discover 16 majestic pieces made by one of Japan's most celebrated artists while you sharpen your brain and relieve stress playing this Jigsaw Puzzle Game.

title: Save the Reactor
description: What if you happened to be in a control room of a nuclear reactor and something went wrong? Save the Reactor gives you the opportunity to fully experience these emotions! This simulator is great for those who like to challenge themselves and aren't afraid of difficulties!

title: Scoop Kick!
description: Help Ms. Cream and her friends on their quest to retrieve all the stolen ice cream from the evil Juice Bunch! Venture through more than 5 different worlds in this arcade inspired game where your goal is to kick scoops and assemble ice cream cones. Aim for the high score or try to get the best time!

title: Faded Stories: Greenberg
description: Here in the city of Greenberg time is meaningless, and space is infinite. The city has endless history and yet... The whole place is fading away.

title: Paper Bride
description: Paper Bride is a Chinese horror mystery puzzle game. You will play as the groom to search for the truth and have bizarre encounters, gradually learning about the dark mystic custom in the bride's home village and a story from the past...

title: Kingdom of Dinza
description: A top-down 2D, procedurally generated, open world fantasy RPG. Explore wild areas, forests and dungeons, fight monsters and craft superior weapons and armor as you uncover the mysteries and overcome the challenges of the Kingdom of Dinza!

title: No Rage Quit Dude
description: a game where only luck counts, jumping from platform to platform. Just mystery and luck will be essential for this game. Maybe you can finish maybe you can not. I just know the assets but I don't know what will you see and what gonna happen.

title: Shadow Cave
description: Shadow Cave - Uncover the secrets of the shadow cave in this platformer game with its protagonist. Explore the dark sections of dangerous nooks and crannies, collect coins and watch out for ghosts!

title: Save the Llama
description: Craft the perfect defense upon shifting platforms, turning gears, and railways to defend your cows from alien UFO's in this space western tower defense.

title: Latarnix Puzzle
description: Help the boar Latarnix as he passes through a variety of puzzles with obstacles to reach delicious golden apples at the end of each of the 50 levels in the game.

title: Feed All Monsters
description: Feed All Monsters is a cute and cozy Line Puzzle game. Assist a team of delivery workers in their quest to bring tasty food to all the little monsters. Find the optimal path for each worker in order to get all the monsters fed.

title: Haunted Hell House
description: Horror action ADV to enjoy the fear.

title: Eden's Last Sunrise
description: A classic tactics RPG where magic and technology clash to determine the fate of the world. Command tactical battles, befriend and train your troops, create custom heroes, and experience the story through multiple branching paths.

title: Once in Flowerlake
description: This is a short story in a sci-fi setting with a top-down view, telling the story of a nameless man lost in routine in the middle of a cold world and soulless machines. But what if it could be different?

title: The Tribulation Entanglement
description: Born into a nightmarish fever dream, the Entangled One must fight its way through diverse, visually striking environments, from a blasted wasteland beneath an eternal eclipse, to mutant-filled swamps, and the putrid guts of the underworld...

title: The Misty Tale
description: The Misty Tale is a third-person fantasy-fighting game where you have to swim on a raft, navigate the terrain on the map, find and remove magical runes, and fight their defenders, to fulfill the request of your savior

title: Malody V
description: Ultimate music game simulator

title: Monkey Doomsday
description: Welcome to a world where the entire human population of earth is undergoing a massive de evolution process! The human race has de evolved back into monkeys and are causing an apocalyptic mayhem over the entire earth, and It's only up to you to end this terrorizing madness!

title: Aussie Clowns At War
description: Aussie Clowns At War Dec 15, 2021 a free humorous fast paced multiplayer pc fps war shooter with some favored old school qualities like "COD MW2 kil streak announcer and Vietcong CTF" & 5 game modes 20 maps, awsome weapons classes including flame thrower, easy secure player hosting.

title: Sky DarkCrow
description: Crow has to defeat enemies and collect coins and others.

title: Connectify
description: Welcome to the Connectify puzzle! The object of the game is to connect dots with the same numbers in a line without crossing other lines.

title: The Fabulous Fear Machine
description: Everything you’ve ever dreamed of can be yours with The Fabulous Fear Machine, a narrative-driven strategy game with a pulp horror style. Become a Master of the Machine, spread the darkest Legends of urban myth, and let fear rule the world.

title: Battle Fishing Masters
description: Battle Fishing Masters combines a fishing RPG and shooter with rogue-lite elements. Catch, battle and collect over 150 unique robot fish. Upgrade new weapons and gear. Meet a cast of exotic characters with quests, and challenge the fishing bosses on your way to becoming the champion!

title: Little Red Rocket Ship
description: Little Red Rocket Ship is a bullet hell game with shoot-'em-up and platforming sections, featuring challenging but short levels and multiple weapon and ship options.

title: Alien Shepherd
description: Alien Shepherd is a platformer with a flying mechanic that can be activated by fusioning with a pet Jellyfish.

title: Cellings
description: Cellings is a creative sandbox game taking place in an abstract procedural world full of various species. Experience the full evolution of cells across 3 generations, compete with other species, and explore breathtaking worlds.

title: Dog Clicker
description: Welcome to the world of Dogtopia! Here in Dogtopia, dogs are your greatest companion! They often like to play around, bark at inanimate objects, and fetch stuff! They also seem to have a keen eye for shiny things!

title: Pixel Skater
description: Pixel Skater is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game with precise controls, a deep combo system, and an extraordinarily detailed level editor. Play, build, and compete online with your friends. Not a social butterfly? Enjoy an immersive story mode, challenges, and even puzzles!

title: Poor Lucas and the Evil Duke
description: Poor Lucas and the Evil Duke is a Metroidvania with action and RPG elements. Jump, slide, wall jump, swim, and battle your way through the Dukedom. Other mechanics include pushing boxes, pulling levers, and swinging on ropes.

title: Moorhuhn Adventure: Der Schatz des Pharao
Blade Crusade
description: Put your platforming and fighting skills to the test in Blade Crusade, where each of the 200+ levels may take you seconds or hours to beat! Use your growing arsenal of moves to slice through enemies and dash through levels at breakneck speed.

title: Kupechestvo
description: Kupechestvo is a board game with historical elements.

title: Vendir: Plague of Lies
description: Vendir: Plague of Lies is a classic party-based RPG with a deep storyline and initiative-based combat. Experience an intricately crafted world, steeped in history and brought to life through a carefully crafted atmosphere and the trials and tribulations of stories of the people that inhabit it.

title: Delivery Boy
description: Become the best courier in Crystal City and create your own delivery business. Explore the big city, complete tasks, collect resources and build your own delivery services.

title: Mathomatics
description: Runner puzzle on reaction speed and ability in mathematics. You control a cube that moves towards math blocks.

title: Cannon Canines
description: Cannon Canines is a 3D, mini-tank driving, action-adventure game! Play as a Cannon Canine, and join a crew of freedom-fighting animals in the Pawpad Isles in order to free your friends from a tyrannical megacorporation!

title: Pants Quest
description: Pants Quest is a tiny, lovingly crafted point & click adventure game about finding your way in life. And your pants. Sometimes just getting dressed & leaving the house feels like an impossible task. Follow one man's emotional journey to deal with the hurdles that life can throw at you on a bad day.

title: Serendipity Hotel
description: The detective is invited to the Serendipity Hotel. What will the detective experience in the hotel? Become a detective and participate in the Serendipity Hotel event

title: Brinefall
description: Gather resources to build your own home and village. Explore a vast open-world to find all its secrets and explore its mysteries. Defeat enemies and gather loot in a game that combines sandbox and RPG.

title: Alien Prop Hunt
description: Jump into an exciting new take on a classic concept! Alien Prop Hunt is an action packed team-based game where one team desperately tries to hide in plain sight, while the other relentlessly searches through environments to find them!

title: The Hepatica Spring
description: Run a beautiful bathhotel, uncover drama, and date a fabulous cast in this fairytale-inspired visual novel!

title: Enigmarella
description: Happy birthday Alice Rahner! You will be forced into an arranged marriage. Of course, falling in love with your new husband is entirely up to you. With 16 truly unique endings, are you willing to follow your heart?

title: Star Witch
description: The adventurer Neia is commissioned by the guild to investigate a mysterious tower in the forest. However, a series of powerful enemies appear one after another...

title: Scriptur
description: Scriptur is a kinetic visual novel featuring original artworks, soundtrack, and characters. You woke up on the train, knowing not how you ended up in it and where it was going. What is the secret behind all this? Will it be possible to reveal it and restore the memories of what happened?

title: Dungeon Color
description: Dungeon Color is a top-down puzzle game, where you switch between flames in order to achieve the rainbow flame in each room. Interact with special obstacles and melt your brain to find the exit. Cute, colorful, hard, fun.

title: Tetromino X
description: Tetromino X is a collection of falling block action puzzle games each with their own unique spin. Relax and drop blocks at your own pace in Chill. Balance and stabilize a stack of blocks as it grows ever higher in Stack. Match blocks together to upgrade upcoming blocks in Match.

title: Child of Hope
description: In this old-school RPG, you are the Child of Hope.

title: Treason
description: A group of wise guys found a dead body; there are traitors amongst them... Innocent players have to collect clues to find the murderer(s) and kill them!

title: Captain Jackson
description: Dynamic 2D retro, pixel-art, shooter. Fly fast, shoot accurately. Fight back the Rivanirs invasion. You are the Captain Jackson, you are their Doom.

title: Arms Trade Tycoon: Tanks
description: Arms Trade Tycoon: Tanks is a unique combination of tank design and tycoon game. It puts you in charge of an arms trading company specialized in tanks from WWI to the modern era. Research, design, sell and follow your tanks in battle to make your own history!

title: Monster Tamer
description: Monster Tamer is a 2D turn-based adventure where you capture, train, and battle with unique creatures. Explore a vibrant world, build your team, and become the ultimate tamer.

title: Stretchy-Man: The Video Game
description: Stretchy-Man is a physics based puzzle game. Earths mightiest super hero Super-Duper-Man has been captured by the villain Evil-Man, leaving it up to the unlikely hero Stretchy-Man to save the world from destruction. Will you be able to stop Evil-Man before its too late?

title: Dark Colors
description: Dark Colors is a psychological horror adventure set within an abandoned research facility. You follow your character as you find out what exactly happened here years prior, tasked with gathering information, you start to suspect that you may not be alone in this facility...

title: Kitsune Battlemage
description: Kitsune Battlemage is an intense elemental magic combat game where you're not limited to any specific school or style. Choose your abilities, wage battle against your fellow battlemages, and train your skills in order to fight the growing darkness that approaches!

title: Hydrofoil Generation
description: Hydrofoil Generation is a realistic sailing and foiling simulator. The game focuses on "in-shore" regatta style with heavy emphasis on realism and multiplayer with a first person perspective.

title: Sudden Darkness
description: Sudden Darkness is a top-down horror game where you have to find all the first aid kits as a guy on a wheelchair. When you collect them, the door will open to the next floor. Be vigilant, ghosts and monsters inhabit all floors, do not let them catch you.

title: Undead Pixel Monks
description: Fight dangerous and terrifying enemies, explore a dreamlike world, interact with its strange inhabitants, and uncover the truth. Undead Pixel Monks Adventure is a 2D action-adventure game set in a fantasy world inspired by Japanese mythology and philosophy.

title: En Route: Space
description: En Route: Space is a 2 player co-op puzzle game where you need each other to figure your way out through the mysteries of space. Work together, open your mind and trust one another to persevere this adventure.

title: Heatris
description: For those who want to play a puzzle with time where it will require patience, you can choose the image and the level of difficulty.

title: Magna Graecia
description: Magna Graecia is a colorful building strategy and puzzle game in ancient Greek style in which you create a sprawling village with olives and grapes by placing buildings strategically, leveling them up, receiving adjacency bonuses, and expanding your territory, while enjoying the whole process.

title: Blade and Ham
description: Blade and Ham is a classic fantasy beat'em up with modern picture! Grab your sword sharpen blade and don't forget a ham.

title: Rojo: A Spanish Horror Experience
description:
Explore the apartment of a nostalgic Francoist to find your friend in this short first person horror experience set in Spain.

The game takes place in an oppressive and unique atmosphere, full of references to the traditional Spanish culture. In this experience, the players must explore the creepy apartment to find clues and solve puzzles that help them find the protagonist's missing friend. With only a flashlight and their ingenuity, the players must enter the darkness and overcome their fears to reach the end.

title: Alpha Zoo
description: A cozy typing game for parents to play with their young children. Build a zoo, ride the rides, eat and shop, explore and play together!

title: The Legends of Tynedale
description: The Legends of Tynedale is a classic top-down action adventure game. Journey with Geordie as he takes on his Grandfather’s legacy: to find out if there is truth in the old Legends.

title: The 8 Sins: New Hell Order
description: Turn-based horror strategy game with RPG elements where the action takes place in hell, player take lead one of 8 demonic races that each of them represents one of 7 Deadly Sins (the 8th sin is Acedia).

title: Dunjungle
description: A 2d action-packed roguelike about an ape protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power. Explore ever-changing dungeons, fight weird enemies and gear up with lots of weapons and relics you can combine for a new experience every run. Explore, fight, die, and repeat!

title: Catoise
description: Make portals and levitate objects to solve puzzles - help Catoise get back home after a shopping trip in space ends in a crash landing. Collect parts of the damaged ship scattered across this strange planet. Meet friendly and unfriendly animal characters along the way.

title: Unmetaverse
description: Have you ever tried VRSNS but quit because you couldn't get used to the community? Unmetaverse is a VRSNS for people who have no friends. No voice chat, open world MMO space with content that you can enjoy alone.

title: Cute Chess
description: Cute Chess is all the fun of regular chess but with cute little characters, scene designs and music to make the game even more fun. Improve your chess skills by practising against computers with a range of different difficulties or take your skills online and compete against others.

title: Cute Dogs
description: Is it possible to buy some happiness with money? Who knows, but you can buy yourself a dog! Look, how cute they are! Play with our fluffy little fellas, a «find-differences» game. These cute little puppies can help you relax and find some peace of mind.

title: The Pied Piper of Gamelin
description: Casual third person game. In fact, this is a remake of "Snake", but thanks to the 3D graphics it has a peculiar gameplay. The camera position can be easily adjusted at will. Character control is very simple, you can also use a gamepad.

title: Roady Life
description: Experience the life of a trucker, delivering cargo between various industries. Feed the most valuable production lines or fulfill contracts to earn enough money to own the largest fleet of trucks among your friends, or start your own industries to maximize your profits.

title: Darwin's Aquarium
description: Breeding and training intelligent fishes is your hobby. Discover new species and defeat the bossfish - make your fish become real animals - wiht a real brain... brwwww. Learn AI the easy way - like playing.

title: Motorbike Traffic Splash
description: Motorbike Traffic Splash is an arcade scoring race.

title: Repit
description: Madness is the repetition of the same action over and over again, in the hope of a change. The challenge that Repit throws at your nerves is not everyone is ready to accept and only a few will be able to reach the end

title: Hailing from the Abyss
description: Hailing From the Abyss is a rhythm game with a unique duel setup. Beat powerful enemies in rhythmic battles by using consumables, acquiring power-ups, and skill. Guide Suri while she faces her past memories in style and rhythm!

title: Wild Dogs
description: The world is under a frantic alien attack. Amidst the chaos and with the army virtually subdued, the deadliest and most inconsequential pair of specialists are called upon to do what must be done. Join the war hunting aliens around the world and in every way possible.

title: Crate Mates
description: The pinnacle of warehouse worker simulators. Crate Mates is a block pushing puzzle game with a unique twist: Gravity.

title: Evasilix
description: Evasilix is a 2.5D die and retry platformer combined with a unique movement mechanic. Challenge yourself in more than 25 hand-crafted levels, each filled with deadly traps, countless obstacles, strong enemies, and reveal the disturbing truth that lies behind Evasilix!

title: Return to Kurgansk
description: Return to Kurgansk is an virtual reality adventure game, where you need to survive in an area full of danger and mystery.

title: Prison Life Simulator: The Legend of Navalny
description: Immerse yourself in the prison life of the most dangerous criminal in modern Russia.Go through the prison path from the beginning and determine the fate of the famous defendant. What will you become? Offended, authority or maybe the president of the Russian Federation? Everything depends on you!

title: Roma Invicta
description: Roma Invicta combines action packed real-time battles with turn-based strategy on a big campaign map. Supply your legions and conquer ancient Gaul turn by turn. Fight by yourself or hand over your soldiers to the AI ​​and enjoy the spectacle.

title: BeetleQuest 2
description: BeetleQuest 2 is a point & click adventure game about three beetlefriends who go on their second adventure to help the bumblebee postman. His letters and packages have come alive through a magic spell. The spell has gone wrong however, and all the letters and packages have run away.

title: Dumb Bomb Game
description: Bing bang boom, explode your guy across the room! Use bombs to guide your guy to the portal at the end of each level. Avoid the danger that sits between you and a high score!

title: Dangerous Drift
description: Dangerous Drift is an arcade racing game, in which we must manage to beat our rivals by driving in different locations around the world. Will you be able to win all the challenges?

title: Deep Cave
description: Deep Cave is a roguelike game about the adventures of a brave dwarf in search of great riches.

title: The Unlikely Prometheus
description: A classic 2D Point and Click adventure game

title: Lunar Odyssey
description: Lunar Odyssey is an immersive first-person VR experience, depicting details of the Apollo Missions, Lunar Lander, lunar surface, and Apollo-era technology with impressive accuracy and levels of interaction.

title: Wekufu
description: A Dark, Hand Drawn 2D Hack and Slash Platformer. Play as Sakinko, a young warrior set on a quest to avenge her father’s death and protect her people from the evil spirits that now menace her land, these evil spirits take the name of Wekufu.

title: Fall of an Empire
description: Defend your realm from invaders in Fall of an Empire. Barbarians attack your frontiers and treacherous vassals plot against you. You know your crumbling empire won't last forever, but it's up to you to see how long you can save it.

title: Elusive World
description: Survive against wild animals, common bandits, and overpowering rulers. Collect ingredients to craft from simple arrows for your bow to complex Ice Sword. Rich coming-of-age adventure. Single-player, story-driven RPG.

title: Tape to Tape
description: Tape to Tape is a unique roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the ultimate hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, find new abilities, bribe the referees or visit the blademaster while you progress toward the major leagues.

title: Workshop Simulator
description: Workshop Simulator allows you to repair and refurbish items using a range of restoration mechanics such as disassembling, cleaning, sanding and painting. The accompanying story will immerse you in the nostalgia of tinkering with your grandfather.

title: Pusheep
description: Pusheep is a very simple yet challenging puzzle game about planning your moves to achieve one clear goal, removing all evil sheep from your beautiful floating islands.

title: Captain Diarrhea and the Shartening
description: A top-down action shooter/sprayer. Use gross and weird movement mechanics and abilities. Enact revenge on the black military division that abducted you and made you the way that you are. BRING FORTH THE SHARTENING.

title: Dungeon Runner XZ
description: Dungeon Runner is based in a Hub city and from there you will choose your quests and dungeon runs. There will be a lot of Game mechanics when the game is released.Quest SystemParty System Class change systemAnd much More!

title: The Vellescian Gambit
description: Play the role of a merchant's apprentice in this 1600s-inspired realistic setting full with trading companies and business ploys. A short (2-3h) but replayable visual novel/RPG with logistics and trading aspects, brought to life with beautiful baroque paintings and classical music.

title: Jigsaw Souls
description: A fun puzzle about Daltoniel, the protagonist from the Souls Saga by Pickles Entertainment. Relax resolving this jigsaw puzzle with 12 original pictures and 3 difficulty levels!

title: Runeforge
description: Design your own spells, weapons, armor and tools. Discover procedurally generated mobs, resources, and regions. Build anything, anywhere. Team up with friends & play together in the ultimate sandbox RPG!

title: Lendas
description: Lendas is an action RPG with focus on exploration and survival in a living ecosystem procedurally generated. You will harvest resources, defeat powerfull creatures and borrow their powers to defeat the Corpo-seco and the mighty Cuca.

title: Blood Red Fists
description: Explore a vast and crime ridden city, fight your enemies in first person mode, talk to random strangers, steal and sell various items, gamble with your money, gain experience and spend it on helpful skills. But above all, try to stay alive in this 2d retro beat 'em up.

title: Exquisite Ghorpse Story
description: Sit around the campfire with your friends and assemble a spooky ghost story. Was it an eldritch cult or the living dead causing trouble for the local townsfolk? Did the terror happen in a derelict gas station, or perhaps it was an abandoned carnival? And how did they meet their fate?

title: The Medieval Psychologist
description: You are a stranger in Lostworth, full of people lost in the darkness of the Middle Ages. Your purpose; helping people spiritually. For this, you only have books, potions, spells and your words. In this adventure, you will face the truth about yourself as you uncover the secrets of the city.

title: SpaceCraft Brawl
description: A top-down, multiplayer, physics driven, space shooter game with destructible ship parts. Build your own spacecrafts. Fight with and against other players in different game modes, using a variety of weapons. Pick up super weapons and slice enemy ships in half. Easy to get into, hard to master.

title: Carnage Cross
description: Start your engines in the vehicular combat game Carnage Cross, with seven playable drivers, nine levels, and an arsenal of weapons, specials and rogue-like abilities at your disposal in story or skirmish modes, your hi-octane skills will uncover secrets of the mysterious and destructive contest.

title: A Contusion
description: A Contusion is a slow-paced slightly realistic roguelite top-down shooter where you find yourself lost and with impaired memory. Weapons and armor, shields, grenades and first aid kits, powerful artifacts and perks will help you on a difficult road to the past.

title: Boomerang Woman
description: This is an orthodox horizontal scrolling 2D action game 'Platformer'. A player will control 'Kyoko Senbonbashi', who always stands on the side of justice, to defeat an evil organization 'Dokuro-dan' by using a boomerang thrown to 8 directions and passing all 8 stages.

title: Cartels
description: Cartels is a tactical hardcore multiplayer first person shooter taking place in 1980s Colombia. Experience a variety of intense objective focused versus and cooperative game modes where a single bullet is often enough to win the fight.

title: Everglow
description: Experience story of Glow, young and naive furry heroine caught between two empires interplanetary ambitions forged in tragedy and conspiracy.

title: Unfair Souls: Darkest Grind
description: A 2D Souls-Like Pixel Art Platformer.

title: Academy of Magic: The Great Dark Wizard's Curse
description: In the third part of the magical match3 serial, your goal is to help Dennis to break the curse and save the "Academy of Magic" from a dark sorcerer.

title: 10 Seconds to Win!
description: 10 seconds to win! is a platform game where you only have 10 seconds to complete each stage, be agile and skillful to complete all levels.

title: Three Defilements
description: Three Defilements is a hack and slash adventure game about a young woman who keeps waking up in the same place every day. She travels to find a way out of this cycle, passing through various strange places. and must battle her most vexing foe, her own defilements.

title: Day After Day
description: Day After Day is a resource management/survival game set in a zombie outbreak. Keep your characters alive, set out on scavenge runs and maybe find a safe haven.

title: Undead Menace
description: Undead Menace - A brave girl went in search of treasures in ancient caves, despite the legend of the immortal guardians of jewels. She is sure that her passion for treasures cannot be stopped by neither skeletal magicians, nor dangerous chasms and traps!

title: Fallen Flowers
description: Strange atmosphere, strange things, but the performance is so "familiar". How "strange" does the familiar room and familiar her look? Why does everything start? Where will it go?

title: Sigh of the Abyss: Shadow Bonds
description: Embrace the monster within to free yourself from a curse in this dark fantasy visual novel, an introduction to the characters and setting of Sigh of the Abyss.

title: Isaiah 188
description: Fight on the ground and in space around 17 different bodies in our solar system with unique lite orbital mechanics. Recruit armies, build fleets, and conquer the solar system as one of three unique factions in this turn based strategy game!

title: Take As Needed
description: Assume a lead drug development role at Mazer- the foremost pharmaceutical company in the world! Create groundbreaking drugs for your customers, work hard to impress your bosses, and try not to ruffle too many feathers...

title: Project Runner
description: Project Runner is a Survival Game where the protagonist is trapped in a maze with the main objective is to scape the maze.

title: Grand Hike
description: Go on a unique and unforgettable Hike and discover the old historical forest and it's secrets. Get ready for an calm and relaxing adventure far away from the civilization. What kinds of encounters will your Hike have?

title: Exodus: Trapped In Time
description: A retro 2.5D sci-fi FPS shooter with modern mechanics with custom engine. Features completely destructible environments, bullet-time slow motion, Newtonian physics, dynamic lighting and more fun features.

title: Lupa
description: A beautiful stylized polygon 3rd-person exploration game, with a semi-open world and a beautiful She-Wolf, called Lupa who is looking for her missing pack and her two little cubs. With a story inspired by Roman mythology. Join Lupa in this beautiful world and her journey!

title: Tormentis
description:
Prepare your dungeon against intruders and protect your loot chests with monsters and well-placed traps. Train your hero, equip powerful gear and conquer other players' dungeons to fight your way to the top of the league.

Where classic action role-playing meets dungeon building. Your task is to protect your loot boxes from intruders. They supply you with coins and your opponents want to empty them!

Create a unique dungeon that will mislead your opponents. Place monsters and traps in your dungeon and lead your opponents into an ambush. They may not reach your treasury in time!

With every victory over another player you will receive trophies and rise in the rankings.

title: Heroes of Agora
description: Multiplayer online PvP combat arena third person fighting game featuring both ranged and melee style combat with a large roster of playable characters each with unique attacks. Destroy your opponent or die trying.

title: Blood Nova
description: Princess Love is set to assume the throne of a powerful galactic empire. But when conspirators try to thwart her ascension, Love and her best friend Kel become stranded on an interstellar lighthouse. Prove Love worthy of rule in this thrilling point and click adventure game.

title: Progeria: Vae Victis
description: XXI century, Russian Empire. Kirill Yeletsky is a fifth-year student at the Saint Petersburg Academic University of Necromagic. Help him defend the honor of his noble family by winning in the grand imperial necromagic tournament.

title: Space Balls
description: Shoot yourself into space as high as you can in this arcade game with a retro soundtrack!

title: Cubes of Death
description: Cubes of Death is a 3D-puzzle game, with both story mode (single player) and arcade mode (to play time-trials against a friend). If this first release is somewhat successful, PvP and Co-op story mode will be next on our to-do-list.

title: Nitrojet
description: Nitrojet is a metroidvania where everything is destructible. Explore and survive this ruined world filled with deadly beasts with the help of your jetpack and blade.

title: True Magician
description: How do you become a true magician? Find out in True Magician, an interactive text adventure with RPG elements. Travel through the kingdom with your teacher, learn the art of magic, fight enemies and make friends. And remember, the world is not what it seems!

title: Unread Unwound
description: There’s one goal: SAVE THE WORLD. Unread Unwound is a warm RPG where a strange power connects you to a mysterious guide. Battle enemies, explore a colorful journey, and perhaps appease your inner demons.

title: Hordebreaker
description: An army of monsters, demons, and undead sweeps the land. Armed with only an old sword, crossbow, and A LOT of fireworks, waves of unique and dangerous enemies advance on you. Upgrade your equipment, and push back. Take the fight to them, destroy their leaders, and break the horde.

title: Dash Cup Kickers
description: Super fast paced arcade action soccer with incredible power dashes, sweet mega tricks and unbelieveable powerful super shots! Master all tricks, skill up your team, develop the best technique and earn gold in all cups! Play online or locally with up to 4 players in varying stadiums

title: Bouncy Cube
description: Bouncy Cube is an arcade game where you keep the balance of a cube on moving platforms.

title: High Elo Girls
description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

title: Love Notes
description: Play as Rachel or Jesse in this horror dating sim featuring 2 male and 3 female love interests.

title: Microbrewery Tycoon
description: An economic strategy dedicated to microbrewery management. Your craft beer should become famous all over the world!

title: Best Forklift Operator
description: Best Forklift Operator is a super-realistic, physics-based forklift vehicle simulator. Experience what the job of a forklift operator looks like, participate in the training and show that you are ready for the challenges.

title: Sokoramp
description: Sokoramp is a relaxing puzzle game with various mechanics in over 50 levels.

title: X Fugitive
description: X Fugitive is a police chase game where player have to run from the police cars . This is an endless game in which you just have to survive as long as possible.

title: Yavi
description: A retro styled 2D Sci-Fi RPG including robot fighting, hilarious dialogues and a great story that will make you laugh and cry - if you're a sensitive person (which is nothing to be ashamed of!).

title: Mini Army Tactics Medieval
description: Casual turn-based strategy game set in a fantasy Medieval era. Strategically command your troops on the battlefield to crush your opponent in combat. Use your troops abilities carefully to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Do you have what it takes to win the war?

title: Pangaroids
description: Destroy the deadly bouncing orbs for the highest score in this Pang meets Asteroids arcade blaster.

title: Karl's Kooky Warehouse
description: A madcap, arcade-style, platforming challenge! Can you best the evils of the warehouse and defeat the C.E.O.?

title: Lirica
description: The world of Opera is fading away! To bring the spirit of music back to life and help restore Lirica to its former glory, join Renatta and new musical friends as they explore the world, solve music puzzles, and restore life to Lirica.

title: Zombie Maze
description: 'Zombie Maze' is simple top-down shooter game with maze. You need to find way to escape. Only way to escape is helicopter on the roof!! Run!!! and kill those zombies!!!

title: Shrumblo and the Magical Grumblo
description: Survive for as long as you can while playing as the blue robot Shrumblo! The objective of this game is to lure Grumblo, the red demon, into several moving spikes which temporarily stuns him, and also earns you a point. Survive for as long as you can and earn a high score!

title: Dreamy Planet
description: A gloomy yuri VN set in an abandoned theme park, focused on a ruinous relationship between a pair of estranged childhood friends.

title: Reefland
description: Reefland - is a colorful city-building simulator with a relaxing atmosphere, where you are up to paint the island by placing buildings.

title: There is No Stairs
description: Thousands of rocket jump accidents are reported worldwide every year. Unfortunately, a bald inventor here also lost legs trying to get up to the second floor. But he wasn't frustrated. Now he is designing an unprecedented new invention, dreaming of a world without rocket jumps... It's the stairs.

title: Atomic Souls
description: Atomic Souls is a tactical roguelite deckbuilder which has you playing as an awoken remnant of the old world. Journey through the new world, encounter bizarre creatures, assemble the perfect deck, discover powerful artifacts, and fulfill your destiny!

title: Cursed Quest
description: An action adventure game where you will explore, fight, solve puzzles, improve your abilities and find equipment to make your way to the "source".

title: Software Company
description: Build your own videogame-studio from the early days of videogaming to the future of the industry. Develop the games of your dreams, take care of your employees and mange your business.

title: Mystery of Island
description: Mystery of Island is a wilderness survival game. Various enemies, huge map to explore, collect resources to improve and strengthen yourself over time.

title: Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code
description: Explore a vibrant world where ancient religions fuse with technology in this character-driven JRPG. Master deep turn-based combat as you battle with divine magic against beasts with mecha parts. Embark on a grand adventure to retrieve the sacred Babel code needed to face your Gods.

title: Stolen Crown
description: Stolen Crown is a deck-building game with dynamic combat, diverse encounters, and powerful relics. Three different classes, paired with hundreds of spells and abilities, means each run has something to offer!

title: Arksync
description: Wired from the ashes of twin stick Shooters, Arksync evolves the genre with breakneck player movement and lethal enemy AI. Kill for energy to buy weapons, utilities, and upgrades; risk it all as you enter the depths of the evacuation facility. It's the only way to take this robot teddy bear home.

title: Iron Lung
description: A short horror game where you pilot a tiny submarine through an ocean of blood on an alien moon.

title: Destroy the Cubes 2
description: Destroy the Cubes 2 is a casual puzzle game where you need to find the right trajectory of the balls to destroy all number cubes at once. Various mechanics will challenge your physical intuition and accuracy. Use the level editor to create levels and challenge yourself in your own way.

title: Inner Light
description: Meditation beyond a simple relaxation - actively using the power of VR to bring meditator into deeper levels of relaxation, awareness and focus.

title: Turbeton
description: Turbeton is a competitive multiplayer game in which two players go head-to-head, waging a strategic fight for control of the Afterlife.

title: Starblast: Retro Wars
description: A simple colorful arcade twin-stick shooter in space.

title: KeyHero
description: KeyHero is a puzzle game. In the game, the key is the only tool for you to pass obstacles.

title: Maybe Immortal
description: Maybe Immortal is an action role-playing hack-and-slash game based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow in a courtyard of one mysterious taoist to become immortal.

title: Eat Colors
description: Eat Colors is a precision platform game, where instead of running and jumping you throw yourself from surface to surface using just the mouse and a fluffy slime that sticks anywhere.

title: Cu-Blit
description: Cu-Blit is a grid-based sokoban style puzzle game in a Sci-Fi city that's lost its power. Follow the journey of a small worker robot using the last of its battery to control other robots, recharge, teleport and build pathways to the head console and reboot the city back to its original self.

title: Ghoul Dungeon
description: Welcome to Ghoul Dungeon, a level-based adventure. As you make your way, you will encounter monsters you must fight off. You'll only be able to hit them up close, so make sure you stay agile.

title: The Spanish Privateer
description: Escape the confines of high-society and find freedom, romance, and danger on the high seas as a privateer in this pirate otome. A historical fiction visual novel set in the early 17th century, travel from Spain across the Caribbean while surviving life at sea.

title: Toolnich Village
description: Toolnich Village, a Retro, 2D level-based game similar to an RPG. The game has a story where you "PLAYER" try to save or not the Toolnich location.

title: A Day Out
description: A Day Out is a monster-hunting, paranormal-investigating, and case-solving co-op shooter game. Unlock gadgets and upgrade your base as you discover a new supernatural world with your friends!

title: Kamigami: Clash of the Gods
description: Easy to play, hard to master, join this adventure on an unique card game where you are able to do everything you ever wanted. Collect cards, build your decks, play offline on history mode, challenge your friends online or take on the world in a ranked system!

title: SlipDream Resonator
description: SlipDream Resonator is a multi-directional rhythm game with unique twin-stick controls. Inspired by both classic rhythm games and top-down shooters, SlipDream Resonator offers addictive arcade gameplay designed to challenge while featuring eye catching visuals and a heart pumping soundtrack.

title: Watermelon Wars
description: A game based on a popular Chinese video. A war caused by buying a watermelon.

title: Infinite Progression
description: Never worry about finishing your current idle game, because this one never ends! Play through a procedurally generated incremental. Gather currencies. drive once hard to get currencies to obsolescence, or just mess around. What you do is up to you in this infinite idle.

title: A Frustrating Platformer
description: Test your platforming skills in this challenging 2D platformer game

title: Endless Zombie Weekend
description: Endless Zombie Weekend is an endless arcade game with RPG elements. It's hard to be the only survivor after the apocalypse. How often do you think about it? As the main character of the game, you can feel it! Upgrade your weapons and try to survive as many days as possible.

title: Umbra Galaxy
description: Umbra Galaxy is a sci-fi shoot'em'up where you pilot a spaceship adrift in the restricted space filled with enemies. Destroy enemy generators, fight your way to the bosses and secure the obscure goal in the end!

title: Space Roguelike Adventure
description:
It's time for an incredible adventure in pixel art roguelike platformer game - Space Roguelike Adventure! Be the hero! Save the universe!

Now, there’s another far far galaxy from a parallel universe — and suddenly the Rainbow planet appeared there for no particular reason. It had such a strong magnetic field that it practically smashed the protective barrier of the prison planet Abakaz. Many dangerous galactic criminals have managed to escape and settled in some uninhabited lands. All these unfortunate events bring us to the point where the adventures of a young hunter from planet Earth will start. It’s you, of course!

title: Fragmented Memories
description: Immerse yourself in the Psychological horror adventure of James Charouz on his way to find his missing wife and uncover the dark secret of his hometown.

title: Bear Adventures 2
description: Bear Adventures is a 3D platformer with exciting levels in different locations and unique graphics! You can play alone, as well as invite your friends, because Bear Adventures is co-op game mode supports up to 4 players!

title: Wingsuit Dream
description: One day, you have dreamt about fly the sky in there you feel free to fly A simple game about scoring, avoid and fly!

title: My Last Journey
description: We all fall once...And now that day has come,when we were down,too.You have to go on an unforgettable adventure,which change you forever.Your fate depends on your decisions, will be you able to survive,or this journey will be your last...

title: Here to Stay
description: Join the race for power in the new political strategy game. Build a strong political party, win the regional elections and have a majority in parliament. As the head of state, you are in charge of running the state, managing the state budget and diplomacy.

title: Handyman Corporation
description: In Handyman Corporation you become the owner of a business where you handle a variety of jobs in cleaning, maintenance, design, and construction. Accept contracts, play minigames to perform every task required. Then expand your company – buy spare parts, tools, train skills, and manage.

title: Clocknockers
description: Bad Dudes have broken Time Itself, You must travel to multiple Times and Locations to fix time.

title: Axial Drift
description: Axial Drift is an online-multiplayer FPS-Z modding platform where you can create your own maps, skins, weapons, and game modes using Unreal Engine 4.

title: Star Shift Rebellion
description: Infernis Prime is a mining colony in the Outer Rim, under brutal occupation. With the help of a hacked android, and the discovery of a dark secret below the surface, the rebels see their chance to finally break free from their oppressors.

title: Solitaire Harmony
description: Minimalist solitaire peg puzzles, find your way out to the last dragon in this relaxing and beautiful game.

title: Repella Fella
description: Set in a future, post-apocalyptic Australia, Repella Fella tells the story of several characters as they work to change their position in the world. Shoot, stab, lie or maim your way through each problem as it presents itself.

title: SGS Operation Hawaii
description: On December 7th, 1941, the Empire of Japan struck a surprise blow against unsuspecting American forces at Pearl Harbor, Hawaï. In the ensuing confusion and panic, the USA feared a Japanese invasion of Oahu island, but it fortunately did not materialize. But what would have happened if it had?

title: Marble Computing
description: Using only marbles and gravity, solve logic problems in surprising ways!

title: Alephant
description: Alephant is an abstract sokoban-like puzzle game about rules and languages. Solve tutorial-less puzzles and help Alephant find a way to communicate.

title: Cyber Lounge Tycoon
description: Cyber Lounge Tycoon is a sandbox management game where you get to build and customize your own gaming club. Serve each customer or get a staff to do that for you. Upgrade and maintain your existing services. Unlock new options. Decide what kind of club you want to run!

title: The Holy Chalice
description: A top-down rogue lite twin stick shooter based on surviving wave based onslaught of enemies.

title: Juicy Bois: Conflict
description: A Juicy Treasure Hunting Game. Search for the Gem Chest. Search for the Key. Unlock the Gem Chest with the Key. Bring the Gem back to the Gem site.

title: Grappling Hook Ball Tournament
description: Grappling Hook Ball Tournament is a shooting game, players against players. Play with friends, up to 8 players. Welcome to the arena!

title: Keep Light
description: Bruno is looking for those who left him. He wants know the reason. Will he bring the Light to them or no?

title: Fortune & Famine
description: In this tabletop strategy game you play as the ruler of a fantasy kingdom on the brink of a long winter. You compete against neighboring rulers to gather the best workers and stockpile the most resources in the land.

title: They Came From Below
description: They Came From Below is a cute Tower Defense in Lowpoly 3D graphics. Here you have to build an economy and various defense towers to resist hordes of skeletons.

title: Blocks Must Fall!
description: Find a way to take off all the bright tiles in this relaxing puzzle game.

title: Russian Drunken Boxers 2
description: New fights of drunken Russian boxers at night. Spoof your friend or Ai bot using empty bottles of alcohol. Use super abilities

title: Being Ball
description: Traverse your way as a round ball through a beautiful dangerous cube world with traps, obstacles and challenging puzzles.

title: Super Liquid Soccer
description: Super Liquid Soccer is a fun arcade style 7 aside soccer/real football game coming soon for PC and Mac. A game for those less worried about simulating every blade of grass and more about epic battles amongst friends, last minute winners, cynical fouls, bullet headers and questionable tactics.

title: Kubberz
description: Kubberz is an Action RPG where you can take part on epic battles against your friends and other players around the world, as well as collect and train more then 100 different species of Kubberz.

title: Tarot: Theo's Quest
description: Embark on a quest of self discovery in this card-based adventure RPG! Complete your Tarot deck, read people's future with taromancy, and use your powers over the elements to solve environmental puzzles. Summon your spirit and duel other witches in turn-based combat. Will you discover yourself?

title: Calamity Eliminator
description: Calamity Eliminator is an anime-styled roguelike single-player deck-building game.You play as a member of the Existence Management Company, using the Calamity Eliminator to lead pioneers and Valkyries to save the day on a planet that has been struck by disaster.

title: Possession Obsession
description: Possession Obsession is a 2-4 player local multiplayer party game. As interns, you and your friends will compete for a coveted position at the infamous HELLC. Utilize your demonic powers and possess mortals to complete the boss's tasks in any way possible.

title: Bad Credit
description: Let's take it back to 2016. Donald Trump just went on Jimmy Fallon. The new Ghostbusters is still in theatres. You're working as a two-bit financier in the morally and financially bankrupt city of Tucson, Arizona. Take your own path amongst 100+ dynamic characters in this neo-western visual novel.

title: Dream Kitchen
description: Follow the story from different points of view and make choices to decide your future on five different routes and discover the mystery behind this magical adventure as you find love with one of the appliances of your kitchen.

title: Demon Spore
description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

title: Color Flash
description: Color Flash is an endless runner 2d game based on colors. The player has to pass through a series of obstable bars (divided into four tiles) by matching the tile with the same color as the player.

title: Bullet Casters
description: Bullet Casters in an unconventional Shoot ‘em Up game with a local PvP mode where you can challenge your friends and create your own bullet hell or face a single-player mode that will test your skill and wits.

title: Knightlife
description: Four villages in a war. You are the only hope for a peaceful life. Play as a knight in this cute open world RPG and loot through many different weapons, magical spells and bows. Become the strongest knight and end this war.

title: Vampire Combat
description: Test your skills in the Art of VAMPIRE COMBAT. Become one of 6 dynamic, elegant, Vampires of Fullerton: Ashzel, Casandra, Larson, Johfra, Colmillo, and LeonaLisa. Rendezvous with a worthy Vampire opponent acclimated in all disciplines. Showcase your VAMPIRE COMBAT skills.

title: Crazi Lift
description: Crazi Lift is a simulator / arcade with a forklift. Manage your warehouse and earn up to get the MANAGER qualification !! But be careful ... Time goes by ... and the mouse explode !!

title: Valley of Dragons
description: In Valley of Dragons, be prepared to raise and care for your own personal dragon!

title: Spooky Horror Game
description: A psychedelic horror shooter. A prison, four monsters, and you. Collect items and keys to survive. Don't let them find you.

title: Far Away From Home
description: Far Away From Home is a story-driven tactical RPG. Battle foes in turn-based combat, turn monstrous enemies into friends, customize your party with a variety of builds, and craft powerful gear to enhance your playstyle. Unfold the mystery of your lost party as you try to find a way home.

title: Mega Zombie Explosion
