description: Infinite destruction in infinite combinations! No Reloading: Survival Trials is a third-person rogue-lite style shooter taking inspiration from classics like Max Payne. Slay simulants, earn upgrades, and look cool while doing it!

title: Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One - M for Mystery
description: Mycroft's agents were outsmarted, and confidential documents have been stolen. You are tasked with locating a shadowy figure known only as M. It appears there is a worthy opponent at large on Cordona.

title: Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One - Saints and Sinners
description: Sherlock is forced to find the boundary between church and state, challenging his commitment to the law and justice.

title: Prinny Presents: NIS Classics Vol 3
description: Join up with your pal Prinny to experience NIS history with Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 3: La Pucelle: Ragnarok / Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure!

title: Clik Flip
description: Search the bizarre parallel world for the fabled hotdog. Items you shift on one side influence things on the other. Hot dog of all hot dogs, this is the game you didn’t know you’ve always wanted.

title: Hyper Light Breaker
description: Enter the Overgrowth, a new land in the world of Hyper Light. Play alone or with friends to explore massive biomes, defeat brutal monsters, create new builds, survive the mysterious Crowns and overthrow the almighty Abyss King in this adventure from the creators of Hyper Light Drifter.

title: Cataclysm: Bright Nights
description: Cataclysm: Bright Nights is an open source fork of Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. Bright Nights emphasizes game balance and interesting combat with heavier sci-fi aspects over grounded realism focused simulation of Cataclysm:DDA. Additionally Bright Nights contains a lot of rebalanced and reworked game mechanics, optimizations and Quality of Life features to make gameplay more fluid and enjoyable.

title: Seventh Lair
description: From Novectacle, the creators of the highly acclaimed The House in Fata Morgana, comes Seventh Lair, a tongue-in-cheek, but emotional look at the online interactions between an indie game developer and fans!

title: The Last Defense TD
description:
Follow the unique narrative in this Fantasy Tower Defence and lead your mages, strategically deploying them to defend the last kingdom standing - Murgaz.
Take part in the war from King Severin’s perspective.

title: Behind the Screen & Defoliation
description: Behind the Screen & Defoliation is a suspense puzzle set of games.

title: Let's Play Curling!!
description: Genuine Curling now on the Nintendo Switch! Utilize simple controls to make that all-important game-winning throw!

title: Betia Pera-pera English Adventure
description: Betia Pera Pera English Adventure is an immersion-type Interactive English conversation learning game in which users encounter battles and collect items by communicating with the characters of the game by listening, speaking, and writing, learning the correct pronunciation, and daily conversation as they play.

title: SRG Mixtape Volume #2
description: Super Rare Mixtape Vol. 2 is a physical indie game collection including 30 games and 6 demos. Packaged as a USB drive shaped like cassette tape with only a limited number sold.

title: Bibi & Tina: New Adventures with Horses
description: A violent storm has hit the area near Martinshof. Mount up and see what damage the storm has done. Ride across the fields, jump over numerous obstacles and have Bibi the witch magic away the mess. But most of all, you can have lots of fun in fast-paced horse races, show off your jumping and slalom riding skills, take loving care of the horses and send photos to your worried friend Naomi in Australia.

title: Super Mega Zero
description: Super Mega Zero is a fast-paced precision platformer and shoot 'em up hybrid with a built in Level Editor. Challenge hundreds of handcrafted levels or make and share your creations with others.

title: Shooting Star Island
description: Shooting Star Island is a big and colorful 3d platformer. Stanky Star will rekindle his powers throughout his journey to the comet's depths, where lost worlds slumber and the Muses of the End sing their songs of destruction.

title: Pad of Time
description: It's time to play a 2.5D retro-style platformer... With a twist!

title: The Textorcist: The Village
description: Follow Ray Bibbia 10 years in the past in this adventure set in a small village where religion is considered only a fad of the past. Unveil the mystery that lurks in Castel di Vania and get ready to face ancient demons with only the help of your trusty bible and your typing skills.

title: Vetrex
description: Vetrex is a game for two in which you will compete with your friend for the winning place using different types of weapons, throwing grenades and dropping red exploding barrels on the enemy's head!

title: Are You Smarter Than the Crowd?
description: You think you're a smart little fella, huh? Well, come on down and prove it in the "Are You Smarter Than the Crowd?" -gameshow! Compete with or against the crowd in a fun I.Q game, hosted by our lovely host!

title: Tenko's Magical Sword Quest
description: Upbeat precision platformer, with energized photons to reach a super charged state. Take yourself on a tremendous journey to collect all the magical stone pieces.

title: Arrival of the Punnu
description: Arrival of Punnu is a story about Punnu from outer space, explorers who make a crash landing to a planet called Earth. In their mission to fix their broken ship they get an ally of a little child, whose imagination will open up a whole new perspective to our homeplanet.

title: Blocknator
description: In this game, your objective is to fit the pieces on the board to accumulate points. When you complete one or more floors, the pieces are destroyed and you earn points. It’s that simple!

title: Hare Apparent
description: An ancient custom is invoked, and five kingdoms send their young heirs to play a legendary game. Build relationships, form alliances, and win the crown in this high-stakes game of woodland politics and social maneuvering.

title: Armored Firestorm
description: Armored Firestorm is an intense top-down shoot'em up action game in a futurist environments. At the controls of your Hovertank, survive against the attack of the machines in the orbital city of the federation.

title: A Butterfly's Dream
description: Be a Butterfly in this beautiful and relaxing game with no goals or enemies. Based on a Zen tale.

title: Easter Bunny
description: A very small Running game, where a Rabbit has to collect as many easter eggs as possible. Who will collect the most easter eggs? Compare your score with your friends and family.

title: Heroes of the Dark
description: Battle Vampires, Werewolves and Humans in a dark Imperial Age strategy game! Collect and upgrade Heroes for 5v5 action, forge alliances, and restore world order.

title: Healing Simulator
description: Take the role of healer in your party's quest again evil. Manage your party's health with healing spells in this strategy RPG.

title: Tomb Robbing with Friends
description: A multiplayer game about looting tombs and pushing your friends into traps so you can steal their treasures! Dodge spikes, grab coins and become the richest tomb robber!

title: Terry Poorflyer
description: Help Terry Poorflyer escape an island ruled by evil crabs! Inspired by retro side-scrolling platformers, Terry Poorflyer adds own "stomp" flair to it, handled by physics engine more advanced than in HL3!

title: Bird and Beast Fantasy
description: This is a national style pixel art, action role-playing independent game.

title: Go, Go, Knight!
description: Long live the brave knight! He is ready to fight skeletons and dodge traps to save this world ... or he just wants to find ancient treasures. It doesn't matter - Go, Go, Knight!

title: Where are My Mittens
description: A lost kitty. A dangerous environment. It's snowing. A cute indie platformer about a boy named Jason looking for a kitty named Mittens. Requires a standard qwerty keyboard and mouse.

title: Radon Break
description: Radon Blast is a classic Brick Breaker / Arkanoid style game. Break bricks by using the ball. Get items like speed, ball splitter and paddle resize to make the game more challenging. Some specials like gun, power ball or block wall helps you while playing your game.

title: Signals of Chaos
description: In an isolated vessel you find that the only path forward is through an endless wave of enemies. Upgrade and configure your ship to get through as many of them as you can, and perhaps a better tomorrow awaits you on the other side.

title: Jumpy Mia
description: Meet the always smiling girl and help her jump over enemies. Collect coins on differently constructed levels, discover a beautiful world and defeat a wide range of opponents. Join Jumpy Mia’s adventure now!

title: Spingram
description: Spingram is an exciting puzzle game that will blow your brain, with hundreds of levels and an extraordinary design. Our minds love challenges, and Spingram goes the extra mile to challenge players' gray matter. The goal of the game is to reconstruct the pattern presented in the preview by rotating the blocks in any direction. To align the trace perfectly you will need to examine the position and orientation of the original. If you are in trouble, you can always start over or undo the last move.

title: Mahjong Business Style
description: Become a business shark – play Mahjong on the exchange! Complete more than 100 levels, earning points and countless trophies. Each pack embodies a separate market – from stocks to advanced technologies—and each level contains special high-value gold pieces to collect! Enjoy classic levels or challenge yourself with levels that include wandering pieces, in which the arrangement of the tokens changes with each new attempt! Climb the ladder of success and Wall Street will bow to you!

title: Bad Writer
description: Get ideas. Write short stories. Sell them to magazines. Try and keep happy and not give up from all the rejections.

title: 10 Flights of Ballooning
description: 10 Flights of Ballooning is 10 mini-games based on the Balloon Trip mode in the original game Balloon Fight for NES.

title: Knightfall: A Daring Journey
description: Two knights, a strong bond, and a long journey. Take up the race for the rose, ride from village to village and take shelter before nightfall by any means necessary! If your bond is strong and your horse drifts well, you can be the recipient of the fabled rose. Luckily you brought guns!

title: In the Hole
description:
Light the Way!

Young Thyme has fallen into a hole in the ground, finding themselves surrounded by darkness in a strange dungeon. A mysterious entity allows them to borrow a magical lantern filled with fireflies to help them navigate the dark halls, and defend against the angry spirits.

Can Thyme make it out of the dungeon alive? At what cost?

title: Probe: A Game Dev Experience
description: Experience the magic of the videogame production cycle. Go behind the scenes and discover how videogames are designed, the programming which underlies them, and the digital art which brings them to life!

title: Rune Infinite
description: Crush opponents while earning unique prizes in this fast-paced fantasy PvP brawler from Rune: a crypto gaming company pushing NFT games to new horizons. Choose your class, customize your avatar, and collect unique NFTs playing the third game in Rune’s ever-expanding Metaverse. Test your skills against players across the globe and rise above the rest as Champion of the Infinite Arena.

title: Trust No Bunny
description:
Everybunny has a secret. Who do you trust to keep the town safe?

Trust No Bunny is a 5-8 player social deduction mission game for fans of Avalon, Town of Salem, Among Us, or Werewolf, actively being developed by new studio Friendly Pixel. It's a game for thinkers, schemers, and downright liars, where guessing the traitor is only half the battle.

title: Bionicle: Kapura Adventures
description: Step into the shoes of the iconic Matoran Kapura in his quest to move as fast as he can. Bionicle: Kapura Adventures features high-octane gameplay the likes of which you’ve never seen before. Discover the secrets of the island with more than 2 collectibles to unlock, and join Kapura as he undertakes his biggest challenge yet.

title: Dungeons of Aether
description: Dungeons of Aether is a turn-based dungeon crawler designed by Nick ‘ampersandbear’ Blackwood from the Aether Studios team. Rivals of Aether is known for its intense competition and twitch skills, while Dungeons of Aether allows you to take things at your own pace - but it’s still just as challenging! Every choice you make can lead you deeper into the dungeons or to an early demise.

title: Star Defenders
description: Star Defenders is a sandbox fast-paced platformer that takes place on random planets colonized by Star Defenders - the organization of people who've been protecting the idea of star exploration (which is why were mockingly called "Star Defenders" back on Earth). Star Defenders are on a journey to escape supermassive black hole on Mothership.

title: Tumbleweed Destiny
description: The somewhat hateful and slightly charming tumbleweed is the star of the game. This game is a tumbleweed life simulator that depicts the fate of tumbleweeds in my own imagination.

title: Yuuto Ichika Gets DMCA'd
description: Yuuto Ichika Gets DMCA'd is a bootleg fangame of Super Ledgehop: Double Laser and Yuuto Ichika Makes Friends! Play as best bootleg Yuuto Ichika, and defeat bosses solely by dashing!

title: A Slit of Joy
description: Finn was sad, so he killed himself. But he was greeted by Aoi a mysterious girl who granted him one wish before he gets reincarnated. Finn's wish, he wanted to see if anyone cared at all that he had committed suicide. Even though he knows no one ever cared about him.

title: Ed-0: Zombie Uprising
description:
Ed-0: Zombie Uprising takes place in Edo era Japan—but millions of zombies have raided the isolated country! Enter this world as a Samurai, Sumo Wrestler, or Ninja to slaughter the massive horde of undead. Strengthen your character by gathering items and skills in unique dungeons. Everything is randomly generated each time you play! No run is the same. Dungeons won't be easy, so expect tension with every run—fight to the brink of death and make harsh decisions to survive.

Encounter countless surprises and unpredictable adversaries as you expand your power and achieve greatness. Every run is unique. Player judgment will be essential, having to face “once-in-a-lifetime” challenges amid a hoard of zombies.

title: Space Beastz
description: Space Beastz is a cooperative multiplayer music and rhythm game. On a music-playing spaceship, players must time their actions just right to keep multiple instruments running and make the most amazing music the galaxy has ever heard!

title: Past Synergy
description: Past Synergy is a 2 player co-op game that tests you and your friend's synergy. Divide the ability and roles between you and your friend to overcome the obstacles in a cave that appears in your dream every night.

title: SM64 Generations
description:
SM64 Generations is a mod that adds Mario from Super Mario 64 to Sonic Generations, including its own abilities (including the famous Backwards Long Jump) and even the Wing Cap.

This mod needs both Sonic Generations and Super Mario 64 to work.

title: Garden of Seif: Chronicles of an Assassin
description: Garden of Seif is a narrative-driven game where choices matter. Play as Iris Lapis, an assassin navigating a world of danger, adventure, and romance. Two enemy love interests arrive and claim to be trustworthy, but can they win her heart?

title: Wormhole
description: Eat, shoot, dash, and explode your way through the cosmos in this adrenaline-fuelled arcade action game. WORMHOLE is a roguelike twist on the classic snake format featuring a stackable perk system and 100+ hand-crafted levels.

title: Littleroot Researchers
description:
Seven years after "Pokémon: Alpha Sapphire" events, Professor Birch recruited three new research assistants!
You will complete tasks, interact with nature, catch Pokémon, and make new friends!
However, during your adventure...you find something rare in Petalburg Woods...

title: Tedd'or
description:
Fantasy action-adventure RPG with an open world and diverse enemies.
Including a complex upgrade system and a lootbox-style way of obtaining new abilities.

The game contains a simple story you can follow to reveal secrets of the world you play in.
Multiple dungeons with juicy rewards you can obtain by putting your skills to the test.

The game also contains a competitive mode where you must defeat waves of enemies as fast as possible.

title: Winter's Wish: Spirits of Edo
description: A fantasy set in historical Japan in the spirit of the first localized console otome game, Hakuoki: Demon of the Fleeting Blossom. A moving, emotional tale with gorgeous visuals and multiple endings to discover. Choose from one of three different Oniwaban divisions for the heroine to join and get to know her colleagues. Be careful — they may not all be human!

title: Green Lava Studios Volume 2
description:
Over 200 levels, minigames and even real cookie recipes, can you handle the hardcore, platforming challenge of Fenix Furia?

Shoot your way out of fly-infested levels; beat the bosses and save your loved one in Birdcake!

It’s the grand finale of the My Name is Mayo trilogy! Will Mayo finally learn valuable life lessons? Or default to the same old-same old?

title: Instant Sports: All-Stars
description: In Instant Sports: All-Stars, you can play a variety of feel-good activities directly inspired by All-american favorite sports! In INSTANT SPORTS, everyone can play with ease by simply moving with the motion-gaming of the Nintendo Switch. You can also play in the regular way on both Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 through button mode!

title: Foretales
description: Decide the fate of the world in this ingenious story-driven card game. Foretales offers a unique take on the adventure genre, with a multitude of playstyles and story paths through which you can save the world… or bring about its end.

title: Mika and the Witch's Mountain
description: Soar with the wind on your broomstick, deliver packages to your friends, and explore a vibrant sandbox world in a coming of age adventure about an aspiring witch!

title: Egypt Collection
description: Collection released in Germany containing all 3 games of the Egypt-trilogy on a single DVD.

title: One of the Victims
description: From being lost in a forest to end up fighting normal zombies, running from the fast ones, and avoiding traps. Something is abnormal out there.. especially on hard mode! But the question is, will you accept being One Of The Victims?

title: Zemblanity
description: Zemblanity is an atmospheric first-person horror game. What seemed like a little creepy invitation over from an old childhood friend turns into disturbing uncovering of mysterious forces ruling in the mansion. Will you find a way out?

title: Escape Down
description: An adventure in which you play a prisoner who must escape from his captor. You will explore dungeons full of enemies and face powerful dungeon bosses, collecting materials with which to equip your group of fighters.

title: Nature's Habit
description: A video game made by Swinging Pixels, set in the year 2060, the ecosphere's systems are at the brink of collapsing. and you play as a smart synthetic waterdrop your main objective is to traverse the environment created by a group of scientists and ecologists named "Clepsydra".

title: No Anglerfish
description: You awaken on a desert island with no knowledge of who you are, or how you arrived there. Explore and unlock surrounding islands by playing the mysteriously powerful arcade machines spread throughout the lands.

title: Wild West Gringos
description: Classic Western Shootout Duel - One-on-One. Polish your boots, clean your revolver, and hit the road. It's almost High Noon ... and losing is not an option.

title: Choose your Poison
description: You must take a pill. Some are safe, others will kill you. Using process of elimination, survive as long as you can, with as few casualties as possible.

title: Letter Bender
description: A spelling-based puzzle game.

title: Fanite
description: A remake of Magicite, same gameplay loop just a tad bit harder, with new stuff added, but without multiplayer.

title: Hexagonal Tower
description: [Hexagonal Tower] is a tower defense game with cards and roguelike random elements. Try to deploy your turrets and various reinforcement components in the dungeon to form a unique and powerful defense. Darkness is coming. Guard the last fortress of mankind with your wisdom!

title: Arkheim: Realms at War
description: Experience a new take on the competitive 4x genre with Arkheim - Realms at War: Team based strategy in a free to play MMO fantasy world, played in game rounds of 10 weeks each!

title: Terror Shooter Apocalypse
description: You remained the sole survivor of the city after a massive enemy attack in this part of Europe.

title: Aster Force
description: Aster Force is a 3D sci-fi spaceship shooter game set in the far reaches of space. Players may choose from multiple ships to pilot, as they patrol and protect Sector 7184 from the sinister space pirates known as Specter. Join the crew of SS Gallaway to bring peace and order to the stars.

title: Die Die Die and Try
description: A simple runner where you have to dodge obstacle and finish as fast as possible.

title: Sillage
description: Sillage is an Rpg-adventure game that takes place in a fantasy world where magic and technology interact. Explore floating islands looking for treasures.

title: Sisters Possession 1
description: Sisters Possession Is Srpg. By possessing a girl, we will advance the battle to the advantage.

title: King of Kinks
description: King of Kinks is a squad role-playing game based around auto 5v5 battles. Strategize heroes with unique fighting skills to overcome your enemies in battle. Power up your girls and build up your unbeatable squad! Investing time & resources in your squad of gorgeous women will get you kingly (and kinky) rewards!

title: Lonely Knight
description: Lonely Knight is a game that combines idle and roguelike elements. Defeat monsters and embark on a journey to find companions for the lonely knight. Experience growth through idle gameplay and test your strength in dungeons!

title: Blind Wizard's Assistant
description: Blind wizards assistant is an unique turn based RPG where you play as an assistant to mighty but blind wizard. Collect elements, find recipes, craft potions to heal and eliminate monsters.

title: Waves Running Simulator
description: Have you seen the enormous waves destroying the planet? If not, you are in the right place! In Waves Running Simulator you have to escape from the tsunami as fast as possible.

title: Tales from the Crossing: The Captain's Chair
description: When a misfit crew on the last test flight of an experimental engine wakes up on the wrong side of the other side of the galaxy, what’s a Captain to do? You decide!

title: The Game of Unknown
description: The Game of Unknown is a survival horror game where you must last in an abandoned school until the sun rises. How hard could it be?

title: Did You Scared
description: A horror game based on fictional stories. The player can play story mode as well as multiplayer. a multiplayer physics-based prop hunt mixed with classic horror survival.

title: Silver Axe: The Honest Elf
description: Classic 2D platformer, play as a nimble elf and dash through the ancient fairytale forest. Defeat powerful Insomniac creatures, cast spells by combining four elements to summon thunder and entangle flame. Collect the heart of the goddess, unleash the hidden power of your Silver Axe.

title: Tower Words
description: Word game that mixes tetris, categories game and word search.

title: HoopsFPS
description: HoopsFPS is a first person multiplayer basketball game. You can play 1vs1 or 3vs3 against friends or foes.

title: Dandi World
description: The world of the arts has been invaded by a villain who hates artistic expressions and wants to destroy them. Embark on this adventure to save the world of the arts and rescue the Danditos from the clutches of Dr. Hate!

title: Hidden Farm Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Sunshower
description:
Sunshower is a colorful, casual arcade action game that follows a robot's survival in a rain storm! Use the plant installed on your head to reach for the sky as you achieve high scores and stop the rain from washing away the world. Enjoy a transforming, traditionally illustrated watercolor background and fun new music that appear as you gain more points. And, as you play more, find out what the robot you're controlling, Hinata, thinks of your time playing together.

Collect, combine, and chain power-ups to stop the rainfall! Gain more strength to carry more drops, increase your speed, or use an umbrella to deflect one drop. Every playthrough is unique!

Unlock an alternate, more challenging single player mode! You can also find 8 different customization options for Hinata! Try local co-op to reach for your highest score with a friend or compete to see who comes out on top!

title: Lollipop Knight
description: Lollipop knight is a challenging jumping game where you have to overcome various obstacles and traps.

title: Planet Conqueror
description: Planet Conqueror is FPS science fiction game where you have to collect minerals exploring different planets. The main goal in the game is to upgrade your gear up to be able to defeat the Alien boss. Each planet generates randomly, making the possibility to explore 10 000+ different planets!

title: Tower of the Sage
description: A classic rogue-like deck-builder game with some unique twists like Talent system and Random encounters and interesting Relics which change every run.

title: John Christian 2
description: The game John Christian 2 tells the heroism of a young man in a spiritual battle, who after receiving the armor of God, begins his mission to spread the gospel to every creature. On his journey, John is taken by God to a village and discovers that many people are in need of his help.

title: Wish of Abyss Dungeon
description: A real-time strategy to explore the dungeon.

title: The Smash Cars Tournament
description: Your goal is to pass every mission without being crushed. It probably seems pretty hard at first glance, but once you get it, you will become a true master.

title: Touch Some Grass
description: Someone told me to go touch some grass. I'm pretty sure this is what they meant.

title: Mini Pipes
description: Mini Pipes is a game that mixes minimalist puzzle and puzzle pipes. Rotate all pipes until all water connections are closed.

title: Mana Chess
description: Mana Chess is a colorful, turn-based adventure with Roguelite progression. Early Access players traverse three unique areas, and ten stages - collecting randomly offered abilities and items. Manage your resources efficiently to clear stages in as few turns as possible, and earn rewards.

title: Dungeon & Burglar
description: The player can only move. Sneak through traps on different floors to get treasures in this thrilling and action-packed game! Find the best way to conquer each of the 30 dungeon floors by observing enemy movements!

title: Quantum Apex
description: Sci Fi Stunt/Street Racer With Nitrous. Strong emphasis on FUN! Handling Is a well balanced fusion of Arcade and simulation. There is no traction control There is simply the car, the player and the physics. Race Tracks are designed to test every Cm of your driving capabilities.

title: Moonstuck
description: Relaxing rage game in a cutesy wholesome Moonstuck land. Delicate jump-balancing rage platformer where your job is to escape, while staying relaxed.

title: Entomophobia
description: A Singleplayer Rougelite Bullethell where you kill 10s of thousands of insects/bugs. including mini-boss/boss fights every 5-10 minutes. Slay Bugs, Get Upgrades, Kill more. Unlock Characters and weapons by completing achievements.

title: Arcade Squad
description: Arcade Squad is a classic arcade shooter with 15 levels and 6 different spaceships, each with 6 different skins. Rise to the challenge and free the galaxy.

title: ...Knew the Beginning
description: A world you don't recognize anymore. You wake up inside a bar after the apocalypse. The barkeeper of said bar is in trouble. Do what you can to help him, after all he is all you remember.

title: The Infernal Return
description: The Infernal Return is a role-playing adventure game. Players will play the role as Koward, a guy who was abducted to the netherworld to sort out puzzles, collect items and eventually find his way back to life. Meanwhile, the game provides multiple branch quests and fun gameplay.

title: Quad Dice Defence
description: This is a tower defense game where you use four dice to build a turret. The rolls of the dice are the ability value of "number of shots", "time reload", "damage(& range)" and "magazine". Try your best to clear all 40 stages, which are getting more and more difficult!

title: Office Elevator
description: Today might be just a regular workday, or you might end up in a complete alternative reality. Office Elevator is a survival horror game with puzzles that takes place in a dark universe.

title: Get Your Sheep Together
description: A 3D platformer where you herd your emotions by hopping, shrinking and dashing your way through obstacles. Don't hold in too many feelings or it may just blow up in your face!

title: Happy Mining
description: Discover a colorful world filled with resources in a single player mining adventure. Mine resources and expand your productions to earn even more gold.

title: Murasame
description: Murasame is a tense and atmospheric survival-suspense adventure game that blends action, exploration, and narrative choices to create a gripping one-night escape drama. The game begins with a typical school trip that turns into a nightmare when a sudden landslide traps a group of students. Stranded and seeking help, they find a nearby village—but what they discover there is far more dangerous than anyone expected.

title: Space Out
description: Space Out blends elements from Breakout, pinball, and a space shooter to provide a unique, fast-paced, and challenging arcade experience.

title: Perceptio
description: Perceptio is a VR puzzle game set on a small floating Japanese aesthetic island, solve 10 small puzzles and fix the worlds time to complete the game.

title: Hank: Drowning on Dry Land
description: Hank: Drowning On Dry Land is a time-traveling game in witch you play as Hank - a Batman-esque vigilante fighting a sadistic mastermind calling himself The Unraveler.

title: Thunder League Online
description: A strategic MOBA-styled game where you play as a team to complete objectives against the opposing team. Play as unique adorable agents and use their abilities to change the outcomes of the chaotic battle arena! Defend the base, eliminate the enemies or just do both! The strategies are all yours!

title: Cute Cats 2
description: Cute kittens are back in action! These fluffy fellas would train your memory and attention. Spend your time with pleasure and benefit. Compare pictures with cute kittens and find differences between them.

title: My Girlfriend is a Musician
description: “My Girlfriend is a Musician” is a Music Tour Management Simulator and Yuri Dating Simulator. Play as an aspiring junior tour manager helming a series of concerts around Europe for an eccentric yet extremely entertaining Rockstar!

title: Escape: Lia
description: Lia, an 8-year old child got trapped in someone's dark basement. What secrets are hidden in this basement? Discover suspicious items, follow clues, and solve puzzles. Will you be able to escape safely?

title: Drifter's Tales
description: This strategic card game invites you to live small stories in the universe of The First Spine. Choose a story and fight fearsome enemies! You may discover the secret that surrounds the Forgotten Valley.

title: Cool Kid Cody
description: In a world of Losers, Cool Kids and Gods, where Losers wish they were Cool Kids, Cool Kids wish they were Gods and Gods rule over all, Cool Kid Cody embarks on his quest for Godhood! All he's gotta do is achieve the impossible: transform the biggest Loser in school into a Cool Kid.

title: Comrade Quack
description: Comrade Quack is a fun, hybrid, third person tower defense game aimed at young adult audiences! Play as Comrade Quack to defend the Mother Pond from filthy Capitalist Pigs with an array of combat turrets, barriers, and more!

title: I Love Finding Critters
description: I Love Finding Critters is a classic hidden object game where you can search for a huge assortment of animals! Squirrels, hamsters, chicks, ducks, and so many more! Find them all in beautiful scenic locations and solve puzzles and play mini games as you go along.

title: Burnit Quest
description: Blast baddies and burn calories!Use the power of exercise to defeat the evil Somno and save your island from the curse of eversleep.Burnit Quest is a mobile enhanced fitness platformer, connect your phone and PC to the same network and get ready to sweat!

title: Goddess of War Essa
description: Goddess Of War Essa is a vertical scrolling flying shooter. The player controls the protagonist fighter to fight the enemy in the air.

title: Lenin Simulator
description: Lenin Simulator is a political simulator where you run Soviet Russia from 1920 to 1923. You have the potential to radically alter the decisions made and history as a whole.

title: Irritability & Mood Swings
description: You wake up in your room after being passed out from drug abuse. As you wander the house, you start to find that things aren't what they seem. Your mother is missing and something is in the house with you... Escape the house or get sober before it's too late...

title: C.L.U.C.K.
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Explore surreal, monster-infested realms and interact with fully physics-based objects. Grab the chickens and bring them back to the train. Survive and complete your quota - or face the Colonel’s wrath.

title: Firewerx
description: Ready to Become A Pyrotechnics Expert? Firewerx is a firework building simulation game with an ever growing list of customisation options and possibilities. Choose your colours, shapes, effects and more to create the greatest firework show!

title: Wind Angel III
description: "Wind Angel Ⅲ" is a vertical scrolling flight shooting game. The player controls the protagonist fighter to fight the enemy in the universe.

title: Tricking 0
description: Welcome to Tricking 0, the first ever tricking video game ! Use the Flick-it gameplay to Flip, Twist and Kick and Combine 100+ Tricks to express your own creativity. Challenge your friends or bots in the multiplayer modes, practice bigger and harder combos in free mode and become the best tricker !

title: Super Life: Franchise Lord
description: Can you really take over the world with a sandwich? Short answer... MONEY IS EVIL!

title: Golden Mine Pickaxe 2: Mummy Tombs
description: Golden Mine Pickaxe 2 is a sequel to the sandbox game of the same name with RPG elements. Your hero goes to ancient tombs to find even more gold and new resources. Move deeper into the tombs, upgrade your weapons and defeat new enemies to collect as many resources as possible!

title: Chinese Train Trip
description: First-person exploration. Genre: adventure. Train travel simulator in China. You will find a free world, buying and selling items, riding a train and much more.

title: Outcasts of Dungeon
description: Outcasts of Dungeon is a third person fantasy action Being in the role of a powerful War Mage with dozens of deadly weapons and spells, defend your kingdom fortress from a rampaging mob of beastly invaders.

title: Super Ate in Wonderland
description: Time for a cute and spooky adventure! Our little hero, Ate, is going on an adventure to see his sweetheart, Niko, who is at the top of a mountain!

title: Volcanon
description: "Volcanon" is a 2D platformer game with a focus on analog sticks and speedrunning.In this pixelly beautiful world, unleashing the magma power and facing these well-design levels.

title: Zap Dem Rats
description: Zap Dem Rats is a third person adventure RPG of skill where the player helps Mr. Prez regain the Whitehouse. Along the way Mr. Prez transforms zombies into citizens and vanquishes his adversaries

title: Spearmint Goose

title: Doom CE
description:
This mod builds on the PSX Doom Total Conversion and Doom 64 Retribution, to take advantage of the latest GZDoom versions and adds many features that make them more faithful but were impossible to implement at their time of release. To achieve this, a large amount of the code has been adapted from GEC Master Edition (also known as DZDoom) into ZScript, while looking at the reverse engineered source code and existing source ports of these games for reference.

In addition to that, the mod is highly modular and also incluides many optional "enhancements" that deviate from the original experience. Depending on your taste you can opt for going as close to vanilla as possible, or experiment and play with upscaled textures, PBR materials, flashy particle effects and other features that are common in other GZDoom "enhacement" mods.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Tohoku High Speed & Main Line Route

title: Bishoujo Battle: Double Strike!
Aavegotchi: Gotchiverse
description:
Aavegotchi is a DeFi-enabled crypto collectibles game developed by Singapore-based Pixelcraft Studios that allows players to stake non-fungible token (NFT) avatars with interest-generating tokens and interact with the Aavegotchi metaverse, known as The Gotchiverse.

The Gotchiverse is an open-ended social space where players can engage in myriad activities, such as farming, crafting, trading, and combat. Owners of REALM parcels can employ their Aavegotchis (and those of others) to farm their virtual plots, producing quantities of resources known as Gotchus Alchemica. These resources can be combined to create powerful structures such as Haarvesters, Reservoirs, Display Cases, and many more.

Although there are no victory conditions or “end of game” scenarios, one overarching goal of the Gotchiverse is to collect Alchemica to bolster your parcel to produce more yield, and build defensive structures in preparation for the coming of the Prophecy, and the great Lickquidator Invasion.

description: For those of you who are just starting to draw pixel art, I've put together a basic knowledge of pixel art. description: An interactive, furry, adult furry visual novel.

description: Eight factions fight to conquer Mir. The Resurgence took you in when you had little chance of survival. Now it's up to you. Who will you put in the first place? Your faction or yourself? Be careful! Choices have consequences in this unique card battler RPG with tons of choices and cards.

description: Choose your favorite animal and enter The Wilds! Explore the forest in search of food, water, and shelter to survive the harsh conditions of life in the wilderness. Bond with other animals to form families and continue the circle of life!

Master cool maneuvers, unlock abilities, and survive intense challenges as you bounce through unique biomes. Precision and timing are everything. Oh, and don`t get hit in the head.

This is the main trend in anti-stress games of 2021. Bubble POP IT ASMR is a satisfying relaxing game that helps deal with everyday stress.

description: JAMM is a Tabletop RPG map maker that makes it simple and easy to bring your vision to life quickly giving you more time to focus on the story. Make perspective and orthographic maps as well as 3d immersive images in minutes.

description: Find Her in Dungeon - 3D Quest with a variety of actions, where U have to solve (as in quests) your further passage. Sometimes it's fun, sometimes it's scary, sometimes it's sad. With the help of hints and logic, try to find her.

description: You just want to buy milk, but fate loves to slip adventures where you don't expect it. On the farm, you will meet a milkmaid who will make you play the game by her rules. Play the puzzle with the milkmaid. This is the only way you can get her milk.

title: Twin Mind: Ghost Hunter - Collector's Edition
description: Can the twin detectives solve a new case? You are the only one who can help them catch the killer. Are you up for the challenge?

description: Gather seashells and tropical fruit! Develop the best resort in the near lands!

description: A young upper-class boy discovers he is about to die. Since all his life he bullied everyone around him, in order to have God's forgiveness, he decides to go after the people he has wronged and apologize.

title: ZBloody Hell
description: ZBloody Hell is a standalone game made for the GZDoom engine, aiming to recreate the elements of the game Blood (1997), from monsters and weapons, to levels and atmosphere, while also providing a gameplay addon and / or a level pack that is compatible with the other Doom 2 mods out there, letting you mix different mods with the fantastic Blood levels or the unique arsenal of weapons and new enemies of Blood. Get to ZBloody Hell and Start kicking some Zombie heads today.

title: Rise of the Wool Ball
description: Rise of the Wool Ball is a 2017 total conversion for the ZDoom engine. It was made by MSPaintR0cks and is the sequel to Shadow of the Wool Ball. The game is spread across three episodes, each having five levels with a secret level. Like its predecessor, Rise of the Wool Ball uses a cartoon art style, and it was named a runner-up at the Cacowards that year.

title: Shadow of the Wool Ball
description:
Shadow of the Wool Ball is a 2016 total conversion for the ZDoom engine. Made by MSPaintR0cks, this is a unique shooter in which the player is a hedgehog fighting an army of cats. It is spread across three episodes, each having six levels. The mapping style is more akin to Wolfenstein 3D than classic Doom.

The playful art style, creative gameplay mechanics, and humorous plot were well-received, including a runner-up at the Cacowards 2016. A sequel, Rise of the Wool Ball, was released by MSPaintR0cks the following year.

title: Your Path of Destruction
description:
Your Path of Destruction is a Total Conversion for Quake that attempts to recreate the classic Doom games (Doom & Doom II: Hell on Earth, respectively) and act as both a remake and a sequel to the original Doom series.

All of the Monsters and Weapons have been replaced with their Doom counterparts, all of these were remade in 3D. Ranger was replaced with the Doom Marine.

title: Zerstorer
description: This partial conversion is quite old now, released in 1997. This 6 SP map episode, also including a start map, end map, cutscenes, and 5 DM maps, has stood the test of time as one of the most atmospheric experiences available. Using the episode's additions to full effect, Zerstörer has an atmosphere of unparalleled bleakness and inhospitality - and sometimes outright scariness. In this way, it enhances the dark, gothic aspects of Quake.

title: Jack Move: I.C.E Breaker
description: Jack Move is a JRPG that features a unique blend of gritty cyberpunk storytelling, turn-based battles, and beautiful modern pixel art. In I.C.E BREAKER you will meet Noa for the first time and learn where her story begins!

title: Crime Сity

title: Slender: The Eight Pages - Remake
description: No face. No eyes. He's always watching. There's no way out. You are always alone with him. The chilling Slender: The Eight Pages returns on the Unreal Engine 4.

title: Headless Jeff-3
description: Embark on a chaotic adventure through dangerous gauntlets and complex puzzles, all from the perspective of your detached head! Overcome head-twisting obstacles as you stumble along in your quest to escape the abandoned Industrial Megacenter in this action-packed 2nd-person puzzle platformer!

title: New Lands 2: Collector's Edition
description:
Grow cocoa beans, apples and sugarcane. Make the best sweet treats around and win the contest!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- 15 bonus levels!
- Earn trophies for completing challenges
- Integrated strategy guide
- Concept art and music tracks

description: Crack character substitution ciphers. Transmit or receive messages in Morse Code. Decode binary and hexadecimal characters. Memorize sequences of numbers, letters or images. Identify the missing item in a sequence of characters or symbols. Do you have what it takes to be a Codebreaker?

title: Beyond Belief
description: 1997 E1-style single-player episode for Quake, that features 8 small to medium-sized levels as well as a new start map - all of which also support co-op mode and deathmatch - a few new textures, and a modified Chthon boss.

description: A chill narative adventure starring Maya and her Granpa. Defy the difficulties of the scarce environment to discover Maya's origins as they approach their destination.

description: Don't lose the signal to get out of here.

description: Ratten Reich is a grim and unforgiving world, where war has continued for many years. The war is fought between rats, mice, roaches and lizards alike. Slum like cities, burnt corpses, steam tanks, soldiers in imperial uniforms and armor.

title: ReFactory

title: Dragon War
description: A real-time combat game played by the flying dragon in the third person. At this stage, the game mode is mainly chaos. The main themes of the game are flying dragon and magic.

title: Fireboy & Watergirl: Fairy Tales
description: Fireboy & Watergirl are back! This time with fairies to help you!

title: Codename: Tiaras
description: Codename: Tiaras is a fast paced cyberpunk game focused on player movement and reaction time to overcome obstacles and collect data cubes.

title: Punihi Loader
description: The 12th release in the franchise, 221Games Punity series is single player, Mech custom & Third person shooter.

title: SuperHot Quake
description:
SUPERHOT Quake is a total conversion for Quake by Ash, inspired by SUPERHOT.
Time advances only when you move or perform an action, such as shooting or jumping.
Use your axe to vaporize incoming bullets, or shoot them if you have a weapon.
Pick up weapons from your fallen enemies and kill their buddies with it.
Blow up your enemies into gibs then pick them up to use them as projectiles.
HOTSWITCH into enemies to telefrag them.

title: Brutal Half-Life
description: Brutal Half-Life is a modification that makes the "Half-Life" game more violent and addictive. It is also a tribute to the classic FPS game "Brutal DOOM".

title: Quake: Dwell

Brand new monsters, including many returning from other Quake worlds. New weapons to hunt down and utilize. A Complete Soundtrack by Alekswithak. Support for up to 4 player co-op.

title: Project Dagger

However, your journey will not be easy as many foes along the way will attempt to kill you! Unlock new weapons, upgrade stats, battle enemies as you make your way through the world!

title: Nehahra
description: 17 maps by an all-star team of mappers, cutscenes, new monsters, great features. Comes with a custom engine. Neharha is considered by many as one of the innovative mods that shifted the Quake modding dynamics toward single-player map development. The Episodic spiritual fan sequel to Quake contained a four-hour fully voice acted machinima movie and was well over 53817 kilobytes, an incredible map pack at the time, still considered by many as the best Quake mod.

title: Amadeus
description: Amadeus is a 2017 partial conversion, community scenario for Amnesia the Dark Descent.

title: Amnesia: The Great Work
description:
Amnesia: The Great Work is a 2013 partial conversion scenario for Amnesia the Dark Descent.

You are Charles Longden, an archaeologist studying Minneburg, a German castle abandoned due to recent cave-ins. You are sleeping late one morning when you are shaken awake by a tremor running through the castle. There is no sign of your partner, Jane. Where has she gone?

title: Dreamsettler
description:
Sleepnet. It's where dreams are literally made. But sometimes dreams need a little help, and that's where you come in. They say a private eye never sleeps, but to crack these cases you'll need to be out cold.

Dreamsettler is an early '00s internet simulator in which you solve cases for an array of strange and endearing characters as a Sleepnet Private Investigator. From hunting down elusive soup recipes to unearthing global conspiracies, you'll need to explore countless pages, download apps and master minigames to close your cases and solve Sleepnet's mysteries.

You'll start small, with little more than a bare-bones Dreamsettler template page, but before long find yourself caught up in a plot that will determine the very future of Sleepnet and sleeptime computing at large.

title: Ultimate Jazz Jackrabbit Doom
description: Jazz Jackrabbit Doom is Total Conversion for Doom 2 featuring Jazz Jackrabbit from the same-titled game.

title: CountryCide
description: Prequel to the popular "Trench Foot" Warhammer 40,000 and Lovecraft-inspired total conversion for Doom II.

title: The D-T.E.A.M.
description:
Dwarves. Tanks. Energy. Ammo. MMMGold!

In this 3D Tank Blaster Platformer, you will take down an enemy mining facility, all the while finding energy pickups and collecting sweet gold. Double jump, speed boost, and blast your way to earn performance stars and achieve a personal best in time!

title: Doom3D
description:
Doom3D is a modification for DOOM and DOOM II released in 2020.
This .wad file replaces every sprite (enemies, player, objects) in each DOOM game into 3D models and changes some enemy behavior to resemble Quake.

title: Epochs of Enmity
description: Epochs of Enmity (EoE) is an original Episode Pack for Quake, a collection of 12 maps. A group of reputable mappers has been gathered together to form a “vanilla feel” episode. The goal was to create an “unofficial 6th” episode, to follow Quake’s unofficial 5th, Dimension of the Past. The focus was to design a series of various themed maps, where Ranger is traveling through time to stop the evil that is tainting the time continuum. Main maps had to include at least one quad, stay within the range of 100 enemies (more if multiple quads exist), and not use external models or sounds; however, skyboxes, colored lighting, and the fog were okay. Mappers for the episode include the following: Bal, Fairweather, FifthElephant, Greenwood, JCR, Jpal, Markie Music, Nolcoz, Rhoq, and ZungryWare. Due to the use of the progs_dump mod, some minor, “quality of life” changes have been made. Epochs of Enmity also includes an original soundtrack.

title: VietDoom
description: VietDoom is a Vietnam War DOOM modification by Sgt_Mark_IV (Marcos Abenante), of Brutal DOOM fame.

title: Half-Payne
description: Half-Payne is a Half-Life mod that brings some gameplay bits from Max Payne, such as Slowmotion, Diving move, Painkillers, and custom game modes.

title: Doom 3: Hard Corps
description: Hard Corps is the remastered Dhewm 3 update to the Doom 3 mod "HardQore2. Hard Corps brings fast-paced, 2.5D side-scrolling action to Doom3. Take on the Forces of Hell in this homage to classic action platformers such as Contra, Metal Slug, and Castlevania.

title: Black Mesa: Blue Shift
description: Initially developed and released by Gearbox Software in 2001, second Half-Life add-on, Half-Life: Blue Shift is a return to the Black Mesa Research Facility and another look at the Incident's consequences from the eyes of Gordon Freeman's best friend - Barney Calhoun. In 2012, Crowbar Collective has delighted Half-Life fans with release of the magnificent Half-Life remake, but there are still no released remakes for add-ons. This is when they are coming in - HECU Collective are developing the Black Mesa: Blue Shift - a free remake with use of Black Mesa resources and style.

title: Quake VR
description: Quake VR is a VR modification for Quake, allowing motion controls with the use of a virtual reality headset.

title: RoboCop Doom
description: RoboCop Doom is a total conversion for Doom II, recapitulating the events of the first RoboCop movie, with many bosses' battles taken from the action scenes of the movie.

title: The Ultimate Simpsons Doom
description: The Ultimate Simpsons Doom is a graphics and sound mod made by Myk Friedman & Walter Stabosz and released in 1998. In the modification, you play as Homer Simpson killing evil clones of his friends, family, neighbors, and co-workers (they replace the normal monsters). As it only replaces graphics and sounds it can be used with either Doom or Doom II.

title: Kriegsland
description:
Kriegsland, or Kriegsland: Blutordnung, is a Doom total conversion mod created by GAA1992 and YukesVonFaust inspired by the Wolfenstein franchise, especially The New Order, that adapts and brings its elements to the other id Software's classic FPS.

This PWAD features a completely new arsenal, monsters (including their behavior), HUD, ammo, items, and power-ups sprites. The game's screens, sounds, and gameplay elements were also added or modified, like separated keys for both grenades and the quick melee attack and the possibility of dual-wielding most of the weapons. It also features a good amount of difficulty, blood, and gibbing system.

title: Space Cats Saga: Chapter I
description:
Space Cats Saga: Chapter I is the first Chapter of a series of megawads by DerTimmy
Comes with its own Campaign "Spaceship". 10 regular Maps and two secret ones. Its first Secret level gives you a New Game+ option to start the game with most weapons. Its second one (Encore! Slaughterfest! Secret 2) starts directly after you beat the campaign on Ultra-Violence. Chapter I is a unique episode with its own new arsenal of weapons, compatible with most megawads and add-ons.

title: PsychoPhobia
description:
PsychoPhobia is a new Doom2 campaign for GZDoom and Skulltag.
This total conversion features new weapons, new monsters, new textures, new music, new sounds, new decorates, new HUD, new maps, new episodes, and much more.

The modification is separated in 18 maps, with two secret levels and two episodes.

- Episode 1: "Rise of a Psycho" (8 maps) (location: Earth future)
- Episode 2: "The Dark Age" (8 maps) (location: Earth in medieval times)
- ZBloodpack
- The Pit

title: Goldeneye Doom2
description:
Goldeneye Doom2 is a popular total conversion for Doom II reimagining the classic GoldenEye 007 Nintendo 64 game.

Goldeneye Doom2 includes the following: Single-player maps (based on locations from the GoldenEye movie and other James Bond movies), new weapons, new mechanics, and Multiplayer maps. Multiple versions: including one with Doom levels only.

title: The Ultimate Torment and Torture
description:
The Ultimate Torment and Torture is a megawad for DOOM II released in 2007 and combines every Torment and Torture maps from Daniel Gimmer.
This is a complete compilation of all the Torment & Torture maps ever made including the all-new Episode 4 "Havoc". Get the full "Torment & Torture" experience with The Ultimate Torment and Torture.

title: Hearts of Demons: Baron
description: Hearts of Demon is a compilation of wads allowing you to play as various demons: Baron of Hell, or Revenant. Hearts of Demon features new weapons and player models, as well as many demonic abilities to use.

title: Shotgun King: the Final Checkmate

Check out the extraordinary variety of fighter jets, maps, modes, and possible strategies that this air combat game has to offer!

A truly free-to-play game. Real PvP Multiplayer! Join a squadron & fight for the victory. Play & chat online with your friends against real players around the world.

title: G-Mode Archives+: DoDonPachi DaiOuJou DX
description:
“It's better to die.” Confirm it with your own eyes. The most deadly barrage in history spreads in the palm of your hand.

"DoDonPachi DaiOuJou" is a vertical scrolling shooting game released in 2002. The game's addictive game system, detailed worldview, and challenging difficulty level have won the support of many users.

``DoDonPachi DaiOuJou DX'', which is being reprinted as an archive this time, is a feature phone ported version of the same work.

Not only can you take on a barrage of threats, as the title suggests, ``Great Death'', but you can also compete with users from all over the world for your score, thanks to online ranking support.

There are also plenty of elements that allow you to change your play style according to your skill and preference, such as changing the difficulty level, selecting your own aircraft type, and selecting an enhanced type (element doll).

For both shooting game beginners and bullet hell experts. Challenge the line of death and charm the way of death.

description: The World's First AI Logic Puzzle Game.Generated in Real Time So It's Always New.

title: Worm Run
description: Worm Run is an exciting endless arcade game in which you move the worm right or left, trying to avoid obstacles standing in your way, break the blocks to achieve the goal, collects the worm body items to increase its length, collect coins to unlocks new worms and complete the levels. 20 different characters to unlock and infinite levels guarantees you long hours of fun!

title: Arcade Archives: Rolling Thunder
description: Rolling Thunder is an action game released by Namco in 1986. Control the hero and infiltrate the secret base of the Geldra secret society as they plot to dominate the globe. Experience a hard-boiled adventure with a smart hero in the lead. This title contains three versions, each with slightly different content.

title: My Lady Sayo: Zettai Kunshu! Sayo-sama
description: This is a novel game in which you serve Sayo and deepen your relationship with her as you respond to her reckless requests and endure her playful teasing.

title: Wordbreaker by Powgi
description: Wordbreaker is a code-breaking game using letters. Each word’ll tell you which letters are used, and which are in the correct place. Your reward for solving each puzzle is a terrible joke!

title: Truck Simulator USA Car Games: Driving games & Car 2022
description: Drive a real truck in Truck Simulator USA! Become an American truck driver and show your driver skills. Choose cargo and drive it. Transport cargo to city warehouses. Upgrade your truck for better driving and earning more money. Fix and refuel an American truck at service stations, fuel station. Avoid driving cargo above speed limit, follow driving rules for the transport. Spend money wisely and enjoy day and night driving.

title: Dual Brain: Complete Edition
description: All the games from Dual Brain Vol.1~Vol.3 are included, plus two new categories, for a total of 10 new games, making it a great value.

title: Car Driver Ultimate
description: Drifting an airport bus on a runway? That’s only one of the exciting things awaiting you here! Dive into a huge location with lots of cool stuff to do, discover a race track, an off-road area and more!

title: Floating Farmer
description: A country life, raising animals on a ranch. You’ve been living in this tiny fantasy countryside, a very relaxing environment, but suddenly something unusual happened. You wake up one day and all the animal farms are now floating like little islands in the sky! The paths were shuffled and the baby animals were spread. To fix this, slide the blocks to rebuild the broken paths. So you help moms unite the families again and bring the farms back to land. As you progress solving the logic puzzles, have the great feeling of uniting families and see your land farm expand. There is no time limit or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on solving the puzzles while listening to a soothing soundtrack and animal sounds.

title: Red White Yellow Zinger
description: - A puzzle game in which blocks are erased in the order of red, white, and yellow! - Collaboration with popular music creator Room97! This is a falling puzzle in which six blocks of three different colors are lined up and erased. The blocks can only be erased in order. Blocks of indelible colors can be aligned first to form a chain. BGM is played while the block disappears and until the next block disappears. In the meantime, you can keep the BGM playing by aligning the next block and continuing to erase it. Advanced users can even play a full song. All songs are in collaboration with popular music creator Room97! The wide range of sounds, from K-POP to nostalgic melodies, employing a variety of singers, enhances the pleasantness of the combo.

title: Aaron: The Little Detective
description: Aaron - The Little Detective can be played by children of any age. Thanks to the voice output, even toddlers are able to explore the hidden object pictures on their own. They do not need to be able to read to have a sense of achievement. Concentration and attentiveness are taught in a playful way. Incidentally, a study conducted by the Singapore Technological University proved the fact that hidden object games increase the understanding of spatial perception in memory. In addition, visual search skills were noticeably improved.

title: My Coloring Book 2
description: Did you know that coloring relaxes your brain, reduces stress, improves focus, motor skill and vision? My Coloring Book 2 will bring all those benefits to your Nintendo Switch! There are two types of drawings to choose from: 61 about land and 49 marine animals. Thanks to an amazing variety, My Coloring Book is suitable for all from children to adults. Save your work for later and show off your artistic sense and skill to family and friends.

title: Arcade Archives: Wonder Momo
description: Wonder Momo is an action game released by Namco in 1987. Control the hero, Momo, and take down the Warudemon Villain to keep the world at peace. Ride the whirlwind to transform into Wonder Momo and fight for your success as a costumed hero, using Wonder Rings and special moves!

title: The Card Perfect Collection
description: An all-in-one collection for all your card game needs! Make way for the definitive playing card collection, with ten classic games! Enjoy Six Competitive Games With Multiplayer! If you'd prefer to play alone, the computer AI is more than willing to oblige! Challenges and Rewards! Complete a variety of achievements, unlocking new game backgrounds and music tracks, or test your mettle in challenge mode, where you'll have to take on an assortment of puzzling trials!

title: Big Bang Pro Wrestling
description: It's about to pop off! Muscle-bound wrestlers take the stage for a bombastic all-out brawl! Easy controls allow you to pull off sick and devastating special moves from the push of a button!

title: Tile Flip
description: Experience a fun and unique puzzle game! Flip the tiles and make all colors match Can you complete all 100 levels?

title: Capoeira Legends: Path to Freedom - Chapter 1
description:
Capoeira Legends is a Brazilian video game developed by Donsoft Entertainment and released in 2009.

The game takes place on the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro, during the year 1828, showing the life of blacks, Indians and whites in the mocambos. Capoeira is a martial art shown as the tool used for the liberation of slaves.

The game's protagonist, Gunga Za, is the protector of Mocambo das Estrelas, whose task is to protect his fortified settlement from rulers and farmers who support slavery.

title: Aery: A New Frontier
description: Aery - A New Frontier is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a bird-like creature while flying through a immersive but peaceful Sci-Fi world.

title: Itorah: Save the World Edition
description:
The Save the World Edition contains Itorah as well as the official Soundtrack and Artbook.

Assemble Entertainment will donate 10% of the proceeds for every sold Save the World Edition to Survival International in support of indigenous people around the globe!

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Rita Repulsa
description: Play as Rita Ripulsa, the villain of Power Rangers!

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Poisandra
description: Play as Poisandra, the Dino Charge Villain!

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Karl Heinz Schneider Mission
description: Karl Heinz Schneider is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Taro Misaki Mission
description: Taro Misaki is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Hikaru Matsuyama Mission
description: Hikaru Matsuyama is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - SAM GroundService
description: After WorldJetways, AirportVehicles and FollowMe, the next extension for SAM is ready to go. SAM GroundService XP places the apron vehicles in the X-Plane flight simulator.

title: Poker: Texas
description: The closest thing to a real deal - home game of no limit Texas Hold 'em! Your table, your rules! Invite friends all over the world and have the ultimate poker fun! (other players just need a web browser!)

title: Scary Husband HD
description: You wake up in your house but there is a man here. He said he is your new husband and you are the wife. But you don't have a memories about your marriage with him. Something is very creepy about him, say hello to your new scary husband!

title: Disinfection
description:
Disinfection is a sci-fi horror game, developed by Evil Turtle Productions, set in the depths of space, where you can play alone or as part of a crew of up to 4 players. You'll be tasked with identifying and destroying deadly nanomachine outbreaks on a variety of procedurally generated space faring vessels whilst fighting for survival.

The game features procedurally generated levels and the stats of the monsters are randomly generated. Players have to use a variety of tools to find the infection and destroy it.
Players will be hunted by horrifying amalgamations of flesh and machine, whilst having to deal with the dangers of living in space as the environment is being corroded away slowly but surely, causing oxygen deprivation and machinery/tool malfunctions.

title: Ninja Noboken
description: Ninja Noboken is a 2.5D side Scroller with Fast-paced action-adventure combat with Magic skills. Short clips to follow the adventure with plot and twists will be all along with the game.

title: Harem Girl: Alicia
description: Enjoy some sexy puzzle action in this relax-alot, 'one handed' puzzle game.

title: Harem Girl: Nikki
description: Enjoy some sexy puzzle action in this relax-alot, 'one handed' puzzle game.

title: Wish
description: Soma, driven by destiny, begins his quest to save his home, Israfil Continent, which trembles in fear of an evil empress… Elf Pontifex, princess knight, the first vampire, etc , with the many beautiful women waiting for their stories to unravel, what will happen in the end of this adventure...?

title: Stacklands
description: Stacklands is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures.

title: Arcis Ultima
description: Player finds himself in the war between human race and the invading creatures. You must train yourself, get the very best equipment, recall your past and help human efforts. Otherwise; as the time passes, you may find yourself in a hopeless situation.

title: Foreign Galaxies
description: After a galactic portal failure you find yourself lost in a galaxy 500 light years away from home... With your main propulsion systems disabled you are unable to traverse space, so you try to collect resources you find near you in order to create a galactic portal to return back.

title: Severance
description: Severance is an online co-op horror game for 1-5 players. One becomes a ghost, the others are investigators. Stalk players, throw objects, slam doors, and drain their sanity, or work as a team with paranormal tools to uncover the truth.

title: Sock It
description: Sock It is a wacky, completely unhinged comedy boxing game with platforming and cutscenes. Box more than 12 crazy bosses! Platforming stages to break up the action! Cutscenes that guarantee 1 giggle (Usually around 5 hearty laughs)!

title: Melon Dusk
description: Play as Melon Dusk the famous billionaire who finally landed on Mars. Earn ShibaCoin to buy accessories to customize your appearance !

title: Base Craft: Desolate Survival
description: Co-op twin-stick base building survival game.

title: TukTuk
description: Fight vicious monsters and other unknown threats on a floral and foreign planet as TukTuk. Utilize your imagination on diverse, precise and intense platforming and skill your character based on your preferences on your epic mission to rescue TukTuk's Mother.

title: Ignis Corruption
description: In this Procedural City-Building and Survival game, you must manage your resources, expand your village, assemble an army and destroy the source of evil, which changed the entire eco system of a land that was once prosperous and peaceful.

title: Honey
description:
Honey is a free add-on, made available in the second update of the QUAKE remaster.

An old, abandoned village lies in front of you, and a large church looms overhead. It appears to have been empty for quite some time, but what caused this?

Enter the church and it's depths below and find out.

title: Congestion 1024
description:
Congestion 1024 is a 2005 megawad for Doom II. All maps are designed so that the playing area fits entirely within a 1024×1024-sized area. Authors were allowed to define sectors outside of this area for the purposes of gameplay, detail, and scenery, as long as they are not reachable. MAP01 and MAP19, however, include accessible areas outside of the 1024×1024 boundary.

This project was influenced by the Exquisite Corpse community WAD.

title: Teisatsu
description: Love, war, and spies!

title: The Classic Episode
description: The Classic Episode is a nine-level Doom PWAD that replaces episode 2. It was made by Jan Van der Veken, Anthony Soto, Nick Baker, and Travers Dunne who also worked on The Darkening series. The Classic Episode is one of the few PWADs that Compet-n allows recording on. Two versions of WAD exist: the original version from 2000, which must be used for Compet-n demos, and version 2.0 released in 2002. Only the latter is uploaded on the idgames archive.

title: Winter's Fury
description:
Winter's Fury is a partial conversion of twelve levels for Doom II and GZDoom by Pyroscourge. It was released on December 7, 2012, days before it was named a winner at the 19th Annual Cacowards. The levels are based around a frozen theme, and the WAD's story is highly significant to the overall experience.

Winter's Fury takes place in Siberia, in the year 2033, some time after the events of Doom II.

title: Temp Zero
description: Temp Zero is a minimalist roguelike which mixes intense action and musical bullet hell. Fight enemies which attack to the beat, choose perks, defeat the final boss, unlock new weapons, spells & soundtracks!

title: Jigsaw Fun: 3-in-1 Collection
description: Enjoy a collection of 300 high-quality jigsaw puzzles of Wonderful Nature, Amazing Animals and Greatest Cities from all around the world. Change the size of your puzzle for increased difficulty and solve jigsaws up to 600 pieces. You can also play with up to 4 players to solve jigsaws together!

title: Beat the Clock
description: Beat The Clock is all about being faster than time itself. Can you get to the hour mark before the clock does? Time, the creator and destroyer of all. No one can beat time right? Well maybe you can.

title: HunterX
description: HunterX is an action-adventure game full of spirited battles. Use various styles of weapons and magic to experience your own fighting style and explore a great world.

title: Bunker 2322
description: A visual novel in a post-apocalyptic setting. Find out what happened to humanity, traveling through the deserted world in search of the main character's family.

title: Astrocat: Milky Way Journey
description: Skylar is an astronaut cat who took a lot of cool pictures of the Milky Way, but she needs to gather the pictures to send to the scientists of her planet, help her and discover lots of data and curiosity about our galaxy in this 2D puzzle.

title: Dummynation
description: Geopolitical management game with real-time shifting borders and a streamlined yet realistic gameplay, designed to minimize all burdensome chores while allowing an absolute strategic control, from military recruitment and deployment, to diplomatic and economic management.

title: Touhou Shinjutou: Hollow Song of Birds
description: Touhou Project fangame developed by raichu, ido, and Shijimi Nono with music by Wanwan. The game centers around a time-stopping incident in Gensokyo and features a gem system providing 7 different optional powers.

title: G-Zilla
description: Play as an overpowered boss monster who has decided to go on a rampage.

title: Box Dash
description: Box Dash is a platform game that trains your concentration. In the game, you need to focus your attention to avoid obstacles and destroy as many monsters as possible to get stars. The game is divided into training mode, normal mode and extreme mode, with dozens of levels. It may be difficult to play the game at first, but once you get used to it, you will appreciate the fun.

title: Damoria
description: Build, settle, trade - 'tis time to claim your throne in this medieval world. Saddle up for adventure now!

title: Asdivine Hearts I & II
description: Experience epic RPG adventures at once! This bundle includes Asdivine Hearts and Asdivine Hearts II.

title: Outbreak: Palladium Collection
description: Experience seven retro survival horror nightmares in the Outbreak Palladium Collection.

title: Minemaze
description: Minemaze is a puzzle game that combines classic mazes with cartoon elements. The goal of the game is to get as much ore as possible and reach the exit. The game has 6 difficulty worlds and 360 different levels. Enjoy it and have fun!

title: Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul
description: Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul is an all-new First Person Simulator that brings to life the experience of operating powerful and heavy freight trains on one of America's most stunning and famous railroads; Sand Patch Grade.

title: Immortal Love: True Treasure
description: Not all that glitters is gold...

title: Outbreak: Gold Collection
description: Experience Lydia's undead journey in the Outbreak Gold Collection.

title: Just Dance 2022: Ultimate Edition
description:
Just Dance 2022, the ultimate dance game, is back with new universes and 40 hot new tracks from chart-topping hits like "Don't Go Yet" by Camila Cabello, "Love Story" by Taylor Swift, "Happier than Ever" by Billie Eilish and more!

Just Dance 2022 Ultimate Edition includes 13 months of Just Dance Unlimited

title: Izmir: An Independence Simulator
description: Fight for the beloved city of Izmir's independence, a tower defence strategy game. Lead the common people of Izmir with tech gear from the future but be aware of holding the balance otherwise people could go nuts.

title: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing 2022
description: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing 2022 pits you against the world’s best surfer’s at the most exotic locations on the planet. An in-depth leader-board sports game meets free surf exploration at 12 massive worlds. Get pumped by the unique control, amazing weather & customization tools.

title: Dice Legacy: Corrupted Fates
description: Corrupted Fates is the new expansion to Dice Legacy, Gamescom's Most Original Game of 2021. A mysterious cult has formed within your realm. Convert your dice into Cultists and obtain powerful Revelations. Your actions, however have wicked consequences.

title: Stellaris: Overlord
description: Realize your Grand Design Overlord, a new full expansion for Stellaris, grants access to new features designed to unlock the next level of your empire. New mechanics to specialize your vassals’ roles within your empire and new magnificent megastructures to project your power further, faster.

title: The Textorcist: Amen Edition
description:
The The Textocist: Amen Edition includes:

- The Textorcist
- The Textorcist: The Village DLC
- The Textorcist Original Soundtrack by Gost
- The Textorcist: The Village DLC Original Sountrack by Carbon Killer

title: The Tale of Onogoro
description:
Experience communication with a virtual character in a VR title developed as "an adventure game for the VR age."
Work with Haru to deactivate the large, puzzle-like barriers blocking your path. Teamwork is key, as some objects can only be used by one of you!

title: Black Swan: Collector's Edition
description: Caught in the wrong place at the wrong time - after visiting a performance of the closed ballet school for orphan girls, you receive a letter for help from one of the students.

title: Pinball Freedom
description: Grab your walk-man, and take a trip to your favourite arcade with our classic retro Pinball machines.

title: Gotta Protectors: Cart of Darkness
description: Protect the Princess, Smash Castles, and Pulverize Foes. Will You Be the First to Collect All 948 Game Carts?

title: Grim
description: Reality imprints itself on our individuality through pain. Like grooves on a vinyl record, scars on the soul shape sounds out of emptiness.

title: Iron Order 1919
description: An unique long-term strategy game with week-long matches with up to 101 players, set in the alternate reality of 1919.

title: Cosmic Challenge Racing
description: The most challenging multiplayer space race competition awaits you!

title: Burst Witch
description: A bullet hell game with the classic scrolling shooter gameplay

title: 3D Box Sokoban
description: 3D Box Sokoban is a logic game that will exercise your brain, helping developing its capabilities. - The goal of the puzzle is to push all of the boxes onto the goals. - Only one box can be pushed at a time.

title: Double Shot Gals
description:
Step right up! After a hard and busy week, tonight was supposed to be a fun night in the fairgrounds of Paradise Park.

However, things don't always go according to plan, so here begins this bizarre and sexy story! Complete with small narrative scenes, Double Shot Gals focuses on ecchi themed carnival adventure with arcade gameplay to create hilarious and sexy experiences.

Unlock prizes including new skins and artwork.

title: Traditional Braves
description: Traditional Simulation RPG with Great Thinking Program "SESS-AI"!

title: Arcade Archives: Empire City 1931
description: Empire City: 1931 is a gun shooting game released by Seibu Kaihatsu in 1986. Set in the United States in 1931. From the window, from the rooftop, while hiding, various enemies are aiming at us! Pull out the gun before your opponent and defeat the enemies that appear one after another!

title: BugBits
description: Take part of the largest bug war ever!

title: Yoomp! 64
description: A Three-Dimensional jumping game for the Commodore 64!

title: Super Car Driver
