description: Embody a displaced therapist in a futuristic refugee camp. Discover the life in the camp and share your everyday life alongside people with heavy pasts. Use logic and your therapeutic skills to solve mysteries threatening both your survival and the camp.

title: Plunge the Plumber
description: Is that a Plunger or a Robot? No! it's Plungster!!!!! The Hero we never knew we needed. He is the only one to save this impossible project and make the Community start to feel like Home. Who knew Plumbers were heroes?!

title: Moon Mystery
description: Moon's haunted. No really. Figure out what happened up there, unravel the moon’s mysteries, and uncover why we really raced to land on its surface in 1969. Fill up on oxygen, load up your guns, and set out on a celestial FPS investigation that starts on the Moon and leads across the universe.

title: Horror haze
description: Explore the world, learn magic spells, defeat enemies and solve tricky puzzles. All this awaits you in "Horror haze".

title: Night Racer
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Night Racer and reach the finish line before all your opponents.

title: Box Knight
description: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

title: Outrace
description: Outrace revives the pseudo-3D racing genre with a vibrant colour palette and synthwave soundtrack.Enjoy the iconic sights, sounds, tracks and cars of the arcade age.

title: Mauled
description: Mauled is a Free To Play, Third Person Shooter, CO-OP online, with procedural generated levels, infinite hordes of fierces creatures and many weapons to buy in citadels. Survive on a earth fallen into oblivion.

title: Boyfiends
description: A selfish genius and a polite hero complain about their neighbor's taste in music in a car.

title: Torden
description: A stylized 3rd person action fantasy game. Slash your way with many but simple attack mechanics. Select from dozens of spells to help in your battle. Featuring a wide array of enemies with different quirks that need your quick reflexes and patience to deal with.

title: Delusions of a Lost Soul
description: Return to Lansinet castle to free your partner’s trapped soul. Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and unravel the many paranormal mysteries that await you.

title: Ghosts of Hollow Creek
description: A fantasy story-rich turn-based RPG with customizable characters and romantic interest.

title: Lost in the Space
description: Lost In The Space combines frantic top-down action with fast, fluid and very addictive gameplay, with instant response to player commands

title: Hell is Us
description: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

title: Terror: Endless Night
description: Terror: Endless Night is a turn-based strategy game set in the XIX century. The game takes you aboard a rescue ship in search of HMS “Terror” and HMS “Erebus”, Royal Navy vessels on a mission to sail under the North Pole and reach East Asia. You were chosen to lead that expedition but let your son take your place and make a name for himself. Now he’s missing and you find yourself trapped in the middle of the Arctic Ocean, rid with immeasurable guilt.

title: Lone Planet
description: A sci-fi adventure with RPG with puzzle platform elements

title: Fell
description: Fell is a 2d Precision Platformer with a retro 1-bit aesthetic. Play through multiple unique areas, unlock new color palettes, and use fun movement abilities to conquer levels and make difficult jumps!

title: Dynacat
description: Save Dynacat's home from the incoming army of robots in this fast-paced 3D platforming adventure. Dash to the goal, find all the secrets, defeat enemies and earn points by doing it all in style!

title: Marble Ball Friends
description: This is an online cooperative Corinth-game like game that can be enjoyed by one or all, based on the theme of healing in nature. Cooperate with other players and aim for the jackpot.

title: Twin Edge
description: Twin Edge is a refreshing circular take on the Rhythm Game genre. Divide your attention evenly between two rotating circles and and try not to lose your rhythm!

title: Machinicide
description: Machinicide is a boomer shooter with imm sim and bullet hell elements. Reduce all evil robots to scraps with a huge arsenal of futuristic weapons and abilities, such as telekinesis, changing of gravity and many more.

title: This is Torture Together
description: This is Torture Together is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players, following a structured campaign with randomized elements. Abducted by a sinister kidnapper, you now must escape his deranged facility, survive twisted abominations, solve puzzles, and reach one of several endings.

title: Paper Trails
description: It all started with a simple robbery. When that thread was pulled, a tapestry of mysteries were revealed. Solve cases and outsmart criminals in a detective story full of lies, confessions, and maybe even a murder or two.

title: Bombardier
description: Bombardier is a quick and chaotic online multiplayer game which supports up to 8 players in an arena, or play locally with up to 4 of your closest friends and battle to be crowned the ultimate Bombardier!

title: Twilight's Final Judgement
description: Twilight's Final Judgement is a noir turn-based RPG. Players will explore a 1940s New York where the secret elites of the world are the Greek Gods. You will level up and build upon 4 playable characters. Players will also talk with NPCs learn secret lore and form bonds.

title: Tatari
description: Take the role of a detective from Tokyo who tries to solve the mysterious case of the disappearance of a young camper. You will try to follow the trail of evidence to guide you through an enigmatic and paranormal case connected with a Japanese urban legend. Can you help until the end?

title: Bramblewood
description: Live in a Castle, Work for a Sorceress, Save the Valley! Bramblewood is a cute magical farming sim where you learn spells to care for plants. Befriend the locals and help them save their small businesses to unlock festivals and romance options.

title: Grand Theft Gato: Vice Kitty
description: Work for the Meowfia or work for the Purrlice, it’s your choice. Drive cars, scale buildings, steal, get into back-alley fights, or rob banks. Bring your friends to have a crew!

title: Roaming the Stars
description: A sandbox, space-exploration survival game where you can build bases and explore other planets and moons around the star Craterous.

title: Starchild Velta and loadtosky
description: Let's go on a journey of training! 2D side-scrolling action adventure of a cute star child!

title: Good Bones
description: Your new house has old secrets in this haunting point-and-click mystery, where you'll search for clues about a mysterious death, solve narrative puzzles, and make heartbreaking choices to navigate amnesia, grief, and revenge.

title: All Hail Temos
description: A first-person action RPG in a small hand-crafted open world. You are not a chosen one, but choose your own fate. Explore, fight, loot, trade, talk, quest, ride creatures, cast spells, or sneak and steal. Your actions can grow your starting village into a kingdom or bring it to ruin.

title: Immortal life of Confucius
description: A rpg game of history. Here, you can experience: free and open world, underground city exploration, solving puzzles, looking for legendary equipment, and playing with famous figures in history. Pixel image, story line driven by text.

title: Himbo Harem Homicide
description: A classic whodunit—but with a harem of himbos! Determine which of your hunky housemates is killing off the other handsome hardbodies before you’re left with not a handful of hotties, but just one murderous, monogamous man.

title: Slime Corp
description: Shoot things, get slime, upgrade your arsenal of weapons.

title: Fantasy Battle Islands
description: Let's go on an adventure on our little island. We capture enemy islands and increase our island. We place different types of troops on the island and fight with a stronger enemy.

title: Krut: The Mythic Wings
description: Krut: The Mythic Wings is a fast-paced hack and slash, side-scrolling platformer based on a 2018 Thai CG animated feature-length film "Krut: The Himmaphan Warriors", following the adventure of a Garuda warrior on the enchanted Island, Himmaphan.

title: Destinesia
description: Destinesia is a sci-fi metroidvania which you are looking for a new home for humanity. Parkour your way through most dangerous jungles and explore the ancient dungeons. Upgrade your suit with the remains of your ancestors. Reveal the oldest secrets of Homo Sapiens.

title: Kurama and the Cursed Isles
description: Kurama and The Cursed Isles is an adventure and Platformer Game. Explore 4 opened little area to unlock levels, resolve little quests and collect treasures. In the platformer levels, use the dash run to help you finish the levels which are based on the 4 themed seasons : Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter

title: Lands of Vodria
description: Climb the throne in this tactical game with clever maneuvers in card battles, as well as long-term strategy on the map.

title: Burial Stone
description: A VR tile based dungeon crawl. Delve into a dark horrifying dungeon, with weird creatures and unexpected danger. Use spells, skills and weapons to traverse the dangers.

title: Crupt
description: Slash through swarms of enemies, fight bosses, and talk to wacky characters as you struggle to restore everything one Wave at a time.

title: Alan-13 Reformation
description: An isometric puzzle game, that makes you think like a programmer.

title: Shinogi Chess Club
description: At Yoshino High School, all that matters is your skill in Shinogi Chess. As the Spring Championships approach, Himiko Masaki investigates a dangerous organization and discovers a powerful ability. Climb the ranks, make new friends (and enemies), and search for answers in Shinogi Chess Club!

title: World of Haiku
description: Entering the World of Haiku is the first step to acquiring the critical, real-world skills needed to become a cybersecurity professional. In this first and only gamified cyberpunk experience, you gain real-world hacking skills as you advance through the game missions.

title: Greyhill Incident
description: Greyhill Incident is a Survival-Horror game about classic Grey-Alien and UFO abductions. Survive the invasion of your neighborhood, investigate the outlying village, seek for helpful utilities to protect your neighbors, and hide from "The Greys."

title: Drones: Defenders Astartes
description: A 2D, top-down shoot'em up with simulation elements, embedded in retro tech from the '80s. Blast your way trough space and enemies. Upgrade your space drones. Endure your mothership's AI cynical attitude and enjoy the most realistic shoot'em up ever!

title: The Silent Swan
description: The Silent Swan is a first-person open world narrative experience across a monolithic, derelict world. Mixing both the walking simulator and open world genres together, the game brings the meaning of openness to urban areas for the first time to this scale.

title: The Safe Place
description: This is a dramatic deep social point&click adventure about tough childhood and self-sacrifice.

title: Froggy Quest
description:
The original Froggy Quest made for the Lost Cartridge Jam 2021.
Help Froggy on his quest to eat as many flies as possible! Use your sticky tongue to move crates and solve challenging platformer puzzles.

title: Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird
description:
Garenburg Penitence is an action-puzzle arcade game and visual novel about matching sphere colors and exploring the collapsing psyche that destroyed the world.

With over 70 unique level maps, additional game modes, a level editor, and a tragic tale spanning across eight databases, learn the story of a fragile girl and her regretful actions.

If everything has a cost, then how much would it be to make the world a better place?

title: L.A.P.D. 2195
description: A modern re-imagining of the classic game "Future Cop L.A.P.D.”, you are a rookie cop in the Advanced Weapons and Tactics Unit of the Los Angeles Police Department in the year 2195.

title: Farmer Toon
description: In Farmer Toon, you play a farmer who inherits a farm. You can harvest crops, raise animals and cook food. Trade with other players online to get richer ! Choose your specialty from 3 professions. Relax in the city centre with your friends online !

title: Pokaban
description: Push cards strategically into marked positions to create a poker hand. Beat the dealer's hand to win. Sokoban with poker mechanics.

title: Wavecade
description: Wavecade is a sci-fi, arcade-style, shoot-em-up where YOU control the speed of the game. Destroy blocks in style as you collect powerups and avoid hazards. How far can you go? Set your own rules and unlock your favourite mode to play.

title: Boneraiser Minions
description: Amass an army of deamonic undead to fight endless waves of heroes intent to end your boneraising ways! In this gothic-horror auto-battle roguelite, use the bones of slain heroes to raise your minions, collect powerful relics and spells, and unlock meta upgrades, all to survive King Gigald's crusade!

title: Prayer of the Faithless
description:
Prayer of the Faithless is a unique blend of traditional RPG and classic survival-horror gameplay. In addition to fighting enemies to level up, you must also scavenge the field to find healing supplies, as well as new gear that comes with their own skills and traits to further customize your party. Battles reward smart tactics and aggressive offense by tying stamina pools to both skill usage and damage reduction. Enemies are challenging, but an understanding of the options each character has available to them will take you farther than grinding levels will.

Each ally's personality traits affect their combat prowess and abilities. As the story goes on and the stakes are raised, these traits will develop (and degrade!) along with the character's mental state. You will get to truly understand how each character thinks and feels through conversations and battle performance, and see how the state of the world affects their morale and beliefs.

title: Loopback
description: Loopback is an arcade-style scrolling shooter game where you will battle through waves of enemies, fight unique bosses, and build new weapons as you make your way back home.

title: Vantageous
description: Vantageous is a highly competetive board game, where you have to strategize your piece placement, stack your pieces to increase their range and outsmart your opponent. You can play on the same device, online or against the computer! Play against your friends or challenge the rank ladder!

title: Pillars of Light
description: Pillars of light is a first person action / puzzle game where you will have to continue what your family have done since the beginning of times : protect the world from shadows and make friend with Utu, the light god.

title: Inga Ouhou: Murderous Plaza
description: This is a game about the 12 Star Signs x Blood Thirsty Killers x Communal Life.

title: FireSquad
description: FireSquad is a real-time strategy game in which you are controlling a group of 4 firefighters. You will need to manage the fire spread, break through doors and windows, search for survivors and rescue them to safety before the fire becomes unmanageable and the building collapses.

title: Escape Purgatory
description: Set in a limbo realm, this strategic horror game, charges the player with traversing the world while solving puzzles and challenges. With each discovery, collect items, repent your sins, and be freed from evil. Can you survive the wickedness within?

title: Yokai Hunter Shintaro
description: Yokai Hunter Shintaro presents the adventures of two heroes on a quest to restore balance between the human world and the Yokai kingdom. It will be your mission to kill the different bosses of each stage to restore order.

title: Let There Be Light
description: Let There Be Light is a puzzle platformer developed by Jack Edwards. Using the complex nature of light and its many forms, you will navigate your way through the capitalism-based afterlife that awaits all living beings after their demise - with some help from a very stressed employee, of course.

title: Being a Penguin
description: Being a Penguin is a short and emotional exploration adventure game about wanting to become someone else. Play as penguin Bree as she finds herself as she completes quests from various animals and explores a beautiful frozen world!

title: Artis Impact
description: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

title: Patient
description: You are a patient of a psychiatric clinic. You don't remember anything about your past. A certain orderly helped you escape, because he knew that you were here by mistake. You need to find out the real reason of it.

title: Horse and Go Seek
description: Get ready to gallop through scenic locations with your majestic horse to find all the hidden animals! Travel through a variety of different landscapes to unlock horses, hair colors, levels, spirits and worlds.

title: Beat Stickman: Beyond
description: A well-crafted narrative-driven idle clicker game with stunning and chaotic graphics. Nebody will be your friend on the journey to provide help and stories.

title: Covid 69
description: The Year is 2069, covid is worse than ever. Antimaskers just kidnapped your girl. Now there are hordes of zombies between you and your girlfriend.

title: Far Star
description: Far Star is a story-driven action-adventure game with Metroidvania influences. There is something fishy going on in this galaxy, but this won’t stop your intergalactic general services crew from doing their job using a varied set of skills, weapons and outfits.

title: ConquestAreas
description: Capture flags to earn points. The first team to reach 300 points wins!

title: Exocide
description: Exocide is a retro FPS with an early 00's aesthetic. Manage two powerful sets of weapon systems with extreme aggression to annihilate the swarm! Keep your maniacal robotic backpack excited using a powerful array of weaponry.

title: The Sword of Rhivenia
description: Are you worthy of the throne? Or do your siblings deserve it more than you do? What kind of heir will you be?

title: A Crown of Sorcery and Steel
description: Swing a sword, delve dungeons, and lead a resistance against the tyrannical queen of a war-torn fantasy realm. Will you unite the realm and end the queen’s reign of terror... or join her and rule by her side?

title: Underground Lords
description: Purge the underworld from the demons!. Underground Lords are hardcore action rogue-like dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. Chose one from the 3 characters, gather equipment, and mow the lords that rules the underground!

title: With Good Intentions
description: The Age of Blade and the Age of Gun entwined. The master of the knights and the imperial captain are separated by centuries, but bound by memory. Solve the mysteries of the cursed abbey and its immortal lord. Rejoin the link of time. Find out where the road will take thee with good intentions.
Discover who you really are on an adventure where choices matter and accuracy is paramount.

title: The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge
description: A realistic physics based surfing simulation. Complete the 12 challenge rounds with a choice of 5 different surfers or a body boarder. Compete in two player timed and scored contests with two players surfing at the same time.

title: Slap-It Together!
description: Set in a game show that only cares for the numbers; you and up to 3 online friends slap, throw and whack your way through hordes of enemies and hand-painted environments in this comedic zombie wave-based fighter.

title: Cradlemoor
description: Cradlemoor is an interactive mystery game, which casts you as the detective, inviting you to explore a labyrinth of documents, photos, videos and audio clips via a virtual desktop computer. In Cradlemoor, you are the detective.

title: Paradox Factor
description: Paradox Factor is a 30,000 word interactive science-fiction novel by Mike Walter where your choices determine how the story proceeds.

title: Sirenhead: Southpoint
description: Sirenhead: Southpoint, a Survival Horror game that takes place in the 1980's as you, Freddy Anderson try to go camping with your friends when all of a sudden, things go south. Your friends are no where to be seen, you are all alone. Except there is one creature waiting for you in the woods.

title: Stardander School for Witches
description: Welcome to witch school! Learn spells, solve mysteries, make friends, and battle (or befriend) Fae creatures in a turn based battle system. Will you become the witch who defeats the malicious enemy who has laid siege to the world?

title: My Gaming Club
description: In the game My Gaming Club you can feel exactly what it's like to own a gaming club, because realism is one of the main features of the game. Assemble PC, buy furniture, food for your club and for your visitors. This game is not just a gaming club simulator, this game is a real life simulator

title: Claim your Free BitBuddy Today!
description: "BitBuddy" is a virtual pet raising game. When you quit, your BitBuddy will die.

title: Fever Dream
description: Fever Dream: Escape the nightmare 'Ignatius' has trapped your soul in. Survival is key. You aren't alone in the dream, but only you have the power to escape!

title: One Btn Bosses
description: It's One Button Bosses, it's all in the name. You have one button. There are big bosses to beat. Push, tap, and bash in the handcrafted campaign or in the roguelike rifts.

title: Elegos
description: Want to overthrow the sovereignty or work to stand with them? Decide for yourself in Elegos, an immersive first-person RPG where every action matters. Designed with a flexible play system, forge a path through a world where complex political forces clash in any way you like.

title: Dice Kingdoms
description: Dice Kingdoms is a multiplayer turn-based strategy game where resource collection is based on dice. Build efficiently to quickly expand your kingdom. Roll dice to gather resources while risking natural disasters. Accumulate army and/or culture to achieve victory!

title: Satan's Puzzle 2
description: A continuation of Satan's Puzzle 666 game, this is a puzzle game where you have to match magic circles pieces and get an evil spirit

title: Ellisar
description: Dive into this magical underwater adventure. Explore a corrupted environment moving with your two transformations to help fix the disaster that almost ended life around your world. Ellisar is a third person contemplative exploration and adventure game.

title: Sopa: Tale of the Stolen Potato
description: Emotional narrative adventure about the things we pass along. Inspired by Miyazaki, Coco, and The Little Prince.

title: Matchcraft: Efir Adventure
description: Welcome to Matchcraft: Efir Adventure, a unique hybrid of item crafting sim and match3 mechanic with RPG elements.

title: Yin Yang Space
description: A sandbox FPS game, you can build gardens in the most intuitive and simple way and play with robots.

title: Pingo's Revenge
description: With logical moves you'll be able to push all the diamonds together and thus master the levels. Make your own way through the different areas and kill the enemies with the help of ice blocks to save your girlfriend.

title: Cornucopia
description: Puzzle platformer for the GBA, now on PC!

title: I Wani Hug that Gator!
description: I Wani Hug that Gator! Is a choice-driven narrative about teenagers struggling to find their way. Help Inco, loser highschooler extraordinaire, navigate his budding friendships (and romance!) while surviving being the only human in a dinosaur-filled school.

title: The House of Da Vinci 3
description: Walk in the shoes of an apprentice and friend of Leonardo da Vinci. Find hidden mysteries, solve handcrafted mechanical puzzles and travel through time and space to lead the story to its grand finale.

title: Sentry City
description: Sentry City is a cyberpunk-style side-scroller with gameplay that is part trial-and-error, and part reaction time based. Traverse the city using the motorcycle overworld map, blast and think your way through the levels, and fight tough bosses to uncover who is behind the city's AI disruption.

title: I Am Mouse
description: I Am Mouse is a game in which the player takes the role of a mouse, which must find food for the family. Hide, run, distract and knock down. Do your best to get food for your family!

title: The Bunny Graveyard
description: An episodic puzzle adventure about a bunny who seeks to find the horrifying truth behind her existence.

title: Proto Akane
description: Akane pilots a vehicle that transforms to have different abilities to advance and defeat her enemies.

title: Crabs: Chef's Story
description: In this Multiplayer Party Brawler, play as one of 'Chef's' crabs! Launch crab ass with 'Crab-fu' and battle online in a number of crazy game modes designed to push your crabs abilities to the limit.

title: Sanator: Elmo's Legacy
description: Sanator: Elmo's Legacy is a branching visual novel that follows the adventures of a certain plague doctor. What secrets do the Ailur people hold, and who St. Elmo really was? Venture into the heart of the frozen Taiga and find the answers.

title: Disaster Island
description: Disaster Island is a unique survival based game, where you have to accomplish missions on abandoned island. But It's not gonna be easy, its not ordinary island. You will be confronted by natural disasters and numerous hidden dangers.

title: Auto Cast
description: Auto Cast combines elements from action rouge-lites, RPGs, and Shoot 'Em Ups into a 2D top-down world. Unlock new spells, level up existing ones, equip unique items, and find special events to maximize your chances of survival while cutting through hordes of enemies and bosses.

title: Dungeon Dueler
description: Hack and slash game. Visit blacksmith and create your own equipment. Also remeber about herbalist and make some potions. When you are ready conquer creatures from dungeon.

title: Diamond Hands Arena
description: DHA is a tactical fantasy gladiator game. Recruit a team, train, buy new weapons for heavy arena fights against other teams. Use all you can to win: gossip about opponents, get quests rewards, use powerful magic and pray not to die! The tournament rules are simple: it's harder and harder each time!

title: Sea of Choices
description: With both immersive and life sim elements, plot out your day to day life in the shoes of Aura! In combat use turn-based tactics to employ a strategy that leads to victory! Or just chill out and collect records and read books!

title: The Dreadful Space
description: A very action space war game, the mission is to fight the ships from other planets, the game requires a lot of skill to get rid of enemy shots and counterattack with all the cool features you can get in the game. The combat is intense and very agile, confronting your skills as a Battleship player.

title: Elemental Land
description: Elemental Land is a free-to-play MMORPG where you can explore the world however you want, facing monsters and players. Monsters, Spells, Craft, PvE, PvP, Guilds and many more.

title: Billy Saves the World
description: Run, slide, and Rocket Boost through a scifi-vania platformer, or explore, solve puzzles, and talk to the wacky locals to progress through this comedic love story about becoming a better half, for your other half.

title: Revenge of the Killer Octopus
description: Revenge of the Killer Octopus is a third-octopus game where you shoot and possess your way through throes of enraged scientists in order to take your revenge!

title: The Jelly Adventure
description: The Jelly Adventure is a puzzle-casual game peefect for kids or even for those who had a more stressful day.

title: You Will Die a Lot Buddy, Trust Me!
description: A challenging platformer where you have to overcome obstacles. Avoid rays and spikes using the grappling gun. There are checkpoints for each room, so don't be afraid to die. And finally see your rank on the leaderboard at the end of game.

title: Unaware
description: Gather your strength and find information about your whereabouts. Explore the area. Find and assemble all the puzzle pieces. This way you will learn about the dark past.

title: Unhappy Hour
description: unHappy Hour! is a too accurate life-sim featuring bartender action, lousy work-life balance, and not-so-sarcastic humour. Pour beers, pay your bills, and overcome precariousness in this pixelated drama.

title: Project Mind
description: RAID other spaceships, EXPAND your fleet and EXPLORE space in order to discover the aldions´ real intention...

title: Murder Is Game Over
description: Murder Is Game Over is a pixel art point-and-click murder mystery involving the untimely death of a famous game designer. You and your trusty companion are on the case!

title: Nyaaaanvy
description: Physics sumo-wrestling game! A heated battle for dignity among mysterious cat-like creatures. Nyanvy who wins the battle can be a true cat!! Could it be...?

title: The Mensional
description: Adventures of different characters with their unique atmosphere and puzzles.

title: Railroader
description: You and your fellow railroaders are the lifeblood of your railroad, just like it is the lifeblood of the communities it serves. Switch cars at industries. Keep people moving while running local passenger trains. Run trains with a purpose in transition era Appalachia – in Railroader!

title: Only Lead Can Stop Them
description: Boot up your 486 and launch olcst.exe for this retro fps from an alternate 1990's. Descend into the madness of the Spanish Civil War fighting vicious fascist forces and supernatural monsters. Conquer three action packed episodes wielding machine guns, rifles, flamethrowers and explosives.

title: Castan
description: Explore an open post-apocalyptic city, delving into buildings and businesses where mutated creatures run rampant, few survivors still operate in reclaimed buildings. Working to pay the mafia will be no easy task, as diving into the dangerous contaminated World to make a profit is a death sentence.

title: Spiriat
description: Fly at high speed! Avoid and escape from the dark to find out. Collect light as much as possible, before you meet with the masters, who will guide you to your destiny.

title: 2 Bit Operative
description: As a government operative tasked with handling the most dangerous tasks, you must Shoot, Spy, Sneak, Sear and Sabotage your way to success. Each mission has unique objectives. Can you complete them all?

title: Light the Lamp Hockey
description: Old School Hockey Gaming in a Beer League coat of paint! Welcome to the most dynamic 8-ish bit hockey experience you could have ever asked for. Built on simplicity and full of depth, Take your team to the playoffs and win the almighty 'Ship!

title: Critias Empire
description: Turn-based strategy game with 4x elements. Build your empire while surviving frequent disasters rained down by the ancient Gods.

title: Octo Vinctum: Saga of the Galactic Stardom War
description: A JRPG/Visual Novel hybrid designed like the legendary RPGs of yesteryear! Vanquish the toughest foes using the power of kind words and musical talent! Uncover the dark and supernatural secrets that lurk beneath a cheery and cutesy world! "Prove the justice of our culture!"

title: Bearcycle
description: bearcycle combines fast-paced motorcycle racing with wacky platforming madness. Grind, grapple, and rocket your way through the forest, local city, and beyond! So grab some berries, catch some air, and land a trick in this unBEARably fun classic.

title: Rightfully, Beary Arms
description: Rightfully, Beary Arms is a bullet hell roguelite that is about more than collecting loot, dying, and then losing everything. Carefully choose enemy upgrades against your own. Plan your dungeon crawl tactfully to gun through unique factions of enemies and strategically preserve loot after death.

title: News Reacts
description: Suddenly one ordinary morning you are accused of terrorism! You are hunted by authorities, special forces, panic-stricken citizens and the news media. In a modern city you are always in the wrong place at the wrong time equipped only with your brain but with NO weaponry.

title: Mayu: Last of the Yaksha
description: An exploration-driven adventure RPG set in Ancient India about a young demi-god and his animal sidekicks. Use your jungle detective skills to discover hidden paths, track down mysterious creatures, and find the secret temples of the Old Gods.

title: Undying Lantern
description: Undying Lantern is a third-person action game where your goal is to subdue otherworldly criminals who are on the run. Locate them by exploring mysterious locations and overcome their challenges by mastering the lantern's powers and understanding their weaknesses.

title: The Deep Diving of FloodDragon
description: "Landing on the moon and diving into the deep sea" is a human dream. In this game, you will experience this great journey. Understand the structure of Jiaolong, drive the submarine with the deepest diving depth in the world to dive into the deep sea and explore unknown places.

title: Curtain Call
description: Explore a cursed theater and persevere through all manners of dangers in this first-person survival horror game. Developed by third year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences.

title: R is for Rachel
description: A romance about falling in love for the first time, while suffering from social anxiety disorder.

title: Sinoepoch
description: Sinoepoch is a grand strategy game based on the historical fantasy of the Three Kingdoms period in Chinese history. In the current version, players can create their character, "travel" to the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty,create their family legends.

title: WTF Do You Know?
description: We just have one question for you... "WTF Do You Know?" I think it might be time for us to find out...

title: Xpressorcist
description: A Exorcism Simulator! Take the role of an Xpressorcist (Express Exorcist) and exorcise as many people as possible with out running out of time and accidentally blowing them up!!

title: Sunken Realms
description: Descend into an abandoned underground city to battle orcs, solve puzzles, collect loot, and then return to the surface to upgrade your gear and stats in this modern, old-school dungeon-crawler.

title: Trash Pit
description: A frantic twin stick shooter where you and your enemies are only ever one hit from death. Mow down relentless waves of robots, collect upgrades and claw your way to the highest score you can.

title: Lil Splody: Look Out Below!
description: Zodac and his minions are wreaking havoc! It's up to you to dodge and blow up falling enemies in an attempt to rescue your fellow bomblings!

title: Dungeon: Faster & Deadlier
description: In this singleplayer card game, full of strategic options yet simple mechanics, your brain gets what it craves. Heroes fight under your command in a vast, dark world. They crush their enemies with your prudent judgement, spells, cult items and brute force. Or vice versa.

title: Islands of the Caliph
description: Islands of the Caliph is an old-school RPG with grid based movement set in a fictional island civilization. Thematically it draws on Middle Eastern folklore and religion, offering a lore-rich setting for your character's journey.

title: Rocco's Inferno
description: Rocco's Inferno is a top down, narrative role playing game inspired by The Sopranos and the crime films of Martin Scorsese. You play through a day in the life of Rocco Dante, a captain in the Reggiani crime Family. Who will still be living by tomorrow, is up to you.

title: Meet me at Noon
description: Meet me at NooN is a cozy puzzle game with brain-scratching time-loop mechanics. Control two spirits that create time loops each day, learn their different behaviors, how they can interact with each other and how these interactions are interfering with their time loops.

title: Spelldash
description: Spellburst is a fast paced magical FPS game where you control fire, air, ice and lightning elements to use various spells, fight against exotic monsters and explore different planets with parkour and platforming elements

title: Dumb Little Robots
description: Dumb Little Robots is a 2d puzzle game where you control robots that each have a single function. Help them work together to solve tricky levels. Meet new robots as you go and learn how they change the possibilities!

title: Ballads of Hongye
description: "Ballads of Hongye" is a unique city-building game. Unlike the conventional city-building games, lands in Ballads of Hongye are expanded by finishing the challenges in a limited time. Once you own the lands, you can take your time to build your dream oriental city with over 150 different buildings.

title: Exodemic
description: Destroy aliens, dash between planets, and buy powerful upgrades. Exodemic is a compact roguelike that combines frenetic shoot 'em up gameplay with a procedurally generated overworld filled with vendors, trading hubs, and combat encounters. Race against the clock to save the human race.

title: ElbmarKs
description: A tribute to the magnificent side-scrolling Arcade shoot’-em-up games with a modern look, physics-based movement, and some challenging twists that will test your speed, reflexes, accuracy, patience, and memory at the same time.

title: Aledorn
description: Spiritual successor to many old school hard-core RPG/Dungeon masterpieces, that combines tactical combat system, exploration in the first person view and intriguing travelling system between main map locations.

title: Just Power: The Papal States
description: Are you ready to found a dynasty which controls the Holy See over the centuries? Climb the hierarchies, hire your relatives, blackmail and bribe to get everything you want in this turn-based political simulator.

title: Magical Harvest
description: In this 3D-fantasy farming game you are the one who wants to save the world of Hyldena from the loss of all magic. While exploring Hyldena, you will be able to evolve plants and animals into magical variations and even learn how to use magic yourself with alchemy.

title: Fight of Steel: Infinity Warrior
description: Fight of Steel: Infinity Warrior is a new fighting game with ultimate freedom. Players will have the opportunity to customize their own fighter from the appearance to fighting moves.

title: Dreams in the Witch House
description: Dreams in the Witch House is an open-world horror adventure game where you guide Walter Gilman as he prepares to face the dreaded May-Eve witch rite in the legend-haunted city of Arkham. Choose your own approach and reveal the secret of the Witch House before it's too late.

title: Stone Mirth on Earth
description: Stone Mirth on Earth is a comedy fantasy point and click adventure in which you will take on the role of Stone Mirth, the volcanic stone from Mars who has to save the earth from an evil stone in order to return to his home planet and prove himself a hero.

title: Raccoon Crafts Factory
description: Raccoon Crafts Factory is a game about creating automated factories to produce things of increasing complexity, within an endless 2D world - Use your imagination to design factories, combine simple elements into complex structures.

title: Hero Chest
description: The perfect combination of Roguelike, Hack Slash and Card Game! In Hero Chest you are an angry chest that got tired of being looted and decided to finish them all! With powers and special cards create the dungeon and strategize to reach your goal. An adventure full of combat and gold!

title: Contrablade World
description: Speed through a vast open world and experience incredible battles while you advance your Contrablade in a quest to challenge and beat the mythical gods. A brand new adventure RPG in the unique action physics fighting franchise Contrablade.

title: Space Ballers
description: Space Ballers it's a game between ships that aims to score the most number of goals in challenging arenas with many obstacles along the way.

title: Lulu Way
description: Lulu the little astronaut is trapped in space. Help Lulu escape eternal limbo by jumping from one block to another, solving uniquely crafted puzzles is the only way!

title: Dreamlined
description: Dreamlined is a physics-based automation/destruction game about building machines and crushing dreams.

title: Astrolander
description: Astrolander is a revolutionary action-packed reimagining of platformers. Embark on a thrilling adventure featuring innovative 2.5D fused with 3D environments and gameplay, unique mechanics, and breathtaking worlds. Take control of a curious robot on a roll named Feedback and an adventurous rocket powered sidekick named Haptic on a quest to save the Most Valuable Programs (MVPs)!

title: Vedette
description: You are the head of an experimental anti-crime task force in the city of Osteria. Use search history, recent emails, and criminal backgrounds to determine whether an individual is likely to commit a crime. The choices you make will have a significant impact on the entire city’s future.

title: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns
description: An epic 2D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. Wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn.

title: Rail Walkers
description: Rail Walker, noun, a semi autonomous rail-mounted turret attack weapon. Defend against the swarms of intelligent insects threatening your mining infrastructure. Construct rail tracks, strategically move, repair, recharge, reload and upgrade your rail walkers in the battle against these enemy waves.

title: Multi Idle
description: Multi Idle is an idle game that features Exploring, Adventuring, Hero's, Dungeons, Raids and many more in its own kind of idling way. Get stuck in an endless loop of trying new things every time you play!

title: Dead End City
description: A post-apocalyptic arcade shooter. Collect fuel and dodge enemy fire as you fight back against the evil Scorpio gang. Mixes cars, shmups and themes that would have been right at home in 80's anime and arcades..

title: Godscyld
description: A coop action RPG for 1-4 players, you are one of few Sin-Eaters who can control the corruption and power of Sin. It turned our gods against each other, against the world, against us. Hunt demon bosses, to regain control of the world.

title: Magirune 2
description: While mining in the search of water, an artifact is found. Learn the secret of this world in this casual dungeon crawler.

title: Cat Powered UFO
description: Cat Powered UFO is a blend of turn-based RPG combat and old-school Zelda top-down action. Collect cats, visit crazy dimensions, and be a jerk to NPCs. Find combos of "Illegal bonuses" to break the combat system! Cat Powered UFO is a quirky and light-hearted game with a self-aware sense of humor.

title: Potatoes
description: Potatoes is a puzzle/platformer game in which you control multiple characters by recording what should they do. Make potatoes collaborate to reach the objective in 50 different levels of increasing difficulty!

title: The Enjenir
description: In this light hearted physics based building game, you are a clumsy medieval engineer. The game combines gridless sandbox building with hilarious physics driven third person controls. With infinite structural design possibilities - the only limit is your imagination… oh, and gravity!

title: Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure
description: Explore a diverse island, from dense jungles to snowy peaks. Harvest resources, craft gear to keep monsters at bay. Sneak into pirate camps to free captured creatures, who will become powerful allies. Create a home, tend to your farm and make the island your own. Ikonei is fully in your hands!

title: SGS Spain at War
description: The complete Spanish Civil War from July 1936 to April 1939, with all units, weapons and events included on a weekly base. The most complete strategy game made on this conflict. Fight for your ideals, and take control of Spain!

title: Wildlife Planet: The Incremental
description: Wildlife Planet is a Simulation & Idle game with the theme of wildlife and nature. You will unlock more and more species as you level up and learn the species knowledge. This is a game with refreshing scenes, immersive background music, and different kinds of wild animals and plants.

title: Green Wounds
description: Craft, manage resources, fight enemies, and explore the unknown in this medieval RPG.

title: Welcome to the Backrooms
description: There must be an exit somewhere. Keep your wits about you as you traverse a seemingly endless labyrinth of dingy yellow walls and moldy carpet. Find candy bars and almond water to keep your strength, and stay out of the shadows to keep your sanity.

title: The Complex: Found Footage
description:
Experience the liminal world of the backrooms through a VHS camera, immersing into a mysterious story and wandering the dream-like structures... Might there be something following you?

The Complex: Found Footage is a walking simulator with the world being viewed through a VHS camera. Uncover a mystery that lies in the world of "The Complex", though it may leave more questions rather than answers...

title: Bitlands
description: Platform across strange, magical terrain while meeting even stranger friends and enemies! Discover the history behind the Bitlands, and unlock new allies and powers to traverse the dangerous worlds of the Bitlands, and restore peace to a broken kingdom.

title: Froggo Swing 'n Grapple
description: Froggo Swing 'n Grapple is a retro platformer game about a little frog on an adventure. Swing 'n grapple through the stages with Froggo's powerful and sticky tongue!

title: Super Hamster Havoc
description: Super Hamster Havoc is a twin-stick arena shooter about a war between hamsters and rats.

title: Super Kiwi 64
description: Super Kiwi 64 is a 3D-Platformer and Collect-a-Thon, in a low poly late 90s console look.

title: Kojimachi Island
description: Kojimachi is a widget style pet game where you can feed and care for your pet on the island you decorate.

title: The hardest game in the universe 2
description: The sequel to the most impossible game. The new 2D adventure, embark on this platform game that will test your skill of how much patience you are capable of,New mechanic, 10,000 kills, if you lose your game will be erased, What is the way to make a sequel to an extremely difficult game???

title: Escape the Backrooms
description: Explore the seemingly infinite expanse of eerily familiar levels in the backrooms based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level features different ways to escape with danger along the way.

title: Findme: 30sai no Yume Ooibito
description: It is a Japanese visual novel game. It is a game to read texts. Enjoy the story of anguish, conflict, dreams and hope. There is no branching depending on the choices, but you can have a rich story experience like a movie.

title: Worm Slayer
description: Worm Slayer is a Fast-Paced Bullet Hell Roguelike where you must fight your way through the dungeon that is the Worm King's den to finally reach and then defeat the Worm King.

title: Echoes of Mayhem
description: Echoes of Mayhem is a roguelite arpg souls-like. You'll fight through a procedural dungeon of monsters and bosses in an attempt to reforge the world. You'll score loot along the way and gather resources to upgrade your town and unlock new tiers of items and abilities.

title: Voice from Beyond
description: Voice from Beyond is a short, first-person exploration game. You have crashed an old WW2 fighter plane somewhere in the mountains. The place is abandoned, but there are some strange activities in the area. Search the place and find what is going on. It is a route to your rescue.

title: Smooth Operators 2
description: Welcome back to Smooth Operators 2! Smooth Operators is an advanced simulation where you take control of a customer service company and lead it to financial success! Hire employees and customize your buildings with different types of offices, facilities and accessories!

title: Top Town
description: Top Town is an upcoming life simulation game. Create a character and define your own goals and identity by choosing a profession and hobbies. Buy your dream house, visit stores and explore in a persistent and reactive world.

title: Relicborn
description: Relicborn is a story-driven platformer game that tells the story of Alice, a young dressmaker who finds herself in an undiscovered world, searching for a distant, long lost possibility. ARPG elements, fantasy environments, legendary loot, a skill system along with many secrets to be discovered!

title: Byte the Bullet
description: Get into my infected computer and restore every virus-ridden system by recovering game attributes like color or save functions. Enjoy this parody of multiple classic games from 80s & 90s.

title: The Castle of Time
description: This is a fighting platformer with a dynamic combat system where you have to fight enemies with your sword.

title: Knight Crawlers
description: Knight Crawlers is a dungeon crawling ARPG with physics based ragdoll combat. Each crawl is made unique through dozens of skill cards to choose from. Hunt for loot, craft powerful equipment, and fight your way back home through strange worlds. How deep can you crawl through the endless realms?

title: Synthwave Racers
description: Race at hypersonic speeds through retro-inspired courses in Synthwave RacersⓇ, an indie-arcade racing game with melodic 80's-inspired synthwave tracks, and tight percision-based action racing gameplay.

title: Squamations
description: Squamations is a relaxing yet fast paced word game you can play at your own speed!

title: Balance Knight
description: Balance Knight is a game in which the player must advance up a scaffolding shaken by physics.

title: Gastro Force
description: The player takes the role of the last soldier of the highly specialized "Gastro Force", elite troopers trained to infiltrate the enormous alien guts to fight them from the inside!

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby
description: Experience Vampire: The Masquerade in a new way through this isometric cRPG. Change perspectives as you travel through the Heartless Club as a Human and a Vampire. Roll the dice, take your choices, and embrace the night in this narrative prologue.

title: Fantasy Fishing Town
description: Welcome to Fantasy Fishing Town! Cute pixel graphic x side scroll fishing. It's a unique pleasure! Legendary fish! You're mine!

title: One Life
description: One hit death bullet hell action featuring upgrades, unlockable abilities, minigames, hats and you.

title: Heart Abyss
description: In a world where there is an eternal war between the unions of the human race and beastmen, accidental deaths and slave trade are not rare. But what happens if two slaves by chance unite and survive together, being wanted? Leon and Ray are one of those.

title: Meiro Master
description: Now is your time to become the ultimate Meiro Master. Earn your way in to the history books and fulfill your childhood dreams of becoming the unrivalled Meiro Master.

title: Terrovox
description: Explore a huge world. You can go in any direction. Get resources. Craft weapons and items. Create buildings. Use your imagination to the maximum.

title: Leviathan: Streams of Legends
description: Command your army (composed of your Twitch viewers) in this new legendary Social Real Time Strategy game. Bond with your audience in unprecedented ways where you control the war, while they fight each battle from their phones.

title: Panmorphia: Awakened
description: A point and click, puzzle adventure game set in the magical world of Panmorphia. Wield the Amulet and transform into one of the four animals that represent the four elements. Each change also brings a unique perspective of the world.

title: Escape from the Trap World
description: Help our friend Hatdevil to get back to his world, passing through a world full of deadly traps.

title: Perish Song
description: Perish Song is a 2D action rogue-lite. Traverse through different environments as you battle unique enemies and bosses. Discover the secrets of the world as you dash and blast through anything standing in your path. Each death is an opportunity to learn, adapt, and overcome.

title: Imbalance
description: A fast-paced roguelike shooter with a strong focus on deckbuilding and talent synergies.It fuzes together the dynamic of Doom and thoughtful gameplay and tons of replayability of Slay the Spire.

title: Battle Support
description: This is a 2d war game where players can use the support in the column below to support ground troops. Players can obtain various parts to upgrade their army by completing a game, making the army stronger and winning!

title: Final Stardust: Cosmic Nexus
description: Choose your element and awaken your elemental abilities! Build your deck, create bonds with many Elementalists and engage in fast-paced battles against AI! Enjoy the Final Stardust universe with an amazing single player experience, all in stunning 2D anime like graphics!

title: Lighthaze World
description: Discover a charming adventure in Lighthaze World, a cozy puzzle game for adventure lovers. Collect treasure, solve nonlinear puzzles and follow the anxious hero's heartfelt journey to save their loyal dog. Your decisions shape this delightful puzzle experience.

title: Terra Flame
description: Terra Flame is a horizontal shmup inspired by the 90's. The feature is that you can switch between three types of weapons in real time.

title: Tinyfolks
description: Train your folks, defeat monsters and upgrade your town!

title: C&T
description: C&T is a Goofy Team-Strategy Multiplayer game where you play either as a cop or a thief in teams through a small town. Lets see who can rule between the crime and the law!

title: Bare Butt Boxing
description: Take control of alien youngsters mesmerized by the sport of boxing as they battle it out all over our beloved planet Earth, unaware of the laws and traditions of human society. Enjoy the chaos and whimsy of simulated characters and environments in this action arena brawler that will keep you hooked with surprising combat twists and gameplay variety. Board the spaceship, we're off to the next scrimmage!

title: Find the Gnome 2
description: Help find these adorable gnome creatures. Is it behind the tree? Is it in the bushes? Look, what shuffles over there? ]Features hand modeled stylized low poly lush 3D environments with as much interaction as possible, supported by atmospheric music. And comics! Its all about the feel.

title: SGS Fall Weiss
description: The very first Blitzkrieg campaign of WW2 is covered by this game on a daily basis. And you can also explore alternative situations of different war starts, with the ‘What-if’ scenarios. Man your tanks!

title: Crusader: Dungeon Series
description: Crusader: Dungeon Series Dungeon of Dagginor is the first in the series and is a simple dungeon crawler.

title: Other
description: Challenge your friends in Other ! Collect 5 letters to eliminate your opponents, be the last player alive to win !

title: Hall Infinite
description: Hall Infinite is a challenging infinite runner with multiple varied environments and several playable characters! You will require precise timing and deliberate movements in order to achieve a high score.

title: Car Mechanic Manager 2023
description: Car Mechanic Manager is a tycoon management game that lets you manage your own car mechanic business! Build, expand and modernize your car workshop to maintain a good reputation and attract more customers. Manage your business efficiently and destroy the competition!

title: Adorable Witch 3
description: Adorable Witch 3 is a level puzzle game. Players need to control various mechanics in the level to help the witches and elves of the Magic Academy get flowers to pass the trainee witch test.

title: Rabbit's Tale
description: Rabbit’s Tale, a hand-drawn metroidvania roguelike. Play as a Rabbit in search of his kidnapped family, but along the way something mysterious happens: you get lost in a purple Void, a procedural world where dying is permanent. A Venom-like creature tags along. You bound by survival.

title: Revenge on the Streets 3
description: In this new and last continuation, the wife of the former crime boss assumes her role as boss and puts an end to the life of the game's protagonist's brother, helps Karina and her family get the last fight in "Revenge On The Streets"

title: Pirate Souls
description: A 2D Online RPG where you can become the most wanted pirate, the strongest bounty hunter or even the highest-ranking Marine! Customize your character to be uniquely yours, level up and find treasures. Start your adventure in the world of Pirate Souls now!

title: OneShotRogue
description: Deck-building roguelike Use cards to reduce the enemy's HP to just 0. This is an easy battle because all battles are over in one turn.

title: Cursed Dungeon Raider
description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

title: Fishing Vacation
description: A Game Boy styled fishing horror adventure

title: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child: Log6
description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure

title: Ark Mobius: Censored Edition
description: This is a game containing "beautiful girl + rhythm game + multi ending GALGAME". In 2320, a huge monster appeared on the earth.Only magic energy can do harm to the monster.However,there is no more magic energy left on earth. So,you need to gain the energy from magical girls and save your world.

title: Edge of Reality: Lost Secrets of the Forest Collector's Edition
description: A growing phenomenon threatens the forest...

title: Jigsaw Novel: Double Trouble
description: Layla Scott can't decide which is her favorite: the dean or the physics teacher so she takes both of them. Solve all 12 jigsaw puzzles to find out how it turned out for Layla.

title: The Price of Flesh
description: An immersive choose-your-own-adventure survival horror with optional adult content featuring hand drawn backgrounds, sprites, and over 150 pieces of full screen art- and 50 endings.

title: New Horizon
description: New Horizon is a survival with RPG game. Explore a vast world in search of resources, build, upgrade your equipment and fight monsters to survive.

title: Sarrisa and the Legendary Sword
description: Sarissa and the Legendary Sword is a Brazilian turn-based RPG, with a simple and beautiful story. In it, you will follow friends, Sarissa, Dandara, Elaine and Patricia, as they go on an adventurous journey, where love and friendship, and a fated destiny will change their lives forever.

title: Block Kuzushi
description: It is a retro 3D block breakout that you can easily play. All operations are possible with only the mouse, and the ball behaves by physics.

title: Happiness Double Room
description: The summer has come to an end. You've been kidnapped by a sister you've known for a long time. Leave all your troubles, stresses and worries behind. Live a happy life with your sister in the next few weeks!

title: Lilium
description: Lilium is an action role-playing game taking place in a very small, but dense open world. It has a short, interesting main story, several side quests, dungeons and exciting secrets waiting to be discovered. Find your fun by interacting with your surroundings, develop your character, loot everything.

title: Naughty Waifu
description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

title: Comixxx Memories
description: Comixxx Memories is a casual game with relaxing atmosphere featuring high quality, hot & sexy girls done in comic book style. Enjoy the classic card match gameplay.

title: Disc Golf: Game On
description: The fun of disc golf, coming to PC and console. Featuring six different throw types, ten unique courses and tons of new plastic!

title: The Backrooms: Lost Tape
description: You work in the cinema as an usher and accidentally fell into the Backrooms, now being trapped, needing to unravel the mysteries of the yellow rooms in order to get out of this place, but be careful, there are entities that will be in your way.

title: Twilight Monk
description: Explore the shattered world of Speria as the last remnant of ancient Kung Fu warriors in Twilight Monk! Destroy demons, or enslave them as you hunt down and obliterate the portals from whence they came. In Twilight Monk, you will explore Metroidvania dungeons connected by an open world.

title: Solos
description:
Solos is a puzzle bullet hell with "paper style" graphics.
Practically you'll have to create your own bullet hell, by avoiding bouncing bullets you'll shoot trying to hit all screen elements.

title: Happi Basudei
description: Oldschool platformer which you found on an untitled random cartridge, where you win by doing nothing. Well... except evading.

title: Galagi Shooter
description: Galagi Shooter is based on the old school arcade hit space defender game, probably one of the best game ever made. Highly playable, action-packed, this game include many aliens waves to defeat and power ups to collect.

title: Anno 1800: Seeds of Change
description:
The 1st DLC of the Anno 1800 Season 4 Pass.

Be part of the new world’s agricultural boom with the modular haciendas and face the challenges of a new scenario.

title: Anno 1800: Empire of the Skies
description:
Using the latest construction materials from the New World, you can build a variety of new specialized airships.

Optimize your logistical network by transferring goods and workers between your islands in the New World, and keep your people connected with the new mail system.

Your tactical planning will also take on a whole new dimension as you and your competitors vie for aerial mastery.

title: Anno 1800: New World Rising
description:
The 3rd DLC of the Anno 1800 Season 4 Pass.
Experience the cultural boom in the New World, celebrate with a new population tier and discover new islands to expand!

Anno 1800 DLC 12 includes the following content:

Discover a brand-new, high class society residence tier for the New World – the Artistas.
Take advantage of newly spotted islands on the New World map and use the additional space to expand your empire further.
Embrace the culture of your New Worlds residents by building the Stadium, the grand new monument.
Be able to experience Anno without tax income and beat the ever-changing market to reclaim lost artifacts in the fourth Scenario of Anno 1800.

title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2: Complete Edition
Granado Espada M
description: It is a mobile adaptation of the older Granado Espada.

title: Gabriel's Auditory Playground
description: Gabriel's Auditory Playground has no graphics, no visuals, no way to experience the gameplay with your eyes. In Gabriel's Auditory Playground, your eyes have no use. Put your ears to the test and play through mini-games designed without sight in mind!

title: Neophyte
description: A mini action rogue-lite with chaotic spell-slinging hack-n-slash combat. Collect spells and perks to become an unstoppable wizard and destroy hordes of monsters.

title: Pirates
description: You play as a pirate on a remote island, surviving alone or with other players as you battle hostile skeletons. Construct a shelter and gather resources to fortify your survival.

title: Landnav
description: Landnav is the ultimate adventure race. Plan. Prepare. Survive. Excel. Use real world navigation techniques to blaze your path across awe inspiring vistas. Become an unstoppable adventure athlete.

title: Rally
description: Gather together troops and weapons to fight through increasingly difficult armies in this rogue-like deck-building game. Establish synergies between your cards and treasures to create the strongest army!

title: On a Roll 3D: Levels 7 - 9
description: Three brand new worlds of On A Roll 3D with new music and graphics. Each world has three areas and a boss. Lots of new puzzles and game mechanics with new fastest time leaderboards for each area.

title: Trick or Treat
description:
On Halloween, everyone wants candy, and everyone dresses up to look scary—but can you tell the difference when something truly terrifying actually happens?

Step into the role of Michael, who returns to sort out the aftermath after his parents passed away. On a bizarre Halloween night, you’ll tidy up the house and encounter all kinds of strange people—can you tell apart what’s truly terrifying?

The game takes 10-20 minutes to complete, depending on how much you explore the scenes.

title: Quester
description: Quester is a role-playing game for PC, released by Thousand Games on 2023. Kazushi Hagiwara was deeply involved in the production and based on his suggestions, it was produced by Thousand Games. It's an indie game and includes hack and slash.

title: Sumy Shelltris: Iceblocks 1
description: Tetris? Not! Mutant Tetris!

title: Stranger Danger or Horror, Quest and Magic
description: Stranger Danger or Horror, Quest and Magic is a Survival Horror game where you, as the protagonist, must escape from a mad clown who appears in random stages of his anger. description: ShapeBreaker is a survival clicker: click shapes to break them, preventing sanity lost, survive increasingly difficult waves. Earn coins, buy upgrades, and push further on your next run.

title: Space Voyager
description: Space voyager is a solo action/puzzle game with simple and effective gameplay. Swipe your way through space, but keep an eye of the fuel gauge !

title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged
description: Hardcore survival RPG with non-linear story that lets you play as a young medieval soldier who over the course of battles and adventures becomes the most formidable and respected knight of his era. Or, if he’s not lucky enough, perishes in the chaos of the Hundred Years' War.

title: Mr. Prepper: Animal Farm
description: Take care of the animals, repair the farm’s facilities, learn fishing, explore the new areas, adopt a dog, get to the bottom of the Agency’s special interest in the farm and discover the mystery lurking from above! Use what you learn on the farm in your shelter and breed your own animals!

title: Mad World: Age of Darkness
description: Mad World stays true to the classic MMORPGs but with unique art and grotesqueness. Fight along side your friends to take down formidable enemies, or fight against your friends to test your skills in a world full of fear, despair, and madness. This is Mad World.

title: Slayer
description:
SlayeR is an episode WAD made by Richard Wiles. It also includes four deathmatch maps.

The first level is rather unique compared to the others. It is a large, expansive map while the other nine levels are short to medium and quite focused.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Legends of Mystery 3
description: Solve incredible puzzles with 1001 Jigsaw. Legends of Mystery 3. 500 photos to prove the existence of magic!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode Metal
description: Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode Metal is a free downloadable "Lock-On" part of the episodic game Sonic the Hedgehog 4, released along side of Episode II. It enables any player who owns both Episode I and Episode II on the same console to play Episode Metal, thereby acting very similar to the Lock-On Technology pioneered by Sonic and Knuckles. Episode Metal explains the backstory to Metal Sonic's return in Episode II and also serves to connect Sonic 4 to Sonic the Hedgehog CD, befitting the latter game's recent re-release on digital download services.

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Noroi no Ibutsu to Madoishi Boukensha-tachi
description: This new Konosuba game is going to be a sequel of the dungeon-crawling JRPG Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Kibou no Meikyuu to Tsudoishi Boukenshatachi, originally released in 2019 for PS4 and PS Vita.

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Noroi no Ibutsu to Madoishi Boukensha-tachi: Complete Edition
Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town Special
description: The long-awaited brand new entry in the original farm/life simulation franchise, known in Japan as Bokujo Monogatari, makes its debut on Nintendo Switch, bringing players more freedom than ever before to shape an untamed wilderness and customize their farm down to the very tile. A new cast of marriage candidates, a town that grows and thrives along with your farm, and a request system highlight the new features, all while retaining the core elements of the STORY OF SEASONS series. Finding Earth Sprites while exploring your farmland may lead you to mysterious, fantastical lands such as gardens where the seasons never change, an island in the sky, or even the inside of a volcano!

title: The Quarry: Deluxe Edition
description:
As the sun sets on the last day of summer camp, the teenage counselors of Hackett’s Quarry throw a party to celebrate. No kids. No adults. No rules. Things quickly take a turn for the worse.

Enjoy some extra teen horror flair with The Quarry - Deluxe Edition!

This Edition includes:

- The Quarry Full Game
- Deluxe Bonus Content Pack: ‘80s-themed character outfits, instant access to the Death Rewind system, Gorefest Movie Mode option, and Horror History Visual Filter Pack

title: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of Dana - Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition Includes:

- Ys VIII: Lacrimosa Of Dana PS5 Game
- Mini Art Collection
- Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of Dan, Select Soundtrack

title: Prinny Presents: NIS Classics Vol 3 - Deluxe Edition
description:
Prinny is back at it again, dood! Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 3: La Pucelle: Ragnarok / Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure brings you two foundational titles in one!

Discover the world of La Pucelle: Ragnarok as it makes its North American debut. This action-packed RPG is loaded with tons of extra content including new scenarios, new recruits, and a whole gang of DLC characters in addition to a new voice cast, new music, and quick travel!

Dive back into your NIS roots and experience a game that laid the foundation for the beloved Disgaea series with Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure. Sharper graphics and updated image optimization bring this classic title into the present!

Plus, each physical copy includes the soundtrack and art book at retail. Experience a part of NIS history with this delightful combo pack!

Features:
• Overflowing with New Content: La Pucelle is back with tons of new content including the Overlord Prier scenario. You can also recruit Laharl, Etna, Flonne, and Prinny to join your adventures.
• Where it All Began: The return of the original Rhapsody strategy RPG from the PS1 now has sharper graphics and image optimization options to mimic CRT.
• Exclusives Included: The physical NSW release includes both a soundtrack and an art book!
• Extra DLC characters such as Rozalin, Cornet, Hero Prinny, and Elly are included as well.

What's Included:
• Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 3 Game
• Anthology Official CD Soundtrack
• Compendium Softcover Art Book
• Collector's Box

title: Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory / Fallen Legion Revenants - Deluxe Edition
description: Deluxe Edition includes Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory / Fallen Legion Revenants game, Deluxe Digital Soundtrack (download code), and “Fallen Legion Compendium” Mini Art Book

title: Sway
description: A short experimental bullet hell. Traverse a dubious reality. Talk to manifestations of your own insecurities. Avoid bullets like you avoid your real-life problems.

title: The Haunted: Hells Reach - The Fog
description: THE FOG - Welcome to DLC 2!The second brand new full level of THHR. The testers were excited about the brand new level and you will be too - so get the achievement "SALVAGED FOG" on all difficulty levels.

title: Here Comes the Wiji Waji
description: Here Comes The Wiji Waji is a multiplayer survival game, where several creatures went to a Playground, and one of them is the Wiji Waji, who is blood thirsty.

title: Side Bullet
description:
Side Bullet is a free-to-play, side scroll online shooting game.
Choose your cartel and use special skills and weapons to battle monsters and other players to be the last one standing!

title: Anno 1800: Gold Edition Year 4
description: Improve your experience in Anno 1800 with the Gold Edition Year 4, including the Season 4 Pass and the Deluxe Pack.

title: Anno 1800: Complete Edition Year 4
description:
Unlock the entire Anno 1800 experience with the Complete Edition Year 4, which includes the following digital content:

Season 1 Pass with three DLCs: Sunken Treasures, Botanica, and The Passage.
Season 2 Pass with three DLCs: Seat of Power, Bright Harvest, and Land of Lions.
Season 3 Pass with three DLCs: Docklands, Tourist Season, and The High Life.
Season 4 Pass, which includes the next three DLCs: Seeds of Change, Empire of the Skies, and New World Rising.
The Deluxe Pack, containing the Anarchist AI character, the soundtrack, a digital art book, and more!

title: Deck of Ashes: Tome of Dimensions
description: Tome of Dimensions adds new playable character with unique storyline, 100+ new cards to experiment with, and, of course, a variety of new deadly enemies.

title: Aqua Energizer
description:
Help Nemo collect the red flashing balls into the energizer. Jump into it and get the code for the next level.
Beware of enemies, but be wise; you may want to keep them alive. Nemo can't live without oxygen. So hurry up!

title: BMX Streets
description: Ready to hit the streets? BMX Streets brings the essence of street riding to your fingertips. Experience the next generation of BMX gaming with realistic physics, meaningful customization and a massive open world. Practice, experiment and explore to find your own unique style and master the streets.

title: Maximus 2
description: Maximus 2 is a fantasy beat-em-up (brawler) that focuses on crunchy and satisfying combat. We captured the spirit of some of the best classic beat-em-ups, melding them into one memorable experience. Fight solo or with up to 4 players cooperative multiplayer!

title: Re:Lief - Shinai Naru Anata he: For Switch
description: This is the sister title of the visual novel "Tryment - Ima wo Kaetai to Negau Anata he-", which shares the same world view and game characters. This title combines science fiction, suspense, friendship, love and other diversified themes.

title: Adios Amigos: Galactic Explorers
description: Team up with your friends & family and explore the peculiar universe of ADIOS Amigos. A game with serious astrophysics in a comic setting for 1-4 players. Explore solar systems and discover planets, space stations, aliens, and artifacts. Improvise fuel efficient trajectories to keep your rusty ship running (and you might see your home planet once again). Toy with accurate and delightful space physics. Break into a space station with an asteroid. Tow a sofa into a black hole. Normal stuff.

title: Go Rally
description: With loads of tracks, cars, a career mode, multiplayer time challenges and an awesome track creator, Go Rally is the only rally game you'll ever need! Draw a line on your screen, tap the 'race' icon, and instantly drive your very own track! Add hills, bridges, checkpoints, trackside banners, houses and terrain - create the circuit of your dreams, then share on-line and challenge your friends, and the world, to beat your times.

title: MythForce
description: Inspired by beloved 80s cartoons, MythForce unites swords & sorcery with gripping 1st-person combat in a roguelite adventure fit for Saturday mornings. Brave the dungeon alone or join forces with friends to take on an ever-changing Castle of Evil!

title: Death Drive
description: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.

title: Hot Lap League
description:
Take complete control of your vehicle, perfect your driving, and prove your place in the Hot Lap League. Drift and race your car around 150+ mind blowing tracks, each requiring unique techniques and strategies. Improving your time by racing your best is the only way to the top.
It’s you, the track and the clock - no driving assist, no nonsense.

title: Make a Good Mega Man Level: Episode Zero
description: MaGMML: Episode Zero, an interquel set between the events of MaGMML1 and MaGMML2, is a massive collaboration fangame brought to you by the team behind the MaGMML series! Play as the legendary (?) Reploid (?) Zero as he journeys through over 60 different levels from 40 different creators in a unique blend of Mega Man Classic, X, Zero, and ZX! Blast through levels with the aimable Z-Buster, the trusty Z-Saber, the long-range Z-Burst, and the wildcard Blank Drive, all backed by an expanded version of the elemental chip system from the Zero series.

title: Convenience Stories
description:
Are you ready to redefine convenience?
Step into the shoes of a convenience store manager in this charming business sim. Arrange and customize the store using a wide variety of products - candy, drinks, even hot meals. The choice is yours!
It takes care and attention to take your business to the next level. Listen to your customers, help them find what they're looking for, and they might just become regular shoppers!
When the time comes to expand, cooperation is the name of the game. Negotiate with suppliers and other companies to discover new products and unlock your store's true potential!

title: M.Duck
description:
M.Duck is a roguelite gallery shooter about a duck that knows magic.
Help Magic Duck fight his way up the mysterious tower that has been shining light on his pond each night and interrupting his sleep. Battle fearsome foes, discover new relics, uncover the secrets of the tower, and turn off that light once and for all!

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 13
description: Help run Pinecreek Hills and New England’s Minuteman Valley Help the famous Park Rangers run Pinecreek Hills. Have fun organizing events on Bluewaters lake, Cherokee river and Apache trail.

title: Vaultbreakers
description: Vaultbreakers is a top-down high-stakes adventure Action RPG. Fight challenging bosses in heroic brawler combat. Explore a dynamic world that reacts to your actions. Reclaim lost relics and escape! Play solo or with friends in savage PvE & PvPvE modes.

title: Calm Colors
description:
