In the game you will find 200 low poly illustrations to fill (animals, nature, origami and more), solo mode with hours of soothing gameplay, up to 4 players local co-op mode, a simple and enjoyable way to reduce anxiety and train mindfulness

Discover your inner artist by playing Calm Colors.

title: Hearts of Demons: Revenant
description: Hearts of Demon is a compilation of wads allowing you to play as various demons: Baron of Hell, or Revenant. Hearts of Demon features new weapons and player models, as well as many demonic abilities to use.

title: Areigna Tactics
description:
Areigna Tactics is a top-down hex based strategy game taking place in the world of Areigna, a fantasy world of Humans, Goblins, Dwarfs, and much more. Play in this multiplayer real time strategy game online in ranked matches with people all around the world.

Unlike many strategy games which are based on resources held and build times, Areigna’s gameplay and balance focuses instead on cooldowns. These cooldowns vary across different units, and their attack and movement. You will need to balance these cooldowns and constraints in your building of new units, as well in the actions you command your units making their way to the enemy nexus.

title: Fueled Up
description: Fueled Up is a chaotic couch co-op spaceship recovery game for up to four players. You and your crewmates must fuel, fix and rescue damaged spaceships before the evil space octopus gets its tentacles on them!

title: AOFrost
description:
AOFrost is a server based on "Argentum Online"
With more than 13 uninterrupted years in its development.
Enter a world full of adventures and become the best!

title: Dastardly
description: A frenetic local multiplayer arena combat game for 1-4 players. Jump, dash, and shoot your way to victory, making use of an array of powerups like shields, cloaks, and jetpacks.

title: Animal Crusaders
description: Crusade to distant lands and fight your friends in this chaotic 4 player skill based brawler or play survival alone. Defeat players and AI in order to unlock unique projectiles, weapons, magic, and cosmetics. Use spacing and custom loadouts to defeat your foes in battle.

title: PongBreak
description: Clean up the scattered programmable matter in a fun and challenging tennis like format. Multiple control schemes allow for casual or precise gameplay.

title: Honey Homer
description: Hit Homer to reach quota!

title: One Hell of a Week
description: A 18+ Yuri romance Visual Novel taking place in a tropical paradise. Oh, and there's Satan.

title: Melty Blood: Type Lumina - Mario Playable Character
description: This will add “Additional Character - Mario” to Melty Blood: Type Lumina.

title: Melty Blood: Type Lumina - Powered Ciel Playable Character
description: This will add “Additional Character - Powered Ciel” to Melty Blood: Type Lumina.

title: American Truck Simulator 2022
description: American Truck Driving Simulator 2022 with Cargo Truck Game Get ready for new, offline, and free truck driving simulator in cargo truck game creator of gaming engine.

title: Invasion of the Zombie Monsters
description: Invasion of the Zombie Monsters is an arcade-platformer in wich you take control of Ned, who must try to save the world from the zombie hordes and take back his girlfriend!

title: Chester's Revenge
description: Take control of Chester the pig as you avenge your herd and set out to retrieve the Sacred Carrot. Armed only with his trusty hand cannon, Chester must battle his way through Rad Ralph’s lieutenants in an over-the-top style revenge romp to reclaim the Carrot and stop Rad Ralph from world domination.

title: Reversilly
description: Reversilly is a new type of real time chaos action game! that combines the familiar game of "Reversi" with real-time action elements.

title: Detective Barbie 2: The Vacation Mystery
description: Detective Barbie 2 is primarily an adventure game where Barbie explores the inn and surrounding areas, such as the greenhouse and the lighthouse. Further, the inn was constructed by an eccentric inventor who built all kinds of secret passages and other surprises into the location. Find and use items, leverage your high-tech gadgets, interview the people who work at the inn, and solve the mystery.

title: Demon Turf: Neon Splash
description: Demon Turf is back and better than ever! Join Beebz in this neon lit adventure where speedy platforming reigns supreme!

title: Nomad Survival
description: Battle against hordes of enemies, conquer Boss encounters, and explore various character and skill combinations in this time-based auto-attacking Roguelite in your quest to become stronger and defeat the most menacing of creatures that lay in wait at the end of each run.

title: Mearth
description: Seeking revenge and re-establishing the kingdom, Asteria struggles to escape from the land of dark beings. She wants to defeat Dragos and reunite with her father and her former kingdom.Join this game full of high graphics.İt's a story mode single player RPG game.

title: Emorrior
description: Emorrior is rogue-like dungeon crawler about the struggles in your own life. Where you must assemble your own army of positive emotions to conquer all the bad thoughts that try to ruin your day. Fight, Collect and Survive, seize that happy ending you know you deserve.

title: 3D Puzzle: Farm House
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Ai-(Onic)
description: Fight your friends as a small robot tank and get an outlet for your emotions by destroying your friend's buildings.

title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
description: The Jaws of the Lion DLC is the digital adaptation of the eponymous board game and expansion to Gloomhaven the critically acclaimed grim Tactictal RPG. Recruit 4 exclusive mercenaries and explore a new side of the world of Gloomhaven through an arching story filled with new enemies and bosses.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Dynasties of India
description: This expansion brings three new civilizations of India plus three full new campaigns to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition for the first time.

title: Bitch Hell
description:
Alex is a girl plagued by constant nightmares of flesh, rust and grime.
Fight your way through the night as you spiral into... Bitch Hell.

title: Arcade Archives: The Legend Of Valkyrie
description: The Legend Of Valkyrie is an action game released by Namco in 1989. Valkyrie No Bouken features the popular Valkyrie once again, for an even higher-power adventure! When the seeds of gold are watered by the northern spring, a miracle will spring forth in the doomed land.

title: Aerinde
description: Ærinde is a first person point and click adventure game, created by Cloak and Dagger Games for AdventureJam 2016.

title: Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare
description: Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare is an interactive horror graphic adventure, with the direction and script of Ruggero Deodato. Take control of different characters in a desperate expedition to the virgin jungles of Borneo.

title: I Love Food
description:
Play as a hungry seagull and uncover tantalizing culinary creations across dozens of puzzle stages, each with unique layouts and some light platforming for our fearless fowl to navigate! Grab your ball and throw it at the stacks above you.

If you match 3 or more, the connected orbs will come tumbling down to reveal a part of the image beneath. Be careful, though! The ceiling slowly creeps downward, threatening to crush you under the remaining orbs if you’re not fast enough.

title: SpaceSlog
description:
SpaceSlog is a challenging sci-fi spaceship simulator that focuses on shipbuilding, crew interaction, and exploration. Inspired by games such as Rimworld, Starship Theory, Dwarf Fortress and X-COM, as well as iconic media such as Firefly, Battlestar Galactica, Stargate Universe and The Expanse.

Your colony ship has been destroyed. Fortunately, a few survivors managed to escape on a small ship. Now alone, hungry, and lost in space, you must explore the cosmos and guide them to safety.

title: I H8 Ur Face
description: Want to slap the sh*t out of someone but don't want to do time for it? Load an image of the poor bastard on to the dummy and release your rage!

title: The Oracle Land
description: "The Oracle Land" is a 3D fantasy MMOARPG, set in the magnificent story, enjoy a journey of mission in the western fantasy world.

title: Planet Omnia
description: Welcome to Planet Omnia! A multiplayer sandbox game with a focus on exploration, secrets and having fun with your friends!

title: The Vaults
description: The Vaults is a turn-based RPG card game where you will engage with creatures and beings of other worlds, Explore powerful scrolls and weapons, find treasures, learn abilities, and upgrade your keepers to save the mysterious world of Alexandria!

title: Matchmension: House of Mist
description: Matchmension: House of Mist congratulates you as the chosen winner of the royal lottery! Your prize: Mist Mansion! But the mansion has been left in terrible shape and the estate is in dire need of repairs. Direct your own robot butler and harness the power of mysterious stars to fuel your creative endeavor. Renovate and restore Mist Mansion to its former glory in Matchmension: House of Mist!

title: NeonLore
description: Discover the future...

title: Magi: Mind Game
description: Magi: Mind Game takes the essential elements of a fighting game and turns it into an easy to learn difficult to master turn based strategy game. Focus on manipulating and predicting to outsmart your opponent. No need to memorize combos and difficult controls.

title: Nonogram Minimal
description: Enjoy 200 hand-crafted puzzles, share and play user-made levels!

title: Seashells
description: A short first-person horror exploration game that takes around 20-30 minutes to finish.

title: ARCA Sim Racing X
description: ARCA Sim Racing X (ASRX) is sim racing game that was created after updates to the XPatch were abandoned. ARCA Sim Racing X (ASRX) combines the original ARCA08 stock car with the TSF Trucks and other mods from Community members and make a stand alone game to accessible and include multiple class to race in Oval track.

title: Pokémon Sigma Platinum
description: Pokémon Sigma Platinum is a ROM Hack/Mod of Pokemon Brilliant Diamond & Shining Pearl to recreate the events and gameplay of a Game Freak-styled Platinum remake, as opposed to ILCA's remakes.

title: Suddenly Meow 2
description: In the second part of the fantastical Match3 game, Tim the cat is hungry for more adventure! Lord Devious broke free from the seal of the fairies and now his ominous shadow is threatening the peace of the forest. Help Tim use his meowtastic skills to save the fairies!

title: Idle Business Tycoon: Build Simulator
description: Expand and grow! The possibilities are plenty in Idle Business Tycoon - Build Simulator Build. Earn money to unlock new establishments and expand your business all over town. The more you build, the more money you make!

title: Loony
description: Loony is a multiplayer strategy, role-playing and thriller where one player takes on the role of the killer and kills those who try to escape from the map, and other players try to escape the map by finding the killer or completing missions.

title: ARCA Sim Racing 08'
description: ARCA Sim Racing is a stock-car racing simulator that focus on 2008 ARCA RE/MAX season that happen on OVAL and road courses.

title: Isle of Arrows
description: Build an impenetrable fortress, tile by tile. Place buildings, build roads, and expand your isle to defend against waves of invaders in this roguelike fusion of tower defense and board game.

title: Bacteriophage
description: Bacteriophage Roguelike Platformer takes place inside the body of someone with many bacterial infections. You play as a cyborg named Terri (“like bacteria”), with a gun that shoots bacteriophage DNA-infused bullets. Your job is to make your way through this human body and destroy any and all bacteria and infections that stand in your way.

title: GrimGrimoire OnceMore
description: GrimGrimoire OnceMore is a real-time strategy video game developed by Vanillaware and published by Nippon Ichi Software.

title: Trails of Illusion
description: This is a JRPG free-to-play fan game with reference to the Falcom Trails series, and the battle mode is turn-based combat.

title: Smoking Snakes
description: In Smoking Snakes you are part of the Brazilian Expeditionary Force (B.E.F) fighting Axis in Italian territory during World War II.

title: Time is Solid Here
description:
A long, yellow hallway. A floating head who talks of monster trucks and places in-between. A painting, three a plenty, each with someone in need of moving on.

Such is the horror puzzle game, Time is Solid Here, recently selected for the Goethe-Institut's Stillstand/Standstill Project Exhibition.

title: Jaded
description: Jaded ﻿is a large ﻿﻿dark techbase slaughtermap by lunchlunch influenced by Fractured Worlds, Miasma, Magnolia, Abandon, Occula, and Newt. It was a runner-up at the 2023 Cacowards.

title: Still Heroes
description: A digital comic about the story of Emeline. She tries to live her dream of being a superheroine after her friends decided to change their career paths. A gentle and moving story, drawn by hand.

title: Axolotl is Dry
description: Axolotl is Dry is a precision platforming game where you play as a little axolotl taken from his home. You'll need to jump, dash and slide your way through the harsh desert before you sweat yourself dry. Help the axolotl get to his home!

title: Gold Wiper
description: Gold Wiper is an arcade game like Qix and Gals Panic. If you delete the screen and restore the hidden picture, you will be rewarded incomparably with Qix and Gals Panic.

title: N-Age
description: Live as one of the young cyberspace character inside the world of N-Age and discover the secrets and story behind it. Build communities, fight other schools and prove your mettle. Fight the crippling darkness and evil that wants to throw the civilization into disarray once more.

title: Cozy Grove: New Neighbears
description: Word of your legendary scouting deeds has spread throughout the spirit world... and that means more ghosts want your help. The "New Neighbears DLC" adds four new ghost bears, each featuring lengthy personal stories and no long waits between their requests.

title: 4D Chess
description: VR Chess that isn't flat. Move up and down, between levels, and attack from all directions. All the pieces you know with extra moves that add interesting complexity. Several different volumes to choose from ranging from 4x4x4 to 8x8x8. 4d checkers, 3d chess and checkers are included.

title: Bomberman Online Japan
description: An online Bomberman released only in Japan for PC.

title: Unsolved Riddles
description:
This bundle includes:

- 9 Clues: The Secret of Serpent Creek

- Ghost Files: Memory of a Crime

- Noir Chronicles: City of Crime

title: Pixel Game Maker Series Dandan Z
description: The sixth installment in the fictional "Game Buddy" portable game console series! Play against a total of 10 characters!

title: Get Packed: Couch Chaos
description: Get Packed: Couch Chaos is the expanded edition of the couch co-op removals game that’s full of calamity and physics-based carnage for 1-4 players, and it’s now on Nintendo Switch!

title: Confined with Goddesses
description: Confined with Goddesses is a light-hearted story based on hentai culture, in its "funny" aspect.

title: Cook Serve Forever
description: Cook your way through the bustling solarpunk city of Helianthus as Nori Kaga, a food cart chef aspiring to make it big like her role model, the Culinary Queen herself, Chef Rhubarb.

title: JellyCar Worlds
description:
JellyCar Worlds is a return to the classic softbody platforming series JellyCar, set to release 11 years after the last game in the series; JellyCar 3.
JellyCar Worlds is similar to the classic trilogy, with a variety of platforming challenges you must overcome as a car made from "jelly." Worlds introduces its titular feature, worlds, with an overworld level for each world.

title: Ten Tales from the Record of the Adamant Gambit
description: This anthology of ten short slice-of-life games explores life aboard a generation starship, originally made over ten days in December 2021 for the Variety Megajam.

title: Kirigirisou
description:
The main character is a completely normal student with nothing unusual about them. They get lost one night while returning home, left driving in a dense forest. Vision still obscured, they meet the mysterious beautiful girl Kirigiri Kyouko, and give her a ride.
However, after getting into an accident, the two of them take refuge in a nearby Western-style house. That house is in fact where Kirigiri had been headed, but with a huge tree growing inside, it’s a bizarre place.
The heroes are assaulted by a creepy Western-style suit of armor, a skull buried in the garden, and a girl who’s just like Kirigiri Kyouko…
You are the protagonist. Can you solve the mystery of the house and escape from this strange place?

title: Concrete Crown
description:
BEWARE THE MACHINES
THEY VOMIT SHADOWS

title: Edrick's Conquest
description: Edrick's Conquest is an isometric open world Action RPG featuring unique gameplay, charming environments & competitive play. Explore Plesmur, a high fantasy world, on your own or with your allies.

title: Paranoiac: Remake Version
description: Paranoiac is a freeware horror adventure game by Uri made in WOLF RPG Editor.

title: Numlock
description: A mathematics based timed puzzler where you have to match numbers before being grabbed by a creeping hand. Calculate before you get caught in this endless game!

title: Star Tetrinomino
description: Match stars in a row to clear them before time runs out.

title: Definitely Poker
description: A followup to 'Probably Poker'. This game plays like a normal round of video Poker with a twist. Play against the dealer for a highscore but have control over what they can't get via trump cards. Can you stack the deck in your favor?

title: Bananab!!
description: An obstacle course game for two players -- with a twist! Contestants start on opposite ends of a single race track, one moving forward, the other backward in time.

title: Don't Be Afraid: The First Toy
description: Don't Be Afraid - The First Toy, is an introduction to the dramatic story of a boy kidnapped by a psychopath. Exploring the giant house of your torturer you will soon discover things worse than your childish nightmares. Take on the role of Jamie and see what phrase “The First Toy” actually means.

title: Jim's Adventure
description:
Jim's Adventure is a game where you need to follow Jim, the Native American in an exciting and challenging adventure. He is exploring a large world filled with perils, ranging from various creatures to obstacles, all trying to stop him. There are a multitude of levels to complete and Jim has a very limited amount of lives.

Every level has its fair share of challenges, and there are multiple game worlds ranging from haunted forests to deserts, caves and many others.

title: Camper Van Simulator
description: Get out of your house and begin the adventure today. Feel the summer breeze and prepare for a fun ride!

title: ABC Search with Me
description: Discover new words and learn foreign languages in a fast, easy and fun way!

title: Annie's Millions: A Hidden Object Shopping Spree!
Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood Champion of Gaia Edition
description:
You are Cahal, a powerful Garou who chose to go into exile after losing control of his destructive rage. On his quest for redemption and blood, Cahal plays a crucial role in the great war between the Garous and Endron, a powerful oil company that serves the Wyrm, whose destruction is ravaging the planet.
He can transform into a wolf and a Crinos, a huge ferocious beast.
Each form has its advantages: the wolf can sneak around undetected, Cahal as a human can interact with other people, and the Werewolf can unleash its rage to tear enemies apart.

The Champion of Gaia edition includes:
- Full game
- 3 outfits for Cahal
- 4 exclusive furs for the Wolf and Werewolf
- A nature spirit to help you in combat
- A unique finishing move

title: Labyrinths of the World: Secrets of Easter Island
description: What starts as a relaxing getaway quickly takes a disastrous turn as your world is attacked by an ancient god and their stone statues! Can you stop the destruction before it's too late?

title: Labyrinths of the World: Secrets of Easter Island - Collector's Edition
description: What starts as a relaxing getaway quickly takes a disastrous turn as your world is attacked by an ancient god and their stone statues! Can you stop the destruction before it's too late?

title: Ayleouna
description: Take Ayleouna on an asteroid hopping adventure in this action platformer with gravity bending elements.

title: Profound Red
description: Profound Red is the twelfth game in the Carol Reed series. In the title Carol is contacted by her friend Stina. The hotel she works at received a suicide note through a text message from a woman called Louise Elliot, but no one knows the connection to the hotel. Carol investigates in Norrköping to find out who she is and whether there is any suicide involved at all. The game uses its trademark first-person view with photographs of real locations and objects in a fixed-screen slideshow style. There are puzzles to solve with items stored in an inventory near the top of the screen. A journal is used to keep track of objectives. Optionally hints can be activated or all hotspots can be revealed. As a long-running series, some locations are revisited in an updated way as life goes on and there is a cast of new and recurring characters. No knowledge of previous games in required to play.

title: The Birdwatcher
description: The Birdwatcher is the thirteenth game in the Carol Reed series. Set in Sweden in the summer, Carol has been down with the flu. She is contacted by Immodia, a character from a previous game Profound Red, because her future husband Henrik, a recent widower, has disappeared. She wants Carol to help her track him down. The game uses its trademark first-person view with photographs of real locations and objects in a fixed-screen slideshow style. There are puzzles to solve with items stored in an inventory near the top of the screen. A journal is used to keep track of objectives.

title: The Fall of April
description: The Fall of April is the fourteenth game in the Carol Reed series. Set in Sweden Carol helps her friend Andrea who suffers from temporary memory loss induced by a drug. Soon it turns out this event is not only tied to the unresolved murder of Andrea's daughter two years before, but also to a Swedish Arctic balloon expedition in 1915. The game uses its trademark first-person view with photographs of real locations and objects in a fixed-screen slideshow style. There are puzzles to solve with items stored in an inventory near the top of the screen. A journal is used to keep track of objectives.

title: Geospots
description: Geospots is the fifteenth first-person point-and-click adventure game in the Carol Reed series, once again chronicling the adventures of the crime-solving British expat in Sweden. This time, Carol must solve the disappearance of a friend-of-a-friend by retracing their steps, made both easier and more difficult by the fact that cryptic clues to their recent activities abound, thanks to their geocaching hobby.

title: Amos Green's Final Repose
description: Amos Green's Final Repose is the 17th adventure of Carol Reed by MDNA, a young woman from England living in Sweden. Carol is contacted by her best friend Stina, because her contact infos were found on a dead man, whose body was discovered in a newly reopened part of a natural reserve. She doesn't know him, so Carol is tasked to find the connection...

title: Spooky Waltz
description: Halloween is here! It's time for the annual Halloween Ball on Halloween Town! Join KaraMaple and Punkpin as they prepare themselves for the most important night of the Year! Get your moves ready, tune your hear for the beat, and prepare to battle a legion of Cursed Candieswhile you dance to the spooky beat. Protect your festival from the Old Geezer Gang and drive them off Halloween Town, assuring the spookier festival ever!

title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed
description:
Star Wars: The Force Unleashed completely re-imagines the scope and scale of the Force and casts players as Darth Vader’s "Secret Apprentice," unveiling new revelations about the Star Wars galaxy seen through the eyes of a mysterious new character armed with unprecedented powers.

The Switch version is a port of the Wii version with numerous differences. It retains the motion controls from the Wii version, allowing players to use the Joy-Con controllers to perform various actions like swinging the lightsaber and using Force powers. While the graphical improvements are minor, it benefits from a stable 60 FPS performance, an improvement over some older versions with frame rate issues. This version includes the Jedi Temple missions, originally DLC on other platforms. However, some iconic moments from the Xbox 360 and PS3 versions, like bringing down a Star Destroyer with the Force, are simplified or presented as cutscenes. It includes a local multiplayer mode, a feature in the Wii version. Players can customize their lightsaber with different colors, hilts, and combat crystals, though some specific features from other versions, like the unstable kyber crystal, are not present

title: Parallel Lab
description: A two-player cooperative puzzle adventure, that is all about communication. Players have to follow parallel paths, explore a secret laboratory, describe what they see, and work together to unravel the mystery. Parallel Lab is played on two devices with a browser.

title: Snow Bros.: Nick & Tom Special
description: One day, the peaceful country of Snow Land is suddenly invaded by King Artich of Kingdom Hotteda Kingdom! The twin princes of Snow Land, Nick, and Tom try to stop him, but in turn, are transformed into snowmen by the curse of King Artich. The twin princesses, Puripuri and Puchipuchi are abducted and Snow Land began melting down and disappearing. Nick and Tom start their long journey to regain peace in Snow Land, rescue the princesses and lift the curse.

title: Hidden Through Time: Definitive Edition
description: Hidden Through Time: Definitive Edition promises light-hearted puzzling fun for all ages and even the entire family! It is a cute hide-and-seek/hidden object game with objects taken from different fantastical eras of our world’s history – from missing dinosaur eggs to ancient Egypt and the Wild, Wild West. It is the first hidden object game with dynamic, bubbling, and colorful hand-drawn & animated levels.

title: Final Vendetta: Super Limited Edition
description:
Final Vendetta is a hard-hitting action packed beat ‘em up for 1 or 2 players in the vein of classic arcade titles. Featuring stunning pixel art and a thumping soundtrack with exclusive tracks from Utah Saints! Brawl with bad dudes and tough girls as you fight through dangerous environments.

The Super Limited Edition of Final Vendetta includes:
- Box contents
- Game: Final Vendetta
- Deck of 32 Collectible Character Cards
- Original Soundtrack
- A4 landscape Artbook
- A3 Poster
- Barrel USB
- A radical “Bin Chicken” sticker!

title: My Universe: Green Adventure - Farmer Friends
description:
Become an environmentally friendly farmer! Explore your farm's surroundings, clear your overgrown fields and find a new way to fertilize your crops. Roll up your sleeves and get ready to dig and water your crops regularly to reap the fruits of your labor. Be sure to follow the complete production cycle of a green farmer! Every day is an adventure thanks to the different quests.
Make some animal friends! During your adventure, you will be in charge of the entire farmyard, cows, hens, goats, sheep, ducks, and more. You'll have to renovate various buildings to home your new companions. Care for them, show them plenty of affection and have fun with them thanks to the many mini games.
Meet the villagers' needs! The further you progress in your adventure, the larger your choice of seeds will get. Flowers, fruits and vegetables, pay close attention to the villagers' orders to be sure to meet their needs. With a little creativity you will improve your recipes and create new flavors for your yogurts, jams, etc. It's up to you to show off your local production and your traditional recipes to the village's inhabitants!

title: 2901 Freelancer
description:
Experience daily life in bustling Prodcity #2901 in year 2901! Trashy cyberpunk sim -time/mood management!

Scavenge, work, sell drugs, freelance and make ends meet any way you can to find a way to survive.

title: Illuvium
description:
Step into the adrenaline-fueled Arena, where strategy and action converge. Whether facing the relentless waves of Illuvials in the Survival Arena or outwitting foes in competitive duels in the Ascendant Arena.

Illuvium: Overworld will be an expansive third-person RPG set within a diverse and dynamic open world. Across this alien terrain, mystical creatures lurk—each with potent abilities. Craft gear to explore, collect precious resources, and empower your team. Every decision shapes your path, carving out your legacy in the wilds of an alien world.

title: Duskworld
description: Duskworld is a retro-styled first-person shooter video game, set in the fictitious rural town of Dusk, Pennsylvania. Players will engage into action where they must survive and find the exit of the level while surviving all hazards on the way. You'll come across different horrendous opponents such as demonic livestock, robed cultists, sentient scarecrows, and possessed soldiers. You have a variety of powerful weapons at your disposal. The game also has a multiplayer option and an online deathmatch mode which supports up to 16 players. Gather your friends and head-up for the challenge. Will you survive?

title: Falcon Beertender
description:
Falcon Beertender is a Swedish freeware game by E-Game and a promotional tie-in with Falcon Brewery. It is a remake of Tapper with the same objective, to serve your customers a mug of beer each.

Falcon Beertender enhances the gameplay of Tapper in two ways. First, your customers can sometimes be very thirsty: they will toss back an empty beer mug for you to fill. You'll have to catch those mugs and pass them more beer. Secondly, breaking a (glass) mug also costs you a life, so you must make sure that you're not tossing more beer mugs than necessary, lest they crash into a back wall.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Special Edition
description: A collector's version of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 which contains a steelbook and a collection of art from the game.

title: Rogue Door Defense
description: Rogue Door Defense is a tower defense mazing game with rouge-lite elements. Choose a door, defeat the enemies behind it and claim your unique reward. Build and upgrade different towers. Design your own maze to defend your lives against the attacking waves of monsters and powerful bosses.

title: Walkabout Mini Golf: Myst
description: Putt through the surreal world that defined adventure games. Myst island—the starkly beautiful setting tinged with mystery and shrouded in intrigue. Challenge yourself and your friends to unlock 18 easy and 18 hard mode holes, each a puzzle unto themselves. Rediscover the best-selling computer game of the 20th century, and the island that invented an entire genre.

title: World of Warcraft: Dragonflight
description:
The dragonflights of Azeroth have returned, called upon to defend their ancestral home, the Dragon Isles. Surging with elemental magic and the life energies of Azeroth, the Isles are awakening once more, and it's up to you to explore their primordial wonder and discover long-forgotten secrets.
Master the art of Dragonriding, with a new form of aerial movement, venture into the ancient prison of the Primal Incarnates before their malevolent power can be unleashed against the Dragon Aspects in the new raid.
Fight to reclaim Neltharus, stronghold of the black dragonflight, explore previously unknown chambers of Uldaman, defend the Life Pools of the red dragonflight, and more! In new dungeons!

title: Walkabout Mini Golf: Jim Henson's Labyrinth
description: Explore the world inhabited by creatures, faeries, goblins, and iconic scenes so memorably brought to life by Jim Henson’s 1986 classic film with a dazzling mini golf course of fantasy and adventure! Walkabout Mini Golf: Labyrinth is a vivid, challenging, character-filled, and richly realized course for players where they can escape, explore, and play solo or rendezvous with up to four other players for 18 easy mode and 18 hard mode holes—complete with realistic physics, and beloved creatures from the film. Master the course, collect 18 special lost balls, and follow the clues of the Labyrinth-themed “fox hunt” scavenger expedition as well as expansive mazes and gardens to discover.

title: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Classic
description: The Lich King's forces await you in the icy continent of Northrend. World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Classic is coming, and with it another chance to relive the legend and face one of Azeroth's greatest villains.

title: Maniac Mansion Deluxe
description: Maniac Mansion Deluxe is a 1:1 remake of the original "Maniac Mansion" on 256-colour. Sandy, girlfriend of the games' hero Dave has been kidnapped by evil scientist Dr. Fred Edison. So Dave has to gather two friends around him and go to the old mansion to rescue her.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog Forever
description: Based on the recent decompilation of the mobile version, Sonic the Hedgehog Forever adds a number of abilities, options, and game modes to enhance the experience and celebrate the replayability of the game.

title: Sunky.Mpeg
description: A funky parody of Sonic.exe in which Sunky gathers all his friends to dance!

title: Supertan Marioner 3D Infinity World Adventures
description: The adventures of Super marioner continue. This time with 3D design. Travel through the jungle with marioner. Jump between platforms. Try not to fall in this endless speeding adventure. You have 3 rights. Try to make the highest record

title: F1 22
description: Race the stunning, new cars of the Formula 1 2022 season with the authentic lineup of all 20 drivers and 10 teams, and take control of your race experience with new immersive or cinematic race sequences. Test your skills around the new Miami International Autodrome, and get a taste of the glitz and glamour in F1 Life. Create a team and take them to the front of the grid with new depth in the acclaimed My Team career mode, race head-to-head in split-screen or multiplayer, or change the pace by taking supercars from some of the sport’s biggest names to the track.

title: Super Sus
description: Join the next level of 3D Among Us game - Super Sus: Who is the Imposter! The best free mobile game to social with local friends and those from worldwide offers you an unique experience to be space crews, who struggles to prevent the spaceship from crashing while for imposters, killing crew mates is all they want.

title: Dark Swords Firelink
description: Dark Swords: Fire link is a 2D metroidvania game with a large locations to explore, fight with a lot creatures and epic bosses, and greats skills and power-ups to acquire. Have some of the better features that defines the 8/16-bits era, games like Ninja Gaiden, Super Ghost and Ghouls, Megaman, Castlevania and Super Metroid. Also, it gets inspired by the Dark Souls series, Hollow Knight and Blasphemous.

title: Breeze in the Clouds
description: Become a force of nature in a stylish, combo-fueled 2D action-adventure! Jump, brawl, and command the powers of weather as Breeze, a scrappy and courageous corgi swept away from his regular life to fight pollution in a fantastic world in the clouds where animal forces control the weather.

title: Bugaboo Pocket
description:
Bugaboo Pocket is a virtual pet game starring bugs from land, air and sea!

Play as a research scientist living in a cabin with just your bugs and a penpal for company. Spoil them with pets, minigames, food and furniture.

Raise and release bugs to help Beetleback Ridge recover from a devastating fire.

title: NFL Pro Era
description: The first fully licensed NFL football simulation game made for virtual reality headsets.

title: Retro64
description: A mod which adds Mario from Super Mario 64, complete with all his abilities and physics, to Minecraft. This mod needs both Minecraft and Super Mario 64.

title: Square Runner
description:
Square Runner is a fast-paced platformer where you try to go back to your home planet with the side effect of saving earth.
Will you return home or will you be stuck on earth forever? Form a squad, explore the unknown Adamian archipelago and fight creatures in Square Runner

title: Saleblazers
description: Embark on an epic adventure across the lands as a humble shopkeeper. Build your shop exactly the way you want it, sell goods from your travels, and defend your base from nightly horrors in this open world shopkeeping RPG for 1-8 players!

title: Football Manager
description: The first football management simulator, many of the hallmarks of the incredibly complex games which exist in this genre today are found in embryonic form here. Club finances, player transfers, basic tactics, and perhaps most importantly of all, excellent white noise crowd sounds when your team scored.

title: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Limited Steelbook Edition
description:
Experience Lara Croft's defining moment.

As Lara Croft races to save the world from a Maya apocalypse, she must become the Tomb Raider she is destined to be.

Become the Tomb Raider

Limited Steelbook Edition includes;
- Shadow of the Tomb Raider (the game)
- A steelbook
- Three art cards.

title: Velone
description:
Velone is a creative automation game inspired by the classic Opus Magnum.

On the mysterious planet Velone, aliens have tasked you with saving their dying home. A collision with an asteroid has disrupted the entire energy supply. Now it is your job to build and program hydraulic mechanisms that create and place valuable Velone stones, restoring power to a civilization in peril.

Use logical thinking to solve difficult mechanical puzzles and come up with new and creative ways to program the Velone stones and beat every level. Enjoy the endorphin rush when constructs execute your plan flawlessly and everything slots into place in one fluid series of motions.

Each solved level rewards you with new information about the planet Velone, its climate, population, technology, society and more.

title: The Pigeon P
description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Donate gifts to the incoming drivers with our here of the game The Pigeon P.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2: Absolute
description: A mod for the Sonic the Hedgehog 1/2 2013 Decompilation which has included bug fixes, extra options and abilities that are new to even the mobile ports. Arcade Mode has been added to the game modes menu. Ring Chain has been implemented and Knuckles and Tails are now available to play as a pair.

title: F1 22: Champions Edition
description:
The Champions Edition includes:
- Limited-Time Bonus: Miami-Themed Content Pack
- 3 days Early Access
- F1 Life Starter Pack
- F1 22 New Era Content
- New My Team Icons
- 18,000 PitCoin

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 16
description: Season 16 includes weapon balancing, a trip back to the smugglers' isle, a new ranked season and more!

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 17
description: A new weapon, the return to Sanhok's former glory, new items hitting ranked games and more in Season 17 of PUBG: Battlegrounds!

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Demon Veil
description: Rainbow Six Siege introduces the first season of Year 7, Demon Veil! It features Azami, a new Defender from Japan, a brand new map, a permanent game mode: Team Deathmatch, and more. Azami can shut down sightlines, block off entry points, and create entirely new angles of defense all with a flick of her wrist.

title: Ukrainian Farmy
description:
In Ukrainian Farmy you become one of the scariest combatants on the Ukrainian battlefield - the Ukrainian tractor driver.

It is an arcade game where you challenge yourself against time and "high-precision" artillery bombardments, and capture as many Russian tanks, trucks, and APCs as you can.

title: Rocket Arena: Season 4
description: New Blast Pass, New Map, and More!

title: For Honor: Season 20 - Frozen Shores
description:
The rise of the waters during the Tempest and the subsequent winter allowed seafaring pirates passage to the frozen shores of Heathmoor. These pirates had no allegiance to any faction – they only cared about treasure. In their pursuit of wealth, they began trading with the people, offering warriors access to new weapons from across the sea.

Take your character through a journey of 100 Tiers of rewards for all heroes! Available during For Honor: Frozen Shores only.

title: For Honor: Season 21 - Golden Age
description:
New visitors from far away have unveiled the lost reliquary of Wyverndale. Now, treasures long forgotten have been made available to warriors once more. From the ancient past of Heathmoor comes old weapons that once again glisten in the light of day. Arm yourself with the blades of Heathmoor’s original warriors, and fight like the forebears of old.

Take your character on a quest back to the Golden Age with 100 Tiers of rewards for all heroes! Available during For Honor: Golden Age only.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Paragons
description: Take on a brand new Seasonal Campaign inspired by the legendary wars and heroes of Medieval France. Begin your campaign in the starting region of the Borderlands, and keep the Loegrians at bay from glorious Pays-de-la-Gloire. Do battle in twice-weekly Territory Wars with your House, complete Stages, and keep the faith during the final struggle in Augolia at the end of the Season.

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 6
description: Adventures abound on the Sea of Thieves! Explore Sea Forts summoned from the Sea of the Damned, engage with Sea of Thieves’ evolving narrative in new Adventures and test your mettle on a new Voyage for Pirate Legends. Enjoy new Seasonal rewards, Trials, Deeds and more too!

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Glitch
description: The Glitch Season brings a new Champion into the fray. It also introduces some really huge changes, including a new lobby where you can choose where you’ll spawn, weapon skins, and a new leveling system.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 1 - Rival Incursion
description: A competitor has made its way to Hoxxes! Miners, let's show them what Deep Rock Galactic is all about!

title: Rocket League: Season 4
description: Season 4 is the eighteenth competitive season in Rocket League and the fourth competitive season after the Free To Play update. The season is western-themed, which is reflected in the accompanying Rocket Pass items and Deadeye Canyon arena. The Rocket Pass features the Outlaw car body.

title: Rocket League: Season 5
description: Season 5 is the nineteenth competitive season in Rocket League and the fifth competitive season after the Free To Play update. The season is space-themed, which is reflected in the accompanying Rocket Pass items and Starbase ARC (Aftermath) arena. The Rocket Pass features the Nexus car body.

title: Rocket League: Season 6
description: Welcome to the animated world of Rocket League! Season 6 is going off the rails with the addition of an animation-themed rocket pass, a new Neo Tokyo (comic) variant arena, and zany tournament rewards!

title: Speedcat
description: Speedcat is a tiny 2D platformer where you play as a cat trying to pick up all 32 Speedcoins! Run, jump, and use the environment to navigate your way through the map as quickly as possible. Developed on PICO-8 by Fletch, the game is delightfully small and easy to pick up, with an estimated completion time in under an hour.

title: Mouse Maze
description: Navigate mazes with your mouse! Be fast enough to finish the level on time, but be careful not to crash! This game is able to be controlled entirely by mouse alone, no keyboard required! Plenty of settings to customize your experience (adjust difficulty up or down).

title: Phoenix Point: Kaos Engines
description:
Take a drive on the wild side with DLC 5: Kaos Engines. This vehicular focused DLC features a brand new vehicle, the Kaos Buggy, and tons of vehicle customization options for all your existing vehicles, too. Plus, try out new and unpredictable Kaos Tech weaponry: great power, but also great risk!

Of course, DLC 5 also includes new missions, new research, and an all-new marketplace to buy gear and technology.

title: Outriders: Worldslayer
description:
With new horrors to challenge you and new weapons, mods and gear to discover, you’ll be further developing your build through the new PAX hybrid branch class trees.

Survive the campaign and you’ll face even greater horrors in the Trials of Tarya Grata, the brand new endgame. Which partnered with Ascension Points offers a new long term progression system for the most committed players.

Finally, push hard through the new Apocalypse difficulty tiers, with each step up to level 40 increasing the chances of obtaining incredible Apocalypse gear and its game changing third mod slot.

title: Train Simulator Classic
description: Welcome to the ultimate railway hobby! Master complex operations on the DB BR 411 ICE T, BR Class 390 Pendolino, Union Pacific AC4400CW, and more as you explore authentic routes. Whatever you love about trains, Train Simulator Classic lets you take your hobby to the next level.

title: Eyes in the Dark
description: Fight with light against the dark in this “roguelight” platformer starring Victoria Bloom! Drive back the darkness that's overrun Bloom Manor and conquer swarms of creatures as you discover powerful new items to upgrade your arsenal. Are you ready to enter the ever-changing manor?

title: Knockout City: Season 5 - Greatest Hits
description: We’re rolling into a non-stop block of all the chart-topping hits from Year 1 in Knockout City! There are no commercials and no fillers in Season 5: Greatest Hits! We’ve brought back five Playlists you know and love: one every two weeks! Plus, we scrambled up a twist on an old classic for the Mid-Season Event that’ll have you hopping wild. Each Limited-Time event will feature many of the cosmetics, Ultimate Holograms, Intro Poses and MVP Poses that you’ve been waiting for a chance to see in the Shop again, along with unique items that we’re releasing for the first time! There’s never been a better time to experience the best that this City has to offer!

title: Friday Night Funkin': Elements of Insanity
description: Elements of Insanity is an FNF mod based around the many Creepypastas and parodies of My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.

title: Friday Night Funkin' D-Sides
description:
Get funky once more in yet another remix mod. The minds of DastardlyDeacon, PhilipLol, Fifleo and gc present a brand new take on the same ol' story: Friday Night Funkin': D-SIDES

You know the deal. This mod features the whole nine:

- Bangin' remixes.
- Entirely new designs.
- Brand new sprites and icons redrawn from scratch.
- Unique backgrounds and settings.
- Mechanics!
- ORIGINAL SONGS for every 2nd week.
- Unique HUD and UI.
- Mod crossovers!
- thats about it but danm isnt that a lot

Your life is on the line, all for you to date the girl you love. You got what it takes?

title: Monochrome Heaven
description: Monochrome Heaven is a otome visual novel released in 2009.

title: Shooter League: Robot Goal
description: Robot Goal is a multiplayer first-person shooter with a soccer twist!, score goals with your gun to win! Choose one of many champions with each their own abilities! Use your gun or abilities to attack players! Do very accurate passing! Use your gun for defense and more!

title: Snipe Hunt
description:
Snipe Hunt is an ambient horror game that forces you to find clues hidden in a maze to identify and capture a monster.

Explore atmospheric, spooky mazes. Bring tools with you to test evidence scattered throughout the mazes. Uncover the identity of the monster while avoiding becoming its next victim. If you're feeling brave, lay out a trap with the right bait to capture it or escape to hunt another day.

title: Cookie Run: Tower of Adventures
description:
Enjoy exploring every corner of the Pancake Tower with friends in a 3D Cookie action adventure! Work together to defeat challenging bosses!

CookieRun: Tower of Adventures - A Cookie-crisp, Top-down Adventure!
The seal on the oven has broken.
Join GingerBrave and his friends on their epic journey to save the Pancake Tower from evil!

Clear stages to earn sweet equipment and join the Cookies on their adventure as they learn the secrets of what threatens the peace inside the magical tower!

title: Vampire Hurts
description:
Those who live in the world of day under the illumination of the sun are known as humans, while those who rule the world of night under the cloak of shadow are known as vampires. Each race while in seeming opposition to one another, in truth, rely on each other for survival as vampires leech blood off the humans for sustinance and humans rely on the strength received from them to live on the barren land that continues to erode away at the remnants of a once pristine landscape.

Follow the adventure of Touma, last child to the human race, who finds himself caught in the middle of a world ever divided by growing light and darkness soon after his arrival in the creepy and haunted town of Casketville. In a fated encounter with a beautiful vampiress named Stella, the two find themselves undergoing certain physical changes they must counteract while hiding the truth from those around them if they hope to survive!

title: Air Dasher
description: Air Dasher is Fast! Air Dasher is Fluid! Air Dasher is Platformer!

title: An Outcry, Prelude
description:
A 10-minute long alt-literature delivery program.

voices. choices. dust. rust.

title: Attraction Force
description: Attraction Force is a classic arcade-style experience where you have to attract, dodge and destroy all enemies in a level before you move on to the next one. Pull enemies with your magnet gun to stun them, but don't let them touch you!

title: Aventura Copilului Albastru și Urât
description: Dive into a short adventure you'll forget within 30 minutes of closing the game. What are you waiting for? Join the Blue and Ugly Child on an adventure in a peculiar world at night. A 2D visual novel where your choices matter and multiple endings await.

title: Space Genesis
description: Space Genesis is a top down-style action and shooting game with SF-style graphics.

title: Someone Stole My Lunch!
description: A short comedy visual novel about your lunch and a thief... both of which are hot.

title: Escape From Lavender Town
description:
A short game about the missing lavender town frequencies.
Best played with headphones.

Cover art by Ray-girl50.

title: Warframe: Echoes of the Sentient
description: On Uranus, the Tenno encounters strange drones that seem to be looking for something... or someone. Upon scanning them, the Lotus will ask the Tenno for their assistance. Assuming that they are of Corpus origin, Lotus sends the Tenno to Earth to investigate these drones, only to discover an Old War wreckage which heightens her confusion. In an epiphany, the Lotus realizes these drones are Sentient Oculysts, cutting off transmissions immediately with the Tenno. An individual of the Orokin-era, Conclave master Teshin offers his aid to unravel the truth about the mysterious Lotus, suspicious of her true motives.

title: Morse
description:
Break the bitter attrition of the Great War using timing, tactics and telecommunications in Morse.

Before, you relayed messages. Now you're calling the shots. Send co-ordinates for artillery strikes to cut off supply chains, batter trenches and shred recon planes. Between missions, wander the grounds of the manor and get to know the other staff.

title: Present Memories: A Vox Akuma Fangame
description:
Present Memories is a very special project dedicated to the Nijisanji EN's voice demon, Vox Akuma.

In this visual novel adventure game, you play as Vox himself as he explores his memories and leave no stone unturned for an unforgettable experience with his clan of the past.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Online
description: A mod which allows online multiplayer while playing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. This mod needs an application called ModLoader64 to work. It also supports cosmetic and audio mods, as well as specific events and collectibles that can be purchased by using a specific currency called Rubies in Morshu's shop (adapted from the CD-i Zelda games).

title: He-Man
description: Comes with map of Eternia, Versus Fighting mode, shooting/riding stages ( 28 total on map) and Giant Bosses.

title: Power Rangers: Beats of Power
description: Power Rangers: Beats of Power is a FREE fan-made beat-em-up videogame for PC and Mac. It combines aspects of classic Power Rangers video games for the Super Nintendo and Sega Genesis, as well as adding original elements.

title: Golden Axe: The Curse of Death Adder
description:
Death Adder is a sequel to the fourth part of Golden Ax. This is a work made by fans.Very good scenarios and great news in this game. Extremely tactical variety is possessed by the characters who are available for use. They have different characteristics and the game with each of them is different.New pictures and new landscapes are added, and a character from other sagas you take part in your campaigns.
The battles are spectacular, new fantastic creatures have been added to use, among them are bears and fiery bulls. Your special ability to summon dragons or other natural phenomena is preserved.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Vs Shitass Full Week
Friday Night Funkin' Lullaby
description: Friday Night Funkin' Lullaby is a mod created and formerly directed by Banbuds and currently directed by ScorchVx and SimplyCrispy, that revolves around Pokémon creepypastas and urban legends.

title: Doom: The Golden Souls Remastered
description:
Project "Redemption" was inspired by the hub traveling shenaningans of Unloved and unconventional colorful scenarios of the first Serious Sam games as opposed to the usual dark n' gritty in shooters, with a sprinkle of all the things I loved about Nintendo.
That project then became Golden Souls, a humble little beginning for a small modder-wannabe.
After announcing the project I went to celebrate New Year's eve with my parents, I remember pulling the phone out from time to time and checking the comments on the forums, plenty of people were excited for this project and already started giving their input on it.
It was exciting, and it was only the beginning.

Through good times and bad times, Golden Souls has been a big part of my life for 8 years, and while the new games have become something even more unique, I still look back and think of those humble roots, that simple happy garden with the Golden Cacodemon running away from the player, the first Van Gogh inspired map that has become a staple of all my works and the quirky little drawings of Doomguy killing demons to save the day.

My intentions with this remaster are not only to improve on that foundation without betraying what was my vision back then for this project, but also provide an entry point for people that want to experience this mod for the first time and for the people that already played this adventure and want to experience it all over again with a fresh new coat of paint.

title: No Return
description: No Return is a first-person psychological horror game set in modern-day China. With a focus on family tragedy, the story unfolds as our protagonist is mysteriously prevented from returning home by an unseen force. Can he navigate a nightmarish maze of hallways and uncover the disturbing truth?

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Through the Ashes
description: Featuring an entirely different experience from the main story and first DLC, Through the Ashes has you playing the part of an ordinary citizen of Kenabres (without the mythic powers players had in the main story) who managed to survive Deskari's opening attack on the city.

title: DooM: Infernal Attack
description: With more than a year of development, Infernal Attack is a mod for DooM that adds more that a half thousand of new enemies, more than a hundred new weapons, many objects, graphic effects and new player abilities that combine the best mods for DooM.

title: La Tailor Girl
description:
This is a weapon mod that does not touch the monsters in anyway.
Well more of armor mod, or maybe half of both?

Your armor/clothes is your main core of health and well being, your weapons are enchanted by what you wear
They are not eternal, they will break eventually, and when they do, you are in trouble as going all naked makes it hard to handle guns if you wanna stay modest.
Luckily there is plenty to choose from, but you can only wear one at a time, so sometimes you might need to strip on purpose.

All weapons except chainsaw have been replaced with counter parts.
Medikits and bonus shards give clothing scrap which repairs armor instead of restoring health
Berserk, chainsaw, armors, megaspheres, radsuits, invulnerability and invisibility spheres have cloth replacements, tho the invulnerability one can be a bit more... aggressive clothing.

All weapons have alt fires and some even have reload based specials, make sure to bind those and the mod specific strip button so you can pick up those new enchanting clothes.
Free look is recommended as some guns might not properly behave with mere autoaim.

title: Lazarus Doom
description: Lazarus Mod 3 is a is a solo/multiplayer complete modification with Doom 4 weapons, monsters, sounds, sprites, hud style and aesthetics of Doom 2016 for Doom I & Doom II. Lazarus is a redesign of the weapon sprites created by Necronixis but using part of the original artwork created by Id & Betsheda for Doom4.

title: Netronian Chaos
description: Scottish Former Sergeant of the Earth Coalition Force. After the war of between Netronian and Gaian(alien term of earthling), She finally rested and enjoyed the spare time of peace... Until she took the important message from Gundrai Zispon II, the Grand Starchief of the United Macrocosmic Party that Macrocosmos(alien term of space) is once again in danger! The evil Netronian Empire has risen and now they're about to take over the Macrocosmos. And so Eilidh grabbed her trusty Service Pistol and equipped her Tactical vest to fight back the Netronian Empire.

title: Project Einherjar
description:
Project Einherjar is a five-episode total conversion for GZDoom/Doom II developed and released by Mike MacDee (Impie) in the summer of 2016; Episode 2 was later released in the winter of 2016; and Episodes 3 through 5 throughout early 2017. It is set during nuclear winter, and features 35 new maps and a totally replaced roster of weapons and enemies in the style of an early-90s 3D shooter. Impie made the mod as a promotional gimmick for a dystopian novel series set in the same universe. The gameplay involves lots of fast, brutal shootouts with enemies that die relatively easily, but can badly injure the careless player. Each episode features a short story that sets the stage for the action to follow, written in the novel's pulpy style.

The mod series is referred to as "Winter Agent Juno." Impie got the mod series title from a Japanese review blog's description of the mod: "Winter Agent Jin: Destroy the Armored Sisters Institute!".

Impie later released a fan mod of the Wolfendoom episode Operation: Arctic Wolf using Project Einherjar assets.

An 11-map sequel episode, Midgard Outlaw, was released in 2018. The third Winter Agent Juno mod, Operation Sea Wolf, was released in 2019.

title: Re-Blood
description:
Re-Blood (formerly Brutal Blood: One Unit Whole Blood Rebirth or just Blood Rebirth) is a project building from ZBlood to create an expanded experience from the original Blood transplanted onto the GZDoom engine. This involves remade maps, levels, enemies and more, as well as liberal usage of assets from Blood II. A v0.1 release was put out on May 22, 2019.
Contents

title: SuperDoom
description: SuperDoom is a mod for Doom II that aims to recreate SuperHot's gameplay in Doom.

title: Where It All Began
description: Where it all began is set in the same universe as Summer's Gone. Both games are deeply connected and are the first two out of five planned games in total.

title: Infinite Turtles
description:
You are but a cog in in infinite machine. Yet you are all the cogs. There is no end and no beginning. Only computation.

There are only a handful of base components to master. Clone replicates a token. Filter redirects a zero of Nul token to another path. A lock will not allow a token through until it has been unlocked from the side. Switch directs tokens left or right, which can be selected by supplying a token at the other end. And finally a nullifier converts a zero to a Nul and vice-versa. All other units in the game are ones made by you.

title: Horobi Kuchiru Sekai ni Tsuioku no Hanataba wo
Super Mario 64: Odyssey Mario's Moveset
description: A mod for Super Mario 64 PC Port which adds the movement mechanics from Super Mario Odyssey, as well as new collectibles and playable characters.

title: SM64EX Coop
description:
Online multiplayer mod for Super Mario 64 EX that synchronizes all entities and every level for multiple players.

The project was discontinued and a new community-mantained fork SM64 Coop Deluxe is its official continuation.

title: Super Mario MoonShine 64
description: Super Mario MoonShine 64 is a mod for Super Mario 64 PC Port with completely new levels.

title: Quest for Glory I: So You Want to Be a Hero
description: A VGA remake of the original Quest for Glory, made using Sierra's SCI1.1 interpreter. Unlike the original game, the remake uses a point and click interface instead of a text-parser.

title: The Shopping List
description:
The Shopping list is a full length mystery-psychological story rich horror game experience that blends unsettling scenarios with intense characters and a nostalgic retro theme.

Rediscover your past as you try to make yourself at home in a new town. Enjoy different encounters and puzzles while talking to the locals,

and finish the shopping list as the mysteries of the town watches from the shadows.

title: No-Snake Hotel
description: Welcome, to the No-Snake Hotel, the only hotel with a 99.99% no-snake guarantee! Here at the No-Snake Hotel we pride ourselves in our incomprehensible lack of snakes!

title: MITS: Monsters in the Shadows
description: Low-poly horror fps survival shooter game. Kill monsters hidden within the walls of an abandoned city.

title: Mask Two Two
description: Mask Two Two is a 2D horizontal scrolling shoot-em-up.

title: TacTac Prologue
description:
Puzzle-adventure game where you adopt the rol of Dunai, a young guy from Gaab. He's soon moving to the big city but before doing so he'll have to say goodbye to his loved ones. On his way he'll have to solve a desapearing case.

Explore the town of Gaab freely, you'll find all kind of colorful characters. Investigate the town to unveil the secrets that Gaab hides. Also the circus has arribed to town, go take a look at the attractions and the games it offers.

With a unique and original artistic style you'll fall in love with the scenaries and characters of the game. The game counts with two cases to solve and more than 20 different puzzles on the way that will make you rack your brains and are distributed all over Gaab.

Enjoy this prologue, this is just the beginning of a big story!

title: Eyewitness Virtual Reality: Dinosaur Hunter
description: Eyewitness Dinosaur Hunter is an educational video game in the Eyewitness Virtual Reality series, developed by DK Multimedia and released for Windows and MacOS in 1996.

title: Alice Gear Aegis CS: Concerto of Simulatrix
description: At the end of the 21st century, humanity was forced to escape the planet that was under attack by the mysterious mechanical lifeforms called Weiss. Half a century to the galaxy, the omnipotent artificial intelligence "Alice" discover emissions. Young women who are able to use it are called "Actresses". The battle against Weiss changed completely and brought peace again. One day, the organization Aegis requested a combat simulation system for a demonstrative test between "CS" and Actresses.

title: Alice Gear Aegis CS: Concerto of Simulatrix - Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Alice Gear Aegis CS: Concerto of Simulatrix
- Alice Gear Aegis CS Non-Scale Kaede Agatsuma
- Alice Gear Aegis CS Non-Scale Sitara Kaneshiya
- Alice Gear Aegis CS Marking Set A
- Alice Gear Aegis CS Marking Set B

title: KYM-tan Shoots Things
description: KYM-tan Shoots Things is a shooter game, based on the website personification of the internet humor site KnowYourMeme.

title: Way of the Hunter
description: Become the new owner of a hunting lodge nestled among gorgeous habitats and rich animal populations. Explore vast open world environments and hunt with a premium selection of firearms. Enjoy the perfect hunt on your own or with friends in co-op.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - Collector's Edition
description:
Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach – Collector's Edition Includes:
- Maximum Games Exclusive 12in Sun and Moon Daycare Attendant Duo Plush by Youtooz
- Maximum Games Exclusive Vanny Vinyl Figure by Youtooz
- Mr. Hippo Magnet
- Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach Collectible Plush Pin Set
- Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach SteelBook
- Physical Copy of Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
- Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach Retail Exclusive Sticker Sheet
- Mega Pizzaplex Box

title: Crazy Chicken Xtreme
description: Hunt mischievous moorhuhns across a mystical campsite in the forest, shoot them down in the old walls of a knight's castle, or put your marksmanship to the test in a medieval marketplace.

title: Madison: Possessed Edition
description:
Madison is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.
Possessed Edition:
• Base Game
• 2 Ritual Cards
• 2 Instant Photos
• Blue Knees' Book
• Blue Knee's Music Sheet
• Digital Content:
o Camera DLC pack
o All 5 Ritual Cards, Priest Tapes, Blue Knees Song, and Official Wallpapers

title: Super Bullet Break: Day 1 Edition
description: Super Bullet Break is a one-of-a-kind strategy deck builder filled with a wild bunch of cute and colourful characters - 'Bullets' - each and every one of them unique in their own way. Rescue online games from total destruction in a world where online multiplayer games have been taken over by a rogue AI! Can you save the world, defeat enemies in strategic turn-based battles, and beat Super Bullet Break?

title: No More Heroes III: Day 1 Edition
description: Day 1 Edition contains a 5.3” x 7.3” softcover 70-page art book, a CD featuring select songs from the soundtrack, and a 7” x 4” Santa Destroy commemorative biker license plate, all in a custom box with an original illustration

title: Insomnis: Enhanced Edition
description:
Insomnis is a first-person horror game focused on story, exploration and solving puzzles to advance through a terrifying atmosphere. Players take control of Joe Castevet, who will have to deal with a mysterious inheritance he has just received. Discover all the secrets of the Castevet mansion!

Insomnis: Enhanced Edition includes:
- Base Game
- Special Cover
- Artbook
- Set of cards

title: Stellaris: Console Edition - The Royal
description:
Explore different stars, get acquainted with a wide variety of races, and deepen interaction. Dispatch research vessels, construction vessels, and sometimes warships to build a giant galactic empire. Each of your actions will determine the fate of the entire galaxy and bring evolution, development, and conflict to the various races living in it. Like other large-scale strategy games, this game will evolve over time. With the active free updates that characterize Paradox games, you'll always be able to keep your empire expanding with the latest technology and features.

Stellaris: Console Edition - The Royal includes the Console Edition for Stellaris and Expansion pass one + two.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection - Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Game: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
- Cloth poster featuring Kevin Eastman's adaptation of TMNT: Turtles in Time
- Multi-layer acrylic diorama of Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael and Michelangelo
- Enamel pin set of five classic designs
- Set of 12 translucent comic style character trading cards based on TMNT
- Full color artbook with 180 pages

title: Pastel Chime 3: Bind Seeker
description:
One day, during a mission with a 0% danger probability, an A-class adventurer Kaitos comes across a mysterious witch and accidentally disrupts her ritual. As a result, many evil spirits called Binds are released into the world and Kaitos, being affected by the ritual too, doesn't have much choice but to start helping the witch in sealing the Binds that have been set free.

Enlisting the support from his friends both new and old, our hero sets out on a quest which ends up being much more complicated than a simple Bind hunt...

title: Salome
description: Salome is a game by increpare where you rotate yourself to the goal in first person.

title: Sickly Victorian Boy
description:
The Vicar of Plagueborogh has a son...a very fragile boy who's constantly at the edge of death. You, the best doctor in Plagueborogh, have the unpleasant task of trying to keep him alive and well. Anyone who takes a look at the unfortunate whelp would agree, you may only be delaying the inevitable...but you must carry on.

Search the house, interview the child for symptoms, and find things to cure him of his ailments before he is gone from this mortal plane.

title: Knotwords
description:
Knotwords is a minimal and elegant logic puzzle — with words.

The rules are simple: arrange the letters in each section so every word is valid, across and down.

Each puzzle may seem difficult at first — but like all my favorite newspaper puzzles, it gets easier as you progress. Each step guides you naturally towards the solution.

title: Bunnies vs. Bunnies
description: A short but challenging realtime strategy game which is primarily a heavy-handed fable.

title: Bunnies vs. Bunnies: Ukraine Edition
description:
A short but challenging realtime strategy game which is primarily a heavy-handed fable.

This is a newly updated and enhanced edition dedicated to the people of Ukraine.

title: Warframe: The Second Dream
description: The Sentient Hunhow awakens from his slumber, seeking revenge on the Tenno for their actions during The Old War. Allying with the Stalker, they seek to destroy the "womb in the sky", later revealed as the Tenno's weakness: a Reservoir on Lua that was hidden within the Void by the Lotus to protect the Tenno from the Sentients.

title: Shoot Trip Die
description: Shoot Trip Die is a psychedelic, arcade, rogue-like romp! Finger blast your way through dozens of levels mowing down strange monsters and collecting even weirder items, all to get back to your pissed stained mattress!

title: Camp Buddy: Scoutmaster Season
description: Camp Buddy: Scoutmaster Season is a boys love visual novel that features the adventures of Scoutmaster Yoshinori Nagira proceeding the events of 'Camp Buddy' during the off-season.

title: Windswept
description: Our feather-shelled heroes were swept away by a storm, and they need your help! In this '90s-inspired platforming adventure, take on over forty handcrafted stages to discover the secrets of their world, the moon and beyond!

title: Central Fugitive
description: A game about escaping constantly rotating mazes! An experiment in mastering coordination instead of controls! A story about a thief and a genie! Basically one of those astronaut tests where you get super disoriented! Almost definitely a bad idea!

title: Couch Goblins
description: A local multiplayer obstacle course party game.

title: Feyna's Quest
description: Feyna's Quest is a plot-driven platform game with role-playing elements. Join Feyna, a young dark elven sorceress, on an epic quest across three worlds.

title: Final Spike
description: Final Spike is a side-view 1-on-1 beach volleyball game. The objective is simple--score more points than your opponent to win! Players can knock the ball up with their bodies, launch it with a set, or knock it down to the ground with a blazing spike!

title: Tile Cities
description:
Tile Cities breaks city building down to its very basics making it more of a simple puzzle.
Compose nice-looking city maps of randomly generated city blocks (tiles), match colored buildings and parks to meet demand, connect tram lines with depots to get bonuses.
Creative mode with no limitations is also available. In this mode you can regenerate random tile until you get the one you like.

title: Warframe: The War Within
description: The Grineer Empire grows stronger as a cryptic adversary surfaces. What secrets does the Grineer Empire keep? Underpowered, unprepared and forced out of your comfort, you must find it in yourself to improvise, not just to save yourself but the fate of all Tenno. The Queens' Fortress awaits, where both Warframe and Operator will be pushed past their limits as they slowly unravel mysteries about the Tenno's past and their true capabilities.

title: Leisure Suit Larry 1: In the Land of the Lounge Lizards
description: A remake of the original Leisure Suit Larry in the Land of the Lounge Lizards featuring redrawn, VGA graphics and a point-and-click interface using Sierra's Creative Interpreter (SCI) engine.

title: Ukko & Guara: Stellarbound
description:
Ukko is a reindeer from Finland and Guará is a maned-wolf from Brazil. One ordinary day, a shooting star falls into planet Earth breaking itself into two parts. The star pieces landed at the north and southern hemisphere, being found by each of our heroes.

Join Ukko and Guará on their adventure to reunite the halves of the star and restore its powers while trying to complete many fun puzzles along the way. Beware, as the broken star's power is unstable and has, in some way, influenced the relationship between the characters and their environments.

title: Warframe: Octavia's Anthem
description: Do you hear the music, Tenno? Faint memories of the Mandachord orchestra linger, and Suda wishes you follow it. Do as the Cephalon requests and be rewarded knowledge of an instrument from another time, the Mandachord. But, take caution... following her instructions may lead you down a twisted path...

title: Antipathy
description:
Take the exam.
Verify your humanity.

title: Sakura no Uta: Haru no Yuki
description: Trial version of the original Sakura no Uta project, included with the limited edition of Supreme Candy. The content contained in this trial does not reflect the content of the 2015 release, which was rewritten from the ground up.

title: Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten
description: A new RPG from veteran studio Aquaplus, commemorating 20 years of the multi-media Utawarerumono series. This is the story of a man who will be sung about in legends.

title: American Arcadia
description:
Escape from a televised utopia in Out of the Blue’s brand new puzzle-platformer game.

Welcome to Arcadia! A 70's retro-futuristic metropolis where all its citizens enjoy a life of luxury and comfort… unaware that they’re being broadcast live 24/7! Arcadia is not an ordinary city, but the most watched reality show on the planet - where a drop in popularity ratings comes at the highest cost: death.

Uncover the truth and escape with your life in American Arcadia!

title: Kaiserreich: Legacy of the Weltkrieg
description: Kaiserreich: Legacy of the Weltkrieg is an alternate history mod for Paradox Interactive's Hearts of Iron series of grand strategy games. Its history goes back to 2005, when the first version of the mod was released for Hearts of Iron II. Kaiserreich envisions a world in which the Central Powers win the First World War, with the Third French Republic collapsing following a popular socialist revolution in 1920, followed by another such revolution in the United Kingdom in 1925.

title: Planet M.U.L.E.
description:
Planet M.U.L.E. is an unofficial, cross-platform, online adaptation of the classic multiplayer game M.U.L.E.
The game is a combination of real-time and turn-based strategy elements where up to 4 players compete for land and resources.

title: Future Vox Imaginarium Dot Exe
description: Explore the future in musical voxels simulation!

title: Future Vox Imaginarium Dot Exe V1.1: Doge Lover Edition
description: A pastel remix of Futurevoximaginariumdotexe.

title: Gig Life
description: After literally living under a rock for years, you emerge hungry and thirsty. You'll have to take on low-paying "gigs" in order to survive.

title: Grime House
description:
Grime House is a top down survival horror game in the style of the truly oldschool era of gaming.

Help Thomas escape from the horrors of Grime House as you explore, solve puzzles and defend yourself from the grotesque.

title: I Hurt Myself: Postjam Edition
description: A short Bitsy game based on the original jam version from 2018. This version is greatly expanded, and is almost entirely a new game.

title: TimeKeeper
description: This is an idle casual game where you can shake the tree pole again when the number on the time board turns green and shows "0" to drop fruits from the tree. When you can shake the pole again, you'll find that several days have passed.

title: Dayshift at Freddy's
description: Dayshift at Freddy's is a satirical visual novel game parodying the franchise Five Nights at Freddy's

title: Cherry Kisses
description: Cherry Kisses is a visual novel dating sim that takes place over the course of one week running your shop for various monstrous companions.

title: Downfall: A Slay the Spire Fan Expansion
description: A FREE complete expansion for Slay the Spire, made by the modding community. Features one brand new normal character, plus a new game mode with SEVEN fully complete new characters starring in a twisted campaign, and so much more.

title: Progressbar95
description: Progressbar95 is a unique indie game with a strong nostalgic vibe. It turns vintage GUI elements like panels, buttons and icons into game elements! Fights against virtual office assistants, calculators, annoying pop-ups and maddening visual glitches. The game will make you smile! You need to fill the progress bar to win.
