It's the groundbreaking point-and-click web adventure game sequel to Lenny Loosejocks Goes Walkabout in all its pixelated glory - exactly like you remember playing when you got home from school in 1998.

title: Rogue Warlords
description: Combine RTS combat with roguelike to create highly replayable and strategic action. Summon troops and purchase stacking upgrades to create a massive army of incredibly powerful troops. Can you reign supreme as the all-powerful warlord of the island?

title: Marsmare: Alienation
description: Marsmare: Alienation is a thrilling adventure of an earthling kidnapped by malevolent aliens. Improve your gear and gain new abilities as you progress through the game. Encounter numerous enemies such as Martians, robotic spiders, space slugs and flying drones.

title: Erebe
description: Join Erebe's pit as a Mythical Heroe with unique abilities! Defeat your ennemies in simultaneous cards duels where anticipation and forecast are the keys of your victory! Will you be the best mastermind ?

title: Legend of Rome: The Wrath of Mars
description: Experience a challenging match 3 game and help the Roman people appease Mars, the god of war! Build and restore the proud city to its original splendor.

description: Survive in space by dodging strange obstacles in an ever-changing gauntlet and reach the end to defeat entropy. Fly with limited resources, get stronger with upgrades and make the right decisions in this action arena rogue-lite. Warning: there is only 1 way to live but 42 ways to die in space...

description: Pilot your sub through waves of angry sea-life and punishing bosses in this aquatic twin-stick shooter.

title: Heart of Battle
description: Battle for love as a gladiator in this epic romance of swords and sandals! Win glory, victory, a better life, your freedom - and spark a revolution!

description: Serve your customers as efficiently as possible to maintain your reputation as the best darn store keeper around in this frantic, time and resource management, strategy, arcade action game.

description: The School Bus Driver Simulator game offers you the chance to contribute to our future, namely, to transport the children to school.

title: 1001 Black Raven Jigsaw

description: You are an ordinary employee of a research laboratory. One of your workdays becomes a horror. Suddenly a nightmare happens and now you have to survive and figure out what's going on here...

description: Samuel! The name of the dark evil master god of a distance universe created by himself. 4 fellas felt to this dimension by a huge mistake made by Huseyin –our hero. Help these 4 fellas to return home safely and defeat Samuel if you can!

title: Mire
description: Mire is like a very small metroidvania, but nothing is gated. You can visit any area, in any order. There are 'upgrades' that you might find useful but they are not necessary, and you can just pick up the ones you want. It's more about exploration, of seeing something at the corner of the screen and figuring out how to get there.

A post-apocalyptic recon unit recruit makes his first voyage to the surface world and questions the reality of his lifestyle and the underground society he grew up in.

title: Bluem
description: The story of 1 robot and 1 cat

title: The Rusty Sword: Vanguard Island
description: The Rusty Sword: Vanguard Island is a short, top-down adventure game inspired by several 16-bit games.

description: Gather your minions, conquer the lands and become the Darklord! Grim Horde is a fast arcade game with rogue-lite elements, where you lead your armies through the lands of the mortals, raze villages and claim souls. Die and rise again from your ashes and learn new summoning spells.

title: Project Nautilus
description: A first person exploration game set in the not so distant future. Remote operate a drone to explore this newly discovered cave system. Use tools to break away obstacles and propel your way down to find what lies below these long forgotten caves.

title: Agent 01
description: Laura, the daughter of a renowned businessman, hires Markz to rescue her father from a kidnapping. Markz then discovers the captivity location and devises a strategy to safely rescue the businessman.

title: Naxos
description: Naxos is like all of my other games! I just feel like there arent many Auto Battle RPGS out there.... I really want to keep moving the genre forward!

title: Defensive Measures
description: Defensive Measures is a FPS/Tower Defense Hybrid game. Deal with your enemies first hand or let your turrets do the talking while you sit back and enjoy the show.

title: DOOM: Slayer's Rampage
description: Prepare to go back to hell, and wipe it out of bad guys, again Slayer's Rampage brings a fast paced experience in the good old Doom and Doom II games, with new guns, monster IA, HUD, Controls and mechanics.

title: Is Simon There?
description: Is Simon There? is a short horror experience with an approximate completion time of 40min. Is Simon There? also includes a single checkpoint at the mid-point of the game for those of you who want to explore alternate ending options.

title: Dusted's Pandemonia
description:
Dusted's Pandemonia is a gameplay mod that replaces pretty much all everything, in a classic randomizer fashion.

Inspired by mods like Scalliano's 667 Shuffle, Hard Doom, Complex Doom, and Colorful Hell, this mod aims to provide a new look on the old Realm 667 content you all know and might love, while also coming with its own unique enemies, weapons, items, and special effects.

title: Cyber Car
description: Feel yourself in a futuristic world piloting ships through incredible scenery! Made for VR, Cyber Car will undoubtedly be a relaxing and immersive experience. Put your problems aside, and come ride and enjoy the best virtual reality experience ever made!

title: Hyperbase
description: You find yourself in a mysterious alien base from which no one has ever escaped. Explore the base's perilous inner labyrinths to uncover ancient secrets, escape from this hellish trap, and warn humanity of the impending danger.

title: Miner of Minerals
description: In the exciting game "Miner of minerals" you play as a miner and your task is to dig up as many gems as possible to earn a lot of money. Upgrade your equipment and try to set a record for mining minerals every time!

title: Dash Around Madly
description: Dash Around Madly is a casual game with rogue-lite elements. In the game you will incarnate as a beautiful warrior, control the chess pieces on the board to fight! Mow thousands of enemies until dawn.

title: Lithium
description: Play as one of three social groups of your choice who mobilize against a planned lithium mining project. The developer seeks to start mining quickly, you aim to halt this project and initiate a debate about a just and environmentally friendly solution.

title: Walpurgis
description:
Walpurgis is...

A gameplay mod that works with Doom, Hexen and Heretic, straight out of the Box!
Focused on giving everything three fire-modes without needing any extra resources, just balancing them around standard blue and green mana/ammo consumption.
Upgrades for each of those afformentioned fire-modes (think Trailblazer).
Strong and fun, but balanced. Extra care has been put into making everything have punch and impact and be fun to use but not the level of overkill. I'm a mad perfectionist when I get going; so repeatedly testing something over and over whilst I tweak values is not unusual.
Gothically medieval, with a taste of moderate-high fantasy. Magic is meant to semi-common in the world, whether through artifacts, or mystical items.
Based around play where you get used to using both your arsenal and your inventory items in tandem. Flechettes and Discs of Repulsion are really useful now; so use them!
Rigorously playtested with custom doom, heretic, and hexen wads to get a feel for how it plays with them; and to see if I can find reason to switch between my arsenal all the time (which is the sign of a good arsenal, in my opinion).
Is named this way because... well, "Hexen" are witches from germanic folklore. Walpurgisnacht is a grand festival for witches in general. So as a festival of new content for Hexen related shenanigans; its doubly relevant.

title: DOOM: Enhanced Vanilla Project
description:
Q: What this mod does?
A: Gives vanilla Doom a fresh coat of paint, while maintaining vanilla gameplay.

title: Unreal Engine The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: A fan recreation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with updated graphics, made using the Unreal Engine.

description: Go on an adventure to save your village from a voracious Shade. Alone or accompanied, this turn-based roguelite will take you on a journey through a world of incomparable and colourful landscapes.

description: SMYS is a 2-4 player local-multiplayer party game. Challenge your friends in this building race to the top! Gather blocs in various minigames and then use them to build your stairs as fast as possible, use your special items wisely to disturb your friends' minds and capture the flag first.

description: Fight online with friends and strangers in different stages and become the last one standing.

title: Gnome Online
description: Gnome Online is an innovative, Real-Time, fast-paced, PvP, Sandbox MMORPG.

title: Homemade TCG
description: Yugi-inspired card game -roguelike with an extra deck. Enemies use the same cards / rules as you. Reduce opponent's life from 20 to 0; by playing cards and attacking. Pick a card of 3-choices after each win. Use the deck-builder between games. A lot of unique cards, 5 floors, and the final boss.

title: All Songs are From the King
description: A game where Silent Hills meets Kahlil Gibran’s ‘The Prophet’.

title: Heroes of Book & Paper
description: HB&P s an old-school RPG game that uses an 80s/90s style of design and concept. Your decisions will determine the ending of each adventure you take. Every story has different and random components. This means that the stories will vary from game to game.

title: Farmer Against Potatoes Idle
description: Pick up your sword and fight off waves of Potatoes by upgrading your stats constantly, use Equipment, choose between different Classes, put your many Talents to good use, and so much more designed to keep you entertained for a long time.

title: Sexy Mystic Survivors
description: Roguelite bullet-hell combat meets sexy anime action in Sexy Mystic Survivors, as you rise to the occasion to help gorgeous heroines destroy countless invading monsters. Plan your builds, upgrade heroines, and survive against the clock. Keep the heroines alive and they’ll be sure to reward you!

title: Heartstop
description: Heartstop is an emotional, story-driven game, taking place in a world where every living being has suddenly stopped moving. Uncover the mystery of this eerie event while building a dynamic relationship between the only two people remaining, through the many impactful and hard-hitting choices.

title: Lab
description: Deep underground in an old laboratory, an animal wakes up. Invisible enemies blocking the way, complex old underground facilities, narrow ducts... Lead the helpless lone animal to escape to the ground floor.

title: Night of Love
description: Some things may seem unforgivable at the first, but a long night spent together may change everything and bring back the forgotten feelings...

title: Taiga
description: Taiga is an atmospheric first person horror game with elements of survival. Explore the maze like forest, Uncover dark secrets that lay beneath pine and spruce. Save your colleagues if you can, but most importantly. Escape with your life.

title: Mark's Magnificent Marble Maze
description: Unwind from the stress of daily life with this magnificent marble maze. Sometimes all you need is a place to let your mind wander.

title: Light-Bringer
description: LIGHT-BRINGER is a first-person exploration horror game with psychedelic visuals and a harsh noise soundtrack. Explore 3D platforming environments with puzzles and mazes reflecting facets of American Christianity, collect hidden Sacred Hearts, and confront Lucifer's temptation.

title: The Great Ocean
description: Dive into adventure-missions in the earth’s oceans. Explore in your high-tech submarine fascinating spots like the Galapagos or the Deep Sea. Use your upgradeable tools to solve quests when you free jailed whales, or explore sunken WW2 battleships. Swim with majestic whales, sharks and sea turtles. And take real action to save the oceans.

title: Gravitar: Recharged
description: The cult classic Gravitar has been Recharged. Complete missions in each solar system, navigating a variety of challenging environments, each with varying levels of gravity that will test your skills as a pilot before unlocking new solar systems to explore.

title: Spe:x
description: You are Ilie, an Eastern European Entrepreneur who is starting a new company of building PCs. You love computers and building them since you were a kid and now you think it will be a good idea to make your family proud and start your own business with money borrowed from unconventional sources.

title: The Farmer's Story of Slow Life
description: The sisters inherited the ranch and the mountains from their father's estate. But the island is no longer vibrant. You set out to rebuild the ranch and the town. When you have gathered enough assets, you can visit remote islands far away. You will surely find unknown items waiting for you.

title: Legacy of Sin: Blood Oath
description: Buy unique troops, control the battlefield, defend the routes from different enemies! Hand drawn frame by frame 2D animation!

title: Super Ride Grandpa
description: Race your grandpa against other grandpas (and goompahs).

title: Fire the Zombies
description: This is a Guard Game, you can control the gun o fire,There are multiple styles of zombies and bosses need you to destroy. Different weapons have different powers, come and experience it.

title: Timestride
description: Manipulate time to overcome obstacles in a clever way. A sci-fi FPS game with large variety of weapons and foes set in a remote military research lab where an experiment has gone horribly wrong.

title: Sakura Succubus 6
description: The sixth part of the Sakura Succubus series. Hiroki thought his harem of adoring women couldn’t get any bigger, but now a genuine European princess had taken a liking to him. What’s a (disgustingly) popular guy to do?!

title: Covid Carl
description: Covid Carl is a Metroidvania/Contra-style 2d side-scrolling shooter. It will feature a brief story, 10 levels, and boss fights

title: Moonphase Pass
description: A rougelite meeple placement game. Help Lili as she fights back against the Red Moon to protect her forest hut!

title: Heroes of Rome 2: The Revenge of Discordia
description: Caesar and Cleopatra were kidnapped by the Roman goddess Discordia! Don't waste time and go on a journey full of adventure, myths and legends.

title: Prism: A Visual Novel
description: On her way to the city of opportunity, a young Freyja is trapped when a sudden fog descends upon the town known as Avon-On-Reach. Soon, she starts to wonder if there's more to the fog than meets the eye, and if it has a connection to the strange monstrous happenings around the town.

title: Tales of Inca 2: New Adventures
description: Join the Incas on their exciting journey, fight against demons and mystical monsters and experience exciting adventures!

title: Basureroes: Invasion
description: “Basureroes: Invasion” is a 2D platform game with retro aesthetics in which a group of heroes with different abilities must save the world from an alien invasion. Run, jump and fight your way through twenty levels full of danger and epic boss fights.

title: Squish
description: Inspired by the PSP puzzle game Crush; In Squish, the player compresses 2D views into 1D.

title: Superola: Champion Edition
description: A challenging runner-style platforming adventure, in which you’ll have to guide a burger loving llama in its quest to defeat the Hotdog Aliens and recover the stolen hamburgers... before they get cold!

title: Nectar
description: Use nectar to restore the world and its natural beauty. Traverse a desolate post-apocalyptic landscape and bring vibrant color to the environment. Solve puzzles, grow platforms, and explore a forgotten world.

title: Find All 3: Travel
description: Look for hidden cats, raccoons, other animals and objects, color this painted world. You have to go on an exciting journey through different levels. More than 1500 items of varying difficulty are waiting for you!

title: School Sweets Discovery: Granulated Sugar Edition
description: A beautiful girl 2-choice quiz adventure game where you can experience a little variety of languages! Enjoy multi-end collection and online ranking in Challenge Mode!

title: My Student Loves Me!
description: A short visual novel VR for adults where the story and play changes depending on your choices! You can become a tutor and fall in love with your student. Your student loves you and confesses her love to you. Let's make out as much as you want!

title: Kami-sama's Personal Servant
description: The story of the relationship between a god and a young sacrificed boy, Kami-sama's Personal Servant. A mysterious fukichi na kami (god who brought bad luck) with a mysterious past who lived in the mountains and an orphan boy who was a descendant of an outsider and had been chosen as a sacrifice. What would happen between them?

title: Valera: The Drunken Lobster
description: A simple and relaxing arcade game about a lobster called Valera and his attempts to collect bottles deep in the ocean.

title: My Naughty Summer Vacation: Days in Countryside and Memories of Summer
description: An 3D simulation RPG in which the main character returns to the countryside and enjoys his summer vacation. Let's spend a special summer in the countryside with heroines, by talking, go to various places with countryside, playing, and others, while making memories of the summer.

title: Zetria
description: Zetria is a pixel/retro style platformer with action and puzzle elements. Help Solana jump, shoot and think her way through the perils and dangers ahead to rescue the missing facility workers!There are nine levels in total, and a few secret areas to find and unlock too.

title: The Backrooms: Found Footage
description: The Backrooms: Found Footage is a psychological horror game where you "no-clip" through reality and into the Backrooms. Explore 600 million miles of randomly generated office space, contend with entities, collect unique and useful lore, and attempt to maintain your sanity as you try to escape.

title: Vivaland
description: Vivaland is the first life simulation game built with co-op in mind from the ground up. The game allows up to 8 players to live in the same town and engage with each other. Players can create and control their characters, establish families, build homes, and perform various daily activities such as sleeping, eating, and working. In addition, the game features multiplayer events and world aspects that encourage players to collaborate and play together.

title: Legend of Keepers: Soul Smugglers
description: Including new master, new monsters, new game mechanics and more!

title: Aery: Last Day of Earth
description: “Aery: Last Day of Earth” is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bird that is on its non-violent journey through time, space, and different dimensions to discover an alternative reality for our planet.

title: Unwording
description: Unwording is a narrative puzzle game about happiness, gratitude, and the power of words. Use a combination of exploration and word puzzle gameplay to reshape reality and guide Tom through the course of three painful but transformative days of his life.

title: Rule No. 2
description: Rule and the greatest warm-up game are back for seconds! Kickstart your eyes, limbs and otherwise general biology from the vestiges of normal (boring) human behavior and become honed and sharpened as you battle an onslaught of Waifus and Geometry for your position on the Leaderboard!

title: The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon
description: The story-rich 18+ prequel to The Divine Speaker. Follow alongside a younger Aemyl as he uncovers the world for himself!

title: Chroma+Elektron
description: Chroma + Elektron is a 2D twin-stick shooter. Return all chromatic energy back to its proper state. Survive against increasingly difficult waves of constructs and collect their energy to unleash powerful weapons and abilities. Your speed and power will know no equal.

title: Quest Room
description: The main goal of the quest is to get out of the room, and for this you need to solve riddles and find hidden clues.

title: Programmer Dungeon Knightress
description: In this tactical game, use logic programming to solve puzzles and beat each level. Gather unique skills, use visual programming, automate your character and defeat your enemies! Choose wisely and enjoy this adventure!

title: Late Photographer 4
description: A simple and easy beauty dynamic jigsaw puzzle and relaxing music can make you have a good mood

title: Flashout III
description: Flashout is back! Where high speed meets high stakes. Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. Take part in an exciting, head-to-head fight to the finish!

title: Otoko Cross: Pretty Boys Mahjong Solitaire
description: Meet 5 cute cross-dressing characters as they challenge you to tile-matching mahjong solitaire! Clear the playfield and unlock new outfits for your companions in this this celebration of Japanese "otokonoko" style and sub-culture.

title: Deck Adventurers II
description: Save the Valley from the hordes of monsters that ravage it in this turn-based tactical combat and deck-building RPG game.

title: Impulse Rogue
description: Impulse Rogue is a punishing souls-like action RPG. Master combat, face relentless enemies, venture fractured mind, explore twisted landscapes, unravel forgotten mysteries, confront lurking demons. Will you succumb to darkness, or emerge victorious? a pure soul's fate hangs in the balance.

title: Save Room: Organization Game
description: When you enter a save room you know you are safe, no danger can come to you, you can relax. Take advantage of this short period of time to organize your inventory, heal your wounds and reload your weapons. Can you make all the items fit in your inventory?

title: Solitaire Match 2 Cards. Thanksgiving Day
description: Solitaire Match 2 Cards. Thanksgiving Day Card Game is a card game with a cozy autumn atmosphere! 120 new levels await you!

title: Toilet Chronicles
description: Toilet Chronicles - is a public toilet simulator with mystical setting where you need to find a way out of the toilet with the help of your toilet neighbor. Find a way to escape with your partner until one of you dies. Every choice you make brings you to a different outcome.

title: Soul
description: This is a brain-burning puzzle game, with well-designed puzzles everywhere, find clues, analyze the hidden meanings in the clues, solve the puzzles, and finally unlock the secrets of the whole world. Let your brain turn at a high speed, ding, and enjoy the thrill of solving the puzzle!

title: Biomisland
description: Biomisland is a relaxing minimalist nature builder game. Visit randomly generated islands and restore nature as your own pace using diverse plants at your disposal.

title: Solitaire: Beautiful Garden Season
description: Garden season, whenever you want! "Solitaire Beautiful Garden Season offers hours of challenging gameplay.

title: Old World: Heroes of the Aegean
description:
Old World's first expansion Heroes of the Aegean gives you control of Ancient Greece's greatest leaders and warriors. Lead Athens to victory in the Battle of Marathon, defend Greece from a Persian invasion as Leonidas and his 300 Spartans, and conquer the Hellenic world as Alexander the Great himself in a series of scenarios spanning over 200 years of classical history.

Heroes of the Aegean also adds the Hittites as a brand-new civilization playable in the main campaign and led by the warrior king Ḫattušili I. The Hittites field powerful and unique three-man chariots and gain extra civics thanks to their status as the world's first known constitutional monarchy. Additionally, their entire unit roster has the special ability to cross hills without movement penalties and the ability to chop down forests, reflecting the Hittites experience in the rugged Anatolian landscape and their record of deforestation. With all of these advantages, the Hittites are poised to take the Old World by storm.

title: SCP: Event Classified
description: SCP: Event Classified is a unique horror shooter that allows players to take on a role of a soldier, prisoner, scientist and even monster. Fight other players or unite with them to survive in this mysterious facility.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 8
description: 1001 photos of our fantastic planet! Discover the breathtaking beauty of our world alongside 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 8!

title: NMDC
description: Your token, character sheets, and maps are endlessly customizable so you can adapt games to fit your quests, or create your own rules from scratch. Spark adventure, foster creativity, forge friendships, and unite tabletop communities across the globe with games that are easy to play.

title: On the Wings: Birth of a Hero
description: You are not born as a Hero. But you can become one! Bruce and Ursula are sister and brother living with their mother. One day their life starts to change with a Dragon. Now, it is time to become a Hero by saving their village and their captive father from Dark Rider. Get ready for a nice RPG story.

title: Dash and Slash
description: Slash and Dash through your enemies in this pixel-art, one-button, hack and slash! Cut through the city, break into its' heart and descend to its' depths.

title: Survivor Cells
description: Discover the beauty and fragility of life in Survivor Cells, a unique survival game against viruses and bacteria, which strategically combines the elements of roguelite, bullet hell and tower defense in a challenging experience. Your destiny depends on your agility and choices. How far will you get?

title: Paranormal Simulator
description: As a paranormal investigator, your job is to discover the magical properties of anomalous items and find creative ways to use them against supernatural creatures. Without accidentally being abducted by a dark entity or suffering a bizarre anomalous effect, of course!

title: Jelly Express
description: Jelly Express is a two player co-op physics game. You will be playing two little jellies who will deliver boxes over obstacles to reach their destination. The only tool you have is a wooden board overhead, so use your ability to stretch, jump, and move to keep the boxes steady on the board.

title: Repulsor
description: Repulsor is a challenging 360° Retro Arcade Shoot 'em Up featuring a color-switching gameplay mechanic.

title: Astroworld
description: Astroworld is a side-scrolling co-op game where the players will have to build their colony on a planet full of danger, valuable resources and alien artifacts, using which the player can explore new technologies and equipment to arm their colonists with.

title: Aquarium Designer: Sea Life
description: Let the marine life thrive and create a wonderful undersea kingdom using saltwater fish, seashells, and corals. Accept new challenges and build fishtastic aquatic landscapes.

title: Wild Indigo Ranch
description: Wild Indigo Ranch is a cozy cowboy-life RPG for 1-4 players. Start a new life on the prairie, explore the frontier, build the finest ranch in the West, and ride into the sunset.

title: The Ball Flow: Nature and Light
description: Explore beautiful world! The ball use to carefully calculated physics. Change the ball's material for explore beautiful world smoothly. Enjoy and I deeply wish that you feel better after playing my game.

title: Airport Administrator Simulator
description: In Airport Administrator Simulator you have the chance to know the smallest details of how a big airport works.

title: Master of Pottery: Suzhou Garden
description: Enjoy a quiet time by making pottery in the garden.

title: Escape From Zombie U: Reloaded
description: If you thought the school system has reached its lowest levels... Think again!

title: Fruit Farmer
description: Build your incredible farm! Create upgrades, get resources, create new types of fruits, sell what you have collected or create products from it! Explore an open world with lots of puzzles! Be the best farmer!

title: Tiltfire
description: Ignite your rocketship engines and zoom your way through the caves of tiltfire. Fly around tight corners and blast AI drones in this fast paced top-down shooter.

title: Warmonger: Sins of the Naga
description: Gunpowder and Sorcery Squad-Based Tower Defense game

title: Eros Fantasy
description: Eros Fantasy is an Idle RPG game full of magic and sex. Travel through a fantastic world, meet, seduce the hottest humans, beastfolks, demon girls and mermaids!

title: Colors! Platform
description: Colors! Platform is a minimalist casual platform game.

title: Tomorrow for Mar
description: Pass your final, graduate university and... finally confess?! Tomorrow for Mar is a 2.5D VN about crushes, tricky finals and starting a new chapter of your life.

title: Cartographer
description: Cartographer is a turn-based game, where you decide how the world map looks. Build the map to build the world! The combat system is very simple and each enemy has its own attack pattern, which you can learn and exploit to defeat them in glorious turn-based battle!

title: Grimgrad
description: Build your settlement to survive all the hardships of the dark Middle Ages and not to anger the Slavic gods!

title: There's a Rikishi in my House
description: A casual escape game with 15 multiple endings.

title: Jishogi
description: A dark, story-heavy puzzle game. Enter the mind of Mayu, as her soul is invaded and dug through by a seemingly evil witch. Can you stop her? What if you were able to get the upper hand, and invade her back? Would you show mercy, or destroy her? Jishogi will test you in more ways than one.

title: Dominus Rage
description: Beat 'Em Up is a game in traditions of the old masters. Fight alone or with a company and beat up all your foes. Dominus feels that the Tavor has come back to life again. He returns to Altran, where his enimies are waiting for him.

title: Rich Lady's Slave Role Play
description: I reluctantly agreed to accommodate my difficult supervisor from the company I had worked before, but in return, she started to “play slave” as her payment, calling me “master” and occasionally stripping me of my clothes and putting her hands on me! What the hell was going on?!!!

title: La Vie La Rue
description: Cartoonish 2d game made by two brothers. Unique art all around these wonderful locations. Try and go to the furthest possible to beat your highscore and maybe be the first one to reach the end.

title: Pokémon Luminescent Platinum
description:
Pokémon Luminescent Version is a mod for Pokémon Brilliant Diamond, inspired by the fantastic work of Drayano. Thousands of changes have been made to the base game, including (but by no means limited to) animation and texture changes, new forms for Pokémon coming from many other points of media such as Crystal Onix or Armored Mewtwo, the full Renegade Platinum main storyline (postgame upcoming), trade evolutions methods changed, more gift Pokémon throughout the storyline and so much more.

This is a mod made by the community, for the community, so anyone is free to join the Discord and apply to join the development team.

title: CrushBorgs
description: "Run and Gun" oldschool single-player platformer with NES aesthetics, including an authentic 8-bit chiptune.

title: Matchpoint: Tennis Championships - Legends Edition
description:
Matchpoint: Tennis Championships is a modern take on tennis, featuring a true-to-life on-court experience supported by a deep career mode and unique rivalry system.

The game places a strong focus on tactical realism, positioning and aiming, allowing the player to move their superstar in exactly the right way to get the most out of their shots.

title: Rogue Lords: Day One Edition
description:
A dark fantasy roguelike where you play as the Devil!
Lead famous evil geniuses through events and turn-based fights to spread terror and corruption. Create synergies between your disciples, use your evil powers and take revenge on those miserable Demon Hunters.

title: Century: Age of Ashes - First Flight Edition
description: Take it to the skies and become a legendary dragon rider, with an extra jump start thanks to the Introduction Pack!

title: Century: Age of Ashes - Colossus Deluxe Edition
description: Unleash bestial power with a loaded heap of rewards. The high quality items included in this best-value pack will make your enemies shiver!!

title: Dynasty Warriors 9: Complete Edition
description: Offering a discount set that includes the game, "Special Costume Set", "Season Pass", "Season Pass 2", and "Season Pass 3".

title: Little Mouse's Encyclopedia + Brawl Chess
description: Explore the natural world while learning through play, then compete with your family in greatest game of all time - chess! A great game for little ones, Little Mouse's Encyclopedia comes bundled with Brawl Chess!

title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts: Full Arsenal Edition
description: Become the ultimate assassin in Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts, a highly realistic modern warfare shooter featuring an immersive single-player campaign across large, open-ended maps. Tactical thinking, high-stealth movement, and extreme precision required.

title: Century: Age of Ashes - Fellow Edition
description: Stand out from the crowd with the Fellow Pack - an epic heap of dragons, customisations and consumables fit for every true dragoneer who want to leave their mark in the history of Century: Age of Ashes.

title: Blaston Spectator
description: View and stream Blaston matches with broadcast-quality tools so that your audience never has to miss a moment of the action! Built with streamers and esports fans in mind, Blaston Spectator gives PC owners everything they need to keep an eye on the action of VR’s hottest competitive dueling game.

title: JumpBeard
description: Challenge awaits you in this platformer journey, where you take control of one legged captain called Rupert the JumpBeard in your tactical jumping adventure where your only way to go is upwards to find a mythical treasure but be wary, every missed jump will result in a fall back where you started.

title: Formula Top
description: Fun top-down 3D formula racing game with tense side-by-side battles against competitive AI or other people in online multiplayer. The perfect blend of tight arcade controls and immersive world of formula.

title: One-Armed Cook
description: One-armed Cook is a chaotic co-op cooking game for up to 4 people. Work as a team or cook on your own, set your own pace, and don't let the stress of a full restaurant catch up to you. The goofy physics-based aspect of the game gives this cooking game a new twist.

title: Aery: Vikings
description: Aery: Vikings is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bird that is on its non-violent journey to complete a shire impossible task of the gods. Make your journey through a wonderful, peaceful, and exciting world and enjoy the feeling of flying.

title: Triga
description: Slap triangular tiles down in this cause and effect, chain reactive, radically funky puzzle experience! Collect as many golden triangles as you can to unlock new levels, but don't sweat it if you aren't a triangle-brained genius: Each stage has 3 goals ranging from casual fun, to extreme puzzling!

title: Epic Battle Fantasy Collection
description: A collection of short and silly games from the early days of the internet. There's turn-based RPGs, shoot-em-ups, platformers, and more - updated with new quality-of-life features. Plus there's a whopping 150 achievements to collect!

title: Moi Mei: Hidden Objects
description: A game in the genre of "hidden object", in which you, in the role of a young priestess Mei, will have a journey into magical space. Search for talismans and ingredients for rituals, enlist the help of cunning and greedy Voodoo spirits to save your beloved!

title: The Last Secret
description: Light-hearted visual novel adventure with an epic tale - with challenging and fun puzzles, humorous storyline and quirky characters. Solve the "last secret", save your friends and maybe find true love on the way, too...

title: Island of Aito
description: Island of Aito is an interactive survival / item management / dating simulator game with visual novel elements.

title: Space Ducks: The Great Escape
description: In this cosmic puzzle adventure, help a lost tribe of duck-people in their millennial quest for a stable world!

title: Creature Hunter
description: Produce powerful spells with the loot you collect. Destroy creatures that get stronger at each level with collective or single spells. Defend yourself with defensive spells. Cross deadly parkour with the spells you've crafted.

title: Crafting Town
description: Crafting Town Is : A Crafting game with Simulation&Building where you can Craft and Develop your Village, Source Management and Quests.

title: Santo Island Incident
description: Overgrowth took over the whole Santo Island and facility as a result of an unknown incident. Your mission is to find out the source of the incident and solve what's happened at Santo Island.

title: Hero's Quest: Automatic Roguelite RPG
description: Simple RPG game with incremental progress

title: The Unsettled
description: The Unsettled is a first-person Psychological Horror game. You as an Investigative Journalist, Got Intel about a Missing girl in a Boarding School, but it reveals something more Evil and Scary.

title: CarX Drift Racing Online: Hit the Wall
description: Have you ever thought how much damage your car can take?

title: Moros Protocol
description: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

title: Per Aspera: Blue Mars
description: The Blue Mars DLC introduces players to new, ocean-size bodies of water and all the benefits that come with them! You've changed the face of the Red Planet with the Green Mars update - now let's go for blue!

title: Soul Wargame
description: This is a dark style strategy game that combines Wargame and Rogulike. Everyone received a mysterious invitation after destroying the conspiracy of the cult. You will lead a group of undead warriors on an adventure journey to defeat invincible enemies one by one.

title: Aza: Zend vs. The Dark End
description: Help Zend save himself the Dark End and his anxieties, in this Narrative-driven Action-RPG shrouded in darkness. Discover and customize new abilities, save the lives of others, hack, slash, and power your way through mysterious creatures from the darkness, and learn just who the secretive Aza is!!

title: Vaxomon
description: Vaxomon is a psychological horror based on Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Darkness and has many fixed dungeons during gameplay.

title: Escape Dark Tunnels
description: Escape Dark Tunnels is a puzzle game where the player gets trapped underground being chased by mysterious creatures. You will have to use your ingenuity and logic to escape from the tunnels.

title: Tratritle
description: A little master lived happily with his maids. But what bothered him was that the maids were too naive and simple. One day, he received a letter from his father. He thought he could solve the current problem... But unexpectedly, another succubus maid came. Will he still be a good boy or...?

title: Me and My Eldritch Parasite
description: You have an eldritch parasite. It sucks. Find a way to get rid of it while meeting its demands in this strage mix between sidescrolling horror, virutal pet and sarcasm.

title: Guardians: Agents of Justice
description: Guardians: Agents of Justice is a cancelled superhero squad tactics game developed in 1996/1997. The game was supposed to play like X-Com, but with superheroes.

title: Total Conflict: Resistance
description: Total Conflict: Resistance is a unique symbiosis of global strategy, tactics and first-person action. Realistic mass battles, many types of armored vehicles, weapons, uniforms, unique mechanics, immersive free gameplay. Lead any state and bring it to greatness!

title: Armageddon War: Old Era Wreckers
description: This is a turn-based historical chess simulation game Players will experience major battles between 1840 and 1920 The game consists of four conquest scripts, each with three different modes and 60 free conquest years to choose from, where the player takes on the role of a commander

title: Connected Hearts: Fortune Play - Collector's Edition
description: Love can wound and heal. It is a feeling inherent in everyone. But can you get love by force or deception? Find out in this new game!

title: The Medical Examination Diary: The Exciting Days of Me and My Senpai
description: Would you like to start the love romance by your senpai that you desired? "The medical examination diary: the exciting days of me and my senpai" is the novel game.

title: La Jetée
description: ‘This is the story of a man marked by an image from his childhood.’ An 30minute black noire game, with an deep story, 30 beautiful images and stunning backroundsound.

title: Search and Rescue
description: Turn-based, strategy board game for up to 4 Players! Search, Rescue and Survive!

title: ShadowBringer
description: Escape the underground research facility and discover the truth of your origin. ShadowBringer is a 3D stealth game where you take on the role of a shadowy monster. Awakened with no recollection of the past, a voice in your head whispers softly to you: "Get out of this place".

title: Run n Jump
description: Run n Jump your way through dangerous obstacles to save the lost maiden at the top. Find yourself dropped into a treacherous world running full speed while trying to avoid being massacred by the obstacles in your way. Do you have the skill to rescue the lost maiden?

title: Sunline
description: Sunline is a first-person 3D free-running game that follows Ana, a rebellious teen in the solarpunk city of Elyria, as she saves the city from a crushing storm.

title: Orbital Mechanics
description: Orbital Mechanics is a sci-fi, third-person shooter, single player game in which the player jumps between spherical asteroids whilst combating enemy forces.

title: Hexfactory
description: Build cities and factories in an infinite Hex World. Explore more tiles. Balance your city's production and consumption, attract more citizens of different classes, research new technologies and build more factories and cities.

title: Spell Welders
description: Play as 1 of 17 different welders in this strategic turn-based RPG! After you choose your spell, decide how you will cast it. Will it be fast? Accurate? Powerful? You've never had control like this before as you weld your way to victory!

title: Fix Me Up: Hospital Edition

description: An agency called the FED has identified an online group of potential threats. All they need is evidence to have them locked away. You are a new agent going undercover in that online group with the task of getting that evidence, by whatever means necessary.

title: Spiritus
description: Albert and Rose investigate a manor with miscreants and broken souls. Stay together and survive the horror.

title: MyrnEscapes
description: A single player fantasy based exploration game with audio-reactive elements set to the music of Myrn's Circles EP

title: Your Computer Might Be at Risk
description: Your Computer Might Be At Risk is a first-person narrative puzzle game. Locked up in a room after a mysterious car accident, you must figure out how to escape while surviving dangerous trials.

title: Call of Duty: Devil's Brigade
description: Call of Duty: Devil's Brigade was a canceled third-person shooter for the Xbox 360, PS3 and PC developed by Underground Development. The game was set in World War II, focusing on Italy. In the game, the D-Pad was used to direct orders to the player's squad. These commands were: Assault, Barrage, Hold the line, and Form Up. One screen also showed the player giving a squad member the order to stealth kill an enemy soldier.

title: The Tales of Bayun
description: Can a flat world resting on the backs of three demon bears live in peace? Of course not! Immerse yourself in the universe of the dark Slavic legends, explore the characters' stories and make difficult choices that affect the course of events. Bayun the Cat will help you. If you're lucky, that is.

title: Loskop
description: Experience a new type of puzzle-solving in this new linear second and first person puzzle solving game. Control the little robot also known as Loskop and help him escape his old factory and out into the wild.

title: Desolatium: Prologue
description: Desolatium: Prologue is a first-person point & click Graphic Adventure based on Lovecraft Mythos. Live this horror story where you will have to visit mysterious locations, face lovecraftian creatures, find clues and combine objects to solve puzzles.

title: Mysterious Island: A Race Against Time and Hot Lava
description: On Mysterious Island, lead Will, Lily, and Tomas in search for awesome treasure and then help them escape before the volcano erupts. Embark on an incredible journey at the amusement park where they decide to take a hot air balloon ride even though there is a storm and the ride is closed. Take the ride of a lifetime to an uncharted island filled with hungry creatures, mind-bending puzzles, and hidden dangers.

title: HopDodge
description: HopDodge is bringing back classic grid based platforming, with a new twist! Hop around on the back plane, and dodge spikes, wolves, and cannons in the foreground. Every level is built using an in-game editor, so players can create their own limitless content.

title: My Cool Diner
description: Seven interactive games teach players the value of money and other skills as they run an out-of-control diner. The edutainment title offers three levels of difficulty.

title: Crux: The Great Outdoors
description: Climbing is about carefully planning your route and flawless execution. In Crux you move your hands or feet to a new hold - but each hold will only let you hang on for so long. Find the sequence of moves that get you to the top and execute them! And when you've reached all the tops - beat the highscores by finishing each climb in the fewest possible moves.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II drops players into an unprecedented global conflict that features the return of the iconic Operators of Task Force 141.

title: Shinies: Call of Light
description: A single-player adventure full of wonderful landscapes and beautiful musics for PC, it tells a deeply emotional story of a lovely friendship. Solve puzzles, sneak around creatures and use your spherical shield as your only protection. Attack using the same shield with speed, or by countering

title: Aletta
description: An adventure visual novel with a pixel art style. About ghosts, past love, and a world of the unconscious.

title: Factor D
description: Manga-style 2d turn-based fighting game, choose 1 character among the 12, with different endings for each one, discover the story by winning with each character

title: Dolphin Hustle
description: Somewhere in the wastelands of the ocean lives a young dolphin. He likes to get high and hang out. All he does is hang out. But it so happened that the cyber Internet sucked him in. It's time to end this.

title: Pirate Fishing
description: In the exciting game "Pirate Fishing" you play as a fisherman and your task is to catch as many fish as possible to earn a lot of money. Pump up your fishing rod and try to set a record for catching fish every time!

title: Meekanoid
description: The player controls a platform that can be moved from one wall to another by placing it under the ball, preventing it from falling.

title: Sorry, We're Open
description:
Welcome to the Corporate Ladder.

Sorry, We're Open is a procedurally generated Horror CRPG Roguelite, Supermarket Simulator. As the new Manager of your local supermarket branch, you'll be expected to manage your employees, tackle both the Day and Night Shifts, and make the hard decisions to keep the store running each hour of the day.

title: Outbreak Diamond Collection
description: Experience six terrifying survival horror adventures in the Outbreak Diamond Collection.

title: Dragon Prana
description: An evil king that threatened the world in the past becomes free from his seal after 120 years. The descendants of the heroes who saved the world have to stand up to fight this new evil. However, will the world overcome the suzerainty and racial pride of humans, elves and dwarves to face this threat? A fantastic retro RPG with top quality nostalgic pixel art and a game system worthy of modern times.

title: Dungeon Legends 2
description: Dungeon Legends 2 is an addictive RPG Dungeon Crawler with graphics that will allow you to enter the amazing fictional world of monsters.

title: JumpStart 3D Virtual World: Trouble in Town
description: Someone or something is causing trouble in Jumpstart Town! Frankie and the rest of the JumpStart gang are waiting for you to come and figure out who or what it is and clean up the crazy mess.

title: Dungeon Village 2
description:
A new legend begins here!
Build and manage a town in grasslands, snow fields, even in the underworld! Set up inns, weapon stores, and more to convince adventurers to come visit.
Use items and equipment to power up your adventurers and help them get more gold and experience from their quests. Be on the lookout for new dungeons to explore and new monsters to fight!
Need help attracting adventurers? Try building new facilities, selling new kinds of food, or improving the local area to earn Titles. Keep experimenting, and you might stumble on some rare awards...
As your town develops and becomes more popular, adventurers won't just visit, but move in for good!

title: Arcane Vale
description: Arcane Vale is an action packed open-world RPG. Embark on an adventure to discover a long-lost treasure in a vast and dangerous world.

title: Gefeuert! Dein letzter Tag
description: Clog the toilet, blow up the microwave, or get your butt bare on the copier - but no matter how you try to score points, don't let your boss catch you!

title: The Last Tater
description: You are a little fried tater trying to survive as earth turns apocalyptic in this action packed side-scroller shooter

title: You and Me
description: A short puzzle RPG-Maker Game made with washitape graphics. This was made in a week.

title: In the Midnight Light
description: In the Midnight Light is a short horror RPG Maker game where you hide or face your fears to collect memory fragments which will help Ryo remember some of his important life events.

title: Almost Home Now
description: A 10 minute horror experience of a girl walking home alone at night.

title: Jello
description: Jello is a physics-based platformer where you jump as a cute slime using just the two sticks of your controller

title: Tim-Tim 2: The Almighty Gnome
description: Tim-Tim the Gnome must journey through mysterious dungeons to find his kidnapped girlfriend while battling fierce monsters with dubious origins.

title: Wonder Pot
description: Are you tired of existing poker games? Then try Wonder Pot Texas Holdem.

title: Birb Café
description: Birb Café is a coffee-making visual novel about a cute bird helping adventurers on their quests. Your choices matter!

title: Dwarfenstein
description: Fight your way through countless enemy waves in this story driven mix of First Person Shooter and Tower Defense. Bring death to various creatures in different worlds. Kill, collect crystals, level-up, die and revive again.

title: Doorman
description: Doorman is a simulation game where you go from door to door and serve people.

title: Space Lines: A Puzzle Arcade Game
description: A space puzzle adventure for kids!

title: Alien Horizon
description: A sci-fi city builder set on an inhospitable alien planet.

title: Felix the Cat
description: Join Felix on his worldwide search as flies a monoplane across mountains, delves into the ocean depths in a submarine and races across bizarre landscapes in a wild and whacky one-wheeled car! All provided by the Magic Bag of Tricks!

title: Cow Hunter
description:
Cow Hunter is a point-and-click shooting game similar to many traditional hunting games with a supposedly humorous twist. Instead of targeting deer, players shoot cows, which in most cases are flying through the air. The game features several modes where players can use weapons such as the Cowabunga Rifle. The modes are as follows:

Skeet Shooting: Cows fly across the screen and the player shoots them. Bonus items such as hamburgers also appear. This mode includes three different locations. Players point and click to shoot the flying cows.

Cow Tipping: The player controls a disembodied hand used to tip over sleeping cows. Some cows are not yet asleep and will fire dung at the player. This dung must be clicked on to stop it.

Target Practice: Cows briefly pop their heads out from behind haystacks or around barn doors. The player must point and click to shoot them.

title: Felix the Cat's Giant Electronic Comic Book
Warped Kart Racers
description: Get warped into the ultimate kart racing game - by yourself, or multiplayer - featuring the stars of 20th Television’s hit animated shows: American Dad!, Family Guy, King of the Hill and Solar Opposites! Experience iconic locations and even some surprise ones in your quest for karting glory!

title: A100
description:
This is a collection of five mini-games includes：

- Weather Invade
- Stronghold Attack
- Guard Tank
- Heavy Artillery
- Space Miner

title: Godless Tower
description: Now you are ready to accept the trial.

title: Purrate Adventure: Volcano Isle
description: Explore, Platform & Plunder a large Volcanic Isle in search of Coins, Gems, Crowns, and the 5 hidden talismans!

title: K9 Uprising
description: Experience survival & bring your best dogs to battle the waves of evil alien invaders. A top down shooter with scoring mechanics, wave based stages & 5 dog soldiers to select.

title: Impossible Crime Book
description: This is a decryption class of interactive novel. One accident, two suicides. In order to prevent more innocent lives from being killed, you will be assigned to lurk on campus with your partner and find out the suspicious in different criminal cases.

title: Effigy: The Descent
description: Effigy: The Descent is a first-person survival-horror game in which you will face statues, with your lantern as your only tool to stop them. Gather all artefacts from the cave and freedom will be yours !

title: Taste of Heaven
description: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

title: Mapstermind
description: Compete with your friends in this 3v1 asymmetrical party game. Team up as one of the piecelings or wreak havoc as the Mapster in an exciting race against time!

title: Note 2
description: Note2 needs to find Ana, daughter of scientist Dr. Anderson, its creator. Ana was taken hostage by the evil robot Note1, the first robot created by Dr. Anderson. Note2 needs to find Ana on one of the 11 planets in the solar system X. Is Ana still alive? Run, be quick, help Ana!

title: Perseverance: Part 3
description: Perseverance: Part 3 is the much-awaited conclusion to the drama/horror visual novel series full of intrigue, guts, and gossip. Swap between Jack, a father trying to protect his family, and Karen, an ex-agent on the run from her troubled past, and help them form an unlikely alliance.

title: Who Shuffled My Shapes?
description: Your shapes have been shuffled and it’s up to you to fix them! Get your 20 new puzzles back in order, it sounds simple but it’s not. With some of the simpler puzzles offering over 43 quintillion possible configurations finding the single correct one will be a challenge!

title: Badland Party
description: Badland Party continues its creators quest to perfect atmospheric side-scrolling adventures with stunning graphics and innovative physics-based gameplay. Witness the award-winning series take the visual allure another step forward, introduce dozens of new characters to play with and allow friends to play together in both local and online multiplayer modes. Or enjoy a single player adventure together with an AI companion.

title: The 10th Planet
description: The 10th Planet is a cancelled game from Bethesda Softworks. It would have been a sci-fy space combat game, slatted for release in 1997. Playstation and Sega Saturn version were also planned.

title: Attack on Titan 2: Singular Target
description: A new episode "Singular Target" is added to the Daily Life section in "Story Mode", and as a "Scout Mission" in "Another Mode".

title: Revenge Master
description: Help the king to take revenge, kill as many traitors as possible and take them with you to hell before they get to you.

title: Before the Last Hour
description: Play a unique rogue like game, mixing item and card games in an original post-apocalyptic universe. Explore, upgrade your equipment, fight unique monsters and bosses. And unlock all the secrets of the Before The Last Hour universe.

title: Uligo: A Slime's Hike
description: Join Uligo the slime in this sticky journey to find the way back home. Jump, dash, get launched, stick to any surface to triumph over any obstacles in your way. Will you overcome the dangers ahead?

title: Lunaela
description: An beautiful open world anime RPG. Play offline or online.Fight against enemies and collect materials to evolve your character. Complete your card collection and explore a world of 6Km2 with 12 different classes at your disposal.

title: Scholar
description: Scholar is a spelling game with RPG elements. Level up your hero as you spell words and unlock new skills. Fight powerful bosses at the end of each level and get that loot.

title: Sire Abandon
description: It is an RPG type game, in 2D retro. You play as a knight (Sir Abandon) who will evolve through many levels. You will have to farm certain levels several times to increase your experience and gain levels, as well as collect enough gold to improve your equipment.

title: Commando Mountain Rescue
description: Beat The Mountain - Save The Day!

title: Trash Patrol: Academic Version
description: Trash Patrol is a local cooperative multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Break into a house, look for something to steal together with your raccoon friends. Don’t forget to wash and dry all items carefully! And watch out for the homeowner - They are not amused to see you within their home

title: Furi: Onnamusha
description: Rediscover Furi with the Onnamusha Rider: a powerful fighter that alternates between two stances: fast and agile or slower but lethal, until she's able to unleash the devastating power of the Star.

title: Zombie Army 4: Dead War - Ragnarök
description:
The nightmare is almost over. Hitler’s hell-cult has been torn apart, along with the occult mastermind behind it – yet the few surviving cultists have retreated deep into Hell, and have put into motion the mysterious Projekt Ragnarök.
Schweiger is the only one able to guide Alpha Squad to wherever they have hidden – to where they will take their last stand against the cult, and stop whatever ritual of annihilation threatens the world.
Conquer Hell in the devastating 2-part Ragnarök campaign, and hopefully find some answers in the process!

title: Love is… in Small Things
description: "Love is... in small things" is a hidden picture game with emotional art by artist 'Puuung'. It is a healing game that can relieve stress and excitement like relaxation, and enjoy the charming emotional coloring game that spreads at your fingertips.

title: When You Wish Upon a Star
description: "When you wish upon a star" is a visual Nobel in the genre of love comedy that unfolds the story through the player's choice.

title: Temirana: The Lucky Princess and the Tragic Knights
description:
This is a world in which status and occupation are all determined by the month of birth. At the eastern end of the country of Temirana, about fifteen years ago, a baby with a bruise on her forehead was born as the third princess. The baby was rumored to be a "cursed princess" and was forced to live separately from her family in a mansion away from the castle, but a big turning point came for her.

One day, my 16th birthday is just around the corner. At the venue of the duel tournament "Helis Duellum," I saw five men shining in a dazzlingly strong "light."

- Yes, this "cursed princess" had special luck. When her life is in danger, things and places shine as if to tell her to avoid them. Those around her who knew the princess's luck advised her that these men were dangerous people and that’s why they shone... but it was different from the light she had seen so far. Believing in her intuition, the princess decided to invite those who seemed to shine into her knighthood order. But some of them have no experience in swordplay, nor are they even interested in being knights. Will the princess be able to overcome the calamity that is about to occur with only a small group of five knights?

title: Men in Black: The Game
description: Men in Black: The Game is an officially licensed game based on the 1997 film Men in Black. The plot is unrelated and it is a survival horror game as opposed to being a comedy.

title: Shiro to Kuro no Alice for Nintendo Switch
description: Shiro to Kuro no Alice for Nintendo Switch is a bundle of both Shiro to Kuro no Alice games.

title: Flatout Pixel Racing
description: Go flatout! No brakes needed! A retro arcade top down racing game in a pixel art style.

title: Beautiful Mystic Survivors
description: Roguelite bullet-hell meets sexy anime in Beautiful Mystic Survivors, as you rise to help gorgeous heroines destroy countless invading monsters. Plan your builds, upgrade heroines, and survive against the clock. Experience polished 3D graphics, flashy VFX, and surrounded by thousands of monsters.

title: Explosion
description: An indie puzzle game based on satisfying explosions and an exciting story. Use your wits to solve levels with varying TNTs and progress through the fun and exciting story of Amber, you, and the Corporation!

title: Memory Shards
description: Live the story of Jake, a man stuck in the past as he finds out a way to understand it by playing an old JRPG from his childhood. This is a small introspective drama story.

title: Curro
description: Curro is a first person shooter game. Set your record in the world generated endlessly.

title: Soda Sabotage
description: Soda Sabotage is a Sci-fi 2D top-down shooter, where the player guns his way through 25 levels and 5 bosses belonging to a soda weapon factory using their own weapons against in order to disable the evil soda weapon making factory. Shoot, dash but most importantly survive!

title: Heroes of Time
description: A turn-based JRPG game which mixes science-fiction and medieval fantasy making young teens from the future contrasting with medieval people and creatures. Get ready to make your own choises to save the future.

title: Drift Type C
description: A multi-discipline real-physics driving game where the ghosts are actual ghosts. Drive 50+ real spec cars right from the factory on 100+ miles of track to free the God of Time. Master Drift, Time Attack, Off-road, Rally, and even a few head to head races against bad AI. Robust Creative Mode.

title: Baldi's Basics Classic Remastered
description: Baldi's Basics Classic Remastered is a survival horror stealth game that parodies cheap 90's edutainment and never takes itself too seriously. Explore Baldi's schoolhouse and try to find all 7 notebooks, but don't get caught by Baldi! He wants to play hide-and-seek, but something... Isn't right. Luckily you have a slew of items you can find and use to your advantage, but Baldi also has friends who can cause problems for you if you're not careful. And remember, Baldi hears every noise you make, so do what you can to stay quiet!

title: Animal Babysister Fighter
description: As the zombies and monsters are taking over quite a few planets in the galaxy, animals are losing their habitants and your mission is to protect the animals to take the spaceship to the shelters on the first colony star built by human beings.

title: The Bathhouse
description: The Bathhouse is a Japanese horror game.

title: Bug Explorers
description: Bug Explorers is an educational minigame collection with an insect theme.

title: Warframe: Rise of the Warlords
description: Confront warring factions throughout a sprawling interplanetary system as you follow the guidance of the mysterious Lotus and level up your Warframe, build an Arsenal of destructive firepower, and realize your true potential across massive open worlds in this thrilling, genre-defining third-person combat experience.

title: Four Footed Friends
description:
Four Footed Friends is an adaptation of the classic 1914 children's book of the same name. It contains rhymes and illustrations about animals with 40 pages in total. The bookworms Albert, Wendy and Pablo guide the player through the story. Albert has interesting facts about animals, while Wendy shows the player how to learn new words, and Pablo allows the player to colour a picture from the story. Activities involve reading, spelling, vocabulary, animal facts, painting, and discovering hidden surprises in the backgrounds such as videos.

With the Inter-activator, the player can go forwards, backwards, go to a page, change the language, and visit the card catalogue for other information. The game was fully localized in English, Spanish, French and Japanese. The game also included a parent guide which showed parents how to use the CD ROM.

title: Jamir
description: Jamir is a free-to-play fast paced sci-fi tactical shooter created by one person. Master your abilities and items to destroy creatures and enemies. Upgrade your character, guns, abilities and items to become the most powerful along the globe.

title: Spearhead
description: Spearhead is the story of agents who join secret organizations in a chaotic world surrounded by infectious diseases. Experience the story of six agents joining.

title: Cyber Bay
description: In the distant future, when every person is under the control of the system, only one brave warrior tries to resist it.

title: Interstellar Space: Genesis - Evolving Empires
description: Interstellar Space: Genesis - Evolving Empires is the second expansion to the turn-based space 4X strategy game Interstellar Space: Genesis. Adds two major new features to the game, Evolutions and Minor Civilizations. These features provide tons of new content, 7 new leaders and 2 new music tracks!

title: Running in the Y2K
description: Run, Jump and Hunt through procedurally generated levels to feed your family in the post-apocalyptic world of the year 2000 after the Y2K bug occurred. Compete against everyone in the leaderboards to show who is the best hunter in the new world.

title: Symmetry Lines
description: Simple puzzle game with symmetry and lines.

title: Stadtleben
description: Stadtleben is a strategic city building game in which you place gardens, streets and buildings on squares to create a big city. Here you should build as many or high skyscrapers as possible in order to be able to plant more tiles.

title: Melodier
description: Connect music note blocks and solve the puzzle to discover a popular melody in this good looking minimalist puzzle!

title: Adventure Trip: London - Collector's Edition
description: If you are a virtual bird but love adventure too, this game is just for you.

title: M87
description: An computer's artificial intelligence (AI) becomes the dominant form of intelligence on Earth, as computer programs and robots effectively take the control of the planet away from the human species. M87 is ex special force marine, and he is the only on in this world who can take this world back

title: Khoros
description: Khoros is a Sokoban puzzle style game set on the graceful scenario of the greek theater, take Ere to the glory performing the most claimed plays. ¡Bring togheter a powerfull cast and rise against the top critics of that time!

title: Planetary Planter
description: Planetary Planter is an open-world farming game where, instead of farming normal plants, you grow celestial bodies while exploring an alien world.

title: The Backrooms VR
description: Live the true Backrooms VR Experience in a psychological horror game, where you'll be alone in a liminal world full of entities that will hunt you at every moment, Scary, dark this immersive VR experience allows you to use your hands to grab and use items to solve puzzles inside this liminal world.

title: Delivery in Space
description: Delivery in Space is a relaxing puzzle game where you'll travel across the galaxy making deliveries to different planets. Black Hole, Nebula, Solar Storm and other wonders of outer space won't stop you on this journey! Prepare your spaceship and navigate using a card-based movement system.

title: Reaper of Immortals
description: Reaper of Immortals is a 2D pixel-art adventure game that tells the story of a lost reaper who is seeking his true purpose. Fight your way through countless enemies, reap everything that stands in your way, and find out the ultimate truth.

title: The Golden Eyed Ghosts
description: The Golden Eyed Ghosts is a dark fantasy soulslike heavily influenced by the legacy of Zelda adventures, set in the crumbling kingdom of Andromeda. As exiled warrior Orion, search for a way to restore his memories and unravel a terrifying conspiracy.

title: Rowfall
description: Skillfully arrange falling rows of colored stones so that at least 3 of the same color touch and explode in breathtaking effects. Move all stones simultaneously to create new combinations and master random events that will change the game experience. Enjoy Rowfall!

title: Time to Hunt
description: Here you could not only experience thrilling combat on land, but also on the sea within one match. Engage in sea battles between medieval ships, feel the confrontation between cold weapons and firearms. Fight or hide，Law of the Jungle or win-win...... to survive to be the last one standing.

title: Roll Player
description: In Roll Player your goal is to create the best role playing character. Roll and draft dice to build up your character’s attributes. Purchase weapons and armor to outfit your hero. Train to gain skills and discover your hero’s traits to prepare them for their journey.

title: There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings
description: Enter the doomed town of Pareildas. Watch as the flames turn bone and stone to ash. Like joined wicks, we'll all burn together.

title: Escape from Rowei
description: Strategic puzzle, your every choice will be decisive to save Leycla or not!

title: Eloquent Countenance
description: Eloquent Countenance is a short 2.5D RPG Maker horror/narrative-driven game with visual novel/adventure elements following the story of a nun who was selected by the church to assist in progressing the pastor's funeral service suddenly hearing a strange voice who claims to be a "guardian angel".

title: Grandpa's Cheese
description: Grandpa has gone mad! collect the cheese and give them to Reeze so he can feed his mouse to get the hell out of the house!

title: Doterminism
description:
This beautiful minimalistic 'dutch design' game with a stunning soundtrack is a mix of art and puzzles.

The black and white dots got separated and you can reunite them.

Remove parts of the artwork, of specific colors, and try not to get stuck!

The zen mode is a way to relax, unwind the mind.

If you feel like a challenge though, choose the hard mode, and every decision will have a consequence!

Choose your own color palette to suite your style and reunite the black and white. Every level is handmade and designed.

title: Back to the Dawn
description:
A gripping prison escape RPG woven with crime, corruption, and hidden agendas. Step into a maximum-security facility where every inmate has a past—and a plan. You'll have to fight to survive, investigate, and ultimately break free before the time runs out.

Uncover a scheme that threatens more than just your life—it could bring down the entire city. In this thrilling adventure, choices matter, and escape is your only salvation!

title: Super Alloy Ranger
description: Super Alloy Ranger is a 2D side-scrolling action game. Play as Marksman Kelly or Combat Robot No.2 to challenge different levels within the dangerous Machine Empire and unlock new weapons. Use Kelly’s shooting and No.2’s deathblows to defeat abnormal Machine Bosses!

title: Zenless Zone Zero
description: Zenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse, here to provide a thrilling combat experience. Build a squad of up to three and begin your assault with Basic and Special Attacks. Dodge and Parry to neutralize your opponents' counterattacks, and when they're Stunned, unleash a powerful combo of Chain Attacks to finish them off! Remember, different opponents have different traits, and it would be prudent to use their weaknesses to your advantage.

title: Cupid Parasite: Sweet and Spicy Darling
description: Cupid Parasite: Sweet and Spicy Darling is a fandisc for Cupid Parasite.

title: Barbarium
description:
Barbarium is a free action platformer, set in a post-apocalyptic world, where the man with the fastest lasergun and the biggest sword is the king.
Travel across exotic enviroments, kicking ass and saving girls. Fight towering bosses, drink beer, and enjoy a casual chat with the locals!

title: Scripted Souls
description: The title granted to those who choose to bravely fight against the corroded ones were known as the scripters. As a scripter solve and use the power of words to control your monsters and defeat your enemy.

title: A Gladiator's Hell
description: A Gladiator's Hell is a Singleplayer 2D side scroller set in a rundown city name Outlinn You will play as a gladiator name "Gill" that is going thought the city "Hacking and Slashing" to reach is biggest enemy.

title: Blocked Zona
description: Blocked Zona is a 2D shooter in which you play as a special unit mercenary who has gone to an infested area infested with zombies in search of the R-327 military chip. The fate of the world is at stake. Arm yourself with the best military weapons and go into battle!

title: Slaughter Cannon 2
description: Slaughter Cannon - Continuation of the first part of an exciting physical puzzle! In the game you will find even more exciting and exciting levels of varying difficulty.

title: Incubus
description: Incubus is a 2D simulation game. Get help from Incubus and have sex with various women for 30 days.

title: Block Breaker 2
description: Block Breaker 2 - Sequel to an exciting puzzle game with many challenging levels and beautiful graphics.

title: Box Rush 2: Ice Worlds
description: An icy winter has come to the magical kingdom and ice monsters have invaded your kingdom. The little prince must once again take up arms and repulse the enemies. Take advantage of all the bonuses that were before and those that have appeared again!

title: Brave Survivor
description: Brave survivor - In this heart-pounding beat em up, you take on the role of a brave survivor whose fist punches a path to freedom through hordes of enemies. Beat bad guys mercilessly, collect bonuses and destroy bosses in this incredible game!

title: Long Journey
description: Long journey - Many people know that a large amount of sweets is bad for teeth .. But not for this skeleton! Embark on a long adventure with this skinny sweet tooth and collect all the donuts!

title: Raccoon Tales
description: Play as a raccoon in this stealth game where you steal, destroy and knock over trash cans in a variety of levels while eluding dangerous foes.

title: Bobbi Adventure
description: This is a kind dwarf Bobby, who travels through a fantasy world.

title: Lone Elven Wanderer
description: Lone Elven Wanderer is a 2D platformer with roguelike elements. You have to go on an incredible adventure through different worlds in search of gold, jewels and fame.

title: Arcade Archives: Fighting Hawk
description:
The Falcon joins the battle in the skies!

"FIGHTING HAWK" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1988.
Players pilot the fighter plane FALCON and battle enemies through stages set on plains, icebergs, glaciers, snowfields, and cities, with the ultimate aim of taking down the enemy's latest bomber: the DRAGON BAT!
Build up your reserves of powerful missiles, then unleash them on high-powered foes!

title: Shopping Clutter: The Best Playground
description: The Walker family is back with an all new puzzle adventure game. You know the Walkers from the Travel Mosaic series. This time, they are looking to create a perfect playground where children of all ages and their parents can spend quality time together. As it turns out, this will not be an easy task. Help the Walkers sort through mounds of clutter to find all the necessary equipment to finish the job.

title: The Lost Kingdom Prophecy
description: Help Princess Serena stop the dark wizard Balaak and save Rosefal in a fantasy match‑3 with hidden‑object stages, four match modes, and power‑ups across configurable square and hex boards.

title: Pizza Run
description: Pizza Run is a Runner style arcade game where the user leaps and dashes through obstacles to get to the finish line. Play and survive through 12 levels of as you complete your quest as a Pepperoni Pizza.

title: Barbie as the Princess and the Pauper
description: In her new adventure, Barbie takes on two roles--Erika and Princess Anneliese. Based on the classic story The Prince and the Pauper, this game follows Erika as she tries to prove that she's worthy to be crowned queen. With the help of Princess Anneliese, you must help Erika move through the game's unique environments and settings--the village, castle, and forest--so that she is fully prepared for the coronation ceremony and her role as queen. Showcase Erika's best qualities by helping villagers, solving puzzles, and completing creative tasks.

title: Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses
description: Barbie is cast as Genevieve, one of the twelve princesses who live with their windowed father King Randolph in a castle.
