They live a frivolous live, so Randolph brings over his cousin Duchess Rowena to raise them as proper princesses. She makes their lives miserable however and poisons the king, so they flee to a magical world brought to life through a story of their mother. Rowena traps them there, along with Genevieve's friend Derek, and they need to use a goblet to collect mystical water that can cure their father.

title: Barbie Fashion Show
description: Barbie Fashion Show lets you help Barbie get ready for Fashion Week in Paris! Advance through 3 design studios creating stylish outfits for Barbie and her four friends to model. It's up to you to put on the coolest, most fashionable fashion shows ever!

title: Barbie Mermaid Adventure
description:
In Barbie Mermaid Adventure, Barbie assumes the role of a specimen of that mythical fish-human hybrid, the mermaid, and plans a party with all of her undersea friends. Unfortunately, a magical light shell in the main palace broke. In order to fix it, Barbie needs to enlist the help of 3 rainbow dolphins.

Explore three exotic undersea worlds!; Play seven fun-filled games and activities!; Care for cuddlefish, free Whisper the whale, and more!; Collect decorations and hand out party invitations!; Help Mermaid Barbie and her friends compose the "Song of the Sea"!; Play two of a kind with school fish and watch them dance at the celebration and design a crown and necklace for Barbie to wear!

title: Barbie of Swan Lake: The Enchanted Forest
description: Play imaginative games to restore the forest to its grandeur as you journey to six magical locations! Search for hidden items within each world as you paint murals, create a field of singing flowers, piece together puzzles, and more.

title: Barbie Jewelry Designer
description: Barbie helps you design all kinds of jewelry that you can wear. Mix and match colors, patterns, and pretty designs. Print favorite designs on the Print 'n Shrink material using an ink-jet printer, then simply cut them out and bake them in an oven. They miraculously shrink into colorful plastic jewelry.

title: Barbie as Princess Bride
description: Barbie as Princess Bride introduces the player to a young Princess Barbie and her childhood friend, Prince Ken. The 2 grow up close together, fully intending to wed the day they come of age. One day, Prince Ken is called out to sea on a long journey but promises the princess that he will return to marry her one day.

title: Barbie Beauty Styler
description: Barbie Beauty Styler is a creative painting / drawing package featuring Barbie and her friends Teresa, Kira and Christie. It is aimed at the younger gamer. There is very little writing, all the icons 'speak' to identify themselves as the mouse passes over them and the game regularly chips in with encouraging comments like 'You're really good at this' and 'Isn't this fun!'.

title: Barbie Magic Genie Bottle
description:
Barbie Magic Genie Bottle is a computer game that is packaged with a custom-purpose input peripheral -- an actual genie bottle that attaches to a Windows PC via a standard PC 15-pin joystick port. The bottle is used to invoke special actions during the game and is thus a required component of the gameplay.

Barbie transports the player to the distant land where you will be assisting her. Barbie needs the player to visit 5 different lands and collect 5 different gems. In order to collect the gem in each land, the player must solve a puzzle. Solving the puzzle requires collecting 5 puzzle pieces scattered about the land.

Gameplay involves navigating through a first-person 3D city on foot and via flying carpet, which raises the player up to a higher plane. All the while, Barbie is in tow lending advice. Throughout different cities, the player also has to interact with other people and complete sub-quests that they assign in order to advance the game.

title: Barbie as Sleeping Beauty
description: Barbie as Sleeping Beauty tells the story of Princess Rose, who was gifted with beauty, laughter and love by good fairies, but cursed by an evil fairy to fall asleep for one hundred years before her 16th birthday. Help Princess Rose get ready for her 16th birthday party, wake up her animal friends, design a crown and dress to wear to the party, and find the hidden fairies in the library to get the key to the banquet hall.

title: Barbie Nail Designer
description: Design personalized nail stickers you can really wear. Join Barbie at her fabulous nail salon and choose a style to match your own--Daisy Days, Cool Styles, or Glossy Glam. Choose from an array of colors and animated designs, from pinks and reds, blues and greens, to rainbows and fun jungle prints. You can even create your own special nail designs. Then add sparkles and other finishing touches for the ultimate digital manicure. Now print the nails you have designed on special sticker sheets included--and wear your nails for instant fingernail fun!

title: Dome Keeper
description:
Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action mining game. Use the time between attacks to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources and relics – deliver them back to your dome to unlock powerful upgrades and useful new gadgets.
But it won’t be long until the relentless monsters return - do you risk delving deeper into the mine? Or return to base and prepare for imminent attack? The choice is yours, but make it quickly!

title: Boo!
description: 'Boo!' is a spooky puzzle game for you! Can you make the correct pumpkin in 42 Halloween themed levels?

title: Polar Penguin Post
description: Penguin Delivery Service!! Run a logistics company in Winter Mountain, the land of snow! Place the items in the bag so that the penguins can deliver them safely. Do people's favors and gain trust. You can help the Pola Penguin Post settle and penguins become recognized as residents.

title: SenS
description: In the Beginning was the Nothingness... Enter the Unknown, explore the Infinite, find your own SenS.

title: A Shot in the Dark
description: A Shot in the Dark is a choice-driven adult visual novel about new possibilities and dark secrets.

title: No One Survived
description: This is a multiplayer cooperative open world construction survival sandbox game, where you and your friends must find supplies and build shelters in this world. You have to keep an eye on your character's needs state at all times, a bad state is likely to lead to death.

title: Picture Builder
description: Innovative art puzzle. Build pixel pictures from blocks by stacking them on top of each other.

title: Dreamin' Her: Boku ha, Kanojo no Yume wo Miru
description: From the creators of Seven Days and Lost:Smile, Life0 presents their third game: "Dreamin' Her". In his dreams, the ideal girlfriend appears taking the form of his childhood friend. Is she really just a dream, or is she something more?

title: Deios I: Director's Cut
description: Deios I is an arena shooter set in a surreal pixel art landscape. Players traverse through strange areas, challenging a series of arenas. Set in an alternative Internet world. The players uncover a mystery of what is the Deios BBS system invented by a strange interfaith cyber author. Themes of God.

title: Palmas
description: Pick up a weapon, use your ability, shoot down your friend~but be careful! you might mess yourself up by opening the box.

title: Nazi Furry
description: Nazi Furry will wonder you with animations of hot unusual characters after every successfully passed level. You need to show up your logic in interesting puzzle game to enjoy everything what furry girls prepared for you!

title: Kitabashers United
description: Bad Dudes are attacking Kitty City. Team Kitty has United to Bash the Bad Dudes. "Kitabashers United" is a fantastic 'JRPG inspired' game with a turn-based combat system.

title: Dune Mechanic: Survive the Steampunk Era
description: Create weapons of your dreams from gunpowder pistols to grenade launchers. Craft cartridges by mixing powder ingredients. Melt ore, blow glass, study chemistry, and make explosives. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the Dune deserts!

title: Gran Premio
description: A fast paced online multiplayer car racing game!

title: Mist
description: Uncover the secrets of a ruined world in Mist — a dark RPG with idle mechanics, evolution, and horror vibes. Battle alien horrors, shape your destiny, and search for your missing daughter in a story where every choice matters.

title: Paper Bride 2: Zangling Village
description: This is the sequel to our Paper Bride series based on Chinese folklore. This story takes place in Zangling Village, where players must explore a village shrouded in occult mystery to uncover the secret origins of this haunted village.

title: The Princess of the Tower wants a Hero
description: Princess Lumi has been held captive in the demon lord’s castle situated in a land of everlasting winter. She hates it. It’s cold, it’s lonely, the food is bad, and there’s literally nothing to do! The only good thing about this place is the tea and snacks.

title: Solraid
description: SOLRAID is a single player top-down spaceship shooter.

title: 01's Blackhole
description: 01's Blackhole is a singleplayer 2D top-down bullet-hell RPG about Jack getting sucked into a blackhole and has to find his way back home and stop who is creating the blackholes.

title: PewDiePie's Paradise Island
description:
Survive on this paradise island and wait for the chopper!

Game done in 72 hours for indies vs pewdiepie game jam.

title: Bear Surfin Mega Wave
description:
A short difficult fast paced crazy weird arcade game with hectic graphics. You are 'Bear' surfing a Mega Wave.

Use the mouse to maneuver Bear around obstacles. Try to get crates and health packs. When the counter reaches zero you win.

title: The Call of Krul'ar
description:
Survive the horrors of the unknown as you expand out to keep from being dragged into the darkness; and devoured by that which lurks inside.

Collect, Combine, Defend, and Expand using the various cards you find in this land.

title: How to Live a Healthy Hentai Lifestyle!
description:
Gotou Hajime has enrolled in Penile University, majoring in perversion in order to study and deepen his understanding of the art and eventually carry out research on the subject.

Due to Hajime’s chosen field of study, he has registered to live with the Maezono family – a family whose mother is the legendary pervert that prevented World War 3 with her sexual diplomacy!

title: Ari In Wonderland: Episode 1
description: Ari after a long day falls fast asleep and goes back into wonderland. She has no idea why she is back. A lot has changed and the more she thinks about her past it gets more and more blurry. Ari meets some friends on the way to help her find what she wants and to restore wonderland, discover Ari's past along with her.

title: Neko Secret: Homecoming
description: When you were traveling around the world, someone told you about an anime factory located in some Neko Town. Now this is your way. Perhaps the anime begins here. Is this your place?

title: Warframe: Vor's Revenge
description:
In Warframe: Vor's Revenge you get the following additions:
- "Nova". Hunt the "Raptor" on Europa if it is Nova you seek...
- Orokin Void Map expansion (with Mobile Defense, Defense, and Capture!) with 5 new Prime weapons to be found (Bronco, Fang, Paris, Braton, Orthos)
- Captain Vor Boss Battle (drops rare "Seer" scoped pistol blueprints)
- New Sentinel Attachments - Jet Wings, Koi tail, Mechhead mask
- Dojo Statues have Arrived! Explore 12 new placeable decorations for your dojo (Plus, coming soon, +2 more decos for top ranked clans from Fusion MOA and Snipetron event)
- New Weapons

title: Reaction Quake 3
description:
The idea is that each bullet counts for a lot, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't pump them full of as many bullets as you can spare; they'll get a chance to shoot back before they die if you don't finish them off. Cover actually means something, it's better to make sure there's a pillar or a desk near by to duck behind, especially if you have to reload or bandage yourself.
Combine that with the ability to strafe, ramp, ladder, and double jump and you've got yourself one hell of a good time.

title: Miss Clue: Formula for Danger
description:
Jane's summer vacation is interrupted when she arrives at the lodge of her Aunt and Uncle, and finds out about a mysterious formula.
Her friend is plunged into a difficult situation, and needs the help of Jane Darcy to get to the bottom of the mystery! Will you be able to find the hidden formula, before it's too late?
Unravel a web of secrets and put your sleuthing skills to the test, as you take on the risky mystery of Formula for Danger!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Crusaders
description: Warhammer: Dark Crusaders is a cancelled FPS that was in development for PC by Mindscape in 1995 / 1996. Dark Crusaders was going to be one of the few first person shooters based on the Warhammer world, but the gameplay was not that much fun and in the end Mindscape decided to never publish the game, even though it was almost complete. The game was however later released onto the internet and is for the most part playable. It seems that the FMV sequences used in Warhammer: Dark Crusaders were later recycled for Warhammer: Final Liberation, a turn-based tactics game published for Windows in 1997.

title: TKKG: Deadly Chocolate
description: TKKG is a point and click adventure game following four students solving a crime.

title: Warframe: Shadows of the Dead
description:
ADDITIONS
- New Warframe: Nekros
- New Prime Warframe: Mag
- Survival Missions Return!
- Survival now takes place in procedurally generated levels, allowing greater mission variety, challenge, and replayability.
- Weekly leaderboards are now live for all survival missions on the Starchart!
- All Raid Void Keys have been retroactively replaced with Survival missions.
- A handful of our new mods can be found by playing Survival missions, good luck!
- The Conclave
- New Level Sets: Orokin Derelict Spacecrafts.
- New Sentinels!
- New boss: Infested Golem
- Level Expansion - Grineer Settlement
- New Weapons!
- New Clan weapons!
- New Prime Weapons in the Void!
- New Mods!
- New Customization Options:
- Clan Dojo Level update/props:
- All Grineer now speak "Grineer", a language capable of communicating their barbaric ways!

title: Growing My Grandpa!
description: Growing My Grandpa! is a narrative-driven point-and-click horror game with virtual pet elements.

title: Friday Night Funkin': V.S. Father Foundest
description: Boyfriend and Girlfriend visit America's greatest national monument- Father Foundest - for presidents day!

title: A Floof's Adventure
description: The giant currant tree has been giving fewer fruits over time, your duty is to, at least, bring back some edible currants to your village...

title: Sinister Night
description: Sinister Night is a multiplayer, social deduction horror game combined with betrayal. Eight streamers came to an abandoned Gnostic school where a terrible murder happened, yet two of them have been possessed by the Corrupter. Once the Scarlet Dream started and piercing screams split the air, one player was lying in their own blood. Hidden under the Ghost, is it Satan incarnate or a wicked witch? Wraiths that died miserably are still wandering around in this school. They will tell you exactly what happened here. Find the Offering that stops the evil rituals, or execute the Corrupters hidden among you. Save your life from your destiny as the "Last Supper."

title: The History Channel: The Civil War Experience
Slaycation Paradise
description: Are you tired of the same boring old vacations? Then boy have we got the tonic for you! Slaycation Paradise offers the ultimate in multi-dimensional apocalyptic tours. Slay away your worries with Twin-Stick action mixed with Tower Defence as you visit the end-of-world scenarios of your dreams!

title: Dragon Ball FighterZ: Super Edition
description:
Dragon Ball FighterZ Super Edition includes:
• Goku (Ultra instinct)
• Kefla
• Broly (DBS)
• Gogeta (SSGSS)
• Jiren
• Zamasu (Fused)
• Vegito (SSGSS)
• Goku (SSGSS) and Vegeta (SSGSS) early unlock
• For each of these characters, you will receive 5 costume colors, a lobby avatar and Z stamp

title: Tekken 7: Legendary Edition
description: This version contains the base game plus 7 DLC fighters.

title: Baldo: The Guardian Owls - The Three Fairies Edition
description: Action, adventure, dungeons... Dive into a thrilling odyssey!

title: Academy34
description: Become a freshman cadet at the prestigious Sentinel Academy, where aspiring Agents train to protect the world – while navigating the familiar chaos of a wealthy school full of young adults.

title: Endrr
description: Survive the hordes of monsters as long as you can. Fight, upgrade your skills, loot equipments, die, rince and repeat.

title: Harvest Moon: One World - Collector's Edition
Gravit
description: Manipulate gravity to reach the end of each stage in this first-person, physics-based, puzzle-platformer. The game includes a variety of hand-crafted levels and increasingly difficult challenges to put your problem-solving and navigational skills to the test.

title: Intern: An Intern's Guide to Maintaining Internal Rage
description:
Welcome to your first day at *redacted*! This new employee guide comes to you directly from the Far Corner Devs.

We here at *redacted* thank you for joining our family. You may have heard people refer to this job as: monotonous, passion devouring or a complete waste of shareholder funds.

title: MugenCards
description: Play MugenCards, an endless card game!

title: My Name is Mayo 3
description: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!

title: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator
description: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator is a 2.5D first-person adventure mystery game where you play as an investigator who solves cases by taking pictures of cryptids, urban legends, & mythological creatures as well as befriending them in an open-world environment

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Legends of Mystery 4
description: Mystical Legends 4 is a fascinating puzzle game. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of mystery, mystery and mysticism. Don't be afraid to immerse yourself in a magical and mystical world, 500 mosaic pictures will help you to do so.

title: Volvalis
description: Experience a dark, epic RPG mystery laden with multi-faceted characters and dangerous secrets! Unfolding with a soundtrack carefully implemented for maximum storytelling and emotional impact, the lost land Volvalis beckons the intrepid....

title: Waste
description: Waste is a pseudo 3D RPG where you take on the role of a Dustbin/Garbage man, collecting Waste from the houses of the street you are working on, avoiding obstacles like cars, bikes, dogs.. If your customer is happy, they will invite you inside to play on their new computer or ask other favors.

title: Ahmes
description: In Ancient Egypt, Ahmes and his little brother Akil are orphans and live a simple life. Until one day, the Royal Guards come and attack their village. Akil is thrown into the Nil river. Ahmes rushes to save his brother, but a giant hand emerges from the water and carries Akil into the darkness of the Nil. Ahmes then enters the Underworld in order to save his little brother.

title: Masks of Deception
description: Masks of Deception is a 6 player multiplayer game where you must work together to find and expel a demon. However, correctly identifying the monster will be difficult as one of you has been possessed and turned against the rest. Use your senses and investigative tools to gather the information required to send this hellish creature back to the depths from whence it came, all while avoiding the fatal wretched beings that stalk these haunted lands. Note that one chance is all you get, and any mistake can lead to utter failure.

title: Aeolwyn's Legacy
description: Aeolwyn’s Legacy is a new first-person party-based RPG for the PC. It’s an epic tale in a sprawling world filled with knights, kings, allies and betrayal.

title: Skull Maze: Tiny Roguelike
description: Skull Maze was a very simple roguelike where you have to run through levels collecting coins while avoiding enemies

title: Thirty Cycles
description:
A game made for Nemesis Jam.
Control one of the nine knights and fight to become the greatest.

Video game mechanics should not be patented.

Inspired by a recently patented Nemesis system from Shadow of Mordor and Shadow of War games.

title: Hellstuck: Rage With Your Friends
description: Get ready to rage with your friends in this co-op precise platforming adventure! You're stuck in Hell. You can only jump upwards and all you have to do is escape … it can't be that hard, right?!

title: Star Hearts: Launch Point
description: Star Hearts: Launch Point is a tight 2D action adventure featuring an 8-bit retro aesthetic in classic NES-fashion. Journey to the galaxy’s edge and discover the origins of Prin - an interstellar revolutionary in the making - as she embarks upon her first space-faring adventure!

title: Hayai
description: You are Ronin. Survive against an onslaught of enemies using a unique, mouse-based combat system. Draw your attack, felling your enemies in one swoop!

title: Spacemancer
description: You will peek, manipulate and travel through the chaos dimensions in search of energy stabilizers to fix the messed up world.

title: Trade Sails
description: Ever wanted to deliver cargos amongst the islands that waiting you to discover! In Trade Sails, you will sail for the delivery of cargos, while a shadow is waiting for you at the sea.

title: Spotted
description: Spotted is a mouse maze game, requiring agility and bravery. Travel along the river, being careful to only touch the water and not the riverbank. The more water you accumulate, the higher your score. As you progress, the pace will get faster, so try your best to keep up.

title: The Jumping Burger
description:
Join BIG B on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

title: House Flipper: Farm
description:
Experience fresh farm vibes, thanks to the latest addition to the House Flipper family.
Let your surroundings be filled with the sounds of the life of your animal companions!
Build homesteads and look after swine, sheep, chickens, and more!
Your very own farming adventure begins now!

Hungry? It's thyme for dinner! Lettuce celebrate!
No matter what you plant, you better take care of creating the right conditions for your vegetation!
A selection of unique tools and a set of farming skills will help you with that!
Prepare the soil, spare no water, and you shall be harvesting plentiful crops in a blink of an eye!

Keeping your farm in check is not just a responsibility, but also a pleasure!
Whistle for your favorite steed, hop in the saddle, and go for a ride around your land.
Keep in mind that this is just the beginning of your adventure, farmer.
Maplebloom Village awaits you!

title: Get to the Top 2: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade
The Witch's Garden
description: The Witch’s Garden is a relaxing, slice-of-life gardening and crafting game.

title: Ugo Volt
description:
Ugo Volt was an action-adventure shooter set in a post-apocalyptic Lisbon in the 22nd century, the world would be at a detriment due to global warming and only Ugo would be able to define the destiny of humanity.
It started development in 1999 as an entry to a contest from Infogrames Portugal with the title of Fusion, placing it at 7th place. It eventually was renamed Doshowbikum: The Run when Move Interactive was formed and renamed again when the game was further in development to simply as Ugo Volt, being showcased at E3 2006.

In 2007, the game was put on hold due to financial difficulties after its fundraisers pulled out of the project, and by 2008, the company was out of business.

title: Cybernetic Moon Horse 2071
description: Cybernetic Moon Horse 2071 is an endless galloper that randomises itself on and throughout each run, the results of each randomisation evolve over time.

title: Play with Neko
description: Sweet, half-naked, hot cat girls are waiting for your presence.

title: Hentai Milf Quiz
description: You must remember the school curriculum and answer the most interesting questions on the topic of the lesson, just remember that it is not so simple, because after the correct answer your game teacher will remove one piece of clothing from himself.

title: Gamer Girl
description: Gamer Girl is a cancelled FMV game by Wales Interactive that was announced in 2020. In the game, the player plays as a moderator for Alexandra "Abicake99" Burton, a famous streamer, and has to help moderate her chat, her stream content and also help her make personal choices. The game was quickly cancelled after its announcement after the trailer received backlash from the online community due to the insensitive nature of the game.

title: Town of Us
description: Town Of Us is a mod for Among Us that adds brand new roles into the game, all with unique abilities.

title: Ralph's Party RPG
description: Ralph's Party RPG is easy and fancy RPG game. Complete the game by going through all the dungeons, but be careful - there might be some enemies waiting for you. It has simple design, good music, and great levels.

title: Othello: Daynight Time Clash
description: Transcending time and space -- Nymphs from all dimensions, emerge and engage! Let's Othello!

title: The Lost Dachshund
description: Your granddaughter is coming over on the ferry from the mainland. You have promised her a puppy for her birthday– a dachshund named "Peanut". But Peanut has escaped her pen and is free on the island. You must traverse the island and rescue the mischievous puppy, before your granddaughter arrives.

title: Apocalive
description: Fight for your life against zombies, dinosaurs and other post-apocalyptic creatures. The game includes several maps and different game modes. Some are Fast-paced, while other are slow.

title: Snack Stall
description: AboutThis is a game that runs a small fast food restaurant where you need to order for guests, make dishes, and entertain customers.

title: KeepUp Survival: Red Desert Map
description: A small additional Red Desert Map. Explore this cute little map, go hunting and build a nice shelter.

title: Typer Girl
description: Enemies will continue to appear from the right side of the screen. All enemies will have a word above their heads, and you need to use the keyboard to type the correct letter to kill them before they reach the edge of the screen.

title: Berrywitched!
description: Berrywitched! is a lovely twisted game where you, our protagonist, are lost within a forest that is supposedly cursed. You pass out, only to be awoken by a cute girl claiming to be a Strawberry Witch.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Vs Huggy Wuggy
description: Friday Night Funkin': Vs Huggy Wuggy is a Friday Night Funkin' mod developed by KJElliott. The mod is based around the character Huggy Wuggy from Poppy Playtime.

title: ImageStriker
description:
Image Striker is a 2D vertical-scrolling shooting game.
You can operate the fighter “Image Striker” to fire shots and destroy enemies.
The fighter supports forward shooting and two pods.
These pods can be switched forward, sideways and backward.
You can also use 6 different types of head parts.
By using the appropriate head parts according to the situation, you can enjoy the strategy.
The game has a 6-stages long Arcade mode with 3 difficulty levels, and a 3-minutes long Caravan mode.

title: Hentai vs Virus: I Am Waifu
description: The game about anime girl trying to stop the dangerous virus. The Hentai-prequel story of waifus fighting with evil forces

title: Kyou Kara Maou!: Ore-sama Quest
description: Ore-sama Quest was released June 23, 2006. It was released to run on windows XP and later had a patch released to allow it to run on Vista.

title: Goetia 2
description: What could happen to two lovers who decided for a short break in Venice, Italy? Among all the possible scenarios, being pulled apart and tricked by a demon is certainly not what Daphné and Luca were expecting. Awakened as a pure soul in a twisted world he doesn’t understand, Luca is trapped in the reality of Buer, a demon with ulterior motives.

title: Cubey's Adventures Classic
description: Cubey's Adventures Classic is the original game in the Cubey's Adventures lineup of games. It's a retro-styled platformer game, with approx. 21 levels. This game, though not finished, was released as a standalone game on the Microsoft Store, later being released as a .zip file online. You play as a pink, happy cube, on a journey to defeat Lord Evilcube.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Dearest Double Date
description: On a lovely friday night, Boyfriend and Girlfriend are taking a break in GF's bedroom. Unfortunately, the Dearest family knows all... Does BF really know what he's in for?

title: Aqorel
description: Cook up different solutions to elemental puzzles as you make deliveries on a strange planet. Combine and use the elements in this unique system to create your path forward.

title: Cubey's Adventures Rewritten
description: Cubey's Adventures Rewritten is a retro-styled platformer game, with 58 maps split across three "Map Packs": 20 in Classic Pack (Original maps from Cubey's Adventures Classic), 30 in Default Pack (The new levels for Cubey's Adventures Rewritten) and 8 in Precision Pack (An extremely hard pack added in an update).

title: Arcmaze
description: Arcmaze is a free-to-play browser 3D MMORPG with first-person view and grid-based movement set in dark fantasy medieval world with multiple dungeons. Develop your character and explore the fantasy world of Arcmaze. Learn professions, craft items, build factories and trade to influence the player-driven economy of the game. Solve quests, crawl dungeons, uncover secrets and find treasures. You can play alone or create your guild and siege castles and factories.

title: Magical Girdle
description: Odysseus Schliemann is a savvy adventurer with an eye for only two things: valuable treasure and beautiful women. Odysseus chases them both to the end of the Earth in this adult adventure story, and it always leads him into more misfortune than he can handle. With player's guide, Odysseus’ luck may finally change. In the first chapter of Hazard: Magical Girdle, players will guide the flirtatious treasure hunter towards the invaluable treasure of his dreams: the Magical Girdle of Hippolyte - the Amazon Queen.

title: Nosher
description: Nosher serves up the perfect platforming meal. Nosh on a variety of 'enemy treats' to possess their powers and movement, opening up more of the stages to find those hidden secrets you remember from classic '90s platformers.

title: The Unfamiliar Story of Grandfather's Heritage
description: Returning to her grandfather's house years later, a woman finds herself in an adventure with ghosts from her past as the only way to uncover a terrifying truth.

title: Goofy Man
description: Goofy Man is an exciting adventure game in which you move between several maps to free your beautiful kingdom, because the enemies invaded it and began to spread, your task is to save yourself by killing the enemies and collecting the coins then move to other maps through the gates.

title: Project Medved
description: What do you know about the risk if you haven't danced with a mutant to incendiary tracks? Find out about it in the musical horror.

title: Cities: Skylines + Surviving Mars
description: Cities: Skylines and Surviving Mars are taking on the town together in a new bundle that merges more management mayhem than ever.

title: PigShip and the Giant Wolf
description: Put your helmet on, and get ready for action!

title: The Legend of the Dragonflame: Highschool Collection
description: Kick, punch, and jump your way to becoming the toughest kid in school

title: Venus Looks for Jupiter
description:
Snort some confidence and run for your love.

A short first-person parkour game about searching for love high and low and also shooting red objects with a big, fat revolver.

title: Knight Story
description: Black and white 2D platformer about a knight's journey.

title: The Backrooms 1998
description: The Backrooms 1998 is a first-person found footage psychological horror survival game where it tells the story of a young teen after accidentally falling into the depths of The Backrooms in 1998. Roam freely, mark, explore and try unravel the story - however you are not alone. Don't scream.

title: Cowboys Showdown
description: Cowboys Showdown is a platforming shooter with waves of enemies, bounty hunters and high-ranking criminals who will be well paid to kill. Boxes with bonuses and the ability to buy new weapons will help you in your hard work. Game Features: - hardcore - Pleasant musical accompaniment -Pixel Art

title: Dragon Ball FighterZ: FighterZ Pass 3
description:
The FighterZ Pass 3 will grant you 2-day early access to no less than 5 additional mighty characters that will surely enhance your FighterZ experience! Each fighter comes with their respective Z Stamp, Lobby Avatars, and set of Alternative Colors.

Contains the following fighters:
- Kefla
- Goku (Ultra Instinct)
- Master Roshi
- Super Baby 2
- Gogeta (SS4)

title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy + Marvel's Avengers
description: A bundle including Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy and Marvel's Avengers.

title: Pure Farming 2018: Germany Map
description: Expand Pure Farming 2018 with the Germany Map for hours of additional gameplay. Run a new farm located in one of the most beautiful parts of Germany and try your hand at unique, region-specific activities: growing rapeseed and raising sheep!

title: Gas Station Simulator: Can Touch This
description: Get some new tools and redecorate your gas station. Change walls, doors, windows and move things around. Make your own art and rival Dennis' artworks. Want to change the warehouse or the workshop? Now you can. And much, much more.

title: Tales from the Dancing Moon
description: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a life-sim RPG set in a parallel universe inspired by UK culture and fantasy novels. After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and collect hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

title: Four Course Dungeon
description: It’s the 100th year anniversary of the ultimate cooking competition show, Four Course Dungeon! Every year, chefs from across the land gather to compete in a hunting, gathering, and cooking battle royale. Four chefs will enter, but only ONE can claim the title of the Legendary Dragon Chef!

title: Sushi Rush
description: This is a revolving sushi management game, you need to prepare the right sushi for your guests, within the guest's budget, by matching different kinds of sushi, as much as possible to satisfy the guests.

title: Skyraid
description: Squad up with your friends in this 6 vs 6 game of aerial conquest! Pilot cute parodies of iconic war planes ranging from early props to modern multirole jets. Become the top dog leveraging a huge array of equipment to tip the scales in your favor and rule the skies!

title: Warframe: Valkyr Unleashed
description:
ADDITIONS:

- New Warframe
- New Weapons and new Prime Gear:
- New Damage Model 2.0!
- New Customizations
- New Decorations for the Dojo
- New Tile Set: Corpus Gas City
- New Enemies and new boss
- New System: Trading 1.0!
- New System: Codex and Scanner
- New Mods
- New Resource Drone
- The Hunt for Alad V

title: Warframe: Zephyr Rises
description:
ADDITIONS

-'Ties That Bind' - Darvo's Alert return!
- Level Expansion
- New Game Mode - "Interception"
- New Clan Dojo room available - Tenno Research Lab.
- New Clan Dojo Garden room + 8 new decorations!
- New Warframe - Zephyr, the aeronautical Warframe
- New Weapons
- 4x new Warframe "Immortal" skins
- "Oryx" Oberon Alternate Helmet
- HUD 2.0
- Added 3D character portraits for transmissions !
- Improved Mod management
- Enemy Leaders AI

title: 365 Birthdays
description: An interactable story starring articulate Dot Coppersimmons and the mysterious events that partake on her 21st birthday; including the accompaniment of the Birthday God himself.

title: Breaking & Entering
description: Run, steal, hide, and try not to get caught! Guards patrol and will chase you if they see you. Steal what you can, but be careful so you don't get weighed down. Guards and cameras protect these treasures. Do you think you have what it takes to become a master thief?

title: A Fungus in My Garden
description: A Fungus in my Garden is a VR first person shooter where you have to save the Kingdom and Humanity fighting against Giants and mutant insects.

title: December 24th
description: From the creators of Gazmatera: Return of the Generals! December 24th is a fast-paced classic FPS, inspired by the Quake 2 and Team Fortress. Collect crates to earn bonuses, destroy your enemies with 9 types of weapons and play with your friends with support up to 18 players on one map!

title: Minion Slayer
description: Prevent the invasion of the minions that stimulate the desire for challenge and prove that you are a slayer physically and mentally.

title: Part of You
description: Retrieve your misplaced Identity from the Lost and Found at a Clown Convention. Use tools to change the faces of the people of Hacksaw Springs. Encounter a frazzled diner owner, a blueberry loving information broker, an unlicensed orthodontist and more on your way to find your lost self.

title: Deep Abyss
description: Become a diver yourself to explore the unknown. Take a trip to your deep abyss. Experience a poetic and fantastic world as you explore the deep sea and space.

title: Rasetsu Xan
description: An expansion for the 2001real-time strategy role-playing game, Rasetsu, that was released in 2002. The player takes control of mercenaries in a futuristic conflict.

title: Dice Tribes: Ambitions
description: A dice-based worker placement game. Manage the randomness and complete your ambition to win.

title: Stonegeon
description: Stonegeon is a 2D action game with adventures in the dungeon. By fighting monsters, collecting resources, making items, searching treasure chests in the dungeon, and finally to the deepest part of the dungeon, unlock the long sealed secret.

title: Project Feline
description: Play as Gabi, an animal hybrid with unique feline agility, through a thrilling & stylish action experience like none other! Using these new gifts, Gabi embarks on a hunt for the truth behind her transformation.

title: Gordianaut
description: A short puzzle platformer set on an alien planet centered around a moving-platform mechanic.

title: Japanese Romaji Adventure 3D
description: An RPG where you learn Japanese using romaji (i.e. English letters). It is set in the 1800's and is an epic adventure that will teach you about Japanese history and Japanese language. In a matter of hours you could be speaking Japanese.

title: Sonic World DX
description: Sonic World DX is a Heroes-style fangame with over 15 playable characters and 10 unique stages!

title: Wildfrost
description: Take on the elements in Wildfrost, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder! Journey across a frozen tundra, collecting cards strong enough to banish the eternal winter…

title: Gunbrella
description: Gunbrella is a noir-punk action-adventure set in a world dependent on a rapidly diminishing natural resource. Players take the role of a gruff woodsman on a quest for revenge, armed with the mysterious Gunbrella: a firearm that doubles as an umbrella. His investigation becomes entangled with the inner workings of ghouls and gangsters, cops and cultists, and the fallout of corporate exploitation.

title: Another Crab's Treasure
description: Another Crab’s Treasure is a soulslike adventure set in a crumbling underwater world plagued by a mysterious curse. As Kril the hermit crab, you’ll need to wear the trash around you as shells to withstand attacks from enemies many times your size. Embark on an epic treasure hunt to buy back your repossessed shell, and discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

title: OneShot: World Machine Edition
description:
The World Knows You Exist.

Experience an adventure game with puzzles that go beyond its own window and establish a unique bond with the main character.

In OneShot: World Machine Edition, you discover a strange computer operating system with a self-contained world installed. Explore this world to unravel its mysteries and help guide a child on their mission to restore the long-dead sun.

You hear that saving the world may no longer be possible… But it’s worth a shot, you think. Now with collectible content and features exclusive to the World Machine Edition!

title: Opus: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition
description:
Opus: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition is the definitive edition of the visual novel style adventure game, now with all new voice acting.

Asteroids emitting a sound known as "Starsongs" have become the center of conflict for the immense power they hold. Determined to claim asteroids of his own, a young man ventures out with a girl who can imitate starsongs, lending her voice to unravel an ancient myth deep in the heart of space.

title: Super Nodage World
description: Super Nodage World is an online battle game where you can laugh with people from all over the world!

title: City Attack 3
description:
A Survival Horror Zombie Experience.
Will you make it out alive?

title: Ogu and the Secret Forest
description: Explore the wonderful world with baby Ogu! 'Ogu and the Secret Forest' is a 2D adventure game with hand-drawn characters and various types of puzzles. Befriend bouncy characters and defeat strange creatures to unravel the mystery of the charming world.

title: The Legend of Chibi Ninja
description: CHIBI NINJA is a ruthless 2D Puzzle platformer. Play as The Legendary Hero and destroy hordes of mechanical beasts to save your world from a mind controlling extraterrestial parasite using detonable BOMB SHURIKENS. Be very wary though, you can only endure one single hit. Are you up to the task?

title: The Flames
description: The Flames is a top down shooter where you fight a powerful boss called Hodaya and help save the Wisp the leader of the planet.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Butterflies
description: Puzzles of beautiful Butterflies!

title: Curious Expedition 2: Shores of Taishi
description: The Shores of Taishi DLC features a brand new island type (the Celestial Shores) with new tile types, items, locations, enemies, recruitable characters and more.

title: Njorun's Will
description: Njorun's Will is a 2-player co-op action-adventure fantasy game. Invite a friend to incarnate a pair of Kæra Scouts embarked on a dangerous investigation mission in the Vestmar kingdom.

title: World Championship Boxing Manager 2
description:
The boxing world is at your fingertips in this deeply detailed and outrageously entertaining sports management simulation. Enlist competitive fighters, recruit top-notch staff, and ride the hype train all the way to endorsement city! Watch your fighter rise to the top, or get KO’d trying.

An official sequel to 1991’s highly-applauded World Championship Boxing Manager, this iteration captures the essence of the original and expands upon it. Offering updated visuals, deeper gameplay, and new characters that extend the World Championship Boxing Manager franchise, WCBM2 provides fun for grizzled veterans and lightweight fans. Go toe to toe with fantasy characters, or take the main stage with historical boxing legends including Rocky Marciano, Sugar Ray Robinson, and more!

title: Train Valley 2: Myths and Rails
description: Myths And Rails unleashes the most bizarre and silly episodes of your railroad transportation company’s everyday schedule. Intergalactic trade agreements, alternate timelines, forgotten treasures and flying cars - timely deliveries are the key to success.

title: Thieves' Paradise
description: Welcome to Shopper's Paradise! Thieves' Paradise is a stealth action game where you will break into the capitalistic wonderland known as Shopper's Paradise in order to steal what you need. Explore 3 different storylines and 9 individually designed heists!

title: Covenant of Solitude
description:
Covenant of Solitude is a role-playing game published by Kemco for Android and iOS devices.It is considered one of Kemco's best-looking video games, although the soundtrack and audio were not well received.

The game is a turn-based RPG, where players assume the role of Fort, a boy feared by his village for his "genie" blood. This blood grants Fort the power to summon and control "monsters" which serve as the primary allies and enemies within the game. The story involves an expansionist Empire and a struggle for control over Fort's power.

title: Via Mortis
description: You are a soldier, drafted into the Addi. Tasked with capturing and hunting demons from a mysterious new world. This new world is highly dangerous and hostile, the demon like creatures within are planning a massive attack on the Earth and the mission is clear: save humanity at all costs...

title: Bug Star
description: "Bug Star" is a game based on bugs, which means you need to find the bugs that the developer intentionally added to the game & you need to use them to complete the levels.

title: Gakuen Tokkyuu Hotokenser
description: Gakuen Tokkyuu Hotokenser is an otome game, developed and published by TwoFive, which was released in Japan in 2011.

title: Disorient on The Murder Express
description: Disorient On The Murder Express is a short, humorous and experimental murder mystery game in which you are tasked with deducing the details of a convoluted murder that took place on an isolated train, and making a show of presenting the evidence and accusing the culpable parties.

title: Spacewing War
description: Blast off for a retro shoot’em up experience filled with clever twists and secrets!

title: Arcade Archives: Pro Tennis World Court
description: A large gathering of people who like tennis!

title: Field of Glory II: Medieval - Rise of the Swiss
description: From the late 1300s some Swiss started to carry the long pike, at first as a minority weapon, the bulk of their soldiers still carrying the halberd.

title: Fantasy Fighters
description: Prepare for epic battles in "Fantasy Fighters"! Choose your faction, plan your moves, and unleash devastating attacks on your opponents in local multiplayer. Explore a rich world filled with engaging characters.

title: July
description: This is a refreshing horizontal version of the Castlevania game. One after another organ and monster will hinder the way forward on the journey. Go beat them. Let's embark on this journey together.

title: Pokémon RP
description: Pokémon RP is a Grand Theft Auto V roleplay server inspired by the Pokémon world. A social and open experience of a modern world infested by Pokémon that appeared in some mysterious way ten years ago.

title: Nanafushigi: Nanase to Fushigi no Otome-dou
description: Nanafushigi: Nanase to Fushigi no Otome-dou is a roguelike game on PC. This game is a fan game of One: Kagayaku Kisetsu e. The goal is to break through mysterious dungeons like Fuurai no Shiren, including some proprietary systems.

title: Nanaka: Fushigi no Meikyuuroku
description: Nanaka: Fushigi no Meikyuuroku is a roguelike game on PC. The goal is to break through mysterious dungeons like Fuurai no Shiren, including some proprietary systems. It's an improvement over Nanafushigi: Nanase to Fushigi no Otome-Dou, and includes a system for creating your own dungeons.

title: Galaxy Splitter
description:
Interstellar peace is at stake and only you can save it! Accept your mission as fighter pilot in Galaxy Splitter and free all the planets from hostile spaceships!

This action game will beam you directly into a new galaxy with trigger-happy enemies and high-value cargo. Captain Smith will help start you on your galactic adventure. He’ll show you how to make your spaceship combat-ready with weapons and modules and what to collect on your missions.

title: Station Spacewalk Game
description: Welcome to the International Space Station (ISS), Astronaut. In Station Spacewalk Game you'll experience the thrill of conducting NASA repair work on the International Space Station. After negotiating your way through the airlock, you, the astronaut, will be tasked with jobs critical to help power up the space station so it can continue to operate. First take your time to explore the station, but then it's time to get to work. You'll have to move quickly and carefully, with a limited quantity of oxygen you must complete your Extravehicular Activities (EVAs) and get back into the airlock before your air supply runs out.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Smoke 'Em Out Struggle
description: Smoke 'Em Out Struggle is an original full week mod. Face off against a man named GARCELLO, as he tries to peer pressure Boyfriend into smoking a strange cigarette.

title: Dream Vacation Solitaire
description: Dream Vacation Solitaire features over 30 games including: Sea Towers, Grandfather, Old Clock, Scorpion, Big Forty, Easthaven, and Blind Alleys. Making matches and combinations gives you access to power moves that let you clear the boards more easily. And if you do well enough, you'll earn medals, trophies, and even new yachts to sail to the next vacation paradise.

title: Korax' Heritage: Scattered Evil
description: Korax’ Heritage: Scattered Evil, the first game built upon the Vavoom-based KoraxRPG (KRPG) engine, is a cross-breed between a first person shooter and a role playing game, set in the world of Hexen. In addition to the 3D movement, exploration and fighting of the original Hexen, you can travel around the world in different ways and talk to non player characters (NPCs) to learn new spells, acquire new weapons, buy useful items and more. In addition, you get experience for killing monsters and finishing quests. After earning sufficient experience, you level up, gaining more power. Your deeds as well as any useful information you come upon in your travels are automatically recorded in your journal.

title: Doctor Hospital: Hypocondriac Simulator
description: In the hospital again? Doctors are starting to doubt you, so they won't stop asking to find out if you are really sick. Remember your answers!! If you are wrong you will never get well.

title: 3D Puzzle: Castle
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Flawless Abbey
description: Discover the enigmatic and delicate world of The Flawless Abbey. Journey through the lovingly hand-painted fairytale, navigate the Labyrinth Tower using the Musical Star-Key - and unveil the fragile secrets of the Abbey and its inhabitants.

title: Bail or Jail
description: A 3 minute tag-battle with extra twists! Play as a Monster who must lock everyone into jail before time runs out, or as a Human who must avoid capture and bail their teammates out of trouble. Invite your friends and family to play this speedy game of cat and mouse - or rather, Monsters and Humans!

title: Space Crafting
description: Your ship crashed on an uninhabited planet, you need to get resources and repair the ship.

title: Eger
description: "Eger" is a colorful and enjoyable side-scrolling 2D platform shooter. Insectoid aliens attacked our planet, and you ended up in a dense forest with no support.

title: We are definitely the baddies
description: A minimalist city builder where only profits matter. Build factories and extract everything before you are forced to leave the planet.

title: Cyphers Game VR
description: Break Bolshevik ciphers and destroy a Soviet armored train - take part in a great history. VR version of crossplatform educational project prepared as a short point and click game.

title: Cardmon
description: Cardmon is a new adventure inspired in old monster-catching games. Jump in and explore the Tojo region while trying to catch all the Cardmon. Defeat every carder and become the Regional Cardmaster in this aestethic world!

title: Suicide Guy: Deluxe Plus
description: Suicide Guy: Deluxe Plus is the surreal puzzle game set in the dreams of its protagonist. Will you be able to save the thing you love most and overcome the neverending whirlwind of nightmares? Now in a new shiny edition.

title: Complex Doom: Clusterfuck
description: The Complex Clusterfuck is a conglomeration of a large amount of Complex Doom mods/addons, made by DustedPandemonic, and with contributions from many others.

title: Ancient Arenas: Chariots
description: Dangerous, grueling, fierce. Chariot Racing was by far the most favored sport of ancient times. Ancient Arenas takes you back to an age where charioteers were the richest sports stars and team owners were their ruthless and fearless managers.

title: Field of Glory: Kingdoms
description: Politics, religion, war. They are nothing without a legacy that can stand the test of time. Lead any nation, and turn it into a mighty kingdom in one of the most compelling grand strategy games ever created.

title: Ikaruga
description:
In this vertical scrolling spaceship shooter, you control a ship that can change its polarity at will. As blue/white, the ship can easily destroy red/black enemies, and visa versa. Bullets of your polarity can be collected to fuel your missile gauge, but those opposite will kill you. Destroying an enemy ship will make them drop points for you to pick up, but they are polarized, too. Different difficulties exist to change exactly how you interact with polarized points, or how they appear.

Ikaruga is a balls-hard shmup with lots of difficulty even at the easiest level, and lots of replay value for those willing to face the challenge.

title: Mortificare
description: Try to survive as long as you can in this fast paced game. Lets see how long you can keep on playing!

title: Beatus Creation Solitaire
description: Play with VTuber super crew “Beatus Creation” in the classic card game “Spider Solitaire”! Unlock new themes, illustrations, and stamps designed based on each member of Beatus Creation using the coins you earn each time you clear a stage.

title: LandPort
description: Today, the intelligent revolution is taking place. Release in the field of art and design and industry has become the focus of research in art and technology majors. The theme of the project is "Creating the future" is a response to the times when the intelligent revolution is taking place.

title: Kongeer
description: Tribute to the arcade games of the early eighties (Popeye, Donkey Kong..). 1 or 2 players. Great difficulty and addiction as in the games of the past, but with a control more in line with current times. Help Sir Redhood and Sir Greenstone rescue the princess from the clutches of Kongeer.

title: I wanna Reach the Top
description: In order the reach the top, you have to fall, a lot.

title: Space Turbo
description: Space Turbo - A dynamic 3D arcade game in which you have to fly a futuristic space plane through an endless tunnel and avoid various traps.

title: Red Solstice 2: Survivors - Insurgents
description: Experience a new story line with new characters and settings. Play as the Governor and take the fight to Elysium at every turn. Build up a resistance force and overthrow them.

title: Freshman Magic: Spellbooks and Tangled Sheets
description: Magic jock? Magic nerd? Magic bad boy? How about a magic librarian? Woo all of them while tackling the disappearances plaguing the campus.

title: Maps: U.S.A.
description: An educational game to make learning the name, location, and capitol of the fifty states of the Unites States of America fun.

title: Punk Wars: Threat From Within
description: Threat from Within DLC brings two new game modes to the world of Punk Wars!Take control over a small squad of units and try to survive as long as you can in a competitive survival mode. Or embark on a journey of betrayal and retribution in a brand new, story-oriented Atompunk solo campaign!

title: Teleball
description: Teleball is a VR game that lets you do everyone's favorite thing in VR, throw stuff! Use 8 powerful Teleballs to teleport around environments with more than 60 obstacles, traps, and more! Teleball is designed with accessibility in mind, everyone's invited to come check out our balls!

title: Sol Cresta: Dramatic DLC
description: Stand up, Sol Cresta, and take back the sun from the clutches of evil! The galaxy-sized Sol Cresta Dramatic Mode has docked!

title: Mini Royale
description: In Mini Royale, up to 50 toy soldiers fight for victory. The game is played in a children's bedroom, from a rather unusual perspective, full of exciting things to discover, and lots of weapons and equipment that will help you set yourself apart from other players.

title: Jigsaw Masterpieces: Scenes with Horses
description: This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces".

title: Jigsaw Masterpieces: Landscapes with Flags of the World - Asia vol.1
description: This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces".

title: Jigsaw Masterpieces: World's Most Scenic Train Trips
description: This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces".

title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite - Into the Hive Edition
description: Set in the iconic Alien universe, Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a cooperative third-person survival shooter that drops your fireteam of hardened marines into a desperate fight to contain the evolving Xenomorph threat.2202. A mysterious distress call reroutes your Marine Assault Unit to LV-895 in the outer colonies, where deadly Xenomorph legions, hidden corporate secrets, and ancient alien ruins await your arrival.

title: Winning Post 9: 2022
description: A new system called Yushun no Kizuna, represents a bond between horses.

title: Just Cause 4: Day One Edition
description: Rogue agent Rico Rodriguez journeys to Solis, a huge South American world home of conflict, oppression and extreme weather conditions. Strap into your wingsuit, equip your fully customizable grappling hook, and get ready to bring the thunder!

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time With You - Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time with You
- Five-disc drama CD set

title: Flora and Sauna
description: Flora and Sauna is an 18+ visual novel set at a spa with some unique services. Explore the spa and meet a fun cast of interesting characters! Help them out, and they'll be sure to reward you in their own special ways~

title: Gotham Knights: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Gotham Knights Deluxe Edition includes the main game and the Visionary Pack.

The Visionary Pack includes:
- Exclusive "Knightwatch by Jim Lee" Transmog
- Beyond Suitstyle, inspired by Batman Beyond universe
- Salvage to build new Gear
- Boosted Gear
- Exclusive Emote
- Three exclusive Suit Colorways
- Ultra Zur-En-Arrh
- Chroma Frost
- Tribute Asylum

title: Mortal Shell: Game of the Year Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Mortal Shell [Game of the Year Edition]
- Steelbook
- The Virtuous Cycle DLC
- A3 Poster
- Holograph Postcards
- Limited Edition letter ( all numbered)

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Hinokami Keppuutan
- Original figure multi-stand
- Digital content DLC

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Five Memories Spent With You
description: I want to confess my feelings for you...

title: Riders Republic: Freeride Edition
description: A pack that includes the base game plus the Neon Pack.

title: Refrain no Chika Meikyuu to Majo no Ryodan: Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Refrain no Chika Meikyuu to Majo no Ryodan
- Tarot Card (22p)
- Original Soundtrack CD

title: Until the End
description: Love remembers you. Even if you’ve forgotten.

title: The Somerton Man
description:
On 1 December 1948, a body was found on Somerton Beach in Adelaide, Australia. From there unfolded one of the most perplexing (and still unsolved) mysteries of the 20th century.
This game seeks to recreate the experience of the 1948-1949 investigation.

title: Victim
description: Play as the Vulnerable Victim Face the Odds against the never ending threat of the Ominous Oppression. Explore the Mysterious Existential Crisis of the Desolate World as everything threatens The Victim's sensibilities.

title: Dub Club
description: A third person multiplayer virtual music venue featuring an in-game live music stream.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York & Shadows of New York: Collector's Edition
description:
This edition includes the following;

+ Vampire - The Mascarade: Coteries of New York (the game)
+ Vampire - The Mascarade: Shadows of New York (the game)
+ The art book
+ The original sound track in vinyl format

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku Wo! Noroi no Ibutsu to Madoishi Bokensha-tachi: Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following;
- PS4 Game
- Acrylic Figure
- B2 Tapestry
- Soundtrack CD
- Costume DLC (While supplies last)

title: Witch on the Holy Night
description: Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel I - IV & Trails into Reverie Complete Box
description: At Thors Military Academy, Erebonia’s best and brightest learn everything from the art of war to the liberal arts. First-year Rean Schwarzer learns that he's been selected as a member of Class VII, which controversially includes both nobles and commoners. But they’ll need to deal with more than just class warfare - they’ll need to safeguard their country from those who would plunge it into chaos.

title: Baw's Pharmacy
description: Baw’s Pharmacy is a mobile time management and strategy game. Players manage a medical warehouse and sell products to hospitals and clinics. Customers will approach the sales counter and request a specific item for purchase.

title: Watercolor Hell
description: A rouge-lite wave survival bullet hell focused on customizing weapons. Evolve weapon specializations from base weapons each run. Level up to compliment your next build with more projectiles, speed, and starting weapons. Complete chapters to get permanent stacking damage and new weapons.

title: Automation Station
description: Explore a mysterious planet, harvest and refine resources, discover new technology, craft machines, and set up automated factories.

title: WingNuts: Temporal Navigator
description: A classic birds-eye view arcade shooter where the player controls a selection of airplanes from WW2 propeller planes with machine-guns to futuristic jets with energy weapons, bombs and missiles. The goal is to blow up pretty much everything (planes, tanks, ground structures, blimps and the occasional boss) while chasing the evil Baron von Schtopwatch through time-warps across a storyline laid out in short comic-style cutscenes.

title: Wild Wild West: The Steel Assassin
Namae no Nai Yoru
description: This is a world where witches and demons dwell in the far reaches of reality. Charles is in the rain looking for shelter, when he meets a woman who asks him for a favor, to look for something very precious to her. At that moment, Charles finds a house and enters it, meeting a mysterious girl.

title: Find
description:
This is a puzzle game in which the player rolls the cube-shaped hero to find the hidden goal.
When the cube hits the player's line of sight, the goal or gimmick materializes and the stage changes. Control your line of sight and position by rolling the cube, and immerse yourself in the thrill of inspiration and discovery as you find the hidden goal.

title: Hide 'N Seek!
description: Prepare to experience a high-stakes twist on the classic game of hide and seek with Extreme Hide and Seek. Dive into the action as you choose to either hide from or seek out your opponents. If you opt to hide, blend seamlessly into the environment, stay silent, and outsmart the Seeker to secure victory. Or, take on the role of the Seeker, counting down before setting off to find and capture all the elusive Hiders. With heart-pounding gameplay that puts a thrilling spin on the beloved childhood pastime, Extreme Hide and Seek challenges players to master the art of concealment or the thrill of the hunt.

title: Arsilon
description: Arsilon - the adventure of astronaut Alice on another planet. After a crash landing, she needs to find and collect the lost spaceship components. On spacious maps, mortal dangers will lie in wait for her. To get to special places, you have to find a non-obvious path.

title: Blade Bros Action!
description: Blade Bros Action!, presents you with a new game genre "Hack n' Platformer", is a fast-paced gameplay that is a mix of hack n' slash and platforms games, joins the retro pixel graphics, a cool soundtrack, stylish bosses, dynamic battles, swords, skills, magic elements and so forth.

title: Pixel Game Maker Series LAB
description: What happened in the facility where people disappeared? Mystery horror adventure game!

title: Dreams of Pain
description: Dreams of Pain is a highly experimental first-person mystery horror game with elements of horror in its atmosphere. The structure of the game is mostly linear. The game incorporates ARG-like elements into its storytelling. The game's art style was inspired by retro games from the late '90s. It doesn't hold your hand and there are no traditional tutorials for the player. Some of the puzzles in the game are types of puzzles not seen in any game before.

title: Flam the Purge of the Century
Smilemo
description: A new side-scrolling platformer where you go flying out of control at the slightest touch! In this virus-infected world, it is your job to collect the scattered pieces of vaccine code and exterminate the virus!

title: Paranoid: Half-Life for Doom
description: Paranoid, a production of The Persecution Complex, is now available for download. For those of you who can't be bothered with reading the rest of this carefully constructed page here is a download link to the game. Go forth and waste ye no more time.

title: Paranoid: Paranoiac
description: Paranoiac, the sequel to Paranoid.

title: Not Your Mind
description: An experimental first person adventure/horror/exploration game that takes place in a dream-like world.

title: Doom 64 for Doom II
description: Doom 64 for Doom II is a vanilla recreation/re-imagining of the Doom 64 maps. They are made with [mostly] vanilla assets and can run in the original vanilla Doom (and Chocolate Doom). The goal was to recreate the major aspects of the maps while allowing for creative liberties where needed or wanted. There are lots of new graphics, some new textures (like skies), some new music tracks, a couple of new monsters, and minor enhancements for folks who play in advanced ports (like GZDoom).

title: Doom 64: Retribution
description: This project is a fan recreation of Doom 64 for the Nintendo 64 to the GZDoom engine. The goal of the project is be mostly accurate to the original game as well as add very minor improvements for that extra bit of polish. Think of this mod as being an enhanced version of Doom 64 for GZDoom. We have Doom 64 EX, Doom 64 Absolution TC, GZDoom64, and Brutal Doom 64. Why you ask? I was personally dissatisfied with the quality of the GZDoom64 project, and Brutal Doom 64 (while it is a great improvement) is along the same lines but changes too much and deviates from the original Doom 64 experience. And thus, this project was born.

title: Bowling Cross: Final Frame
description: BOWLING CROSS: DARK LEGACY OF THE DEVIL BOWLER (FINAL FRAME) is the complete version of BOWLING CROSS, a weird GBC-style Battle-Bowling Action RPG - play as a roaming adventurer, using Custom Battle-Bowling Balls to knock down your enemies!

title: Intergalactic Taxi Co.
description: Intergalactic Taxi Co. is a casual puzzle game about picking up and dropping off passengers across a colorful, low-poly galaxy. Plan your route carefully to avoid running out of fuel and get everyone where they need to be!

title: Simulacrum
description: Simulacrum is a set of 32 maps in MBF21 format by @muumi and @myolden. This set starts modestly but steadily climbs into challenge and slaughter territory in the later maps.

title: Yosemite Forest Ranger
description: In Yosemite Forest Ranger you will fill the shoes of Theodore Thompson. You will find out why he left the big city life to be a Forest Ranger through Story Rich Gameplay and Voice Acting. With a Survival aspect as well. A very Rich Open World with loads of Forageables and Wildlife to Explore.

title: Core of Innocence
description: Core of Innocence is a platform adventure game in a similar vein to Castlevania.

title: Shmup Mania
description: Challenge yourself to complete this classic retro-style adventure.

title: Project Crypt
description: Project Crypt: The horror adventure about escaping a city overrun by monsters.

title: Scavenger's Deep
description: Scavenger's Deep is an underwater 3rd person action roguelike game, with an emphasis on player movement for traversing the game world and encounters.

title: Molecule Make Lab
description: Molecule Maker Lab is a puzzle game about chemicals with futuristic and minimalist themes. Rotate and arrange the atoms in the correct position until you form a beautiful molecule.

title: Salad Bar Tycoon: Extended Edition
description: Look out, this awesome salad bar will soon become the best one in town! Become the manager of a salad bar and learn for yourself just how hard it can be. Be careful not to mix up your recipes!

title: Redemption Cemetery: The Stolen Time - Collector's Edition
description: After a terrible accident, you wake to find yourself in another realm! A dangerous entity threatens to destroy the constructs of time itself, taking humanity into darkness along with it! Do you have what it takes to save the world before it’s too late?

title: Metal World: Street Scraps
description: Metal World is an endless racing game set in a retrofuturistic world, exploring different eras and themes, assemble your vehicle with scrap parts to travel long paths, test your reflexes and drive at high speed!

title: Escape the Ayuwoki Demake
description: Re-experience the classic Escape the Ayuwoki adventure through this Demake, solving more complex puzzles and exploring new places with the old camera angles of 90’s horror games.

title: Umichan Sorani
description: Take the role of Zytra, a busty girl trying to get money for her sister. Will you help her get it the easy way? Or the sleazy way?

title: Late Photographer 5
description: A simple and easy beauty dynamic jigsaw puzzle and relaxing music can make you have a good mood The right mouse button can quickly complete the puzzle.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - The Furious Wild
description: With the introduction of The Furious Wild Expansion Pack comes the first ever extension of the Total War: Three Kingdom’s map and its already rich cast of characters. Visit the jungles around Southern China and with it, the fearsome tribes of the Nanman. Will you unite the tribes of the south?

title: Lose/Lose
description: Lose/Lose is a shoot-'em-up and art video game developed by Zach Gage and released in 2009 for MacOS as part of his master's thesis show, "Data", at Parsons School of Design's MFA program. Styled after games like Galaga, the player controls a spaceship and can shoot at aliens in their path, each representing a random file on the player's computer. Destroying an alien causes the file to be deleted, potentially corrupting the player's operating system, while dying causes the game itself to be deleted. The aliens do not attack and only act as dangerous obstacles.

title: Yume Mitai
description: Yume Mitai is a traditional Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The objective is to explore Tsukino's dream world and obtain effects to unlock the ending.

title: I Cannot Drown
description:
Your name is Ume. You are in a world. It is a familiar yet unknown world. Stretch your legs and go for a walk.

Created for Dream Diary Jam 3 and updated for later jams. I Cannot Drown is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame with 11 available effects as of Version 0.03. This game is still in development, so more content will be on the way in the future.

title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
description: The story of Cal Kestis continues in Star Wars Jedi: Survivor, a third-person, galaxy-spanning, action-adventure game from Respawn Entertainment, developed in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games. This narratively driven, single-player title picks up five years after the events of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order and follows Cal’s increasingly desperate fight as the galaxy descends further into darkness. Pushed to the edges of the galaxy by the Empire, Cal will find himself surrounded by threats new and familiar. As one of the last surviving Jedi Knights, Cal is driven to make a stand during the galaxy’s darkest times — but how far is he willing to go to protect himself, his crew, and the legacy of the Jedi Order?

title: Warframe: Dark Sectors
description: Tenno, we have received word that Vay Hek has enlisted the ranks of the Grineer Prosecutors and Guardsmen to keep the Tenno at bay. To fight Vay Hek players must first find his location, a secret the Prosecutors protect.

title: Warframe: The Mad Cephalon
description:
New User Experience 2.0!
Quest System
Player Ship
Diegetic UI
Genetic Foundry & The Kubrow
New Warframe: Mirage!
A Region Infested: Eris!
New Weapons!
Dark Sectors Enhanced!
Dynamic Music Additions:
3 new Alt Helmets!

title: Big Brother
description: Big Brother is a cancelled PC game based on George Orwell's novel 1984.

title: Downpurr
description: A cutesy platformer-shooter about magic, cats, and rain.

title: Do You Like Horny Bunnies? Complete Collection
description: The ZyX classic, Do You Like Horny Bunnies? is now remastered and improved, in one complete collection that includes both games in the series!

title: Touhou Gakuen Ki: Shippuu no Shou
Swampstar
description: A two minute vignette about being consumed by stars.

title: Duck Doom Deluxe
description:
“The classic NES gameplay of Duck Hunt,
The splendid brutality of Doom.
Together at last.”

Duck Doom Deluxe is the overhaul upgrade to the surprisingly popular mega-mix Duck Doom, originally released in November 2004.

Really, it's a stupid game; one that's sure to get old fast.

But if this is your first time playing, then more than likely, Duck Doom will be the most satisfying and unwittingly humorous retro gaming throwback you'll download this week.

title: DOOM Remake 4
description: DR4 is a compilation pack of various mods and assets which aims to bring Classic Doom into the modern era. It replaces all 2D sprites to the 3D models, adds new high resolution textures, shaders/materials and some other stuff.

title: Doom 4 For Doom
description:
D4D brings Doom 2016's weapons to GZDoom for all to enjoy, including a few customized versions of the multiplayer weapons. To this day, the mod is continuously being made more and more Doom '16-like, slowly but surely.

Guns. Demons. Violence. Runes. Glory. And it continues to grow to this day.

title: Doom Incarnate
description: The title says itself. Doom Incarnate is a Doom mod which is heavily based on new Wolfenstein series (TNO, TOB, TNC). It replaces our favourite hero Doomguy with two Nazi killing machines; BJ Blazkowicz and Rayne from BloodRayne.

title: The Trailblazer
description: You take the role of Malcolm Striker - a former member of Earth's special forces that main job was to obviously save the Earth on daily basis. A loner and a mercenary now, who's only purpose is to find and finish off his dreaded nemesis - Vladimir Vladimir, a one-man factory of lust for world domination. His shadowy presence is ever pervasive, and despite all of these ugly things getting in your way and giving you a reason to expend shotgun shells in some as ugly faces, such as invasion from outer dimension, caused by accident thanks to UAC, for which sure as 'Hell' V.V. is responsible for - perhaps one day you will finally face him upon the field of battle to avenge his lost love and the tragic refrigerator accident. Where that damned villain could be now, anyway?

title: HappyPlayers
description: A casual party game where you can freely match skills to fight.

title: Quake 2 TC
description:
“Quake 2 TC” Is a TC for Doom 2 that runs solely on GZDoom.

It uses all the original textures from Quake 2 on their original rendition as well as most of the ambient sounds of the game. The TC runs with the outstanding “Quake 2 Stuff” mod that brings all the weapons and enemies straight from the game into GZDoom with total accuracy.

The music comes from the Quake 2 port of Nintendo 64, composed by Aubrey Hodges.

My aim is to create a near perfect recreation of a ID Tech 2/Quake 2 level or expansion pack but with the Doom engine, enhanced and made possible only with GZDoom. Despite a few structural features and effects that are only possible on the Quake 2 engine, the results are near identical and that proves again how an ancient engine like Doom is capable to reach a similar level of technical capabilities with ease.

title: Doom Slayer Chronicles
description:
Doom Slayer Chronicles is the most beautiful and technologically advanced mappack for Doom2 singleplayer.
Doom Slayer Chronicles (DSC) compatible with all known gameplay mods for Doom2.
The DSC takes advantage of the newest features of gzdoom, such as hardware shaders, full-screen post-processing, PBR textures (normals and specular maps, also often called "bump mapping"), high-resolution textures, and of course dynamic lighting.

title: Yume no Tsuzuki.
description: Yume no Tsuzuki. is an interactive online Yume Nikki fangame. Contrary to most fangames, it doesn't contain effects. The main goal is to simply explore Piko's dream world.

title: Genseki Wakusei
description: Genseki Wakusei is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The goal is to explore Pershina's dream worlds and collect Stones (いし).

title: The Other Line
description:
The Other Line is a game that started as a Yume Nikki fangame. It involves a boy named Nathan in his apartment haunted by nightmares who, by use of his phone, dials into the alternate world (the "other line").
Rather than totally free roaming exploration, there are more linear paths that focus on puzzles or events.

title: Ozmafia!!: Vivace
description: Port of Ozmafia for Playstation Vita and Nintendo Switch. It includes port-exclusive CGs and scenarios written by the original writer and illustrator, Yuumasu and Satoi.
